tei:titleStmt.tei:title: bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /ba
bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /ba

tei:div.tei:p: bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/ oṃ swa sti/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun cu'i cha shas las/ /padma sbas tshal las byon bka' brgyad rmad/ /gsang ba zil gnon chos sde'i them byang 'god/ de yang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs sna tshogs pa las/ 'di ni zab pa rtsa ba'i chos sde yi dam sgrub sde bka' brgyad ces rgyud sde dang sgrub sde thams cad kyi rtsa ba ru gyur pa yin la/ rang gzhung las/ e maḥ kho bo bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas ngas: phyi rabs rjes 'jug skal ldan rjes 'brang dang : smon lam las can chos bdag bu yi don: bka' brgyad yang snying gsang ba zil gnon bzhag: ces dang*/ 'o ma'i rgya mtsho'i chos dka' mang lags kyang : snying thig zab mo 'di 'dra sbas pa med: rgyud sde lung gi bshad pa mang lags kyang : kha tshang don 'dus 'di 'dra sbas pa med: rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs rgya chen sbas lags kyang : phyi nang gsang gsum gcig dril 'di 'dra med: ces gsungs pa bzhin/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du bka' bab rig 'dzin brgyad la so sor/ mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mos sgrom bu dngos su gtad cing*/ de thams cad slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas gnyis par bka' bab/ slob dpon chen po'i bsam yas mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang du thugs sras snying gi bu dgu la sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ de rnams la gsang ba'i rgyud lung man ngag mang du byung ba'i nang gses/ 'di ni gu ru'i gnas chen sbas yul padma bkod bal phu yar 'brog mtshor sbas pa/ gter sgrom mthong ba don ldan rgyu bram ze snying po'i dbu klad las grub pa rin po che ru bya'i mdog can sgo gsum dang ldan pa/ sgo dang po la rdzogs chen bla med snying po dang zhi khro na rag dong sprug phyi rgyud theg pa rim dgu dang bcas pa bzhugs/

sgo bar pa la bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs rgyud lung man ngag dang bcas pa/ sgo 'og ma la dregs pa srog thig nag po'i man ngag lag len dang bcas pa/ sku tshab padma mthong grol dam rdzas khro 'dus ril bu/ a thaṃ ma bsgoms sangs rgyas/ gu ru'i phyag mtshan rdo rje rtse dgu/ las phur bdud dpung zil gnon/ mkhan slob chos rgyal gsum gyi na bza' gos ber mtsho rgyal gyi dbu skra sogs khrom gter du gdan drangs pa'i chos sde chen po gleg bam sa bcu'i grangs ldan bzhugs pa las/ rdzogs chen bla med snying po dang*/ phyi rgyud theg pa rim dgu sogs rgyud lung man ngag du ma dus 'gyur skabs slar mi mngon pa'i dbyings su thim par snang la/ skabs 'dir 'dzin ma'i khyon 'dir ji snyed bzhugs pa kun rtsol bas bsdus pa rnams kyi them byang 'god pa ni/ stod cha pod e rtags can la/ ka) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: rdo rje theg pa'i brgyud pa dbang bzhi'i chu bo babs pa'i mtshan nyid/

1-75 kha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dbang chen kun mkhyen snying po'i sgrub pa spyi'i dbang rdzong*/ 76-127 ga) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: sngags chas kyi pra khrid/ 128-135 nga) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bzlas pa sngags kyi pra khrid/ 136-156 ca) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: sgrub khog kun dang sbyar rung ba'i pra khrid shes rab drwa ba ngo mtshar rin po che'i phreng ba 'di mtha' ma tshang / 157-167 cha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: pra khrid gsal ba'i me long gi sa 'dul bdud bzhi tshar gcod/ 168-180 ja) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bla ma rgyangs 'bod thugs rje'i lcags kyu/ 181-197 nya) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: sngon 'gro theg chen dgu ldan/ 198-212 ta) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: 'od dpag med kyi ye shes snying po'i sgrub thabs/ 213-215 tha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: spyan ras gzigs kyi yi ge drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ 216-217 da) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: sprul sku pad 'byung gi sgrub thabs/ 218-219 na) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i las byang 'ja' tshon drwa ba/ 220-280 pa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bskang ba yid bzhin nor mchog 281-301 pha) bka' brgyad phrin las bsdus pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung*/ 302-302 ba) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi rgyun khyer snying po'i don bsdus/ 304-335 ma) bka' brgyad rgyun khyer/ 336-338 tsa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bsangs brngan 'dod rgu char 'bebs/ 339-416 tsha) bka' brgyad chen po gsang ba zil gnon las: gsur mchod lha yi longs spyod mdzod bum/ 417-421 dza) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las:

dzam lha dkar phyogs kyi gsur mchod/ 422-424 wa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: rigs drug bar do'i gsur mchod/ 425-429 zha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: sbyin sreg klu'i mchod thabs bdud rtsi lnga ldan/ 429-432 za) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: rin chen gter bum sba ba'i rim pa 'dod rgu mchog sbyin/ 433-438 'a) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: rnga thug srid gsum zil gnon 'dzugs thabs kyi gsol mchod/ 439-458 ya) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: reg phung dug mda' nag po'i spyi chings ma yig chen po/ 459-473 ra) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: reg phung dug mda' nag po dregs pa nyi shu'i bu yig bsad pa rlung gi spu gri/ 474-513 la) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dam sri mnan pa'i gdams pa chu srin kha tham/ 514-517 sha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dregs pa dgra snying dmar 'byin gyi las mtha' rlung gi spu gri nag po/ 518-532 sa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dregs pa snying 'byin gyi las mtha' gsol mchod/ 533-538 ha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dpal dgu'i bzlog 'khor spu gri reg chod/ 539-558 a) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: las mtha' sbyin sreg 'bar ba glog gi phreng ba/ 559-586 oṃ) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: las bzhi'i sbyin sreg me 'od 'khyil pa/ 587-605 āḥ) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: srung bzlog bsad pa'i dpe'u ris/ 606-624 hūm̐) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dus drug gnas nyul sprad pa khro bo'i rngam stabs/ 625-633 hrīḥ) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bdud rtsi sman sgrub kyi cho ga khrigs su bsdebs pa gsang chen nor bu'i dga' ston/ 699-701

bcas chos tshan so bzhi bzhugs so/ slar smras pa/ zab gter snying po bka' dgongs phur gsum las/ /sgrub sde rgya mtsho'i mthar thugs bka' brgyad che/ /gsang ba zil gnon chos sde yid bzhin nor/ /cha shas gang rnyed phyogs bsdus 'di ru bkod/ /de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang*/ /gang la me tog phog pa yi/ /lhag pa'i lha dang gang de'i chos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ /chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bkam̐' gtem̐r srim̐ zhum̐ ru/ /em̐ waṃm̐ dpem̐ skrunam̐ kham̐ng nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog /ces pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gnam lcags zab gter yongs rdzogs 'phrul par du drangs shing glegs bam re la brgya phrag lnga'i grangs kyi dpe skrun bgyis skabs rang gi 'dod don gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ // ka)༁ྂ: bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: rdo rje theg pa'i brgyud pa dbang bzhi'i chu bo babs pa'i mtshan nyid bzhugs so: kun bzang dbyings rig mu mtha' khyab pa'i klong chen rab tu g.yo ba la gus pas 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma hoḥ yang dag sa mchog rdo rje ri bo'i thugs: gdod nas mi g.yo ye shes snying po'i klong : ma 'gags kun rdzogs rdzu 'phrul dra ba'i gar: dbyings rig 'od stong phyogs bcur rab tu 'khyil: skye dgu'i dpung gnyen dpal la rab bzhad pa: a ti snying po'i lung rigs seṅge'i sgra: dngos rlom phyogs 'dzin tshogs rnams skrag mdzad phyir: ji skad a don brgyud pa'i phreng ba bshad: dbyangs can brda yi gzungs kyis phyi ru phyungs: bstan dang 'gro ba'i chas phyir gnyan gyi rgya: sa ma ya: de yang snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i lung rigs rnam bshad nyung ngur bsdus pa 'di la don rnam pa gsum gyis dbye bar bya ste:

thog mar yid ches shing khungs btsun pa lo rgyus kyi rnam bshad: bar du bsdu ba bka' bzhi'i lung yod pa'i babs tshul: tha ma gang 'dul der ston dbus 'gyur 'o ma'i tshal dang gsum las: dang po lo rgyus ni: thog mar yid ches shing khungs btsun pa'i lo rgyus nyid 'di la lung gnyis kyis ston pa dang gcig gis ston pa sogs phyi nang du mas gsungs pa: ci'i phyir zhe na: drang don spyi rgyud dang mi 'gal ba'i mtshan nyid: nges don gnas lugs kyi don shes nas mi gol ba'i mtshan nyid: zung 'brel theg pa gong ma'i rgyud mchog gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rgyud lung sus kyang ma bslad sus kyang ma bcos sus kyang ma bkag sus kyang ma mthong ba ste: gsang rgya shes rab drwa ba'i klong gur smug po nyi zla kha sbyor gyi sgrom bur yod pa de sangs rgyas kun gyi thog ma gdod ma'i rigs bdag ma bcos spros bral ma 'gags kun tu bzang po rnam gzigs don mkhyen de nyid kyi klong las rab tu shar ba'o: sa ma ya: de'i lo rgyus mtshan nyid kyi rnam dbye chos kyi bab tshul ni: chos sku kun tu bzang pos rgyal ba dgongs brgyud kyi tshul du gsung : longs sku rdo rje sems dpas rig 'dzin brda brgyud kyi tshul du gsung : sprul sku padma 'byung gnas kyis tshig brgyud shog ser gyi tshul du gsung : de yang dus bzhi'i sangs rgyas rnams pas ji lta bur gsungs pa yin na so so'i don bkral nas bshad par bya ste: thog mar rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa ni gsang sngags nye lam gyi dbang du byas na: gnas 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams phyogs lhung rgya chad spu ris dang bral zhing khor yug mnyam gnas kyi pho brang chen por: bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po ka dag thog ma'i sangs rgyas ye nas ma bcos gdod mar gnas pa bsam brjod kyi blo dang bral ba: 'od gsal rang byung nyi ma'i snying por 'od sku'i zer shar ba lta bu'i rol rtsal gyi shugs la thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i rnam pas gzhi skye med:

lam 'gags med: don 'od gsal: 'bras bu de bzhin nyid dang bcas pa'i ngang la: a grags stong gi brda bzhi la brten nas dgongs par bzhugs pa'o: gnyis pa rig 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa ni: chos sku'i mnyam bzhag gi rang rtsal rol pa'i cho 'phrul las 'gro ba'i don so sor shar ba'i rnam pas longs sku rdo rje sems dpar sprul pa'o: de yang gnas bkod pa rab rdzogs kyi zhing khams kun gyi mchog tu gyur pa lta na sdug ces pa 'dod rgu'i zhing khams de nyid du mngon par 'phags pa: de'i dbus su padmo la rab tu brdzus te longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bstan pas rig pa rdo rje sems dpa' rol pa'i rtsal bzhi dang ldan pa nyid du gyur te: kun tu bzang po'i brda rab tu bkrol nas chos thams cad zang thal 'gag med mkha' dbyings kun tu gsal ba'i ngang la: nyon mongs pa gti mug gi gnyen por ye shes 'od gsal chen po'i don dpag tu med pa mtshan nyid yi ges mtshon du med pa rnams gsungs pa dang : rnam par snang mdzad kyis nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi gnyen por me long lta bu'i ye shes gnas pa rtags kyi mtshams sbyar nas gsungs pa dang : rin chen 'byung ldan gyis nyon mongs pa nga rgyal gyi gnyen por gdod nas mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi don rnams gnad sbyar nas gsungs pa dang : snang ba mtha' yas kyis nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyi gnyen por chos thams cad ma 'dres so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi dpe ched du brjod de gsungs pa dang : don yod grub pas nyon mongs pa phrag dog gi gnyen por brjod bya tshig gi sde thams cad gtan la phab: bya byed yid dpyod kyi rtog pa'i rnyogs ma rab tu bsings te sil bur bstan nas gsungs pa'o: gsum pa gang zag snyan khung gi brgyud pa ni: longs sku rdo rje sems dpas 'jig rten gyi khams su 'dul zhing du gzigs pas rgya gar o rgyan dha na ko sha'i gling du rten 'brel bab ste sku yi sprul pa der bskyed:

gsung gi sprul pa ri bo ma la ya dang bsil ba tshal rnams su rten 'brel bab: thugs kyi sprul pa 'og min gyi dbyings la bzhugs pa'o: de yang sprul pa 'jig rten khams su ji ltar byon na: gnas phun sum tshogs pa yul o rgyan gyi gling du yab rgyal po u pa ra tsa dang : yum snang gsal 'od ldan gnyis la sras mo lha mo dge slong ma dharma dhe wa zhes bya ba: mos blo dam pa'i chos la dkar ba rdo rje'i rigs nas chad pa de nyid nub gcig nyal ba'i rmi lam du mi dkar shel gyi bum pa thogs pa: bum pa'i nang du rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyis mtshan pa'i bdud rtsi yod pa zhig gis khyod kyis: dga' ba byang chub kyi dbang longs zer nas mgor bzhag ste bum chu tshangs bug tu blugs nas lus ltem gyis gang bar rmis: zhogs par lus kyang bde nas khol mo la rmi lam bshad pas: khol mo na re: lha cig la sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa zhig 'byon pa min nam gsungs: de nas zhag drug cu rtsa gnyis nas lha lcam gyi rtsibs ma g.yas kyi bar nas sbas pa'i tshul du lhums nas brdol ba'i nang du skyes bu sangs rgyas kyi mtshan rtags tshang ba zhig 'khrungs: lha cig shin tu sngangs te khol mo la smras pa: spyir mngal sgo ma 'grim pa mi srid: dgos pha med pa'i bu 'di 'dre yin pa 'dra bas thal dong nang du sba'o smras te kun gyis ma mthong bar sbas: khol mos de ltar ma bgyid smras kyang ma nyan no: de nas zhag gsum lon nas bltas pas 'phrul skyong lang ling zil pa phrom mer 'dug pa la shin tu spro ba skyes: ma shi ba 'di 'dra ya mtshan zer nas sku la khrus bstsal ming yang ro langs thal mdog ces btags: skyed kyang mi ring bar rdzogs pa byung : yum la smras te yul 'di na nga yis rtsod gleng chos kyi gzhi bting ba'i mkhas grub 'dra yod dam zer: yum gyis yab la rgyal po la smras pas: yab kyis sras la nga'i mchod gnas kyi paṇḍi ta mang po yod kyang :

cung zad rtsod gleng bgyis snga'am zer: rgyal po yang shin tu dgyes: sras pos gsol ba: 'dul zhing dus la bab pa'i paṇḍi ta rnams dang gleng mo bya'o zhes gsungs nas: chos kyi gleng mo mdzad pas paṇḍi ta rnams kyis lan ma thebs: khyad par sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i rdzogs chen rgyud 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi thugs nas gsal por byung bas gsungs la rgyal po yang rab tu dgyes pas mtshan yang dga' rab dgyes pa rdo rje btags: mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis ri bo gnam lcags can du gdan drangs: mkha' 'gro rnams la brda sum 'gyur gyi yi ger btab pa dpag tu med pa gsus: mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis lung bstan nas: dur khrod bsil ba tshal du byon: thugs rdo rje sems dpa' dngos su mjal nas thog ma'i rgyud lung thams cad 'phral du gnang bas gsung rdo rje sems dpa' mi shigs pa'i dbyangs dang ldan par gyur: rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor cig car du rdzogs: dbyings dga' rab rdo rje: sprul pa dga' rab rdo rje: gsung dga' rab rdo rje rnams ngo bo nges tshig gcig tu gyur: de yang gsang sngags nye lam gyi dbang du byas nas dbyings sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje'i thugs ye shes rol pa'i cho 'phrul 'jig rten khams su gang 'dul der ston du sprul par gzigs pa la: lho nub o rgyan gyi gling rgyal po bhai ta'i yul dha na ko sha'i mtsho la rten 'brel babs pas: 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams nas sangs rgyas kyi thugs sprul dga' rab rdo rje gnas gyur te hrīḥyig dmar po'i mtshan can las 'od zer 'phros pas 'o ma can gyi mtsho la phog: 'od zer lnga ldan de las padma'i sdong po phyogs bzhi dbus lnga pa: rtsa ba klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang 'jog pos 'dzin pa: rtse mo'i 'ja' tshon lha dbang brgya byin gyi gyen du phyogs pa: padma'i sdong po de'i mtshan nyid sngo ba lo ma'i mtshan nyid ljang ba 'dab ma'i mtshan nyid dmar ba zi thur gyi mtshan nyid dkar ba 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid ser ba 'dab ma bcu drug tu yod pa:

kun tu bzang mo'i shes rab bum par mtshon pa phyogs bzhir phrin las bzhi ldan gyi utpal tang ku la'i dri yi rnam pa rlung gis bskyod pas: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs rab tu g.yo ba'i ngad dang ldan pa: de'i mtshams kyi lo ma rnams la 'khril ba'i ha lo rnams chu shing gi me tog gyen du phyogs pa zer gyis bsrungs bzhin nang 'od lnga'i gur ras phrag phrig g.yo ba: de'i dbus su gsung yi ge drug cur mtshon pa phyi gling gi mtsho la 'od khyim thod rgal za 'og gter gyi klong bklubs pa'i rbab ltar rab tu yom yom gyis bskyod pa'o: de lta bu'i mtshan tshang phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas de la gdod ma'i kun bzang thugs kyi cho 'phrul g.yo med dga' ba'i rdo rje babs pas: de yi sbubs nas hrīḥyig dwangs ma'i sa bon ze'u 'bru'i steng du babs: rdo rje klong du thim pas hrīḥyig gnas gyur te khye'u 'od sku ye shes drwa ba gzi 'bar du g.yo ba'i gzugs: dgung lo brgyad pa'i tshul can lha las kyang shin tu 'phags pa rus pa'i rgyan du mas spras pa rin po che'i prog zhu dang ldan pa: phyag gnyis dam tshig dang ye shes dbye ba med pa'i phyag rgya ldan pa: zhabs rol stabs ling tsam gar ba'i nyams dang ldan pa phyogs bzhi'i pad 'dab la yang de bzhin tshul mthun pa bzhi: 'dab ma'i rtsibs kyi steng du rig ma mchod sprin thogs pas brda skad dang bcas lang ling gis gar bsgyur ba: 'bab chung gi ze'u 'bru drug cur gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro'i 'dod yon yid bde ba rab tu skye bas mchod pa: phyogs bcu'i zhing nas ngo mtshar gyi dbyangs kyis rab tu bstod de bkra shis pa'i yon tan du ma'i rtags mang po tshang bar gyur nas brdzus te sku 'khrungs pa'i tshul bstan: de yang chos kyi rgyal po bhai tas spyan drangs shing rgyal srid du mnga' gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi'i mdzad pa skyong ba'i phyir rim gnyis zab mo'i don la gzigs te:

ri bo ma la ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rtse mor byon: sprul pa'i sku dga' rab rdo rje sems dpa' sum brtsegs kyi rnam par bzhengs nas tshig gi sde ma lus pa thams cad a don skye med rang sgrar bsgyur nas grags stong gis snyan du brgyud: snang stong gis yi ger btab: gsal stong gis don la dril: bde stong gis sbyor sgrol thabs shes 'du 'bral med pa'i rgyud lung man ngag gi dgongs pa ma lus pa gsan pa'i brdar babs: gzhan yang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gsang mdzod: dbyings ye shes 'phrul gyi drwa ba ru gang 'khod pa'i zab lam thams cad snyan du brgyud: theg pa mtha' dag gi 'jug lam chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong ma lus pa rdzogs par mdzad pa ste: gsang sngags nye lam brgyud pa bzhi ldan pa: kun bzang thog ma nas mngal skyes sgyu ma'i gzugs brnyan gyis bar ma chod pa'i sku gcig bla ma za hor pas mtshon pa'i paṇḍi ta sangs rgyas dbang po gu ru padma 'byung gnas su grags pa'i bab tshul gyi brgyud pa'o: de'ang brgyud pa rim gyi mjug gi dbang du bgyis nas: dgongs pa'i brgyud pa: brda yi brgyud pa: rig 'dzin gyi brgyud pa: rig pa'i brgyud pa: snyan du brgyud pa: tshig tu brgyud pa: shog ser ru brgyud pa: rgya rtags kyi brgyud pa: dbang lung gi brgyud pa: man ngag byin rlabs ched du brjod pa'i brgyud pa'o: de yang lung rtags kyis rgyas par spro na: dgongs brgyud kun tu bzang po: brda brgyud rdo rje sems dpa': rig 'dzin gyi brgyud pa dga' rab rdo rje: rig pa'i brgyud pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen: snyan du brgyud pa shrī singha: tshig don thams cad rdzogs par brgyud pa padma 'byung gnas: shog ser gyi bka' gtad pa rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga: rgya rtags kyi 'phro sad pa gang 'dul der ston pa'i sprul sku phyis 'byung ba: dbang lung gis rgyud smin pa skal ldan gyi rigs sras sam thugs sras:

man ngag byin rlabs ched du brjod pa bka' gtad lung 'bog pa'i slob ma snod dang ldan pa gcig la byed pa'o: yang bzhed pa'i lugs gcig la: rdo rje sems dpa' dang dga' rab rdo rje gnyis brda brgyud du brtsi ba'i snyan brgyud rje btsun ma hā gu ru yang yin no: ci'i phyir zhe na: bshad nyan sdud gsum chos sku'i rtsal zhes pa'o: de yang brgyud pa bzhi lung gi rig 'dzin gnyis: zhes pas: brgyud pa bzhi ni kun bzang rdor sems 'jam dpal bshes gnyen padma 'byung gnas: lung gi rig 'dzin gnyis ni rgya gar sprul pa'i rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje: rgya nag mkhas grub rig 'dzin shrī singha: de bzhin rnam par dbye ba mang yang don la mkhas grub thams cad sngags kyi rig 'dzin kho na'i phyir brgyud pa gang bder 'khod pa ni: bla ma res mos slob ma res mos lta bu gang 'dul der ston du 'khod pa'o: de yang rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa'i slob dpon chen po ji ltar byung ba ni: rgya gar nub phyogs rim gnyis zhes pa'i grong khyer du: yab bram ze legs ldan ston sam pa dang : yum snang gsal mdzes ldan gnyis yod pa la: yum gyi mnal lam du lus la 'ja' dkar po tshom bu du mas brgyan pa zhig zug pa'i gseb nas po ti glegs bam gyi char babs pa dang : sngar nas med pa'i shes rgyud la rtogs pa khyad 'phags 'khrungs pa sogs bkra shis pa'i ltas mang po byung : zla grangs lon pa dang khye'u ya mtshan phun sum tshogs pa zhig 'khrungs: mtshan yang 'jam dpal bshes gnyen du gsol: ma bslab kyang lung rigs kyi rnam bshad rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa byung : dar cig dur khrod gsang ba lung du bzhugs pa'i tshe: mdun gyi mkha' nas he ru ka 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag pos lung bstan te: kyai: shes rab chen po'i theg 'chang ba: don gsum bla na med pa ste: 'bras bu yang dag don chen po: ston pa'i bla ma rdo rje sems:

dga' rab bsil ba'i tshal du gshegs: zhes gsungs pa ji bzhin dur khrod bsil ba tshal du gshegs pas thugs dga' rab rdo rje dang mjal: rgyud lung man ngag nges pa'i don thams cad ma lus pa rdzogs par zhus: dga' rab klong dgus theg pa dpag tu med pa spel bsgyur byas nas rdo rje gdan gyi 'og tu rang byung gi rgyas btab nas sbas: slar dur khrod so sa gling du dgongs pa la bzhugs so: de yang gang zag snyan du brgyud pa ci ltar byung na: yul rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga'i byang phyogs ho sho se tshe bya ba ru: yab khyim bdag gu shi la dge ba dang ldan pa: yum bi zi phis tshi snang ba rab tu gsal ma zhes bya la: yum gyi rmi lam du a tsa ra skra dmar spyi bor bcings pa lag tu tri shul thogs pa zhig gis spyi bor tri shul bzhag nas brda mang po mdzad pa'i nyams snang byung : nyin re bzhin lus la singha la dang saṃ skṛ ta'i yi ge mang po shar ba rmis: nus pa rdzogs pa dang bram ze'i phrug gu skra kham pa mig bya sri la ta'i dbyibs su yod pa lus la dpal chas kyi ri mo yod pa zhig 'khrungs: de yang shes bya'i spang rtogs ma lus thugs su chud pa: ha shang nas sbyangs pas rig gnas kyang brda sprod pa tsam gyis rtogs pa khyad par can byung : de yang dur khrod rdo rje dhe wa ko sha ru bzhugs pa'i tshe kun tu bzang po gsal byed yid la skyes kyis mdun gyi mkha' nas lung bstan te: hoḥ bla med snying po dag gi bdag: rnam gsum shes rab yi ge'i ris: drwa mig phru gu'i rtsal sgron can: nges pa'i don chen rtogs pa'i phyir: rgya gar so sa gling du gshegs: zhes lung bstan pas lo gsum rkang mgyogs bsgrubs pas rdo rje 'khor lo 'phur shes kyi dngos grub thob: rgya gar du byon pas zhag dgu yis dur khrod so sa gling du 'byor: sprul pa'i skyes mchog 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang mjal: rgyud lung nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i dbang bzhi brda yi tshul gyis brgyud de bka' bab snyan du legs par 'jug:

bla mas lung bstan te: dpe dang gdams pa ma lus pa thams cad rdo rje gdan gyi 'og tu rdzu 'phrul ye shes drwa ba'i rgyas btab nas yod pa la: rgya nag byang chub shing drung sogs la 'gro 'dul lung gis gang zin gyis shig gsungs te gdams pa snying byang mang po dang bcas te lung bstan no: 'di'i mtshams su bod dang rgya gar du chos bsgyur ba'i mkhas grub brdzus skyes dang mngal skyes gnyis bskal pa bzang po'i dus su byon pa la: mngal skyes kyi skyon gyis ma gos pa rje btsun ma hā gu ru padma 'byung gnas de nyid kyis rig 'dzin thams cad las dbang lung rgyud dang man ngag blangs pa rnams thar thor tsam las bi to ta ma ru bzhugs pa'i tshe: 'og min gyi dbyings su rdzu 'phrul gyis byon: kun bzang chos sku mnyam bzhag gi rgyud rdzogs par mdzad: stug po bkod du rdo rje sems dpa' sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyis rdzogs par mdzad: ri bo ma la ya ru sprul pa'i sku dga' rab rdo rjer mjal: dur khrod bsil ba tshal du 'jam dpal bshes gnyen mjal: so sa gling du shrī singhar mjal: bde byed brtsegs par rig 'dzin 'dus par mjal: khyad par gsang chen he yi dur khrod du dbyings ye shes mkha' 'gro ma lus pa'i rgyud lung gi dgongs pa thob: de ltar rig 'dzin ma hā gu ru'i brgyud rim phyi ltar de bzhin no: de yang sprul sku bod du byon zhing chos bsgyur pa'i pan grub ni: tshig dang snyan du brgyud pa'i mtshams 'di nas gyes pa'i dbang du byas na: rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs kyi grong khyer glang po sna zhes bya ba na: yab rgyal po dharma a shwa la: yum sras mo bo dhi ma zhes bya ba la sras mo lha lcam rin chen gsal ba zhes bya ba mtshan dang ldan pa che bar 'dug: dgung lo lnga nas rig pa'i gnas la mkhas par byung : dar cig nub phyogs 'dam bu'i tshal du skyo bsang la byon pa'i tshe:

dpal rdo rje sems dpas lung bstan nas: khyod nyid bi ma mi tra zhes: don chen yang dag dam pa ste: nges pa'i snying po len pa'i phyir: rgyud lung khungs kyis rab ston pa: phul byung man ngag gdams pa 'dogs: so sa gling gi dur khrod du: bzhud kyis dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung : zhes lung bstan pa ltar dur khrod chen po so sa gling du rig 'dzin shrī singha bzhugs par mjal: 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa ma lus pa bum pa gang byos tshul du gnang : khyad par lung rigs rgyud ḍākkis gab sbas gsal bar bkod pa lhag lus spang bar gnang : rig 'dzin shrī singha yang rgya nag byang chub shing drung du gshegs: bi ma mi tra yang dur khrod kun tu rgyu byed bya bar gshegs nas dgongs pa la bzhugs pa'i tshe: rgyal po ind+ra bo dhis spyan drangs nas paṇḍi ta lnga brgya'i gtso bor bzhag ste bla mchod mdzad do: sa ma ya: brgyud pa de'i babs tshul dang ldan pa las: dbang bzhi don lnga gnad drug gi rim pa ji ltar babs pa ni: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa mdzad pa las rdo rje sems dpas mnyam bzhag gi ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang thob: des dga' rab rdo rje la ngo sprod brda bzhi mdzad pas don ston man ngag dang tshig gi dbang thob: des slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la bskyed pa ma hā yo ga'i dkyil 'khor bstan pas yi dam lha'i dbang thob: de nas gu ru shrī singha la lung a nu yo ga ltar bstan pas snyan brgyud bka' bab kyi dbang thob: des rig 'dzin ma hā gu ru la 'bras bu a ti yo ga ltar bstan pas rgyud lung dgongs pa yongs rdzogs kyi dbang thob: brgyud pa drug ldan gyi rim pa ni de lta bu dang : dbang bzhi'i man ngag bstan pa bskyed rdzogs lung gsum mo: phrin las rnam pa lnga'i sgo nas dbang gi chu bo babs pa'o: de yang gsang sngags nye lam gyi dbang du bshad na: kun tu bzang pos dgongs brgyud kyis rdo rje sems dpa' la babs:

rdo rje sems dpas dbang ye shes kyis mkha' 'gro ma la babs: mkha' 'gro mas dga' rab rdo rje la babs: dga' rab rdo rjes padma 'byung gnas la babs pa'o: de yang kun bzang bla ma'i dbang : rdo rje sems dpa'i yi dam gyi dbang : mkha' 'gro ḍākki'i dbang : dga' rab rdo rje'i ngo sprod kyi dbang : padma 'byung gnas kyi 'bras bu gsal rdzogs kyi dbang : dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi chu bo rgyun ma chad pa'i mtshan nyid de lta bu'o: yang rgya gar gyi dbang bzhi'i brgyud pa de lta bu mi byed pa'i babs tshul ni: gnas 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas: dpal kun tu bzang pos 'dzam bu'i gling du 'gro ba mtha' dag gi shes rgyud la gzigs nas: snod du gyur pa'i skal ldan la dgongs pa gtad pa ni: ri bo ma ya gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rtser po ti glegs bam gyi char babs shing rgyal po dza'i khang thog tu slebs pa ste bka'i brgyud pa po ti'i dbang rgyal po la babs pa'i mtshan nyid do: gnyis pa yi dam lha'i dbang dga' rab rdo rje la babs pa ni rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gsal rdzogs su gsal ba tsam bskur ba'o: gsum pa paṇḍi ta'i dbang bi ma mi tra la babs pa ni: bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis spyan drangs pa'i tshe: paṇḍi ta lnga brgya'i dgongs pa gcig tu 'dus te smon lam mdzad pa'i don no: bzhi pa rang rig mngon du gyur pa'i dbang padma 'byung gnas la babs pa ni 'og min kun bzang yangs pa'i mdun sa ru dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'tshogs shing : gangs can 'dzam bu gling sogs srid pa gsum gyi 'gro don gzigs pas rgyal ba ma lus pa'i dgongs pa gcig tu gyur nas rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas la thugs bskyed pas: brdzus skyes su gangs can gyi yul du byon: khyad par 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku ru grub ste sangs rgyas kun dang mi mnyam pa'i mtshan nyid ni: brgyud pa ya mtshan gyi che ba la:

rigs dag pa dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i gdung gsob 'dzin pa: skyes sa gnas kyi che ba ni: rgya mtsho'i klong nas rang byung mtshan nyid kun rdzogs pa'i u dum wa ra 'ja' 'od dang dri bzang phyur ba'i sbubs nas sku bltams pa: rten 'brel gyi che ba ni: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis khrus mdzad cing : ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams kyis mchod pa phul: rgyal pos rgyal srid du mnga' gsol zhing zhal mthong ba tsam gyis byang chub thob: sbyangs pa yon tan che ba ni: rig pa'i gnas lnga ma bslab kyang thugs su chud: khyad par nang pa'i paṇḍi ta thams cad kyis rgyud lung gis smin par mdzad: phyis su mu stegs kyi paṇḍi ta rnams tshar bcad cing mkhas pa'i mnga' bdag dam par gyur: zhal mthong la bla ma'i che ba ni: kun bzang rig 'dzin 'dus pa rgya mtsho yan chod thams cad kyi thugs bcud bsdus te smin par mdzad: thob pa la dngos grub kyi che ba ni: yi dam he ru ka'i dgongs su gyur cing rgyud sde mtha' dag gi dkyil 'khor thugs kyi klong la shar te 'bad rtsol gyis bsgrub mi dgos pa'i rang dbang thob: brtul zhugs spobs pa'i che ba ni: dur khrod brgyad la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su byon nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad dbang du bsdus te sbyor sgrol 'dren gsum gyi spyod pa dpag tu med pa mdzad cing gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i srol 'byed dam pa mdzad pa'o: mdzad pa phrin las kyi che ba ni ji lta bu yod na: rgya gar li bar kha che zhang zhung tho gar srin yul dang bod khams ma lus pa'i lha srin sde brgyad thams cad dam la btags: khyad par srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur rdzu 'phrul bstan te chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan sogs rje 'bangs rgya mtsho lta bu smin grol gyi lam la bkod: 'dzam bu gling rta rmig gi 'og tsam yang ma lus par skye 'gro rnams smin grol du bkod pa'i gter gyis gang bar sbas:

de lta bu'i gu ru padma la rig pa rtsal gyi dbang babs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni don gsal ltar ro: sa ma ya: de yang rgya gar nas bod du dbang gi chu bo ji ltar babs na: rig 'dzin ma hā gu ru rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis spyan drangs shing khri srong lde'u btsan sogs rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i tshogs smin pa'i dbang bzhi'i nye lam dang : yang dga' rab rdo rjes shrī singha la dbang bskur: shrī singhas be ro tsa na la dbang bskur: be ro tsa nas khri srong lde'u btsan la dbang bskur: de yang rim brgyud nyung ngu'i mtshan nyid do: gsang ba bla na med pa'i dbang bzhi'i babs tshul ni: thog mar kun bzang thugs kyi byin rlabs lha bu dam pa tog dkar la babs pas rgyud lung gi chu bo de nyid rgya gar du ston pa shākya thub pa mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas de la babs pas: chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong snyan brgyud dang brda brgyud gnyis su mdzad: snyan brgyud ni glang po che sa la rab brtan kyi rgyab khal lnga brgya dang phung po gsum gsung : brda brgyud ni rgyal po dza'am ind+ra bo dhi la rdzogs pa chen po nam mkha' mdzod kyi rgyud lung theg pa rim dgu'i go ba man ngag snying po yang gsang thig le phung po'i sde 'bras thams cad nyi zla kha sbyor gyi tshul du byas pa ste: byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje chos dang mkhyen rab kyi dbang po 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi bka'i tshig thams cad don bsdus na rin po che sna lnga'i shog bu la bkod de: ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la gtad nas bka'i bdag pos tshigs su bcad nas gsungs pa ni dbang gi chu bo dang po'o: gnyis pa rgya gar bde byed brtsegs pa dang gnas rnams su ji ltar babs pa ni padma 'byung gnas yan chod gong ltar la: mkhas shing grub thob rig 'dzin chen po bi ma mi tra: hūm̐ kā ra: 'jam dpal bshes gnyen: 'phags pa klu sgrub: pra bha hastī: dha na saṃ skṛ: rombu gu hya:

shāntiṃ garbha la sogs pa rnams la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas dbang bskur zhing lung bstan te bka' 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa rdzogs par gyur pa ste/ rgyud sde kun gyi snying po mngon du phyung ba dgongs brda shog ser thams cad dus gcig la rdzogs pa'i dbang rig 'dzin 'dus pa rtsal la chu bo gnyis pa babs pa'o: gsum pa rje btsun gu ru padma 'byung gnas la ji ltar babs pa ni: thog mar nyan thos kyi theg pa mtha' dag paṇḍi ta nas blangs pa'i tshul mdzad: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa rnams slob dpon pra bha hastī la bzhugs: dkyil 'khor gsang ba bzhi sbyor gyi theg pa rnams nags tshal drwa ba can du bzhugs pa phyi ltar dge slong dpal mo nang ltar go byi dhe ma gsang ba ltar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ste kho mo las gsang dbang mtha' dag zhus: kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa' dga' rab rdo rje shrī singha la sogs las rgyud lung gong bzhin dang : mchod rten bde byed brtsegs pa ru rig 'dzin 'dus pa rgya mtsho las bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus pa rdzogs par zhus shing lhag par du tu mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod nas dbang bzhi legs par thob pa ste dbang gi chu bo gsum pa'o: bzhi pa bod du ji ltar babs na: chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bsam yas 'phrul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i tshe lha 'dres cho 'phrul bstan nas bshol du thug pa la: byang chub sems dpa' mkhan po bo dhi sa twas lung bstan pa bzhin rig 'dzin chen po padma 'byung gnas rgya gar nas bod yul mun pa'i gling du dam pa'i chos kyi sgron me 'degs su phebs pa'i tshe: rgya gar gling dgu'i chos ma lus pa bod du rdzu 'phrul za ma tog gi nang du gdan drangs te bsam yas mchims phu dge'u gong du sgrub chen bka' brgyad la sogs rgyud bye ba sa ya grangs las 'das pa rnams: chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan sogs rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga la bum pa gang byos kyi tshul gyis rgyud lung thams cad rdzogs par mdzad:

khyad par du zab mo gsang sngags brda'i shog dril la sogs snyan brgyud thams cad bsdus shing gcig tu dril ba'i bka' gtad lung 'bog dbang gi rab tu smin par mdzad pa ste: rgya gar nas bod du dbang gi chu bo rgyun ma chad par babs pa'i mtshan nyid don ji lta ba bzhin no: sa ma ya: de yang dbang lnga pa'i mtshan nyid rgyud bzhi dbang gi chu bo gling bzhi'i snod du srid pa'i gdengs ka dang : khron pa dang 'bab chu dang lu ma sogs ma lus pa thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas chu phran rgya mtsho la 'khyil ba bzhin du gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la bsdu ba bka'i babs tshul ni: rje btsun chen po la thugs sras bzhi yod pa las: thugs dang 'dra ba'i sras bzhi ni gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes: gnubs nam mkha'i snying po: sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms: be ro tsa na bzhi yod: de'i nang nas rgyud lung gdams pa bzhi skor gyi snod yang dag pa ni sangs rgyas ye shes la gzigs te rdo rje theg pa phyi nang gsang gsum: khyad par snying thig mkha' 'gro'i chos bzhi: rgyud lung bka' brgyad chen po las phran dpag tu med pa rnams snyan brgyud tshig gi don sbyar: brda brgyud shog ser logs su bkod: don brgyud smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyar: smin grol gdams pa zab mo'i dbang dang bka' rab tu gtad de khyod kyis rdzogs pa chen po'i lung bstan dus la bab tshe 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po gyis shig gsungs: sgrub pa'i gnas mchog yang rdzong shel brag tu lung bstan: rje btsun gyis gsungs pa bzhin sgrub pa bgyis pa'i tshe rlung sems kyi rtsal rdzogs snang ba dbang du 'dus: nyi zla gdan la bting brag la phur pa btab tshe'i rig 'dzin thob nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phur nus pa'i gdeng tshad dang ldan pa: phyis 'byung nam du dran pa mi brjed pa'i gzungs rgya chen po thob pa'i gdan thog gcig tu rdzogs par byas te: dbang lnga pa'i chu bo skal ldan rigs sras rnams la bum pa'i bcud mchog gang byo'i tshul gyis smin grol gyi rgyun rab tu bsring ba 'gro ba'i khams la cig car du 'gyed pa ste nyi zla'i phreng ba tshar du bsgrigs pa'i lta bu'i mtshan nyid ltar ro:

sa ma ya: de yang grol byed ni khrid kyi man ngag yin zhing smin bya ni mtshams sbyor ba'o: 'di la yang bla med rdo rje theg pa'i dbang bskur ba la don gnyis gnad dang gsum mo: don gnyis po de gang yin zhe na: phyi bskyed rim la brten pa dang nang rdzogs rim la brten pa: phyi thos pa'i chos kyis grub mtha' chod pa: nang myong bas rig pa'i rtsa kha 'byed pa de yang smin pa dang grol ba ste don gnyis so: gsum pa dgos ched gnad kyi gzer bu ni: phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa: nang rtsa thig rlung gi dkyil 'khor la brten pa: gsang ba rig rtsal chos nyid don gyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa: gnas skabs spros pa rdzas sngags phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa: mthar thug ting 'dzin de kho na nyid kyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa: mtshams sbyar bka' lung 'bog pa'i rig gtad: rjes su gsang ba dngos grub gtor ma'i dbang dang rnam pa drug go: rnam pa drug po de la brgyud pa yang rnam pa drug ste dgongs brgyud brda brgyud tshig brgyud shog brgyud dbang lung bum pa gang byos tshul rigs bdag dang drug go: de la chos drug ste: rgyud kyi rnam bshad kṛ ya: man ngag gi gsang mdzod u pa: lam khyer gyi rnal 'byor yo ga: phyi bskyed pa ma hā yo ga: lung gsal ba a nu thig le: 'bras bu mthar phyin a ti rdzogs pa chen po 'di la gsang mtshan gyi lha yang drug yod pa yin te pha rgyud 'jam dpal gshin rje: ma rgyud ma mo rbod gtong : sras rgyud dbang ched rta mgrin: snying po dpal chen yang dag: yang snying rdo rje gzhon nu: gnyis med 'jig rten dmod pa: 'di la dgos pa'i don drug yod pa ste: bskyed rdzogs sngags dang phyag rgya bden pa nus pa dang drug go: 'di la yang lam lnga yod pa yin: lta ba'i lam bsgom pa'i lam: spyod pa'i lam 'bras bu'i lam: kho na nyid kyi lam dang lnga'o: phyi ltar na tshogs lam sbyor lam mthong lam byang chub kyi lam rnam par thar pa'i lam:

'di la 'khor lo yang drug yin te: gtsug tor mi nub 'khor lo: bde chen bskyed pa'i 'khor lo: longs spyod sngags kyi 'khor lo: chos dbyings rdzogs pa'i 'khor lo: sprul pa zung 'jug 'khor lo: bde skyong yongs rdzogs kyi 'khor lo dang drug: de la bsdu na rgyud sde'i lha yang drug ste: pha rgyud kun tu bzang po: ma rgyud gsang ba ye shes: snying po yang dag rdo rje: yang snying che mchog 'dus pa: gnyis med rdo rje gzhon nu: kun 'dus thod pa rtsal chen dang drug go: phyi ltar na pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa: ma rgyud ma hā ma ya: snying po kyai rdo rje: yang snying 'khor lo sdom pa: gnyis med dgyes pa rdo rje: kun 'dus dus kyi 'khor lo dang drug go: 'di la yang gsang chen theg pa'i rnam dbye phyes na: dang po dmyal ba'i theg pa: gnyis pa mu stegs kyi theg pa: gsum pa lha ma'i theg pa: bzhi pa skyabs gsum gyi theg pa: lnga pa nyan thos kyi theg pa: drug pa rang rgyal gyi theg pa: bdun pa dgra bcom pa'i theg pa: brgyad pa kṛ ya'i theg pa: dgu pa u pa yi theg pa: bcu pa yo ga'i theg pa: bcu gcig ma hā yo ga'i theg pa: bcu gnyis a nu yo ga'i theg pa: bcu gsum a ti yo ga'i theg pa'o: bcu gsum pa 'di rgyud pa so sor phye ba ste kṛ ya man chod chos gos kyi gnang ba ma gtogs mi 'jug go: kṛ ya'i sngon du chos sgo brgyad khri bsdu ba'i 'byung gnas yin pa'i sgo 'byed phyag na rdo rje'i dbang ngo sprod 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi brda sprod thams cad spyan ras gzigs dbang ste: gsum po 'di ma thob pa'i gong du rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag gi snod du ma gyur: ci'i phyir zhe na: dmyal ba ni mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad yin pas gsang sngags kyi snod du ma gyur: mu stegs ni rtag chad du gyur pas snod du ma gyur: lha min ni sngon du chos ma bstan pas snod du ma gyur:

skyabs gsum ni ma smin pas snod du ma gyur: nyan thos ni lta spyod shan mi phyed pas snod du ma gyur: rang rgyal ni 'gog pa yin pas snod du ma gyur: dgra bcom pa ni theg pa nges don la ma zhugs pas snod du ma gyur: drug po 'di sbyangs te phar phyin gyi sa thob nas: spyod pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud du 'jug pa la yang rgyud bzhi: bya rgyud spyod rgyud rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang bzhi: bya rgyud la dbang gi dam tshig spang bya mang po yod pas lam du ma lhong na spyod rgyud kṛ ya zhu ba ni khas blangs kyi dam tshig dang 'gal: kṛ ya la yang kṛ ya nang ma u pa'i skor yongs rdzogs lam du ma lhong bar yo ga rnal 'byor la 'jug pa dang cung 'gal: 'bras bu'i dam tshig ni mi 'gal: ci'i phyir zhe na: snying stobs che ba'i rma bya la: dug ni sman du 'gyur ba dang : pre ta yi dwags 'phrog ma la: ro mchog bcud ldan ga la mchis: theg pa gong 'og rnam dbye ni: che bas che ba kun kyang gnon: nam mkhas sa ni phyogs med mnan: spyod ldan rnams la lta ci smos: phra bas phra ba rnams kyang zin: rlung gi drwa bar rnam shes tshud: rim 'jug theg pa ma mthong ba'i: tho shal gcig tu rlom pa de: sa gzhi med pa'i so nam 'dra: dmus long mig bu ga la rnyed: lung rigs rnam bshad ma myong ba'i: brgyad khri'i chos sgo ston 'dod kyang : nam mkhar rdog pa brgyab dang mtshungs: gyen du btegs par ga la rigs: man ngag brda sprod ma thob pa'i: nges pa'i don chen rtogs 'dod kyang : rgya mtsho dbyug pas 'chu dang mtshungs: longs spyod srid du ga la rigs: dbang bzhi'i smin grol ma thob pa'i: rang nyid yi dam rlom pa de: 'ja' tshon lag pas myong dang mtshungs: rgyan du spyod pa ga la rigs: brgyud pa'i bla ma ma bsten pa'i: gzhan phan grub pa 'dod pa de: bye ma btsir ba'i snying po 'dra:

mar khu 'byung ba ga la srid: slob dpon med pa'i phyag len de: byis pa'i rtsed ra'i sku mkhar 'dra: sdod pa'i gnas su ga la rigs: dbang lung med pa'i chos spyod de: sa bon zhum pa'i snying po 'dra: 'bras bu spyod ldan ga la rigs: de phyir don chen brtson pa la: brgyud pa tshul ldan bsten pa gces: de lta bu'i phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi gnad don thams cad badzra thod pa rtsal gyi spyi lung chen mo'i don bshad ma nor ba tshig sdeb dka' 'grel cung zad kyis brgyan pa ste gong du 'phul ba'i cha lag go: sa ma ya: 'di yan gter gzhung*/ 'di man gter gzhung gyi dka' 'grel lo/ /de yang snga 'gyur rin po che'i theg pa'i dbang bskur ba 'phral dang yun du dgos pa'i tshig cung zad kyi gnad 'gag sdeb pa yin te/ 'di la rgyud lung dang man ngag sdeb sbyor sogs tshang dgos pa yin/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ gsang sngags don chen dam pa 'di/ /lo rgyus tshig gis ma bkrol na/ /yid mi ches pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /gsang sngags gsang zhes bya ba 'di/ /chos la skyon can ma lags te/ /skal med spyod yul mi ldan phyir/ /snod min rnams la gsang ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyi nang gsang gsum ngo sprod dang bcas gang gis dbang bskur yang brgyud pa byin rlabs kyi 'brel ba zhig dgos te: thog mar brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ kun tu bzang po nas shog ser yan chod brgyud pa don dang ldan pa gong du bstan pa ltar ro/ /byin rlabs dang 'brel zhes pa ni thog mar rig 'dzin grub thob kyi brgyud pa zam ma chad pa dang*/ bar du chos kyi ngad pa'i bcud ma yal ba| tha ma rten 'brel gyi brda ma log pa/ gnas skabs gdams ngag gi rtsi ma 'chug pa/ mthar thug man ngag gi lam ci bzhin myong ba'i bla ma dam pa des dbang bskur ba ni byin rlabs brgyud kyis 'brel ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /dper na don de bshad bkrol cung zad dgos pa'i mtshan nyid snyigs ma rtsod ldan gyi skabs su chos grogs la mthun 'jug zad nas chags sdang dang rang 'dod grub mtha'i rgyu zhig tu 'gro ba ni shin tu mang gshis/

gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos dang gang zag dbang bcas thams cad bka' med rang bzo'i grub mtha' yin zer ba'i dam sri 'ga' zhig yong bar bshad/ ci'i phyir rgyud lung gsang mdzod las/ ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga brgya'i mthar: mdo log sngags log dam sri'i rigs: sprul pa 'gong po btsun gzugs can: mi snyan ku cos lung pa 'geng : tha snyad rtog ges khungs phyung nas: rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod pa yi: ma rungs log 'dren ru tra 'byung : khyad par gsang sngags chos la sdang : bka' 'dir skur 'debs dus gcig 'byung : zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gsang sngags rnying ma zer ba'i chos mi bden zer ba dang*/ rgyud yod kyang dbang lung gi brgyud pa med zer ba dang*/ khyad par gter chos 'di mi dag zer ba dang*/ dag kyang shog ser nas rgyun chad zer ba dang*/ dam rdzas skye bdun dang sman sgrub 'di khungs mi btsun zer ba dang*/ btsun yang yon tan de dang mi ldan zer ba dang*/ spyir rnying ma'i chos mi bden zer ba dang*/ bden yang ma bsgoms sangs rgyas min zer ba dang*/ rnying ma'i gter ston 'di rnams khungs mi btsun zer ba dang*/ khungs btsun kyang spyod pa 'chol ba'i ser mo'i gral du mi 'gro zer ba sogs/ gong du lung bstan la yod pa bzhin/ deng sang gi skabs 'dir dam sri bdud kyi sprul pa'i sdig to can bdud kha dang snying la zhugs pa/ gdug 'dre mngon sum du 'gro ba'i rigs| khyad par du shākya thub pa dang padma 'byung gnas la deng phan chod bsam pa log pa'i las dbang yod pa'i gshis kyis/ deng sang gi skabs su yang chos dang gang zag la gnod pa chen po byed pa'i las 'phro sad pa 'di rnams la kun gyis legs par dpyod dang*/ dper na don ma go ba'i tshig gi mtshan nyid brtags na/ lung stong du smyon pas ki sgra btab pa dang mtshungs/ sdig to can gyi kha ni nad pa rlung langs pa'i kha dang 'dra/ khyi mang po'i tho yol mi ru mthong nas zug pa ltar yin/

lug khyus chu 'bog pa dang 'dra ste sngon ma de'i phyi la don ma mthong yang mchongs pa yin/ dper na phyi pa mu stegs pas nang pa sangs rgyas pa la mu stegs pa yin zer ba dang 'dra/ dur khrod kyi wa spyang gcan 'phar thams cad kyang dmar ser gyi spu yod kyang kho la chos kyi mtshan nyid med pa yin/ spyir bdud kyi rigs la kha 'jam po'i don dang rgyud ngan pas sems can mang po la gnod thub pa yin/ sems can sbrul la rkang lag kyang med pa'i 'jam po yin mod kyang*| 'gro ba mthong tshad sngangs shing skrag pa yang khong pa'i dug yin/ gshin rje bzhad pas 'gro ba 'joms: zhes pa ltar deng sang gi bdud sprul 'di rnams 'byung po mkha' la rgyu ba'i za kha skyor ba'i rigs yin pas kun gyi bag zon dgos pa'i mtshan nyid de yin no/ /dper na gsang sngags rnying ma zer ba yod pa'i mtshan nyid/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi rdo rje 'chang gi skur bzhengs nas rgyal po ind+ra bo dhi la gsungs pa'i chos thams cad gsang sngags yin pa dang*/ 'di theg pa gong ma'i rgyud snga 'gyur yin pas rnying mar grags pa dang*/ rdo rje gdan gyi ka ba bum pa can gyi 'og tu rnying ma'i rgyud yongs rdzogs rgya dper ma nyams pa yod pa dang*/ bsam yas su jo bo rje phebs pa'i dus su rgya dpe rnams bka' rgya yin pa klog nas gzigs pas rgya gar du ma grags pa'i mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud kyi skor yang mang po yod pa zhib par mjal/ jo bo rje yang thugs shin tu ches nas/ bod 'dir bdud rigs mang po yod par 'dug /gsang sngags rnying ma ha shang gi lta ba yin zer ba yang mi dag par 'dug /bdag kyang bod du yun ring 'dug na skyon rnyed 'dra zer nas bzhud pa'i mtshan nyid kyang de yin/ gsang sngags rnying ma pa la dbang lung yod pa ma chad cing khyad par du 'phags pa ni| thog ma'i kun bzang nas rje btsun ma hā gu ru yan chad la dbang dang brgyud pa yod pa'i khungs ni gong du bstan pa de yin/

de yang khungs ma dag snyam nas/ mdo gsar ma'i rdo rje 'chang shākya thub pa nas lo tsā ba khungs ma re zung yan chod/ de bzhin du yod pa la ston pas gsungs pa tshigs su bcad pa lhugs par brjod pa ched du brjod pa/ skyes rabs kyi sde| lung bstan pa'i sde/ rmad du byung ba'i sde/ mngon par 'phags pa'i sde/ shlau ka bam po chos kyi phung po la sogs gang gsungs pa thams cad lung bstan pa'i sde tsam yin pa dang*/ bka'i chos kyi brgyud pa grub chen brgyad cu'i nang na yang padma 'byung gnas yod de/ sku'i sprul pa lo hi pa/ gsung gi sprul pa nag po pa/ thugs kyi rang bzhin ḍombhi pa/ lung las/ lho tsandan 'bar ba'i nags khrod du/ /stag zhon sbrul gyi gdengs ka can/ /rigs ngan bu mo phyag rgyar brten/ /rgyal sras chen po ḍombhi pa/ /zhais gsungs pa ltar/ bka'i rgyud lung man ngag kyang yod cing mi zad pa'i mtshan nyid kun dang mi 'gal lo/ khyad par gter chos ni shin tu dag ste/ sngon thog ma'i sangs rgyas la 'khrul pa med pa'i mnyam bzhag gis rig rtsal rdo rje sems dpa' la gsungs/ des dga' rab rdo rje la gsungs/ des padma 'byung gnas la gsungs/ padma 'byung gnas ni so so'i skye bo las dag zer tsam min te/ sangs rgyas dngos su 'jig rten la byon pa yin no/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ ston pas lung bstan te/ nga ni mi gnas mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /nga las lhag pa'i padma 'byung gnas 'byon/ /de ni sangs rgyas dbang po snang mtha' dngos/ /'ja' lus sku lnga mtshan brgyad skye 'chi bral| |rtag tu gang 'dul der ston chos 'khor bskor/ /zhes gsungs pa yin te/ bla ma de nyid kyi dgongs pa rje 'bangs rgya mtsho la gtad nas longs sku spros bsgyur gyi rnam pas gter gyi bka' gtad pa yin pas mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob pa yang bla ma'i thugs rje kho na las grub/ slob dpon gyis lung las/ pad 'byung 'ja' lus nga ni dbyings la bzhugs:

longs sku'i rtsal las shog ser gter du sbas: de 'byin 'gro don sprul sku mi yul 'byon: nges pa'i don rtogs bden gnyis dngos su 'byin: rgyud lung dgongs pa ma 'dres kun mthun 'byung : zhes gsungs te/ padma 'byung gnas sangs rgyas yin pas thugs 'khrul pa mi mnga'/ shog ser snyan brgyud kyi dpe yin pas sgra dag /lung rigs bskyed rdzogs yang dag pa'i don las lhag pa'i chos sangs rgyas kun gyi ma rnyed cing*/ chig brgyud nges dag mi lag ma 'grim zhing mang po'i kha gtsags pa'i chos min pas shog ser gyis gter 'di khungs btsun pa'o/ /'di'i brgyud pa yang ma chad de/ shog ser 'di brgyud pa gzhan las lhag cing mang ba yin/ brgyud pa dang po sangs rgyas bla ma padma 'byung gnas/ brgyud pa gnyis pa chos sgo brgyad khri'i shog ser bla ma/ brgyud pa gsum pa brda brgyud ston pa'i mkhas grub bla ma'o/ /bla ma ni shog ser yang yin/ slob dpon gyi thugs ye shes sems dpa' la bkod/ ljags padma 'dab brgyad la bkram/ phyag shes rab mos brtsam| don nam mkha' mdzod kyi shog ser la bris/ rgya skal ldan las 'phro can thugs kyi sras la gtad pa yin pas brgyud pa yod pa yin/ shog ser de rang ston pa'i bla ma/ de'i nang nas shar ba'i yi ge de snyan brgyud kyi chos/ de ston pa'i don de nyams su myong rgyu nges dag kun la bstan chog pa 'di dbang lung rdzogs pa yin/ yang slob dpon gyis shog ser phyag tu bsnams nas slob ma'i mgor bzhag nas chos 'di spyod par gyis/ 'dzin par gyis/ 'chang bar gyis/ ston par gyis/ spel bar gyis/ skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du chos 'di spyod pa'i skal ldan du 'gyur gsungs nas rjes su gnang dbang bskur lung 'bog bka' gtad pa ste/ da lta yan lag 'dus byas kyi sgyu lus 'dra brjes pa las/ rig pa zang thal 'di la dbang bskur ba ni brje ma myong*/

sgyu lus brjes nas dbang gi yon tan rdzogs na sngar gyi paṇḍi ta rang byung mang po de la dbang sus bskur rgyud gang nas brtsam sngar gyi dbang de rdzogs pa nas rgyud chad nas sngar byon grub thob brgyud chad dam| yang na kun bzang dang rdo rje 'chang sha gzugs yin nam nub mo rmi lam gyi skabs su nyin snang nub pa'i bar do yin pas dbang lung chad pa'am/ yang na gang zag thams cad brgyud pa dang dbang chad pa med dam/ 'o na don go ba de snyan brgyud kyi bla ma min na/ rdo rje'i rtsa thams cad dbyangs gsal yi ge'i gzugs su yod pas rlung gi sgra 'byin pa/ longs spyod 'khor lo la phog pas rang byung du tshig thams cad thol thol du shar ba 'di la bstan nas snyan brgyud dgos na sgra tshig tu sgrogs pa'i shog ser yi ge'i don go ba ci la byed/ phyogs med gang rung gi snod cig nas dbang lung snyan brgyud byed mkhan yod na brgyud pa chad kyang zer ba bden mod/ de ni ma yin no/ /don go nas sgra bsdebs pa ni rdo rje'i lus su rang gnas snyam mam/ de yang mdo ltar bka' snyan brgyud kyi shog dril/ sngags ltar brda gsang sngags kyi shog ser 'di thams cad bka' gter gyi khyad tsam las chos kyi go bab ni 'dra mod/ khyad chos ni so so'i gdams pa lag tu lon pa zab| de bas na bka' bab lung gi brgyud pa la dbang thams cad rdzogs pa yin/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ skal med la lung bstan zhing spyod pa'i las 'phro dang rang dbang med pas 'dod kyang gter srung gis mi sprod par snang*/ des na dbang lung snyan brgyud kyis phyug pa shog ser rang khungs btsun pa'o/ /dam rdzas skye bdun dang sman sgrub yang khungs btsun te/ ci'i phyi zhe na/ chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas shākya thub pa yin la/ skye bdun gyi dbang du byas na sangs rgyas skye bdun gyi 'phel gdung la gzhi byas pa yin/ skye bdun de gang yin na/

sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad mkhyen/ /'khor ba 'jigs dang gser thub 'od srung dang*/ /shākya thub pa lha dang mi yi mchog /ces gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi 'phel gdung de skye bdun yin pas deng sang 'gro ba gang gi kha ru myong na skye ba bdun du ngan song la mi 'gro ba yin/ dper na sangs rgyas ring bsrel skyes chen mang pos dam rdzas kyi phabs rgyun la bsres nas ril bu bsgrub pa dang*/ bdud rtsi la bsres nas ril bu bsgrub pa dang*/ bdud rtsi la bsres nas bhandha bsgrub pa sogs yod pa thams cad skye bdun yin zhing*/ deng sang skyes chen mang po la yang de'i phyag srol yod/ dper na rdzas sha chen lnga sogs kyang nang mchod kyi gral du yod pa bka' mdo rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor mang po la yod/ des na gsang sngags rnying mas kyang sangs rgyas 'phel gdung la gzhi byas| khyad par bram ze skye bdun gyi sku sha sogs thams cad la phabs rgyun gyi a ma 'byung ba bsres nas sku sha bsgrub pa ni rnying ma'i ro snyoms skor drug dug lnga lam khyer gyi gdams pa'i phyir/ khye'u gtsang ma glo bur du shi ba'i ro de la sgrub pa bya zer ba phyag srol 'dug pa dang*/ de bas ched du mi bsad nas sgrub pa byas pa'am/ 'o na rnying ma bas 'di byas zer ba ni kun gyi ma thos shing*/ deng sang ni skye bdun rlom pa rnams gter nas ma byung na ro langs gser 'gyur gyi gdams pa ni kun la med mod/ de bas rnying ma'i skye bdun sgrub tshul yang de yin/ skye ba bdun du ngan song mi myong ba'i mtshan nyid kyang de yin/ skye bdun de rnams kyang mi dag cing sangs rgyas byang sems skye bdun ma byung ba khas len pa sus kyang ma ltos so/ /sman sgrub dag la khungs btsun pa ci yin zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi gso byed kyis sman bzang po drug gis bcos pa la/ 'de gu sman mar khaṇḍa gnas gsum mdzad pa de'i phan yon tshe ring zhing nad dkon pa'i yon tan yod pa dang*/

de la gzhi mdzad de slob dpon dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis sems can mang por dgongs nas sman de bsgrubs te smon lam mdzad pas ril bu nas 'bras tsam khar myong bas/ tshe'i rig 'dzin 'grub cing phyi ma yang byang chub kyi lam la 'god pa'i bden tshig yod pa yin/ de'i phyag srol gyis gsang sngags rnying ma'i gso byed sman la brten pa kun la mkho nas bstan 'dzin skyes chen mang po'i phyag bzhes mdzad pa yod/ sman sgrub la yang khyad du gsod nas nges pa ma mchis na sus kyang mi ltos so/ /gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos 'di ma bsgoms sangs rgyas yin zhing khungs btsun/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di theg dman la drang don du gsungs pa'i chos min/ 'di nges pa'i lam yang dag pa yin te/ dper na mkha' 'gro'i gsang lam ci yin zhe na/ rta pho bzhon nas sa khar brgyugs pa dang*/ gshog pas bskyod de nam mkhar lding ba mi 'dra/ rtsal chen rlung gis gzings 'ded pa dang*/ gang zag phal pas skya ba bskul ba gnyis sa chod mi 'dra/ rlung gtum mo'i dros pa dang gos snal mas dros pa gnyis mi 'dra/ theg dman rnams ni slob pa nyan thos kyi theg pa ste/ dgag sgrub kyi lhan pa ni chu bo'i gnyer ma ltar 'debs te/ rnam rtog bkag /rnam rtog sgrub/ rnam rtog srung*/ de rnams ci yin zhe na rnam rtog bkag kyang mi khog rlung rtsal/ rnam rtog bsgrubs pas bag chag a 'thas 'char/ /rnam rtog bsrungs pas tshogs drug kun nas zhugs/ /dper na rgya gar chos kyi yul yang 'dod/ /rgya nag ha shang rtogs pa khrims kyang 'dod/ khams dwangs 'ja' lus lha yi gzugs kyang 'dod/ /bdag 'dzin sgrub pa des ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /zab mo'i gnas lugs rtogs nas 'khor ba ldog /'gog med bsgrub med bsgom med byang chub lam/ /mi sgom dran rig 'od gsal skyong ba ni/ /gzhi thog phebs nas lam du lhong ba'i tshe/ /tshe gcig 'di ni sangs rgyas the tshom med/

/ces pa ltar mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis kyang*/ stong nyid bcu drug chos kyi gzhi ma yin/ /pha rol phyin drug don mthong 'phags pa'i nor/ /gnad gzhi mnyam bzhag gdeng thob sangs rgyas yin/ /zhes gsungs/ mdo las de bzhin dang*/ 'phags pa khang bu brtsegs pa'i mdo las kyang*/ gzungs mchog rgyal po uṣṇi ṣa/ /'di yi 'og tu lan gcig 'dzul nas ni/ /bskal pa stong du bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag /ces gsungs pa yang sngags de'i 'og tu zhugs na sgrib pa dag pa dang ma bsgoms pa'i sangs rgyas rnams lung 'dra/ gzungs mchog rgyal po'i don rtogs na sgrib pa dag pa yin/ ma bsgoms par sangs rgyas pa yang shin tu khungs btsun/ mdo gsar ma'i rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud thams cad gnas lugs don gyi lta ba kho na/ ma spangs dwang du blang ba'i ro snyom dang brtul zhugs bskyed rdzogs kyi lam kun dgag sgrub kyis bsgom pa'i yul min/ dper na ma sgom par dwang du blang ba'i mtshan nyid sngon gyi grub thob thams cad kyi gshegs shul ma 'ongs skal ldan thams cad 'byon lam/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gsang lam 'di kho na yin pas ma bsgoms sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i mtshan nyid de yin/ bdag 'dzin gyis sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i khungs yod na ci yang ma ltos so/ /gsang sngags rnying ma'i gter ston dang chos ni shin tu khungs btsun pa yin/ chos khungs btsun pa'i mtshan nyid ji ltar yin zhe na/ rje btsun gyi rgyal po 'gro mgon padma 'byung gnas kyi lta ba nam mkha' klong yangs kyi rgyud sde dpag tu med par gsungs pa thams cad rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i snying la yang dag par byung ba dang*/ lhag tu khungs btsun pa ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das skye ba gnyis ldan gyi sprul sku rdzu 'phrul gyis phebs pa yin gsungs pas chos kyang rgyud lung spyi'i mtshan nyid yin pa dang*/ chos bskal pa bzang po'i dus su gsungs pa byin che ba dang*/

de'i mtshan nyid ci zhe na/ thog mar rten 'brel che ba ni/ bla ma sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ yon bdag rgyal po dzaḥste ind+ra bo dhi skal ldan gyi slob ma yang rigs gsum mgon po sogs byang sems mang po'i tshogs la gsungs pa ste/ bskal pa bzang po'i bla ma dang slob ma yon bdag yin zhing maṇḍal yang rgyu phun sum tshogs pa phul nas gang gsungs pa'i chos thams cad rjes su yi rang bskul nas gsol ba btab pa yin pas brgyud pa'i dam tshig gtsang ba yin/ de bas snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i ring lugs thams cad so ma nyams pa'i chos yin/ ma nyams pa'i mtshan nyid gang yin zhe na/ thog mar sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa de byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje chos sogs rigs gsum mgon pos bka'i bsdu ba mdzad nas rin po che sna lnga'i shog bu la bris| sangs rgyas kyis rab tu gnas par byas nas/ rin po che'i sgrom du bzhag /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la bka' gtad/ 'byung bas mi 'jig pa'i rtsi yis bsdams/ mi rul mi sum pa'i khyad par mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod dang mchod rten bde byed brtsegs pa/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ kā ma shī la'i gtsug lag khang*/ o rgyan au ḍī ṇi'i gtsug lag khang*/ shambha la/ ri bo 'big byed/ pu reng ta/ a su ra'i brag la sogs pa shin tu btsan pa'i gnas su sbas pa yin/ byin rlabs che ba tsam du ma zad rgya dam pos btab pas chud kyang ma zos pa yin/ chud ma zos pa'i chos ma nyams pa de rje gu ru rin po ches gdan drangs nas bod gangs can gyi khrod du spel nas smin grol mdzad pas/ bod gangs can gyi khrod du rnying ma'i chos khungs btsun pa dar la smin grol rgya che zhing byin rlabs kyi rtags dang re khā phyi dus la bzhag mi dgos pa'i mtshan nyid kyang de yin/ lhag tu khyad par 'phags pa ni bla ma padma 'byung gnas sbyin bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyis maṇḍal yang gser sha ba'i rlid bu du ma sogs rin po che sna tshogs la bgyis pa rten 'brel ma nyams pa'o/

/dper na rnying ma'i chos 'di sems can gyi nu ma nas babs pa'i 'o ma de/ dang po snod ngan gyi g.ya' ma phog /bar du lag ngan gi dri ma 'dres/ tha ma snod bzang po'i nang du skyes bu brtul shugs dang ldan pas lag pa'i 'khrul 'khor shes bzhin phrogs pas drod kyis zhu ba'am grang nas byer ba sogs ma byung ba ci bzhin/ snying po'i bcud bsdus nas smin pa'i mar gyi yang zhun lta bu ni gsang sngags kyi chos yin zhing ma mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs bun ne ba 'di 'dra sa steng na mi 'byung la mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod la yang 'di las lhag pa med pa dang*/ de bas khungs btsun pa snga 'gyur gyi dpe ma nyams pa'i rgyu 'di ga rang yin/ dper na rnying ma'i gser chos snying po'i gter yang dag pa 'di mi btsun na/ bka'i chos btsun pa'i rgyu mtshan yang e yod/ gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa'i dus/ gang gsungs pa'i chos rnams ni dgra bcom pa la snyan brgyud mdzad pa las yi ger bkod pa dang*/ phyi mo sangs rgyas zhing la phebs nas dgra bcom pa thams cad tshogs pas dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob pa zhig ma tshang ba dang*/ de'i tshe bas mtha' zhig yod pa gdan 'dren phyin pas de yang sangs rgyas zhing khams su phebs pas mya ngan gyi gshegs pa dang*/ slar nye gnas kun dga' bo 'di dgra bcom gyi go 'phang ma thob kyang*/ sangs rgyas kyi mdun du yun ring sdod pa yin pas thams cad kha yi nges zer nas kun dga' bo dgra bcom du brtsis thams cad zhal mthun pa gang yin gtan la phab pas/ thog mar mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi skabs thams cad zhal mthun pa dang*/ bar du stong nyid bcu drug gi skabs thams cad stong par shor ba dang the tshom za ba dang*/ bslab pa phar phyin drug la thams cad mngon zhen skyes pa dang*/ tha ma tshogs drug rten 'brel bcu gnyis la zhal ma mthun pa dang*/ ci yin zhe na/ thog mar gzugs la sbyar bas/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/

gzugs ni gzugs ma mchis te/ gzugs kyi rang bzhin mngon par shes pa stong pa'o/ /de dgra bcom pa kha gcig gis snang ba'i rang bzhin bsdu bya'i gzugs dngos por grub pa 'di ma mchis na don yang dag pa gang lags zer ba dang*/ dgra bcom phal cher gyi lan ldog tu ma rnyed pa dang*/ rab 'byor dang kun dga' bo sogs kyis smras pa/ gzugs ni gzugs su ma mchis pa ste chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa'o/ /gzugs stong pa nyid la mtshan nyid med pa ma skyes pa ma 'gags pa dri ma med pa dri ma dang bral ba'o/ /gzugs kyi phung po ma mchis te gzugs kyi rang bzhin 'di stong pa'o/ /dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa'o| |de bzhin tshor ba dang 'du shes dang 'du byed dang rnam par shes pa stong pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas dgra bcom pa thams cad rab 'byor dang kun dga' bo la mngon par bstod zer nas/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa rnams glang po che'i rgyab khal lnga brgya dang phung po gsum gsungs pa'o/ /gang 'dus pa'i chos thams cad rab tu gnas te/ rgya gar gyi gtsug lag gsum du brtsegs nas rab tu gnas par mdzad/ phyi mo'i dus su mu stegs nyi ma 'phur shes kyis gtsug lag mang po bsregs pas phal cher mer shor ba dang*/ slar dgra bcom gang yod dang sbyin bdag rna thos che ba 'tshogs nas bsdus pa dang*/ phyi mor rdo rje gdan gyi phyogs mang po mer tshig pa dang*/ de'i skabs su bka' ma'i chos skor sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa rnams phal cher rgyun chad pa dang*/ spyir rgya gar tshad pa che ba'i shugs kyis dpe phal cher tshad rul du song ba dang*/ chos kyi khungs yod pa dum pa re lus pa des kyang phyis 'byung gi lo tsā ba rnams rlung sems la rang dbang thob pa'i thun mong gi grub pa thob pa yang mang po med pa'i gshis kyis/ rgyud lung khungs ma len pa la rgya gar rdo rje gdan du bgrod dka' ba dang*/ bgrod kyang rung sbyangs pa yon tan slob pa'i gang zag rnams kyi shog ser nas mi drongs pas/

dper na deng sang gi lo tsā ba gsar pa rnams ni dbyar bal po'i kha stod du bsdad/ dgun rgya gar gyi byang gling du khyug tsam slebs kyang dpe khungs ma cha tshang rnyed dka' ba dang*/ spyir rgya gar dang bal po'i phyogs kyi a tsa ra bod kyi rgyus che ba gser 'dod can rnams kyis brngan pa zos te rgya gar du 'gro ste rgya dpe kha yar zhig khur ba 'byung*/ de la yang dag pa'i khungs su mi 'dogs pa dang*/ spyir rgya dpe yod tsam gyis lo tsā ba la chos khungs ma mi thub pa'i mtshan nyid kyang de yin/ de khungs ma zhig 'byung ba la yang na bi ma mi tra yang na jo bo rje sogs dang*/ yang na rgya gar gyi bla ma tai lo dang nā ro pa/ ku ku ri pa/ dril bu pa/ nag po pa sogs grub pa brnyes pa gter la dbang ba ste/ rang dbang thob pa'i skyes chen rnams la yin na khungs yod pa yin/ de rnams kyang gter ston min snyam na/ khong rnams kyi chos rdo rje gdan bzhi sogs dpag tu med pa rnams gang nas dpe blangs pa yin/ ston khungs yod na mi 'gal lo/ /de rnams mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod nas blangs pa yin na/ gter du nges so/ /bka' ma phal cher ni tshong 'dus kyi 'o ma lta bu yin te/ tshong 'dus kyi 'o ma ci yin zhe na/ thog mar 'o ma de mi gcig gis nyo ba nas gzhan gyi lag brgyud pas 'o ma cung zad phri/ chu de tsam bsnan/ slar gcig la btsong des de bzhin byed/ mthar mang po'i lag brgyud nas 'o ma'i dngos po mdog ma 'gyur yang btung bas bcud med/ dkrugs na mar med/ mnan na zho mi 'byung*/ 'bras bu yang rul ba yin/ khyad par kha nag yig nag sprad pa'i dpe rnying phal cher la chos kyi byin rlabs 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid ma ltos/ yi ge yang sgra log pa dang chad pa dang dkrugs pa dang bsre bslad shin tu mang bas ma ning gi rus rtsi ba bzhin te gter chos ma gtogs shin tu khungs btsun pa dka' ba'o| |rgyu mtshan de lta bu'o/

/yang gter ston gyi mtshan nyid dang spyod pa yang khungs btsun yin te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ gter ston khungs btsun pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ thog mar dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis byin brlabs/ bar du bka' tshad ma/ lung drang ma/ gzu bor bzhag nas mos pas blo dkon mchog gsum la gtad/ ma 'dres pa'i chos bcu tshad ma'i lung dang bcas pa nyams su myangs| de'i thugs bskyed bla na med pas dam pa'i chos la rtag tu 'phrad/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa la bar ma chad/ dge ba bcu la 'bad pas sgrib pa shugs la byang*/ mi dge ba bcu la 'dzems pas rje btsun sangs rgyas dang mjal/ skye ba nas tshe rabs su chos la spyod pa'i skal ba ldan/ rim gnyis zab mo'i gnas lugs nyams su myong bas dran pa nyams pa'i gdong len/ de lta bu'i dus su mtshungs med ma hā gu rus skal ldan gyi slob mar gzigs nas rjes su bzung*/ rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba klong yang gi bka' gtad/ bstan 'gror gzhan phan 'byung ba'i lung bstan| dam tshig gi shog ser rnam lngas snyan brgyud ma lus pa thams cad kyi gnyer du bkod/ skye ba phyi ma'i dus su gter gyi chos 'di lta bu dang 'phrad par shog gsungs nas smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar/ de lta bur mdzad pa'i tha ma la sngon gyi bag chags bzang po'i 'phro rnyed/ rje btsun rin po ches rab dngos 'bring nyams snang tha ma rmi lam du lung bstan pa bzhin/ zag med mngon shes kyi mthong ba ma lags pa'i zag bcas skye 'gro kun gyis mthong bar sbas pa'i gter khungs yod mngon du 'byin/ 'byin pa tsam ma zad rtags bdun shog ser gyi brda nam mkha'i mdzod phyes pa lta bu'i bskyed rdzogs man ngag gi mtshams sbyar/ lung bzhi'i chos thams cad kun tu bzang po'i srid pa bkod pa lta bur ngos bzung med pa la/ chog shes kyang zad pa med pa 'di lta bu mkha' 'gro'i gsang rgya 'byed pa'i rtags tshad lung dang ldan par mi rigs sam/

yang na gang zag so so'i skye bo phal pa zhig mtshams sbyar bla ma bzang po gang bsten nas ri phug gam dgon sde gang rung tsam du bslab pa phran bu'i yon tan sbyangs/ bsnyen sgrub mtha' ru bskyal/ grub rtags sna gcig thon pa'i tshe ri thang lung stong thams cad nyul/ slob dpon padma'i gter la dbang*/ mkha' 'gro'i gsang rgya phye ba de ltar rtsol bas bsgrubs te gang zag phal pa grub thob rigs thams cad kyi slob dpon padma'i gter rnyed pa yin na/ gter ston rnams kyang so so'i skye bo chos sgo la zhugs nas 'phral gyi sgrib pa dag pa zhig yin pa kha 'khyags/ yin na deng sang gi dus su dge bshes su ming btags pa/ bla ma ru ming btags pa/ mkhan por ming btags pa/ sku skyer ming btags pa| dge slong du ming btags pa/ grwa pa ru ming btags pa/ sgom chen du ming btags pa/ 'gangs chen nas ming smod pa de btags pa'i gras pa'i sngas 'phangs su po ti khur po bzhag nas gdams ngag gi snying po dpe la lus pa thams cad kyi gter ston bgyis na mi legs sam/ ci yin zhe na/ sa lam gyi sbyangs pa khyim thabs rgan po'i dpral ba'i gnyer ma tsam rtse zhing gti thug gis shig 'thu ba lta bu mtha' ma bud pa 'di las gter 'don pa los dga'/ ma sbyangs pa'i yon tan klong la shar ba rang dka' las chung mod/ yang gter la mtshan nyid kyang med/ chos kyang khungs mi btsun zhing*/ gter ston gyis bskyed rdzogs gnyis la brten nas lam bsnyegs pa yang mi gral du ma tshud na/ gsang sngags kyi gter chen min pa thams cad bskyed rdzogs ma yin pa'i chos yod na mu stegs phyi pa'i lugs ni ga la yin/ min pa na 'dra snyam/ 'o na gang zag spyod yul dang mi ldan pa rnams kyis gter zhes pa ci yin snyam na brjod par bya ste/ bskyed rdzogs kyi snying po len pa rnams mtshan dang ldan pa'i ser mo ba gsha' ma yin na gter ston yang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa kha 'khyags/

gter zhes bya ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ gu ru padma 'byung gnas kyis nam yang mi zad pa'i nam mkha' mdzod gnang ba yin pas gter zhes so/ /shog ser nyi ma dang nyi ma'i rang bzhin ltar yod pas gter yin no/ /brda rtags la sgyu ma mkhan gyis rmi lam bkod pa ltar yod pas gter yin no/ /mkha' 'gro'i shog dril drwa ba smug po'i klong la zhi dul nar mar brtsegs pa'i rtsi yod pas gter yin no/ /yul chen la sbas pa gnas chen du bton pas gter yin no/ /man ngag gab pa'i rgyud bsgrigs chags su bkod pas gter yin no/ /rgyud lung dgongs pa kun dang mi 'gal zhing bskyed rdzogs phyi nang go ma ldog ya ma bral/ gnad kyi zam ma chad sdeb sbyor gyi bcos slad ma zhugs par skal ldan mthong thos myong pa can gyi spyod yul du 'gro ba/ paṇḍi ta padma 'byung gnas kyi shog ser du blo rmongs kyis g.ya' zad par bkod pa'i tshig der phab pa 'di gter yin no/ /sa ma ya/ ྀatsha/ spyir gter ston zhes pa la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba mang ba yin la/ cung zad spros te bshad pa la chags sdang mi mdzad rgyur/ thugs gter ni mkhas grub thams cad la dbang yang padma 'byung gnas kyi shog ser la mi gtogs/ /lung rigs ni paṇḍi ta thams cad la yod kyang ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi gsang mdzod la mi gtogs/ gser dngul zangs lcags sogs rin po che dang ka cha'i rigs sa 'og na yod pa rnams gang zag la la zhig dang*/ so so'i skye bo rnams kyi rtsol bas rkos pa'i mngon shes kyis len nas sa steng gang ba tsam byung yang ma hā gu ru'i gsang gter du mi gtogs| gter gyi mtshan nyid kyang de ltar tshad du byas pa yin/ spyir gter ston slob dpon padma'i lung zin pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid ni/ bskyed rdzogs kyi don dang ldan zhing ma sbyangs pa'i yon tan phal cher shes pa lung rigs gang la yang brda de yin don go ba zhig dgos pa yin/

ci yin zhe na/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas mkhas grub kyi paṇḍi ta yin pa dang de'i gsung gang zag phal pa'i blo la shar ba ltar mi 'byung ba dang*/ skal ldan lung bstan pa'i lo tsā ba rjes 'brang rnams/ phyis smon lam gyi 'phro sad pa'i tshe gter 'don pa'i dus la bab nas 'don pa dang*/ gter de yod par shes pa'i mngon mkhyen yod tshul la bskyed rdzogs kyi don ma go ba'am/ gsang sngags kyi gnad mi shes pa lung rigs dag gi brda don mi 'phrod pa'i sgra sdeb tshig gi zur nyams pa sogs lung la mi mthun pa'i bab tshol byung nas/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i gter ston du mi 'dod/ de ci yin zhe na/ sa 'og gi gter 'di rmi lam gyi nyams shar ba tsam min/ gnas lugs rig pa'i rol rtsal gyi ze'u 'bru'i sbubs su slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi thugs rje'i rtsal shar ba yin/ de shar nas kha byang dang 'phrad de nam yang gter gyi mtshan nyid thams cad/ ma pang du bu rgyugs pa ltar 'byung ste mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod phyes pa yin/ mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod phye ba'i skal pa dang mi ldan pa rnams la gter kha dang kha byang yod zer ba thams cad rdzun yin mod| rgyus ma byas na rkyen gyis ga la g.yeng*/ mtshan nyid med pa'i lung zhig snod min la 'bog par mi rigs sam/ yang gang zag grags 'dod can kha cig gis gnas dang ri la gter 'dug zer nas lung ston mkhan mang po snang yang*/ rang la gter mi dbang zhing slob dpon gyis lung bstan 'byung ba'i don med pa la/ mkhar sgo med pa'i nang du chas ka gang yod ci shes/ gter yod pa shes pa'i thog ma la/ gter gyi mtshan nyid rtogs dgos pa yin no/ /deng sang gi skabs su padma 'byung gnas kyis sbas pa'i gter 'don par las sla ba dang stabs bde bar sems nas 'dod pa phug bcug can thams cad kyi myong chog pa zhig yod pa 'dra snyam yang*/ rgyud lung kun dag nas thog mar rtsa gsum gyis dam tshig ngo shes pa tsam dgos pa yin nam/

slob dpon padma'i zhal nas| gter ni khyi ro min pa gang la'ang 'byung*/ /gsungs pa ltar sna tshogs su 'byung ba gter mi zad pa'i tshig yin mod/ gang min gcin skyag rang gi gter la yod pa min/ gter gyi kha byang sprang po'i mdzod la yod/ /ces pas skal med kyi snying du slob dpon dngos su bzhugs nas lung bstan yang las 'phro med pas mthong ba'i go skabs ma mchis/ skal ldan snying la gdams ngag tsher ltar 'dzugs/ zhes pa ltar gter la dbang ba rnams kyis gter mi 'don pa dang mi spel ba'i dbang med pa yin/ dper na tshig de rnams kyi brda cung zad bstan dgos pa ni spyir ma 'ongs par sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa gso ba'i gter chen dam pa rnams la bar du gcod pa dang*/ mdangs 'phrog pa'i rigs sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang*/ bar du rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas/ tha mar rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga yan du dgra bgegs gshed du bskos pa'i/ sdig to can rnams gter kha la khag 'dogs nas rdo rje theg pa'i brgyud pa'i rkang 'dren par brtsams nas| sha la skyes pa'i lba ba ltar 'byar ba la brten nas zog po'i gral thams cad gter ston la dpe 'dren pa dang*/ khyad par mdo sngags kyi ban btsun dam nyams tha na mo ma lha ma lha bab yan chod kyi zog po rnams kyis g.yo khram dang rdzun la brten nas/ sprang mo'i bal khug yar btags su gter yod ma zer tsam byed pas/ rdo rje theg pa'i chos la che ba mi 'byung zhing yid gnyis za ba'i rgyu mtshan du 'gyur ba dang*/ chos dang chos min dbye ba med de dge sdig mgo mnyam na bstan pa shugs la nyams pa yin pas/ brtag gzhig rgyud lung dang gnad kyi man ngag la bstun dgos pa'i don yang de yin/ de bas rdo rje theg pa'i spyod yul ma lags shing de'i chos sgra rna bas thos ma myong ba khong rnams la gter gyi khag ci yod/ tha mal blo rmongs rnams kyis 'phral dpyad byas pa ci cha 'brang bas mi gtsang ba byung na/

spyir mdo sngags su thad nas gzhan gyi smad pa dang*/ rang gis phab pa gnyis don gcig yin/ de nas gang gi mtshan nyid bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan 'phral du dbye ba phye ba 'di| gter ston gyi chos pa thams cad la zhe bzhag nas rang shed byed pa ma yin gyis/ khungs ma btsun pa'i dpe dang gdams pa phyogs su 'char nas slar chos pa thams cad sma 'bab pa'i btsas su 'gro bas de'i ched du brjod pa'o/ /de bas rang gzhan gyi don nus pa phyung nas gsang sngags kyi gter ston mang ba byung na skyon gar yod/ rkun ma sdig can mang ba zhig ni ma yin/ gsang sngags kyi gnad shes te mdo sngags gang yang don rgyud dang mthun pa'i gsha' ma zhig byung na/ byang chub sems dpa' mang na sangs rgyas kyi rgyan du che ba yin mod/ mtshan nyid de yod pas gter ston pa yin no/ /sa ma ya/ ྀatsha/ yang gter ston dang gang zag phal pa mi 'dra zhing mtshan nyid bzang po yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i gdung gsob dam pa yin pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i lung bstan 'phags pa'i tshig gis zin/ mtshan tshang gi sprul skur 'khrungs/ mkha' 'gro'i gsang rgya phyes/ bskyed rdzogs kyi snying po lon/ chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong mngon sum du bkral/ dper na tshong pa rin chen gling du nor bu lon te log pa lta bu'i dus skabs/ man ngag rin chen spungs pa ltar gang la gang 'dod sbyin du yod pa'i dus 'dir/ yon tan mthong ba rang dka' mod kyang*/ skyon du mthong na skyon med pa'i yon tan yod pa thams cad kyi mtshan nyid ston dgos pa ste/ gsang sngags rnying ma bas sbyor sgrol byas pas spyod pa chol nas slob pa nyan thos kyi ser mo ba'i gral du mi tshud na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bzhed pa ste/ rnying ma'i khyad chos mkha' 'gro'i gsang lam 'di/ thog mar kun tu bzang po yab yum thabs shes ma bral/ bar du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang gi skur bzhengs te yum sgrol ma dkar sngon rdzu 'phrul gyis phyag rgya mdzad/

tha ma rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas kyis mtsho rgyal ma la sogs rigs bzang gi rig ma lnga brgya bsten/ de tsam ma zad lung las kyang*/ srin mo ma tshogs rnams la sbyor ba mdzad: gsang sngags bstan pa dang po de nas byung : zhes gsungs pa dang*/ phyis 'byung grub thob kyi lam rtsa rlung la brten nas sangs rgyas/ mdo ltar rdo rje 'chang nas phag mo grub pa tshun la gsang sngags ma chad pas grub thob kyis lung pa gang ba byung*/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas nas gter ston sngar byon thams cad kyi bar du gsang ba'i rig ma ma chad: chos kyi brgyud pa ma chad cing chos kyi brgyud pa dar la grub thob nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar byung*/ spyir rgyud sde thams cad las bskyed rdzogs ya bral ba'i chos med mod/ dgos rnying ma pa bskyed rdzogs sbyang gsum gyi bdag po yin pas thabs shes ya ma bral ba'i 'bras bus kyang nyon mongs pa kha yan du ma btang zhing gdams ngag gnad yod pas/ deng sang grub thob kyi zam ma chad pa'i mtshan nyid de yin/ grub pa ma thob kyang mang po'i tshogs la bstun pa su yang med/ dben ri nyung tsam zin dus mang*/ rtogs pa'i gdeng tshad cung zad yod pa yin/ chos kyi drod tshad myang ba yod pa yin/ bsgral kyang snying rjes 'dren pa'i man ngag 'gog lam du ma shor tsam yod pa mang*/ de bas rdo rje theg pa ni skyon can gyi chos ma lags so/ /'o na mdo ltar du srung ba'i sdom pa phal cher rdza be'u chag pa ltar 'gro ba 'di rnams kyi rjes su 'brang ba yin nam/ de ni ma yin te/ rdo rje theg par bsrung du med pa'i dam tshig lnga yod pa yin mod/ de ni med pas len pa 'dra/ snod chags pa dang bcud bo ba gnyis 'dug /rdo rje theg pa ni gser dngul gyis snod zhum yang slar bzo ba yang rang mal du log pa yin/ 'o na dkyil 'khor gyi dbang bzhi'i don ha lam tsam ma go ba rnams bla ma dang sgom chen dge ba'i bshes kyi gral du 'dug chog pa dang*/

rnying ma pa'i gter ston bskyed rdzogs kyi snying po blang nas chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong gser phye thang mar du brdal ba ltar bstan pa 'di rnams/ skyon can zhig yin na ser mo ba gsha' ma'i gral ma slebs pa'i mthong yul 'dra skyes pa yin shas kha kyang*/ don med tshig tshogs phal cher sems can rnams phal pa'i rigs rnams kha rlung long ba'i skyon yin no/ de'i phyir na rmu rgod snyigs ma'i sems can rnams rdo rje theg pa thar lam gyi them skas yin pa la sgro skur gyis g.yeng nas ngan song du skye ba'i las chen po mi bsags par 'tshal/ 'di ni hang khog tsam bsdus nas bshad pa yin zhing slar 'dis mi ngoms pa rnams la rgyas par dgos kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ro| |de yang snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa lo rgyus lta bu cung zad bstan te bkral ba 'di rnams ched du bskul mkhan ma byung na gong gi brda yig mtshams nas mi bshad bzhag par bya/ sa ma ya: e ma rgyud lung rgya mtsho'i man ngag klong mdzod 'di: bde chen 'khyil ba'i dpal gyi be'u nas: spros pa'i 'od zer rdo rje'i sbu gur 'phros: padma'i ze'u 'brur son nas g.yo ba'-i bcud: rin chen phreng ba'i srub nas legs thon pa: thabs shes zung gis 'du 'phro'i cha shas kyis: mkhyen rab drwa ba gsal byed logs su bkod: mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor brgyud pa'i tshogs: nam yang 'du 'phro med pa'i phul byung ste: blo gros bum pa'i rgyud la skye bar shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: shanathargya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: thim rgya: sngags 'chang rdo rje bdud 'dul kun grol rol pa rtsal gyis lcags byi lor sbas tshal rngam pa rong nas gdan drangs shing*/ shing pho 'brug zla rgyal ba dang por shog ser rtsa ri ta se tshon gsum pa zhig gi logs nas zhal bshus so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// //

kha) ༄༅/ /bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dbang chen kun mkhyen snying po'i sgrub pa spyi'i dbang rdzong bzhugs so: ༁ྂ: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: dbang chen kun mkhyen snying po bstan: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: da lta spel ba'i gnas ma yin: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: thugs sras gter bdag gling la sprod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dbang bskur bya ba'i rim pa ni: sgrub khog ltar gyi dbang rdzas dang : bye brag dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi: rab ni tsakli 'bring sa bon: tha ma rtsa ba'i lha grangs dang : phyi yi bka' skyong tshom bur bsdu: gzhung gi mchod rdzas tshang byas nas: dbang la 'jug pa'i rim pa ni: dkar gtor gser skyems rgyas par gtong : slob ma mang nyung gang ltar la: yang na khrus byas gos dkar gyon: khrom chen yin na me chu bya: dang po sgrub khang shar sgo nas: hoḥ sgo ba chen po dgongs su gsol: che mchog khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan las can 'jug pa'i phyir: rig pa ye shes 'char sgo phyes: sgo ba rnams kyis: hoḥ nged rnams 'jigs byed ma rungs pa: skal med 'joms pa'i gnyen po yin: ma dag 'khor ba'i 'khrul rgyun gcod: khyed rnams dam tshig ldan nges sam: spyi nas: hoḥ nged rnams skal ldan dam tshig can: sngon dbang bzang zhing phyi 'phro legs: khyed rnams rgyu 'bras sgo srung nyid: phra zhib ston pas sgo phyes 'tshal: nged rnams ci bzhin dam la gnas: de nas me hom chu dang thun zhal las shes: ging chen rnams kyis bgegs bskrad cing : rol mo dang bcas nas: hoḥ de ltar dam tshig bsrung lags na: ma rig nyon mongs sgo bkag ste: rang byung ye shes 'char sgo dbye: skal med bdud dang bar chad 'dul: oṃ badzra kro ta ging ka ra ghṛ wa hūm̐ hūm̐ bhyo bhyo: log 'dren bdud dang bar chad ngan pa mā ra ya u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ces thun gyis brabs te rgyud ma dag pa rnams dag par byas te:

dbang gi bya ba ma rdzogs bar: phyi nang ngo gsar ram dam tshig ma blang ba la bskur du mi rung : de nas yol ba'i phyi nas las kyi slob dpon la zhu ba ni: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: che mchog ye shes dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan las can 'jug phyir du: rdo rje rgyal pos gnang bar stsol: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ 'di ni che mchog rdo rje'i dbyings: khrag 'thung gsang ba'i pho brang yin: khyed rnams snod mchog ldan lags na: khas longs bdag gis dbang mchog sbyin: slob mas: kyaiḥ mi phyed dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor la: rigs ldan rnal 'byor cis mi dad: snod ldan bdag la gnang ba stsol: bla med dam tshig srog ltar bsrung : de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis ye shes lnga yi dar thag brkyangs te: slob ma rnams kyis sne mor 'ju zhing 'khrid: rol mo dang rkang gling gtong : hūm̐: nga ni che mchog he ru kaḥ lhun grub lnga ldan dkyil 'khor du: las sad smon lam ldan rnams shog: the tshom can rnams phyir dengs shig: ces rig pa ye shes kyi lam du khrid de gral du 'khod la: dam chu sbyin: hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig bla med chu: bsrungs na dngos grub sna tshogs brnyes: nyams na snying khrag las mkhan dgyes: de bas dam srungs sa ma ya: oṃ badzra karma du pā la nan sa ma ya i dante na ra kan: slob ma rnams la dbang ma rdzogs bar du rkyen bsrung phyir rdo rjes rgyas btab cing dpung skud gtad pa ni: oṃ badzra he ru ka kro ta kro ti ma ma tsakra rakṣa bhrūm̐ hūm̐: zhes sngags la pho'i g.yas mo'i g.yon du 'dogs so: hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi ngo bo nyid: dkyil 'khor bar chod bsrung ba dang : dbang rnams rab tu gnas pa'i phyir: dam tshig rdo rjes rgyas btab bo: oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha tsakra hūm̐: de nas ku sha gtad cing : hūm̐: sngon tshe byang chub sems dpa' yis: rtswa mchog la ni gdan byas te: ma gha'i shing la sku rgyab gtad:
