rten 'brel brtags shing rdzogs sangs rgyas: oṃ badzra a sa na gha ta ru pa sa muṅga te āḥhūm̐: de nas rten 'brel brtag cing dal padma 'dab brgyad dam rigs lnga'i thog sogs la: so shing mgo bo padma yod pa rtsa ba rgya mdud can la rang gi sgrib pa che chung dang : bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la skal ba ldan nam mi ldan brtag pa'i smon lam btab cing dor: skal pa ldan na me tog dkyil du gyu: mi ldan par rang la mgo bstan na dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal bskor ba byed: yi dam lha dang rdo rje slob dpon la bshags pa bya: dgong mo yang dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su mgo gtad cing nyal: de nas so shing dor ba ni: hūm̐: lus ngag yid kyi so shing la: rten 'brel dbang po'i me tog brgyan: de ring bzang ngan las 'phro brtag: tsittar grub pa bzhin du shog: oṃ sa ma ya puṣpe pha la ma ma siddhi hoḥ zhes dor: rten 'brel dang mi ldan na dkyil 'khor bstan du mi rung : zhes pa ltar legs par brtag: rmi lam du nyi ma shar ba dang dung 'bud pa dang rnga brdungs pa dbyangs len pa sogs rten 'brel che bar gyur na rab ma gyur na: las kyi sgrib pa 'thug pa yin pas: dge sbyor dang tshogs bskang la 'bung dgos: de nas rdo rje sems dpa'-i bzlas lung ni: hoḥ rang gi spyi gtsug zla gdan dbus: bcom ldan rdor sems dung mdog skus: rdor dril bsnol thabs skyil krung bzhugs: rnal 'byor dmar mo gri thod 'khyud: longs spyod rdzogs sku'i na bza' bklubs: snang stong ma 'gags lam gyis gsal: sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon las: 'od 'phros ye shes sems dpa' ni: rang 'dra dbang lhas bskor bar byon: spyi bor zhu nas snying khar thim: thugs kar hrīḥyig dkar po'i mthar: sngags phreng 'od zer drwa ba can: g.yas g.yon bskor nas sdig sgrib dag: chu shel dwangs ma'i sgong ltar gyur: oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐: zhes yig brgya'am sa twa gang mang bzlas shing phya le maṇḍal phul:

hoḥ rdo rje sems dpa' rigs kyi gtso: bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol: gling bzhi ri rab maṇḍal 'bul: lus ngag yid kyi sdig pa bshags: sku gsung dam tshig sdom pa bsrung: yang dag sangs rgyas thob par shog: ces rjes zlos bya: de nas mig dar dang bcas gral du 'khod: dam chu sbyin pa ni: hūm̐: 'di nyid 'da' dka' rdo rje'i chu: dam tshig gnyan gyis sdom pa srungs: nyams na na raka dmyal bar ltung : tshul bzhin ldan na dngos grub thob: oṃ badzra sa ma ya khaṃ i dante na ra kan: zhes dam chu sbyin: de nas maṇḍal thogs te: hoḥ dpal chen rdo rje slob dpon dang : phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gtsor: lus ngag yid gsum maṇḍal 'bul: bdag cag dkyil 'khor 'jug smin stsaul: oṃ kā ya tsi a bhe maṇḍal hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon gyis: kyaiḥ khyed rnams skal ldan las 'phro can: mi 'da' rdo rje'i dam tshig mchog: bsrungs na dbang bzhi don dang ldan: bla med dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra dkon: oṃ dharma gu hya tsakra satwaṃ: slob mas: hoḥ bla ma sangs rgyas nyid mchog 'dod: dam chos ye shes lnga ru myong : dam tshig snying gi khrag ltar bsrung : skyon spang dag snang la gnas so: bla mas: hoḥ khyed rnams snod ldan rigs kyi sras: skal ldan las 'phro sad pa'i bu: bla med gsang ba'i dal du 'jug: dkyil 'khor dbang rdzogs smin par bskur: oṃ ma hā rasmi bha wa satwaṃ: de nas nyag gcig chos sku rig pa ye shes rdo rje thogs nas: slob mas: hoḥ nyon mongs nad sel ye shes sman: ma rig bcom pa'i shes rab spyan: zang thal rdo rje slob dpon gyis: bdag gi rab rib mun sel stsol: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ nga ni lta ba'i ye shes rgyal: sgrib g.yogs 'khrul ba'i dbyings dang bral: rig pa chos dbyings thur ma yis: khyod kyi ma rig ling tog bsal: oṃ badzra dharma tsakṣu pra we sha ya phaṭḥ thur mas mig dar bsal te mos pa'i spro ba dang bcas nas phyag 'tshal lo:

slob mas: kyaiḥ gsang sngags dkyil 'khor rlabs po che: ngo mtshar che zhing spro ba bskyed: nged rnams ma dag rmongs pa'i rgyu: 'di don dkyil 'khor ngo sprod stsol: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di: snying po ye shes dgu dang ldan: rnam dag blo yis bcos pa yin: ye nas rang byung ngo sprod bya: oṃ swa bhā wa dharma haṃ: de nas dkyil 'khor gyi rnam bshad chen mo bya ba ni: hoḥ 'dus pa'i 'khor skal ldan rnams legs par nyon cig: dkyil 'khor dbyings nas grub pa ni: chos sku skye ba med pa'i brda: rlung rdo rje rgya gram sogs 'byung ba lnga las grub pa ni: gzhi ye nas snod bcud dkyil 'khor yin pa'i brda: rgyu rkyen stong pa'i hūm̐ dang bhrūm̐ las grub pa ni: dbyings rig gnyis su med pa'i brda: rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i zla gam dmar po sgo gcig ni: kun gyi rig pa 'char sgo gcig pa'i brda: phyi nang mi sgrib cing bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun gyis spras pa ni: chos kun zang thal la lam bdun mi rtog pa brgyad dang ldan pa'i brda: nang rim chos 'khor nyi zla'i 'od kyi gong bu dang rgyan dar sna tshogs 'phyang ba ni: sa bcu gsum rang la rdzogs te tsitta sha yi sgron me'i dkyil nas rgyangs zhag chu yi 'od zer snang ba dkar dmar la rig dang ma rig pa sna tshogs blo 'das su 'char ba'i brda: de'i dbus su padma dmar po 'dab ma stong ldan yod pa ni: kun gzhi skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brda: de'i phyi rol du 'dab ma bzhi dang brgyad yod pa ni: lam bzhi shes pa brgyad dag pa'i brda: dbu ru gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu hūm̐ sgra dang ldan pa ni: dpal chen che mchog khro rgyal rang byung rig pa'i dbyings la lhun grub shar ba'i brda: ye shes lnga'i tshom bu dang ldan pa ni: sa brgyad rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa'i brda: gru bzhi sgo bzhi dang ldan pa ni:

phrin las rnam bzhi tshad med bzhir mtshon pa'i brda: rtsig pa rnam pa lngar bhandha'i kha bad dang ldan pa ni: ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin las ma 'gags pa'i cho 'phrul 'gyed pa'i brda: khro chu'i gzer gyis bsdams shing rmang pha lam las grub pa ni: chos sku rtog med kyi gzer la 'gyur ldog med pa'i brda: lha brgyad klu brgyad kyi ka gdung dang ldan pa ni: rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag nas mi rtog pa'i rig pa brgyad ldan pa'i brda: rgyu skar gyi dral lcam btab cing zhing lpags kyi thog phub pa ni: rtsa khams thig le grangs med gnas shing bem shun gyi rgyan dang ldan pa'i brda: nyi zla'i ka zhu g.yu 'brug gis brgyan pa ni: a haṃ thabs shes kha sbyor rlung 'byin 'jug gi rang sgra dang ldan pa'i brda: chu srin gyi ka gdan byas shing nang rakta'i zham chu dang me ri 'bar ba ni: ye nas rlung sgra gcan gyis rnam shes bzung nas gtong du med cing phung po lha'i pho brang stod chu dang smad me yi rang bzhin las grub pa'i brda: mi lpags kyi bla bre don snying lnga yi 'phan 'phyang ba ni: rnam shes chags pa'i rten nying lag brgyad yin pa'i brda: rin chen pha gu rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa ni: rang sems ye nas 'dod rgu 'byung zhing tshogs drug ma 'gags pa'i brda: drwa ba mun nag la me 'bar zhing sgra sgrogs pa ni: ye shes lnga la gzhi ma rig pa'i dri ma bral te 'khrul rtog chos nyid du grol zhing grags stong gi brda: rgyu ma dang brgyus pa'i dril bu rnga yab 'phan rtse gsum pas brgyan pa ni: shes rig ma 'gags pa'i rang rtsal sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: mi yi drwa ba mkhal mchin pho rdo brkyangs shing g.yer kha'i sgra sgrogs pa ni: 'khor 'das kun gyi sgra thams cad tshig gi brda dgos pa'i brda: rlung ras mi lpags stag lpags sbrul sogs 'phyang ba ni: ye shes lnga yi rang rtsal gyis nyon mongs pa sna tshogs g.yer ba'i brda:

mda' yab dkar po shel dang rgyang grags byi ru g.yu sogs rin po che'i mchod rten dang ldan pa ni: dbyings ma bcos lhun grub 'byung ba rin po che'i mchod rten yin pa'i brda: phyogs bzhi'i ka ba gshin rje dang gdung ma phyogs skyong khro bo khro mo'i zhu la keng rus kyi ka rgyan klu'i gdan byas pa ni: dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor rang byung khro bo'i pho brang log lta can gyis mi mthong ba'i brda: zhing skyong pho mo 'phro zhing phyogs bzhi'i ka rgyan seṅge 'brug chu srin stag las byas pa ni: che mchog dkyil 'khor phyi rol du sha za 'gyu bas dam med rnams bgrod du mi btub pa'i brda: rta babs bzhir ma mo ke'u ri ma 'phro zhing klong dgur khang bzang dgu dang ldan pa las ma mo ke'u 'gyu ba ni: tshad med pa'i ngo bor bdag 'dzin bral zhing sgo dgu rnams rnams 'gyu lam ma bkag pas rang shar du grol ba'i brda: chos 'khor bcu gnyis la khro bo khro mo'i rang sgra dang ldan zhing za ram ā li kā li'i sgra sgrogs pa ni: snang srid chos nyid kyi rang sgrar phyi nang dang bral ba'i brda: nyi zla nor bu'i phyi rol du lha yi khye'us gar bsgyur ba ni: rang byung gi rig pa sna tshogs 'char ba'i brda: ri dwags rma bya khyung dang mi gcer bu gnas pa ni: 'khor 'das gzhi gcig la lam sna tshogs 'char te ngos bzung stong zhing bral ba'i brda: gzhal yas kyi steng thams cad du rgyal mtshan sna tshogs phyar ba ni: dpal gyi pho brang mtshan nyid stong dang ldan pa'i brda: keng rus kyis gar bsgyur ba ni: chos sku mtshan ma'i gzugs dang bral ba'i brda: pho brang gi phyi rol padma'i phreng bas bskor ba ni: ye nas snod thams cad kun tu bzang mo'i bha ga yangs pa'i klong yin pa'i brda: dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba ni: rnam shes tshogs brgyad rang byung du grol ba'i brda: zla phyed rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba ni:

rdo rje'i klong la 'khor 'das med pa'i brda: mtshon dang me ri'i gur khang ldan pa ni: dkyil 'khor bsrungs mtshams med pa mi shigs pa'i gur dang ldan pa'i brda: gter bum chen po brgyad dang ldan pa ni: rang byung ye shes kyi gter rnyed nas 'khor 'das kun la re dogs bral ba'i brda: dkyil 'khor phyi nang gsum dang ldan pa ni: gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum thig le gcig la rdzogs pa'i brda: de'i dbus su che mchog he ru ka smug nag tu bzhugs pa ni: gzhi chos kyi dbyings la 'gyur ba med pa'i brda: dbu nyi shu rtsa gcig ni: byang sems thig le nyi shu rtsa gcig gi mtshon pa'i brda: spyan mig drug cu rtsa gsum 'khyil ba ni: gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro drug cu rtsa bzhi mtshon pa'i brda: sma ra smin ma la me 'bar zhing shangs nas rlung g.yo ba ni: ma rig pa'i dri ma bsregs shing nyon mongs pa'i bgegs gtor ba'i brda: dbu skra steng gi phyogs la gzengs shing khyung dang thod skam gyis brgyan pa ni: dbyings zang thal la dug lnga'i sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba'i brda: dar nag gi cod pan dang sbrul rigs lngas brgyan pa ni: phung po lnga ma spangs shing gnas su dag pa'i brda: phyag g.yas nyi shus gnam lcags rdo rje gsor thabs su gdeng ba ni: pho rgyud khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu rdzogs pa'i brda: g.yon pa nyi shus dung dmar rakta bsnams pa ni: mo rgyud kun gyi snying po gcig tu 'dus pa'i brda: rtsa phyag gis gri thod thugs kar bsnol ba ni: thabs dang shes rab 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: rdo rje dang rin po che'i sgro gshog brgyangs pa ni: chos sku'i rtsal las longs sku ma 'gags par 'gyu ba ston pa'i brda: dur khrod chas brgyad dpal gyi chas bcu gnyis dang ldan pa ni: tshogs brgyad gnas su dag ste skye 'chi bcu gnyis rang sar dag pa'i brda: zhabs bco brgyad dor thabs su bgrad cing byol song gtso brgyad mnan pa ni:

sa lam bco brgyad rdzogs te 'bras bu kun gzhi'i klong du gyur pa'i brda: bskal pa'i me ri 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs pa ni: ye nas ma rig pa'i dri ma dang bral ba'i brda: yum gnam zhal gtso mo pang du 'khyud pa ni: gdod nas dbyings bde stong 'gyur ba med pa'i brda: zhal dgu dang ldan pa ni: theg pa rim dgu ye nas rdzogs pa'i brda: spyan rtsa bdun shin tu bgrad pa ni: gsal ba'i lam mchog rtsa bdun sku la rdzogs pa'i brda: ral pa rdo rje dang thod skam sbrul rigs lnga dang dar gyi cod pan 'phur ba ni: sku lnga zang thal ye nas rdzogs pa'i brda: nyi zla nor bus snyan la brgyan pa ni: gsal stong zung du 'jug pa'i brda: g.yas dgus gri gug dang g.yon pa dgus dung khrag stob pa ni: dug lnga ma spangs dbyings su dag te dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i brda: rus rgyan dur khrod chas dang ldan zhing gzig sham dkris pa ni: 'khor 'das snang srid gcig tu ston pa'i brda: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum bde stong 'khril ba ni: phyi nang rten 'brel don dang ldan pa'i brda: yab yum spyi bor rdor sems kun bzang bzhugs pa ni: dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med pa'i brda: ye shes khrag 'thung rigs brgyad kyis bskor ba ni: zhi khro rab 'byams ye nas rdzogs pa'i brda: klu brgyad byol song gdan la 'gyings pa ni: mtha' yas sems can thugs kyis 'dren pa'i brda: sgo srung don gyi he ru ka bzhugs pa ni: khregs chod lta ba ro gcig shar ba'i brda: zhi ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyis rab tu bskor ba ni: chos kun ye nas buddha'i zhing khams yin pa'i brda: khro bo'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba ni: ma dag pa'i snang ba tshar gcod cing dag pa ye shes su ston pa'i brda: shar du yang dag gi dkyil 'khor gsal ba ni: thugs kyi lha tshogs thams cad dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'dus pa'i brda: lho ru 'jam dpal gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba ni:

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bo gcig tu 'dus pa'i brda: nub tu dbang chen rta mgrin gyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba ni: gsung gi lha tshogs thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i brda: byang du phur pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba ni: sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las lha tshogs gcig tu 'dus pa'i brda: shar lhor ma mo rbod gtong gi dkyil 'khor gsal ba ni: bla med rgyud kyi lha tshogs thams cad gcig tu rdzogs pa'i brda: lho nub tu rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor thod phreng rtsal gyi lha tshogs gsal ba ni: dgongs brda rten 'brel 'dus pa'i chos bzhi gcig tu rdzogs pa'i brda: nub byang du 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba ni: sangs rgyas kyi mthu stobs lha tshogs gcig tu 'dus pa'i brda: byang shar du dmod pa drag sngags kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba ni: sangs rgyas kun gyi drag sngags kyi lha tshogs gcig tu 'dus pa'i brda: dkyil 'khor gyi bar khyams phyi nang la ye shes dang 'jig rten gyi sha za chos skyong thams cad rdzogs pa ni: skal ngan log par lta ba'i rigs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i brda: pho brang gi phyi nang la 'ja' 'od kyi zer 'khrigs pa ni: ye shes kyi klong dgu dang ldan pa'i brda: phyi yi drwa ba dang ral gri'i rgyal mtshan kha ṭwāṃ rnams ni: sgrub pa'i bar chad bsgral ba'i brda: mda' gzhu me long cod pan 'phur ba ni: rten 'brel gyi chos bzhi dang ldan pa'i brda: nyi zla nor bu sogs rgyan du mas spras pa ni: rdo rje slob dpon la dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i brda: sgo ma bzhi'i phyag mtshan ni: tshad med pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i brda: phyi nang gi mchod pa sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa ni: chos dbyings mdzod la zad pa med pa'i brda: sa rgyan dang gnam rgyan yol ba dang dar dpyangs te rnam pa sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa ni: zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i brda:

rdo rje slob dpon la phyi nang chas dang khri gdan maṇḍal phun sum tshogs pa ni: gsang sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dar la yun ring du gnas pa'i brda: khyed rang rnams kyis dkyil 'khor zab mo 'di mjal ba ni: mkha' spyod o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing khams mngon sum du bgrod pa'i brda yin no: de lta bus khyed rang rnams dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du: dkyil 'khor pho brang dgu dang ldan pa 'di yid la zungs shig sa ma ya: zhes legs par ngo sprad cing : phyi nang gi rnam dbye yang rab tu phyes shing bshad par bya'o/ /de nas dar tshon sna lnga la bcos pa'i me tog gam: tsam pa ka'i me tog rnams slob ma rnams kyis thogs nas thal mo sbyar ba'i srin mdzub kyis dkyil 'khor dbus su dor: kyaiḥ bdag gis tshe rabs 'di bar du: sngon nas bsgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang : deng 'dir smon lam ldan pa yis: yi dam lha dang bdag sprod cig: oṃ badzra puṣpe pra ti hoḥ zhes dor te gang du babs pa'i ming btags: shar du babs na zhi ba'i lha nas ming btags: lhor rgyas pa'i lha nas ming btags: nub tu dbang gi lha nas ming btags: byang nas drag po'i lha nas mi btags: de nas cod pan spyi bor bzhag ste: hūm̐: cod pan ye shes lnga yi rtags: deng nas dkyil 'khor 'dzin mdzad cing : che mchog lha dang skal ba mnyam: gsang ba rdo rje'i ming thob shog: oṃ badzra mu ḍa dhā ti ta hoḥ hoḥ khyod ma 'ongs par sangs rgyas lta ba mi shigs pa rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya bar sangs rgyas: bla mas: khyed kyi ming ci yin gsung rtsar: slob mas: lta ba mi shigs pa: rdo rje snying po zhes bya ba lags so: zhes smra bar bya: de nas phur pa lag tu gtad de: hūm̐: dam tshig dbang po brten pa'i phyir: gsang ba bla med phur pa 'chang : deng nas bsgrub par srog ltar brtson: dam med rnams la reg mi bya: oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha nan kī la ya hūm̐: de nas ma dag pa'i rgyud sbyangs shing dag pa ye shes su 'char ba'i phyir:

phyi bskyed rim lha sku'i rnal 'byor 'bog pa ni: bsang chu 'thor zhing : oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces so: oṃ swa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las snod bcud thams cad ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa e'i rang bzhin can: 'byung lnga brtsegs thabs su spel ba'i pho brang chen po dgu dang ldan pa'i dbus su: nyi zla padma bam dang lha klu byol song gtso brgyad bsnol ba'i steng du: che mchog he ru ka chen po sku mdog smug nag dbu nyi shu rtsa gcig khro zhing phyag bzhi bcu zhe gnyis: rdo rje dang bhandha bsnams pa: rdo rje rin po che'i sgro gshog brgyangs shing dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs la zhabs bco brgyad brkyang bskum 'gying ba: de'i pang du khro mo gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu khro la phyag bco brgyad gri thod 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa: dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs la zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum yab kyi sked nas 'khril zhing : yab yum me ri dmar nag 'khrigs pa'i klong du thugs yig 'bras bu sa bon sngags dang bcas pa'i spyi bor rdor sems kun bzang sems dpa' khyung dang bcas te zhi khro'i lha tshogs gsal ba'o: shar du pad nyi ru tra'i gdan la yang dag he ru ka mthing nag yum kro ti shwa rī ma dang 'khril zhing thugs kyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa'o: lho ru chu glang pad nyi'i gdan la 'jam dpal gshin rje ser nag yum bhe ta li 'khril zhing sku'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'o: nub tu klu dbang pad nyi'i gdan la dbang chen rta mgrin dmar pos yum padma gzi ldan la 'khril zhing gsung gi lha tshogs dang bcas pa'o: byang tu gnod sbyin dang pad nyi'i gdan la phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mar 'khril zhing phrin las kyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa'o: shar lhor pad nyi zla gdan la bla med he ru ka ljang nag yum nyid zhi kun bzang la 'khril zhing yon tan gyi lha tshogs gsal ba'o:

lho nub tu ru tra pad nyi'i gdan la drag po dmar nag me phreng can yum rdo rje bdud 'dul mar 'khril zhing bla ma rig 'dzin gyi lha tshogs gsal ba'o: nub byang du dam sri dang pad nyi'i gdan la dregs pa stobs ldan kham nag yum srid gsum spyi 'dul mar 'khril zhing gnyis med kyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa'o: byang shar du ru tra'i bam gyi gdan la dmod pa khrag 'thung nag po yum 'byung lnga'i khro mor 'khril zhing drag sngags rbad pa'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'o: de rnams khro shing gtum pa dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs shing phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin cing : sku la bskal pa'i me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyis nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang khyab cing chos nyid kyi rang sgra dang bcas par byon te skal ldan slob ma rnams la thim par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod: oṃ badzra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ a we sha ya dza dzaḥ zhes byin 'bebs rgyas par bya zhing rol mo gdangs dbyangs snyan par bya zhing dri bzang gi dud pa phul te spyan drang ngo : ye shes pa phebs pa'i rtags su lus g.yo zhing mi phyed pa'i spro ba skye bar 'byung : de ltar ma byung bar du yang yang spyan drangs shing bstim: sa ma ya: de nas slob ma dang dbyer med thim par bya zhing rdo rje rgya gram gnas lngar rgyas gdab la: oṃ ye shes pa brtan par gyur cig tiṣṭha badzra: zhes rgya gram bya: de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: hūm̐: chos sku bla ma dbyings nas gshegs: āḥ rtog med rang byung gdan la bzhugs: oṃ: gnyis med sprul skur phyag 'tshal lo: hrīḥ phyi nang yid spyod mchod pa 'bul: hoḥ lus ngag yid gsum sdig pa bshags: trām̐: chos 'khor bskor zhing dbang mchog stsol: de nas maṇḍal phul te: dbang bskur ba la 'jug pa ni: bum pa thogs te ngo sprad cing : hūm̐: sprul sku klong yangs bum pa zlum:

yi dam sku dang gnyis su med: skal ldan khyod kyi spyi bor bskur: bskyed rim sku yi dbang thob shog: oṃ he ru ka kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des sku'i dbang thob pa yin pas maṇḍal phul: de nas bhandha thogs nas: hūm̐: longs sku ye shes bhandha'i zhing : bdud rtsi gsung dang gnyis su med: skal ldan khyed kyi mgrin par bskur: grags stong sngags kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ he ru ka wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhais maṇḍal phul: de nas me long thogs te: hūm̐: chos nyid skye med me long dbyings: che mchog thugs dang gnyis su med: skal ldan khyod kyi snying khar bskur: yang dag ye shes dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra he ru ka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gtor ma thogs te: hūm̐: 'dod yon sna tshogs bcud kyis brgyan: dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med: skal ldan khyod kyi lte bar bskur: gnyis med zung 'jug dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra he ru ka hrī ṭha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas sku 'bag thogs te: hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog he ru ka'i: sku gsung thugs yon bla na med: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: yongs rdzogs dbang mchog thob par shog: oṃ badzra he ru ka ma ma siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur ba ni: rdo rje thogs te: hūm̐: khro rgyal g.yas kyi phyag mtshan ni: rdo rje 'bar ba nyi shu gcig: hūm̐ bhyo pheṃ gyi rang sgra can: bde ba thabs kyi dbang bskur te: oṃ badzra ba shi ka dha ha na dha ri ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: g.yas su gtad: bhandha thogs nas: hūm̐: khro rgyal g.yon gyi phyag mtshan ni: bhan dmar rakta chi li li: bla med gsang ba'i rdzas chen po: stong pa shes rab dbang bskur ro: oṃ bhandha rakta ha shi ba le dha ri ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas thod skam prog zhu gtad de: hūm̐: thod skam 'bar ba'i prog zhu 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi spyi bor bskon: ye shes lnga yi ngo bo nyid:

dbu rgyan cod pan dbang thob shog: oṃ bhandha pañtsa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: thal chen tshom bu thogs nas: hūm̐: thal chen 'bar ba'i tshom bu dang : khrag thig zhag gi zo ris 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi lus la byugs: 'dod chags ma spangs bde bar spyod: oṃ badzra rā ga he a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: glang ko stod du g.yogs la: hūm̐: glang ko stobs bcu'i g.yang gzhi 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi stod du g.yogs: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo'i dbang : gti mug ma spangs bde bar spyod: oṃ tsarya dharma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rdo rje'i go khrab thogs te: hūm̐: mi shigs rdo rje'i snying po can: sra brtan 'jigs med pha lam go: skal ldan khyod kyi lus la bskon: skye med go cha'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra sa ma dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhing lpags thogs nas: hūm̐: zhing chen g.yang gzhi'i rtog med gos: skal ldan khyod kyi rgyab tu gyon: gnyis med ye shes lhun grub dbang : nga rgyal ma spangs bde bar spyod: oṃ ma tsarya dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: chu srin stod g.yogs thogs nas: hūm̐: chu srin 'bar ba'i stod g.yogs 'di: skal ldan khyod kyi phrag par brgyan: ngo bo de bzhin nyid kyi dbang : bzang ngan blang dor bral bar spyod: oṃ bha tra a surtsi swa bhā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sbrul chun thod phreng thogs nas: hūm̐: thod phreng dug sbrul chun po 'di: ga shal yan lag brgyan par gyis: me long ye shes rang byung dbang : zhe sdang ma spangs bde bar spyod: oṃ mo hā a darsha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rus sbal gyi rgyan thogs nas: hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub rus sbal phreng : skal ldan khyod kyi sku reg chings: lug 'byung ldog pa ye shes che: chags lam nyon mongs bde bar spyod: oṃ rā ga pra mo ti ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rus rgyan thogs nas: hūm̐: pha rol phyin drug rus pa'i rgyan: skal ldan khyod kyi lus la brgyan:

gsang ba'i gzungs ma bde stong yum: shes rab btsun mo ma spangs zungs: oṃ prañdzā pa ti dha ti ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: stag sham thogs nas: hūm̐: stag gi sham thabs drag po'i chas: skal ldan khyod kyi smad du dkris: bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid: phrag dog ma spangs bde bar spyod: oṃ a ti sha pra mo ti ri a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas yum mchog thogs nas: hūm̐: dbyings phyug chen mo bde chen yum: shes rab phar phyin kro ti ma: skal ldan khyod kyi pang du 'khyud: gsang sngags dkyil 'khor bsgrub par gyis: oṃ kro ti bha ta ṇi gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas yum gyi phyag mtshan dang dur khrod kyi chas thogs nas: hūm̐: gri gug thod khrag bde stong rgyan: gzig sham la sogs dur khrod chas: gsang ba nyid kyi yum la brgyan: mchog gi bla med thob par shog: oṃ u ta a nu ta ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: me dpung thogs nas: hūm̐: ye shes me dpung rab tu 'bar: yab yum bzhugs pa'i klong gur gyur: skal ldan khyod kyi srung 'khor gyis: drag sngags me yi dbang thob shog: oṃ tsaṇḍa aṇḍa ram̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas kun bzang thogs te: hūm̐: chos sku skye med phrin las rdzogs: ka dag zang thal ngo bo nyid: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs dang mnyam: skal ldan khyod la rigs bdag bskur: oṃ sa mānta bha tra saṃ bha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rdor sems thogs te: hūm̐: longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i bdag: sna tshogs rang sar 'gags med pa: skal ldan khyod kyi skyabs yul du: longs sku sems dpa'i dbang bskur ro: oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bya khyung thogs te: hūm̐: che mchog thugs las sprul pa yi: ye shes bya khyung ga ru ḍas: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: klu srin 'byung po'i gnyen por sgoms: oṃ dzñā na kā la ga ru ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas he ru ka yab yum bcu drug thogs nas:

hūm̐: ye shes gsal stong rig stong pa: bde stong mngon byung dran rig mchog: lhan skyes kun grol khro bo brgyad: khro mo dang bcas dbang bskur ro: oṃ dzñā na kro ta kro ti dā sha kha ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sgo srung thogs nas: hūm̐: khro chen don gyi he ru kaḥ ye shes 'khor lo'i sgo skyong ba: skal ldan slob mar dbang bskur ro: 'char sgo ye shes dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra dharma gha te a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas 'jam dpal sku spyi bor bzhag cing : hūm̐: sku yi bdag nyid gshin rje gshed: yum mchog bhe ta za byed sbyor: skal ldan khyod kyi spyi bor bskur: sku yi lha tshogs dbang rdzogs shog: oṃ ya mānta ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rta mgrin mgrin par gtad de: hūm̐: khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa'i skus: padma gzi ldan yum dang sbyor: skal ldan khyod kyi mgrin par bskur: gsung gi lha tshogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra kro ta hya ghṛ wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: yang dag snying khar gtad cing : hūm̐: dpal chen thugs kyi he ru kar: yum mchog kro ti shwa rīr 'khril: skal ldan khyod kyi snying khar bskur: thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ he ru ka badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: ma mo rbod gtong lte bar bzhag cing : hūm̐: bla med ma mo yongs rdzogs skus: yum chen nyid zhi kun bzang 'khril: skal ldan khyod kyi lte bar bskur: yon tan yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ he ru ka ru lu ru lu a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phur pa phrin las gsang bar gtad cing : hūm̐: khro rgyal badzra kī la yas: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'khril: skal ldan khyod kyi gsang bar bskur: phrin las dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: drag po dpung pa g.yas su gtad de: hūm̐: bla ma drag po thod phreng rtsal: yum chen gsang ba ye shes 'khril: skal ldan dpung pa g.yas su bskur:

yang gsang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ artsig nirtsig thod phreng rtsal a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 'jig rten mchod bstod dpung pa g.yon du bzhag ste: hūm̐: khro rgyal stobs ldan he ru kasaḥ yum mchog srid gsum spyi 'dul 'khril: skal ldan dpung pa g.yon du bskur: gnyis med dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ badzra duṣḍa na lokka kro ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dmod pa drag sngags brla g.yas su gtad cing : hūm̐: drag sngags dmod pa'i khrag 'thung skus: yum chen 'byung lnga'i bdag mor 'khril: skal ldan brla g.yas dag tu bskur: drag sngags mthu stobs yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ sarba duṣḍa na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: mgon po bya rog brla g.yon du gtad cing : hūm̐: khrag 'thung mgon po bya rog gdong : yum chen tsaṇḍi dmar mor 'khyud: skal ldan khyod kyi brla g.yon bskur: khrag 'thung gter srung dbang thob shog: oṃ ma hā kā la kha kha mu kha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas khyung brgyad snga ma ltar gnas so sor gtug cing : hūm̐: khro chen 'bar ba'i thugs las sprul: mi bzad bya khyung sna tshogs 'di: rim bzhin lha yi spyi bor brgyan: bya khyung brgyad kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ khroṃ ga ru ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bskur: 'di'i mtshams su tsakli dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bskur na zur du gsal: sa ma ya: de nas 'ja' lus bum pa'i dbang bskur ba ni: ye shes lnga'i 'ja' gur dang me long thogs te: hūm̐: snang zhing stong la gsal zhing dwangs: nam mkha'i dbyings dang 'ja' tshon bzhin: stong gzugs sgyu ma'i ngang tshul gyis: bskyed rim sku yi dbang thob shog: oṃ swa bhā wa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hoḥ snang zhing ngo bo stong pa'i dbyings la 'ja' shar ba'am chu zla'i dkyil 'khor ltar bskyed rim sgyu ma lta bu'i skur bsgom pa la dbang : snang ba stong pa'i rang rtsal gyi ngo sprod thob pa yin pas: deng phyin chad dkyil 'khor bsgrub par byed pa la las su rung ba'o:

de nas mgrin par padma'i phreng ba'am dbyangs can bzhag la: hūm̐: shes rab rang rtsal stong pa'i sgra: ma 'gags grags stong snying po can: gsang ba sngags kyi sgrub sde mo: skal ldan khyod kyi mgrin par bskur: oṃ prañdza mu ḍa aṇḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hoḥ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang chen po thob pa yin pas: deng phyin chad gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs shing sngags bzlas thams cad grags stong ma 'gags pa'i 'byin 'jug rdo rje'i sngags su shes shing : bzlas pa snying por bsgrub pa las su rung ba yin no: de nas shel rdo'am snang stong gang rigs thogs la: hūm̐: chos nyid gsal stong g.ya' dang bral: ka dag rang shar ye nas stong : khregs chod gshis lugs blo las 'das: rang byung ngo bo'i dbang bskur ro: oṃ dharma swa bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hoḥ kun gzhi skye ba med pa zang thal ye nas rang byung rig pa'i ngo bo 'od gsal dbyings gnyis su med pa'i snying po: sangs rgyas kyis ma bcos: sems can gyis ma bsgyur ba de'i rang bzhin mngon sum du ngo sprod thob pa yin pas: deng phyin chad a ti bla med yang snying 'dus pa'i gshis lugs skyong du rung ngo : de nas tshig mtshan nyid dbye ba gnyis med rtsal dbang bskur ba ni: sgro mdongs sam rtsa 'khor lo lnga'i dpe'u ris thogs nas: hūm̐: rang byung rlung gi snying po can: ye shes ngo bo 'gyu ba yi: rta la bsten nas 'char sgo ru: rtsa rlung thig le'i dbang thob shog: oṃ a wa dhū ti kunda yam̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hoḥ rig pa skye ba med pa rang byung gi snying po ma 'gags pa rlung gi rta dang bcas te: dbu ma dang ro rkyang gi lam la brgyud nas phyi nang gi 'char sgo thams cad rang rtsal las grub pa: de yang ye shes kyi rlung dang ma rig pa'i rlung gnyis zung 'brel du rgyu: rtsa yang stong pa'i rang mdangs can thig le yang 'od kyi gong bu mdangs ldan srog 'dzin bcu drug dang bcas nas chags:

lugs su 'byung ba'i tshe: srid pa'i 'khor lo dang : ldog pa'i tshe ye shes bzhi sbyor lnga'i 'khor lo: de yang rtsa rlung 'byin 'jug rdo rje'i lus kyi rnam bshad thob pas deng phyin chad pho nya'i myur lam bsgom du rung : sa ma ya: de nas gsang dbang bskur ba ni: rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan par khrus byas shing gos dkar bskon: bla ma la maṇḍal gyi tshul du dbul ba ni: kyaiḥ dpa' bo thugs rje che ba'i mchog: gsang sngags ston pa'i sa mkhan po: padma dbyangs can rig ma 'di: lam mchog zhugs phyir maṇḍal phul: oṃ padma mu ḍa maṇḍal keṃ nirya ta ya mi: rdo rje slob dpon gyis rgyu 'bras bcu'i chos legs par bshad de rgyud grol bar bya: de nas rigs lnga sogs rgyan gyis spras nas: 'bru yi padma 'dab brgyad kyi khar bzhag ste: bum chu'i bsang sbyangs gsol nas: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lho nub rnga yab padma 'od kyi zhing nas: rig 'dzin chen po padma 'byung gnas yab yum la: 'khor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor ba skad cig gis byon nas: bdag dang gzungs ma'i spyi bor zhugs: thugs dam gyis rgyud bskul nas byang sems dkar dmar gyi sprin 'phros te bhandha'i bdud rtsi dkar dmar la thim: slar yang 'od du zhu ste yum gyi tshangs bug tu thim: rim bzhin snying khar ye shes sems dpa' lam mer sgoms shig: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ badzra padma rā ga ya hoḥ rā ga ya mi: pra mo ti ri kunda li rakta a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: zhes bdud rtsi dang rakta lan gsum dkrugs: de nas rdo rje slob dpon yab yum gyis dam tshig gi lam nas bdud rtsi phab ste: sman raka la gnyis su med par bsres: slob ma rnams kyis: hoḥ gsang ba bla na med pa yi: yang dag rdo rje'i grol lam mchog: deng 'dir bdag la stsal du gsol: dam tshig srog gi snying por bsrung: rdo rje slob dpon gyis:

hoḥ khyed cag dam tshig ldan lags na: gsang rgyud mkha' 'gro'i nye lam bsten: nyams na sha zas srog lus phral: bsrungs na tshe gcig sangs rgyas nyid: oṃ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor ram bdud rtsi nang mchod byang sems sbyar ba ngag tu byin cing : gnas lnga ru thig le bya: de nas gzungs ma bzhengs te rdo rje slob dpon gyis gzungs ma'i phyag g.yon nas 'dzin cing : slob bu rnams la gtad pa'i tshul gyis dbang bskur ba ni: hūm̐: shes rab yid 'ong dge ba'i grogs: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem brda skad sgrogs: 'di bsten bde stong lhag gis 'char: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i dbang thob shog: oṃ mu ḍa rā ga ya hoḥ de nas gzungs ma'i zhabs slob ma rnams kyis spyi bor blangs: de nas rol cing ye shes lnga'i ngo bo skyong : hoḥ gsang ba mi phyed mkha' 'gro ma: khyed rnams 'di nyid rtag tu bsten: thig le 'bebs ldog dgram par gyis: ye shes chen po'i ngo bo skyongs: de nas ngo bo ka dag ngang du lhan ne bzhag: hoḥ mkha' 'gro'i sku yi dam tshig tu: bud med smad par mi bya zhing : mkha' 'gro'i gsung gi dam tshig tu: rtag tu bha gar mchod par byed: mkha' 'gro'i thugs kyi dam tshig tu: gsang sngags lam mchog smad mi bya: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i dam tshig rnams: gnas khang 'di yi phyi rol tu: dam med rnams la smra mi bya: de nas maṇḍal phul zhing me tog 'thor: sa ma ya: gsang dbang rgyas pa logs su gsal: de nas 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad gtad de: hoḥ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis: dbang bskur chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: sems can rgyud rnams smin par gyis: bla med mchog dang ldan par shog: oṃ dharma gha hri āḥhūm̐: de nas dung dkar gtad de: hoḥ skye med grags stong chos kyi sgra: 'gro ba lha mi'i sgra skad du: bshad cing spel sgrub 'chad rtsod rtsom: snyan grags chos kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ dharma shang kha shabda āḥhūm̐:

rdo rje gtad de: hoḥ thabs chen bla med lam gyi mchog: kun rdzob la brten don dam rnyed: dam tshig phyag rgya ldan par gyis: oṃ badzra mu ṭa ya hoḥ dril bu gtad cing : hoḥ shes rab snyan dbyangs theg pa dgu: dgra bcom nyan thos rang rgyal dang : kṛ ya u pa yo ga ste: ma hā a nu a ti'o: oṃ dharma ma hā ṣa na hoḥ de nas po ti gtad cing : hūm̐: chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi: bka' yi 'dus sde ma lus pa'i: 'dzin 'chang gsung rab yan lag bcu: don ldan theg pa la gnas shog: oṃ badzra dharma dhā ra hṛ dha hoḥ de nas rdo rje rgya gram lag tu gtad cing : hoḥ zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las bzhi'i: las kyi rim pa ma lus par: deng nas khyod kyis brtson par gyis: gang 'dul der ston dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra karma tsa tur hoḥ de nas blugs gzar gtad de: hoḥ chos nyid ye shes snod mchog thabs: nyon mongs bud shing la sogs pa'i: 'khor 'das ma rig bsreg par gyis: hom gzar la sogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra a hu ti āḥhūm̐: de nas gtor ma gtad cing : hoḥ che mchog rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la: bsnyen sgrub tshogs dang skong bshags dang : dus mchod rgyun gtor brtson par gyis: bsod nams tshogs chen dbang dang ldan: oṃ bha lingta gha na tsakra hoḥ de nas rdo rje gtad cing : hūm̐: khro rgyal las kyi phyag mtshan 'di: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: ting 'dzin longs spyod 'grub par gyis: zil gnon rang bzhin dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra sa ma ya ti hoḥ de nas phur pa gtad de: hūm̐: khro rgyal las kyi brtul zhugs mtshon: deng 'dir skal ldan khyod la gtad: bstan dgra sgos dgra nyon mongs sgrol: ma rig bsgral ba'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas raksha'i phreng ba gtad nas: hūm̐: ting 'dzin skye med ngang nyid las: gsang ba dmod pa'i sngags phreng 'di: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: snying po gzungs dang drag sngags sgrogs:

oṃ raksha bhandha ma li ta hūm̐: thun snod gtad cing : hūm̐: chu gnas dmar po thun gyi snod: 'dzin shes gtong yang mi nus te: drag sngags dmod pa'i pho brang nyid: rbad pa'i sngags thun 'dzin par gyis: oṃ aṇa ḍa dha ra hoḥ de nas phod kha dang sngags zhwa gtad cing : hūm̐: dmod pa drag sngags nag po'i zhwa: khams gsum zil gnon bklubs pa'i gos: rtag tu ngan sngags zhwa gos 'chang : bdud bzhi zil gnon dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra du kha na ya hoḥ srung 'khor gtad cing : hūm̐: stong nyid chos dbyings srung ba'i gur: mtshon cha mi shigs drwa ba'i gur: phyi nang gdon bgegs srung ba'i mchog: srung 'khor gur khang dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra tsakra rakṣa hoḥ liṅga 'gugs shing : hūm̐: che mchog thugs las sprul pa yi: sras nyid rdo rje khrag 'thung skus: khro rgyal 'dril zhing 'debs pa'i mtshon: phyi nang bar chad dbyings su sgrol: oṃ badzra kī la ya: gnod byed mā ra ya rbad ya: thams cad kyis bsgral: de nas gtub cing rol la: hūm̐: khro rgyal chen po'i dam tshig tu: sbyor sgrol spyod pa mi 'bral bya: rtag tu dug lnga'i sha khrag rol: sgrol ba las kyi dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra sa ma ya ma hā māṃ sa rakta khā hi: liṅga dum bu zhig hom du sbar la: hūm̐: snang srid snod kyi me hom dbus: nyon mongs dug lnga'i dgra bgegs bsgral: deng phyin sbyin sreg brtson par gyis: sreg pa las bzhi'i dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐ hoḥ de nas rdo g.yam la yi ge tri re re bris nas rang mal de ru mnan nam sgo drung du mnan la: hūm̐: mdun du tri las dgra bo khug: rim dgu sa yi 'og tu non: dam sri sgab 'dre gnon par gyis: 'gugs dang mnan gtad las thob shog: oṃ tri dam sri mā ra ya nan: de nas bzlog pa ni: dpal gtor rtsang gis brgyan pa g.yas su thogs la/ hūm̐: srid pa'i dregs chen rngam pa'i snod: dmar nag gtor chen rtsang gis brgyan:

bskul bas phyi nang rkyen ngan bzlog: bzlog bskul drag po'i las thob shog: oṃ badzra ru tra mā ra ya zlog ya: de nas dgra phyogs su 'bebs: de nas drag po'i sa zor thogs nas: hūm̐: pho nya rbad pa'i zor gyi bdag: bzlog med thun dang mtshon gyis brgyan: dam nyams dgra la gtor zor ya: las mtha' yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ badzra thun bhyo rbad bhyo dgra la bzlog bhyoḥ zhes zor dgra yul du log na bskyal te 'phen: de nas mda' dar thogs te: hūm̐: phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: sgo skyong mgyogs ma pho nya 'bum: snang srid tshe yi bcud bsdus la: mda' dar g.yab cing deng 'dir stsol: oṃ badzra ā yurdzñā na siddhi hūm̐: de nas tshe ril thogs te: hūm̐: dgos 'dod kun 'byung bla med rdzas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dngos grub nyid: deng 'dir skal ldan khyod la sbyin: rtag tu dngos grub mchog thob shog: oṃ gha na la ā yurdzñā na siddhi hoḥ de nas tshe chang thogs la: hūm̐: dam tshig bdud rtsi 'chi med rdzas: nyams rtogs 'phel zhing bde drod skyed: bcud dang rtsa rlung yar ldan pa: byin rlabs chu rgyun gter 'byung shog: oṃ a mṛ ta khā hi: de nas rigs lnga mgor bzhag ste: hūm̐: dus rnams kun tu dkyil 'khor bdag: rigs la dbang zhing rgyan du 'chang : dbang chen la sogs 'chad par gyis: 'dus par rigs bdag dbang thob shog: oṃ buddha dharma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun gtad: hūm̐: bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor la: bsnyen bkur maṇḍal 'bul bar gyis: oṃ maṅga laṃ aṣṭa rā dza dhi swa bhā hoḥ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rje'i gzungs thag gtad cing : hūm̐: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor gyi: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs las mtha' sogs: yongs rdzogs deng 'dir khyod la gtad:

tshe rabs kun tu brtan par zungs: oṃ badzra aṣḍa tsakra dha ti ta siddhi hoḥ zhes dkyil 'khor gtad de rab tu gnas par bya: de nas rdo rje thogs te: hoḥ brtan par gyur cig dkyil 'khor tshogs: rgyas par gyur cig snyan grags chos: 'phel bar gyur cig dge ba'i stobs: 'grub par gyur cig bden pa'i tshig: oṃ tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ: badzra bi shwa hoḥ de nas slob ma rnams kyis: dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi nas smon lam btab cing : bskor ba gsum phyag gsum bya: slob dpon gyis dam tshig bstan pa ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i dbang dang bka' gtad lung 'bog thob pa yin pas: dkyil 'khor sgom pa dang sgrub pa spel ba 'dzin pa sogs bya zhing : sku yi dam tshig tu rdo rje slob dpon la mi smad cing tha na kha tsam ku re bzhad gad tsam la yang mi spang mi smad: slob dpon gyi lcam dang gzungs ma sogs la yang skyon spang zhing : dbang gi gral du 'khod pa rnams dam tshig rdo rje'i spun grogs yin pas: 'chi ba srog la bab kyang : ngan skur gyi skyon spangs shing legs pa'i yon tan du blta: bla mar rgyu'i zhen 'dzin srid pa dang bral yang bsod nams kyi tshogs chen rdzogs pa'i phyir yon dang maṇḍal rgyas par bya: zhabs spyi bor len cing smon lam gdab: ci phyir dus gsum sangs rgyas la mchod pa bas: bla ma'i ba spu'i khung bu gcig mchod pa dga': lus dang longs spyod chung ma dang : rgyu dang zhing khang nor rdzas rnams: bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs pa yi: bla ma mnyes pa'i yon du 'bul: dam tshig mig gi 'bras ltar bsrung : dkyil 'khor snying gi khrag ltar 'chang : gnas khang 'di yi phyi rol du: dam med rnams la smra mi bya: rgyud dang dbang bzhi las mtha' rnams: dbang lung med la bstan mi bya: zhes pa ltar 'dzin cing gsang bar bgyi'o: gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi:

maṇḍal 'bul: bkra shis pa'i tshig dang me tog 'thor: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs rjes 'jug bu yi don: dbang rdzogs kun mkhyen snying po bzhag: tshig nyung don che bca' gzhi tshang : go bde bsnyen sla cha lag 'grigs: byin che rgyud smin khungs yang btsun: 'khrugs med gzhung gsal nyams len bde: kun la ma bstan snying gi chos: yang gsang shog dril mgul khug ma: bka' brgyad chos bka' mang sbas kyang : yang gsang 'di 'dra sbas pa dkon: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi chos: 'di dang su 'phrad mngon 'tshang rgya: dbang dang gdams pas 'ja' lus 'grub: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sbobs pa dang : 'di yi dam rdzas myong gyur na: sdig po che yang mngon 'tshang rgya: skal ldan rnams ni ji ltar smos: de phyir kun gyi yang snying mchog: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: mkha' 'gro brda yi yi ger thob: rin chen gsang ba'i gter du sbos: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: padma gter bdag gling la sprod: ye shes mgon po bya rog gdong : bka' yi rgya 'di thub par srungs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan gter bdag gling pas/ sbas yul padma bkod kyi byang sgo/ gangs ri lha btsan rngam 'dra'i mdun zhol/ mtsho 'khor rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dkyil/ klu mo padma gzi ldan gyi phyag nas khrom gter du spyan drangs shing : padma chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas bod yig tu zhal bsgyur ba'o/ /jo bo gze rgyal gyis gangs khrod du dag gter bgyis pa'o// //

ga) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: sngags chas kyi pra khrid bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: rdo rje theg pa'i rnal 'byor gyi: zhwa rgyan gos kyi rnam dbye dang : spyod pa'i dus kyi rnam dbye bshad: dang po lus kyi rnam dbye la: a ti ye grol yin pa'i phyir: srung sdom 'gog bya'i dam tshig zad: rgyud pa kun bzang 'dzin pa'i phyir: spobs pa brtul zhugs mtho bar bya: 'od gsal gzhung shing 'dzin pa'i phyir: lta ba zang thal ngang la spyod: re dogs g.yang sa chod pa'i phyir: bzang ngan thug phrad ro snyoms bya: rdzogs chen byar med yin pa'i phyir: gtad so phyogs ris med par bya: dug lnga ye shes yin pa'i phyir: mi spang dang du len par bya: rnam rtog gol sa yin pa'i phyir: 'khor 'das 'bras bu gcig tu myong : ngo srung zol zog yin pa'i phyir: bzang ngan thag chod gdong la smra: 'di phyi'i rgyu 'bras gcig pa'i phyir: ngos lkog bral ba'i dam tshig 'chang : rang byung spang blang bral ba'i phyir: spyi bor ral pa thod du bcing : dbyings phyug dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i phyir: shes rab btsun mo phyag rgyar bsten: bskyed rdzogs zung du 'jug pa'i phyir: mkha' dbyings padma'i 'khrul 'khor bzung : skad cig bye brag sangs rgyas phyir: lugs ldog chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: phyogs 'dzin rnam rtog gzhom pa'i phyir: rlung sems 'ja' lus rtsal kyang ston: tha snyad grub mtha' gcod pa'i phyir: 'khor 'das blang dor 'tsho skyong bor: kun gzhi 'byung sa med pa'i phyir: dkar sngon nag po'i phod kha gyon: theg pa rim dgu bdog pa'i phyir: chos gos le'u dgu ma 'chang : snang srid dbang sdud gtso bo'i phyir: smug nag gzi byin ber chen bklubs: skyon bral yon tan rdzogs pa'i phyir: dbu la padma'i zhwa chen gsol: kun gyi rigs bdag yin pa'i phyir: rdo rje rtse lnga'i tog kyang btsugs:

srid gsum dbyings la thogs med phyir: rdzu 'phrul rtsal sgro'i phod kha gyon: thugs rjer phyogs ris bral ba'i phyir: nyi zla nor bu'i rgyan gyis spras: theg dman nyan rang zil gnon phyir: rdo rjer rgod sgro'i rgyan yang btags: tshad med bzhi dang ldan pa'i phyir: 'dab bzhir khyung ru rngam zhing mdzes: chos sku'i rang rtsal ma 'gags phyir: sna tshogs rgyan dang cod pan 'phur: rdzu 'phrul drwa ba'i zlos gar phyir: snyan rgyan mgul rgyan gdu bu 'khrol: kun 'byung nor bu yin pa'i phyir: mu tig chun po'i gong lag spras: kun gzhi srid pas ma bcings phyir: za 'og mdzes ldan mu ran brgyan: ma sring mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i phyir: sngon po sgyu ma'i sku rags bcing : rang sems mngon gyur rgyal tshab phyir: rkang la rgya lham swag chen gsol: dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo'i phyir: theg dman rnams la zhe sa spang : rdzogs chen bdal khyab yin pa'i phyir: mtho zhing brjid pa'i khri gdan bzung : 'khor 'das dge sdig bral ba'i phyir: rang rkyang dka' thub sdug sgur bskyur: ye nas rang lus dkyil 'khor phyir: kun bzang lha la phyag mi 'tshal: chos phung brgyad khri'i 'byung gnas phyir: smra bcad lkugs pa'i brtul zhugs spang : tha mal bsnyen bkur mi bya phyir: mu stegs rnams la mgo mi sgur: dgra bcom grub thob lo tsā sogs: 'jig rten gtam la kha mi 'dzin: bdud 'dul kun gyi dbang phyug phyir: 'jig rten lha la skyabs mi 'tshal: mi zad gter gyi bdag po'i phyir: bsgrub pa'i nor lha gzhan mi bsten: theg chen lta ba 'dzin pa'i phyir: dmar ser gos la blo mi bsten: mi chos mgo bskor spang ba'i phyir: nor 'dod dkor sdud chos mi bsten: chos sku mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir: snod ldan mtho dman med par spel: zhi ba'i sngags chas bsdus pa'o: sa ma ya: drag po dmod pa'i sngags chas ni: khrag 'thung gtso bo yin pa'i phyir:

ma bcos ral pa bsgrengs shing bsdam: snang srid lha srin 'dul ba'i phyir: gdong la khrag zhag thig le byugs: rdzu 'phrul gyad dang ldan pa'i phyir: mthing nag mun pa'i phod kha gsol: srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir: sngags zhwa nag po rgyan ldan bya: rdo rje 'chang gis mnga' gsol phyir: gnam lcags ra gdeng rdo rje gdengs: ye shes lnga yi dbang rtags phyir: thod skam phreng ba keng rus 'khrol: ye shes me dpung 'khrigs pa'i phyir: rta drel rkyang gi rngog phod btsug: gza' klu 'byung po 'dul ba'i phyir: bya khyung mthing nag me gshog brgyan: khro rgyal rtsal bcu rdzogs pa'i phyir: rngam byang dmar po'i me khrab gyon: stong gsum 'od kyis 'geng ba'i phyir: khro chu zhun ma'i me long brgyan: ye shes 'jig rten mnyam brdal phyir: 'brong bu ru sngon rnga zhol btags: chos sku mi 'gyur brtan pa'i phyir: steng du chos 'byung bcu drug brtsegs: ma dang mkha' 'gro dbang sdud phyir: 'og tu chos 'byung rtsibs brgyad bsnol: bden gnyis stobs kyi rtsal 'byin phyir: dmar nag sbrel ba'i zhwa sgrog bsdam: che mchog kun gyis mnga' gsol phyir: sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan 'chang : khro rgyal kun gyi ded dpon phyir: rus pa'i rgyan drug g.yer kha 'khrol: dkyil 'khor gtso la dbang bskur phyir: sku yi rgya rtags rdo rje 'chang : las bzhi'i phrin las thogs med phyir: gnam lcags dbal gyi phur pa bsten: ma rgyud gtan du 'khor ba'i phyir: gzungs sngags dngul dkar me long 'chang : rgyal bsen dam sri gzhom pa'i phyir: rus sbal phag rgod mche ba bsdam: rbad bsad dmod pa gdab pa'i phyir: drag sngags rdzas kyis thun rwa brgyan: dur khrod sha la dgyes pa'i phyir: rgyu ma'i zhags pa gru la bskon: shes rab yum mchog bsten pa'i phyir: kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum phyag tu thogs: dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs pa'i phyir:

ga sha rgyan 'phyang sna tshogs 'phur: bdud srin ma mo 'dul ba'i phyir: gza' bdud nag po'i lto zhal brgyan: dam sri 'dre rgod 'dul ba'i phyir: rgya stag pags pa'i swag lham gsol: dug lnga dbyings su bsgral ba'i phyir: bzang ngan ro gcig thog brdzis byed: rnam rtog gab khung 'phud pa'i phyir: dus tshod tshes grangs rtsis 'debs spang : legs nyes ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir: phyi nang ro gcig ngang du bsgral: lta ba thag gcod ldan pa'i phyir: yin min de thog yo lang sbyor: 'di phyi snang ba'i bye brag phyir: bstan dgra sgos dgra tshar bar gcod: bstan pa'i srog 'dzin yin pa'i phyir: bka' bab blo thag chod par bya: chos kun rten 'brel rmi lam phyir: gtong len pham rgyal ro gcig bsre: snod bcud stong gzugs yin pa'i phyir: 'khor 'das gnyis med phyal gyis spyod: blang dor dgags sgrub bral ba'i phyir: dug lnga ye shes ngang du rol: lus la bdud 'dul chas dgus mdzes: dam chos theg pa rim dgus mtho: dam tshig sgo dgu'i bshang lam gtsang : spyod pa ngan dgu ro snyoms khebs: mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud gsang dgu gnyan: ma spangs zhim rgu'i longs spyod tshogs: lta sgom rdzogs chen rgyud dgu zab: drag po'i rgyan bkod bsdus pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo gter bdag gling pas lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing*/ padma chos 'byung gling du shog ser las zhal bshus so// // nga)༁ྂ: bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bzlas pa sngags kyi pra khrid bzhugs: ༁ྃ: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: snying po sngags phreng rnam dbye bshad: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: rig chen gsang ba'i gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam dbye mang yang :

gzhi chos dbyings dang lam spro bsdu'o: dang po gzhi chos dbyings dang lam spro bsdu ni: 'khor 'das kyi byed po rang sems gcig gi rtsal las sna tshogs grub cing : mtha' dbus bral bas khyab brdal: ma 'gags pas zang thal: dngos ma grub pas stong pa: sna tshogs 'char bas rgya yan: 'khor 'das mnyam pas ro gcig: dbye ba mi phyed pas zung 'jug: sgrib pa med pas ka dag: kun tu rig pas khregs chod: de phyir gzhi'i rig pa: a ti bya bral gyi ngang du gnas pas: rnal 'byor lta ba mngon gyur: bsgom pa mthar phyin: spyod pa 'dzin gzhi bral: 'bras bu gdeng dang ldan te: 'khor 'das ris med rnams la: lam bskyed rim mi dgos kyang : 'bring sa mtshams pa: nam zla ston ka'i so nam 'dra ba rnams: bsnyen sgrub dang bskyed rim gtso che ste: de yang rdzogs rim bral bas bskyed rim kho na'i rgyur gyur na: chu rdo dar gyis btums pa lta bu'am: bye ma la so nam du re ba: dbyar gyi rtsi shing phub g.yogs kyis gtums pa lta bu'o: ci'i phyir zhe na gzhi mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin: lam bzod pa gsum gyi go cha: grogs brtson 'grus can gyi nyams len gcig dgos: de la gzhi ting nge 'dzin lam bskyed rim: 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i rim pa gsum dang ldan par bya'o: de yang phyi nang rten 'brel dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas: yi dam lha'i bskyed rdzogs sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i tshe lus yi dam lha yi rnal 'byor ni: ༈ skad cig stong pa'i ngang las lha gang rung gsal gdab tshe: de yang stong pa chu zla'am: 'ja' tshon lta bur snang la rang bzhin dang bral ba phyi nang zang thal can: zhal phyag dang rgyan rdzogs pa: zhi drag gang ltar bsgoms kyang snying khar tsitta rang byung gsal ba'i sgron me'i nang du zhi bar gdan skyon gyis ma gos padma : drag po la nyi zla kha sbyor: zhi ma khro la sum brtsegs: de'i steng du lha zhi ba rnams la hrī ma hūm̐:

khro bo la hūm̐: khro mo la bhyoḥ de yang sta gon lha'i rgyud dang bstun: srog yi ge mdun rtsa'i gdong la gtad: drang po ma yo bar 'grengs thabs kyis bsgoms: khyad par ni: phra zhing phra ba ba spus bris pa tsam: res 'ga' spro ba'i tshe: snod bcud khyab pa'i stong gzugs: res 'ga' lus tshad dang spus bris pa tsam: dbyibs ni rang gzhung lta bu'i sku mdog la: zhi ba rnams 'od zer 'phro zhing mdangs dang ldan pa: drag po rnams tsha tshwa me ri 'bar zhing pheṃ sgra dang ldan pa: mkha' 'gro rnams 'jam mnyen 'khyugs pa la dwangs cha che ba 'od zer gyi rnam pa lta bu gsal gdab: gnyis pa sngags phreng ni: lha zhi ba'i sngags dal zhing lhod pa: gaṅgā dal 'bab ltar 'khor: drag po'i rigs rnams gcong rong zab mo'i chu ltar si li li 'khor ba: mkha' 'gro rnams kha so'i chu 'gul ba ltar myur la 'jam par 'khor: srog yig yab kyi mdangs dang : sngags phreng yum gyi mdangs: pho rgyud g.yas su 'khor: mo rgyud g.yon du 'khor: sngags phreng lug rgyud bar ma chad pa ltar ram: sngags phreng ba'i rnam pa 'od zer phreng thag gi rnam pa: 'od zer yang phal cher dmar sngo dkar ljang ngo : bros ded kyi tshul lam: gdan la khab 'dzugs pa ltar 'khor: yab yum spro bsdu'i sngags ni: yab kyi zhal nas yum gyi zhal du zhugs: dbu ma'i lam rgyud nas: gsang ba'i gnas nas mar drangs te 'gal me 'khor ba ltar 'khor bar bsgom: de yang srog yig mi 'gul zhing sngags phreng 'khor bar bya: ci'i phyir zhe na mig 'bras 'gul tshe lug rgyud byer ba ltar 'gyur ro: de bzhin du lta stangs lus gnad gsum yang bya: lta stangs ni: mig sna rtser phab ste lug gu rgyud mi 'gul bar bzhag: lus gnad drang zhing blo lhod par bya: rlung sems gcig tu dril la: ma yengs pa'i dran rdzi dang bcas nas bzhag: sngags kyi skyon bdun ni: yengs na bying ba'i skyon: rmugs na mi gsal ba'i skyon:

brel na ma dag pa'i skyon: thang lhod le lo'i skyon: 'chal gtam tshig 'brel bar chad kyi skyon: de ltar skyon bdun gyis mi gos par bya: sngags gtsang ba dag pa sgra ring thung snyoms pa gsal ba phal cher grogs kyis go tsam bzla: rbad bskul dmod pa'i sngags ni: lcags zhun gyi tsha tshwa khol ba ltar tho ro ro bzla: phrin las bzhi yi sngags ni: zhi ba'i sngags 'jam la ring ba: rgyas pa brjid la rngam pa: dbang myur la gtsang ba: drag po rno la myur ba'o: sngags sgra yang bung ba rtsis myos pa'i sgra ltar snyan pa rang sgra can du bzla'o: gsum pa spro bsdu ni: sngags bzlas pa'i tshe: gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du gyur nas lus kyi nang thams cad gang : rim bzhin ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad sngags kyi rang sgra di ri ri sgrog par bsam: sngags sgra las spros pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas 'dzin ma dpag tu med pa spros nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul: tshur bsdus pas sangs rgyas byang sems kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'ubs kyis bsdus nas rang la thim par bsam: zil gyis gnon pa'i sngags phreng sngar ltar 'phros pa las rang 'dra ba'i khro bo'am zhi ba dpag tu med par gyur la: pha rol gyi gzi brjid thams cad zil gyis mnan pas pha rol zhum ste dbang du 'dus par bsam: dbang du sdud pa ni: rang gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng spros pa las rang 'dra ba'i khro bo dang mkha' 'gro las bzhi'i phrin las phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa 'phros nas pha rol gyi stobs bsod nams thams cad shog skya rlung gis bskyod pa ltar bsdus nas rang la thim: gzhan yang phyi snod kyi bcud thams cad rang la thim pas gzi brjid bkrag mdangs rgyas te kun gyis phyag 'tshal zhing mchod bstod phul bar bsam: sgrib sbyong ni: rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor ye shes sems dpa' rigs bdag gi rnam par bzhugs pa'i:

sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs lus gang nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu sol khu'i rnam par 'og sgo nas thon te: sa rim pa dgu'i 'og: 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje'i khar song bas ngoms shing tshims te bla med byang chub thob par bsam: tshar gcod pa'i sngags phreng ni: sngar ltar drag tu 'khor bas: sngags phreng las rang 'dra ba'i khro bo dang phyag mtshan rdul ltar 'khrigs nas pha rol gnod byed thams cad dum bur gtub cing rab tu bsregs nas ming yang med par bsam: 'gugs pa'i sngags phreng ni: sngags phreng 'khor bas sngags la 'gugs byed kyi las mkhan dpag tu med par 'phros dgra bo'i bla srog rnam par shes pa byi'u chung khras khyer ba ltar bkug nas gzugs byang la gnyis su med par bsam: bdag mdun yod na bdag bskyed kyi sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od zer mang du spros pa mdun bskyed la phog nas: mdun bskyed kyi lha thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul ba ltar gyur nas dgra bo bkug cing bsgral bas sha khrag gis yi dam lha tshogs dgyes par bsam: yang bdag mdun zhi ba yin na: sngags 'gal me ltar 'khor kyang rung ngo: yang pha rol mnan pa ni: sa rim pa gsum gyi mtshams lcags kyi khang sgrom nag po rngam la 'thug pa zhig gsal gdab: sngags phreng las spros pa'i pho nya rnams kyis de'i steng du gnam lcags gi mchod rten nag po bang rim dgu dang ldan pa de las mchod rten bye ba sa ya spros pas mnan te: bskal pa stong du yang mi thar bar bsgom: gtad pa ni: gang la bcol ba'i yul lha srin sde brgyad de'i rang gzugs: sa yin na sa rim pa dgu'i mtshams su yod pa'i khar gtad pas: kha bsdams pa dang nam yang 'bros sa med par bsgom: chu yin na klur sngar ltar gtad: sgab 'dre dam sri sogs spyi la: sa rim pa gsum gyi mtshams su las kyi chu srin gyi khar gtad: bzlog pa dang zor dmigs la: sngags bzlas pa'i tshe:

mdun bskyed dang chos skyong la phog pas de rnams kyi lha rang rang gi phyag mtshan rnams me dpung gnam lcags kyi sgyogs thogs nas: sngags drag tu 'khor ba'i tshe 'phang pas dgra yul phye mar bshig par bsam: srung ba'i sngags phreng rnams ni sngags 'khor bas phyi'i lha thams cad zhal nang du gyu nas bsrung bar bsgom: bzlog pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i tshe: khro bo rnams kyis phyi la gzigs te bzlog pa'i las mdzad par bsam: lha dpa' gcig yin na sngar ltar bsgom: 'khor mang yin na sngags bzlas tshe gzhan rnams kyang 'khor rnams kyi rang mdog sngags phreng 'khor bar bsam: mthu gtad smad las kyi sngags bzlas tshe rang gi thugs kar yi dam sngags: pho nya'i thugs kar kho rang srog sngags: rbad sngags rnams 'gugs 'dren gyi tshul du 'phros: bsad sngags rnams thun khang phyi nang la rang sgra grags par bsam: gzhan yang yi dam che rgyud ma gtogs drag po'i sngags rang gi snying khar mi 'khor: mdun bskyed rang la 'khor: rang nyid yi dam rtsa sngags srog yig ma bral bar bya: phrin las bzhi'i sngags phreng ltar yig 'bru mi bsgom na sgra stong nyid rang byung du shes pa rtsol bral a ti'i rnal 'byor bya: de'i tshe yig 'bru dang sngags phreng mi bsgom ste: sgra grags pa yang stong pa: gnas pa yang stong pa: 'gags pa yang stong pa dper na rnga'i sgra yang mi'i lag pa'i 'khrul 'khor ltar shes par bya'o: spro ba yang rang sems nas spro: bsdu ba yang rang sems su bsdu zhing bskyed rim sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor bya'o: rdzogs rim yang sgyu ma 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i rang bzhin thams cad sgyu ma las ma 'das pas rdzogs rim sgyu ma lta bu'o: rmi lam ltar gsal ba'i lha rnams kyang gcig las gnyis su gyur nas bdag sgyu ma'i rang bzhin: gzhi'i sgyu rtsal de ltar rtogs na yi dam gyi lha ma bsgrub kyang dgyes zhal mjal: rjes su dbang bzhi'i ngang bsre ba ni:

bdag mdun gnyis yin na: mdun bskyed kyi dpral ba nas oṃ dkar po'i rang bzhin spros nas rang gi spyi bor thim pas lus bdud rtsi dkar pos gang des sku'i dbang thob: mgrin pa nas āḥdamar po spros pa rang gi lce la thim pas bdud rtsis longs spyod kyi 'khor lo ltem gyis gang : des gsung gi dbang thob: thugs ka nas yi ge hūm̐ sngon po 'phros: rang gi thugs kar thim: bdud rtsi mthing gas ltem gyis gang : des thugs kyi dbang thob: lte ba nas swā ser po 'phros pa rang gi lte bar thim: bdud rtsi dmar ser gyis sprul pa'i 'khor lo gang : des yon tan gyi dbang thob: gsang ba nas yi ge hā ljang gu 'phros pa rang gi gsang bar thim: bdud rtsi ljang sngon gyis bde skyong 'khor lo ltem gyis gang : des phrin las kyi dbang thob: de nas mdun bskyed 'od du zhu nas rang la thim rang yang rim bzhin mi dmigs hūm̐ nas spyi bor bsdu bar bya: yab yum yin na yab yum gyi gnas lnga nas sngar ltar dbang blangs yab yum kyang rang la bsdu: nyin re bzhin rim gyis dmigs pa spro bsdu bya: rjes kyi rtags tshad grub rtags ni: dngos su yi dam lha mjal ba dang : lung ston pa dang chos 'chad pa sogs dang nyams 'bar zhing bskyed rim spro ba: lus bde zhing yangs pa nad zhi ba bkrag mdangs dang ldan pa: longs spyod 'du ba gzhan gyis byams pa bkra shis pa'i rtags 'byung : rmi lam du nyi ma shar ba chos 'chad pa dung 'bud pa rnga brdung ba dang : gzhan yang rol mo sna tshogs 'khrol zhing sgra skad cher g.yos pa: gzhan gyis zas dang longs spyod ster ba lus la 'ja' shar ba khrus bya zhing gos dkar gyon pa: rgyan gos gsar bu phun sum tshogs pas brgyan pa khri'i khar bsdad pa: dbang bskur ba thams cad rang la dad cing gus pa: rta nor lug sogs mang ba dang lo thog phun tshogs skye ba zhing bzo ba chu 'gyed pa sa bon btab pa:

klu rgyal me tog gling la slebs pa: lha'i sku mdog ltar gyi me tog thu ba dang : dkar gsum gyi zas ro myong pa gyen la 'dzegs pa: lus che zhing stong gsum khyab pa: rkang pa phyed skyil lam dor thabs kyis gling bzhi brdzis pa stong gsum la hūm̐ sgra sgrogs pa: ri nyil ba mtsho dkrugs pa brag gshig pa chu brgal ba: zam 'dzugs pa khyab 'bangs mang po'i dpon byas pa khang pa: brtsegs pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba bud med rgyan can mang pos dga' ba'i tshul gyis zas ster ba: rin chen sna tshogs rnyed pa sogs ni grub pa'i rtags: khyad par drag po'i gtor zor rbad bsad dus su ral gri'i khang khyim la slebs pa: lus la go chas brgyan pa: dgra la dmag drangs shing thub pa: gzhan gyi mgo snying nang rol gtor ba: rngon bkye ba: sha khrag 'gyed pa: ging dmar nag gis 'o dod 'bod pa: gcan gzan sna tshogs kyis ro za ba: pha rol btson par 'gugs pa: gzhan la mtshon btab pa zor 'phang ba ri bo mgo mjug ldog pa lus la me 'bar ba: ri la me btang ba drag po'i thun brdeg pa sogs rmis pa ni drag po bsgrubs pas mngon spyod gyis las grub pa'i rtags yin: gzhan yang 'khrul zhing rang nyid thugs dam mi ldan na: pha rol dmag drangs shing rang pham pa gzhan gyi mtshon dang rdo rbab kyis ded pa: g.yang la lhung ba chur bying ba: mgo la me 'bar ba skra tshig pa skra bregs pa gos hrul po gyon pa: khrag dang dug sogs bshang lci 'thung ba: sha khrag ngan pa'i gling du slebs pa: sbra nag dang rlung gis g.yog pa: sgrub khang zhig cing bgrang phreng 'thor ba: rang gi spyad cha chag yal grug por song ba: brang rdung zhing ngu 'bod ldir ba: gtor ma dang mchod rdzas zhig cing log pa: bud med ngu ba mthur du 'gro ba: mun rub pa nyi zla zad pa: ser bas brdung ba gcan gzan sna tshogs kyis ded pa: 'gong po ser skya la dbang zhus pa rang gi sring mched dang lcam dral 'khu ba kun gyis sdang bar byed pa:

khang pa'i tog dang rgyal mtshan zhig pa: thog babs pa: bande: bud med: a tsa ras ded pa: lus la 'bu srin zhugs pa sogs rmis na yi dam chos skyong 'khu ba dang pha rol gyi byad ltas yin: skong bshags tshogs brgya 'bungs dgos: spyir yang sgrub pa la snying rus brtson dgos pa'i rtags yin: gzhan yang yi dam gyi lha phyi nang gsang gsum gang sgrub kyang gtso bo ting nge 'dzin la rag las shing : rten 'brel 'grigs pa dmigs pa dam tshig gtsang dgos: sgrub pa'i tshe gdong mi la mi bstan: rab na mtshams g.yog pas mi mthong bar bya: phyi la lha 'di sgrub pa yin zhes gtam mi smra: sgrub pa ma grol gyi bar du gzhan la gos dang kha phor mi bsre: rig ldan ma yin pa'i bud med mtshams g.yog mi byed: dam med la dkyil 'khor mgo gyi tsam yang mi bstan: gtor ma bya khyi dang dbul pos mthong sar mi dor: mi gri bo dang slob ma nyams grib can sgrub khang du mi bzhag: mtshams g.yog mi brje: gzhan yang zas grib can mi bza': tsha dang la phug sgog skya gsum la sngags kyi nus pa nyams pa'i skyon yod pas spang : sgrub khang gi phyi ru ku co dang gtam mi smra: nang du 'thab 'khon mi bya: mi gtsang ba'i rigs zhag gsum ma song bar nang du mi blang : dam tshig mi gtsang ba'i mi la chas lag len mi bcug: rten 'brel ngan pa'i gtam mi smra: sgrub pa ma grol ba'i bar la: rgyal tho brgal nas gtor ma mi 'bul: nang gi sgrub pa grol nas zhag gsum ma song bar du mi grib can la mi 'phrad: sgrub pa la zhugs nas bzung : khyim du gad mi gtong : mal sa mi spo: gdan mi sprugs: nang chas ri la mi bskyel: gos phyi nang bslogs shing mi brje: pha ma spun zla dang bral yang : dam bca' ma grol bar du mi 'phrad: steng nas ri nyil: 'og nas mtsho lud kyang na shog shi shog ma gtogs: yang yang 'gro ba dang : grol ba sogs mi bya: ci tsam sgrub pa chos skyong la:

dmod pa dang dam bzhag byas nas bsdad: dkyil 'khor la kha sprod tshul du mal sa bca': nang gi dbang bzhi'i dngos grub len chog ma zin bar gzhan la dbang mi bskur: gtor 'bul dang rjes kyi bya ba ma rdzogs bar: nang gi rgyal tho dang srung 'khor mi bsdu: snod min la rdul tshon dang byin rlabs mi sbyin: sgrub pa'i tshe pha rol nad pa sogs la bka' bsgo dang dmigs pa mi bya: thugs dam brtags pa mi gnang : mngon mkhyen lnga ldan du shar yang : gzhan la lung mi ston: rang nyid yi dam gyi lha dngos su gyur kyang : grub rtags mi la mi bshad: sgrub pa'i dam bca' ring thung gang yang pha rol la dus mi bgo: phyi nang gi lhong tshad dang tshar tshad grub rtags rkyen ngan gang byung yang : thams cad rang sems gcig po'i cho 'phrul yin par shes pa'i ngang la dga' sdug re dogs gang yang med par bya: na ba yon tan yin: shi ba dngos grub yin bsams te rten 'brel legs nyes gang la yang 'dzin pa med par bya: spyir sgrub pa gang la yang mgo ma grim par mjug ma slod par sngon skyabs yul nas bzung : rjes mi dmigs pas dkyil 'khor ma bsdus bar shi ba srog la bab kyang mjug mi bzhag par kha tshang la rting grim par bya: bogs skyed med par zhag mang zhig sgrub pa las: ting 'dzin gsal la dus thung ba yon tan che: lus ngag rgya yan bag med can gyis bskal pa stong du bzlas kyang mchog thun gyi 'bras bu mi 'grub: snying rje phan sems med pa rnams kyis: lha drag po sgrub na skye ba bdun phrag la srin po dang shan pa'i lus su skye: spyir yang zhe sdang can gyi ban bon sngags pa rnams kyis 'jig rten lha drag po sgrub pa na: 'gro ba kun la gnod pa'i gdug 'drer skye: de bzhin sgrub pa tshul bzhin nyams su len cing : 'di phyi sgrub pa rnams phyi nang bskyed rdzogs smon lam bzang po dang ldan par bya: phyi rgyud gzhi bdag sogs bsgrub na 'phral du longs spyod che yang phug la yi dam gyi lha go log pa yin pas gtan gyi 'dun ma rnam g.yeng bdud kyis bcom na:

lha bu bdud dbang du 'gro bar 'gyur: de phyir yi dam lha bsgrubs te skyid sdug bzang ngan gang byung yang khyed shes kyi blo dang ldan par bya: tshe rabs gtan gyi sa mtshams da lta yin pas rang tsho thub pa seṅge lta bur sgrub tshugs bzung : skye ba 'di la lta ba rang rig gi lha zhal mjal lo: phyi ma bde bar snyon pa zad pa'i blo rgya bskyed: khas drag dang mthu nus sogs byung nas kun gyis bstod kyang bde 'gro mtho ris 'gog pa'-i sgo mo yin pas shin tu spang : pad 'byung bslu med kyi zab chos nyams su len pa rnams: phyi nang slob dpon bzang po'i zhal khrid dang ma ldan na 'tsho byed kyis zas btsal bas reg phung gi dug dang 'phrad pa lta bu shin tu nyen che: rten 'brel phyi nang gi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon bsten la: lag khrid phra zhib kyis rgyas btab: bsnyen sgrub bzang pos mtshams sbyar: yi dam gyi lha mnyes par mdzod cig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: spyi chings zhal shes gdams pa mchog: pra khrid gsal ba'i me long bzhag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo gter bdag gling pas lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser las zhal bshus so/ /maṅga laṃ// //

ca) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: sgrub khog kun dang sbyar rung ba'i pra khrid shes rab drwa ba ngo mtshar rin po che'i phreng ba bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: dkyil 'khor phyi nang che phra'i rigs: kun gyi thun mong blo gsal mchog: ngo mtshar rin chen phreng ba bstan: dbyangs can mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: mi brjed ri mo gzungs kyis zung : zab mo gsang ba'i gter du sbos: skal ldan shes rab las 'phro can: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ phyi rabs rig 'dzin rjes 'jug gis: dkyil 'khor sgom sgrub brtson pa'i tshe: mi mthun rkyen gyi rigs dag ni: dgra dang mi rgod gcan spyang jag: nyil la khad kyi brag rdo dang : 'gyel la khad kyi khang pa shing : mer la khad kyi mtsho dang gangs: yal la khad kyi g.yang dang gad: gnyis 'dzin dgos pa'i mi dang yul: zhe blo mi mthun g.yog dang bran: mang po 'grim pa'i lam dang rlung : tshig sgra che ba'i gnas dang phug: 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba'i las spyod dang : nyams grib che ba'i zas dang gos: dam tshig bral ba'i gzugs dang dam: kun slong che ba'i sde dang dgon: nyams rtogs mi 'phel gzhi dang gnas: yid blo 'phrog pa'i gzugs sgra yi: sos dal bag med g.yeng dang gnyid: 'os mchog tshod kyi grangs dang rtags: phangs sems bskyed pa'i mchod rdzas phud: rang phung khungs med dpe dang lung : mi mgo bskor ba'i kha rgyangs gtam: mi 'ong dam bca' mi 'grub blo: dbang khrid thob la sgrub pa bcad: de sogs rnam g.yeng mi mthun byur: de dag spang zhing dben yul na: dur khrod gnas sam shing gcig drung : brag phug nyams dga' dben pa'i ri: yang na bde zhing dal ba'i thang : nags ma mtsho 'khyil gangs kyi khrod: yid spro bkra shis dge ba'i yul: mtho zhing dwangs pa rab kyi gnas: nyi zla shar snga 'grib phyi ba: yul ni nub byang gang gyu ba:

sgrub pa'i lha dang phrin las gtso: zhi rgyas dbang drag dbyibs dang bstun: byang sems 'phags pas lung bstan zhing : phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas mchog tu: dkyil 'khor rdzas ni gzhung bzhin dang : 'khor dang spyad cha gang dgos bsags: 'du 'dzi sems khur chung bar bya: dang po dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni: rdzas dang spyad kha bsags pa'i tshe: thams cad cha tshang 'phral 'grigs shing : 'dzing dang 'thab sogs ma byung na: bkra shis lhong tshad chung ba'i rtags: dbang lung gdams pa zhu ba'i tshe: bkra shis 'phrod sbyor ma chad na: phyis rgyud bsgrub la bar chad med: dbang chas la 'khon pa dang : dgra sogs glo bur byung ba na: de dag lhong gi bye brag yin: sgrub tshe g.yeng ba mi rung bzla: gnas ni rgyus yod med pa na: sngon du btsal bar chas pa'i tshe: chu dang shing dang 'bru sna spyad: rta khal 'gel sogs mang po la: 'phrad na yi dam dngos grub brnyes: gri dang mtshon cha thogs pa dang : go khrab drag chas 'phrad pa na: chos skyong dam can 'grub pa'i rtags: phyugs rdzi bud med khye'u yis: gnas dang sa rtags lung bstan na: bka' srung bran du khol ba'i rtags: bande bon sogs mang po dang : skya ser 'dres pa mang 'phrad cing : sdang ba zhe sa mi 'dug na: rgyal pos gnas de sgrib pa'i brda: rgas pa mgo dkar 'phrad pa dang : lung bstan rten 'brel yod zer na: gnas bdag rogs dan sgrub pa'i brda: bla ma sde dpon drag rtsal 'phrad: zhe sa dwang ba med pa na: yul der phyin yang don mi 'byung : skyes pa bud med byis pa dang : chas sdug lus nyams khal stong ded: kha nas mi bzang gtam bshad na: yul de bse rag gling yin pas: sgrub kyang thun mong dngos grub med: rta khal 'grogs dang chas ka bcag: sems can khong khro langs gyur na: 'gong pos bar chad yod pa'i rtags: dang po phyi la 'gro ba'i tshe: pho mo gang zhig su 'phrad la: yul der rten 'brel e 'ong ces: yong ngo zer na 'gro bar rigs:

ming la ci skad dris pa'i tshe: tshe dang lha dang rgyal dang grags: bsod nams tshe dang dbang sogs rnams: rten 'brel 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i rtags: gang zhig yin min zer ba dang : yod dam med dam 'dri ba'i tshe: yong ngo yod do zer ba rab: med dang mi 'ong 'gag pa dang : rkyen dang ming ngan kha sdug na: gnas ni de ru mi 'gro'o: gang zhig mthu dang grags pa sgrub: mngon pa mang dang 'phrad gyur na: drag po'i phrin las 'grub pa'i rtags: tshe sgrub sogs la de dag spang : phyugs lug gnag mang 'phrad pa na: longs spyod 'byung zhing mi kha byams: kha char drag 'tshub bya rigs kyi: mi snyan sgra skad sgrog gyur na: mi kha bshad skur mang ba'i rtags: gang phyir tshig bzang snang ba dga': nyi dro sprin dang blo bde na: gnas dang dben ri rnyed pa'i brda: dang po gnas ri btsal ba'i tshe: brag rngam rang byon ring bsrel dang : sgrub phug nyams dga' rnyed gyur na: drag po sngon du sgrub par bya: mtsho nags gangs ri spang ljongs skyed: rnyed tshe sngon du zhi ba sgrub: shing nags 'tshub rgyas ri yang dmar: 'o na zhi drag dkar nag rigs: mang du 'dus na gang yang rung : g.ya' spang gangs ri klu yi ljon: bya rigs skad 'gyur snyan bde na: lha mo'i rigs ni sngon du bsgrub: ri rnams lhun thub de'u ni: sbrum ma'i lus 'dra nor lha sngon: rtsi shing ral bsigs gcan gzan ngar: chu sgra rlung 'ur che ba na: sngon du mgon rigs chos skyong sgrub: dur khrod ro dang keng rus gar: bya rgod tshogs shing gcan gzan 'gyu: sngon du yi dam sgrub par bya: gang du dang po'i gnas rnyed par: tshogs dang rten 'brel shes par bya: gsar pa 'tshol du mi dgos na: spyad kha 'tshol dang sgo ru don: de dus rten 'brel gang 'grigs brtag: sa ma ya: da ni dkyil 'khor 'debs pa la: sa dpyad ri yi chags tshul bstan: rgyab ri mtho la rngam pa de: rang mtho mi 'og mi 'chor sa:

sgrub gnas mthong zhing dwangs pa de: nyams rtogs ting 'dzin skye ba'i sa: mdun ri rnams kyang dma' ba dang : thams cad tshur la mgo sgu na: snang ba dbang du 'dus pa'i sa: g.yas g.yon brag la shing rigs ni: dgra satwa phyar dang ral gri phyar: mda' mdung gzeng dang 'dra gyur na: drag po'i phrin las 'grub pa'i sa: shar du lam dang lho ru chu: nub tu brag dmar byang du rdza: srung bzhi 'dra na thams cad 'grub: mdun du nor bu 'dra ba dang : bud med sbrum ma'i lto ba dang : phag lto lta bur 'bur ba na: longs spyod phywa g.yang 'byung ba'i sa: g.yas su chu dang phyug pa'i shing : na kha me tog rgyas pa na: chos dang dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i sa: g.yon du ri 'bur chu dang nags: 'bras spungs 'dra'am bhandha 'dra: gdams pa spyi rgyud mi 'chad pa: 'og tu chu dang spang ljongs klu: gser gzhong 'dra na chos nor 'dzoms: mdun du mtsho dang ri 'bur dang : gangs dang nags tshal me tog rgyas: phun tshogs 'dra na kun kyang 'grub: yang na ri rnams shin tu grags: chu sgra che zhing brag rnams gzeng : dpa' bo g.yul du zhugs 'dra na: drag po'i sa ru shes par bya: spyir yang mdun du chu shing lam: 'khyil zhing phun sum 'tshogs pa dang : shar phyogs phyes la lho phyogs sgrib: nub phyogs spungs la byang phyogs g.yor: de ni phrin las kun dang ldan: zhi rgyas dbang drag rang gzhung la: kha yi gyu phyogs gzhung du gsal: yang na bde zhing yangs pa dang : gnam yang 'khor lo rtsibs bzhin du: sa yang padma 'dab phyes 'dra: de yang rgyud dang mthun pa'i sa: gnam sa chos 'byung 'dra ba dang : zhing lpags bkram pa 'dra ba na: ma mo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i sa: glang chen chu la snyog pa dang : seṅge gnam du mchong 'dra dang : dug sbrul mthur du 'gyu 'dra rnams: shin tu gnyan cing chos skyong 'du: rgyab ri yab yum sbyor 'dra dang : rig 'dzin gral du bsgrigs 'dra na: dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i sa la bzang :

mdun dang g.yas g.yon chags pa'i gnas: khra zhing bud med 'dra ba dang : gsang gnas 'dra dang lte ba 'dra: 'khor lo 'dra dang rus sbal 'dra: de yang dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i sa: chos 'byung bsnol dang po ti 'dra: de yang dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i sa: gral du 'grig dang dbang bskur 'dra: de yang dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i sa: byang chub chu rgyun mi 'chad dang : ri rnams dmar smug snum pa dang : nag sngo lhun la chags pa dang : de yang dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i sa: brag la chu 'bab thang la 'khyil: rtse la gangs dang sked la chu: snying la mtsho dang mtha' la chu: lung pa mang po'i mdo rgyas rnams: de yang dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i sa: me long 'dra dang dkyil 'khor 'dra: dur khrod bkod 'dra dben pa'i gnas: de yang dkyil 'khor 'debs pa'i sa: spyir yang mtho la rgyas pa dang : ming yang rten 'brel che 'gyur na: sa bzung mtho ba'i rten 'brel yod: sa ma ya: da ni mi 'dod sa bstan pa: dbyibs kyang skya zhing bse rag ri: shing skam mang zhing sa chad che: rngo dang mdze rigs 'dra ba dang : nyi ma skye 'chi bsdong ba dang : mdun du dgra 'bod 'dra ba'i shing : g.yas g.yon lung skam chu med gling : me tog 'bras bu dben pa'i yul: 'og nas shing skam mdung 'dra mang : brag dmar ral gri 'dra ba'i gdong : gnam mched sa mched 'grigs pa'i dbyibs: gdug na de 'dra mdzems par bya: mdun nas lung stong mang gzugs dang : lam chad chu chad 'phrang chad dang : gcan gzan ro la 'jab 'dra dang : phyed zhig ral ba'i khang rul dang : gnam sa yo zhing grogs med 'dra: de yang spang ba'i sa dag go: mdun na mo mtshan 'dra ba dang : rgyab na yab yum 'dra ba dang : bug pa mang ba'i sa bdag ni: rab byung dkyil 'khor mi 'dzin pa: de dag shin tu brtag pa gces: 'di'i man ma dper ma tshang pas phyin chad rnyed par gyur na 'dir 'dzud par 'tshal*// // cha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: pra khrid gsal ba'i me long gi sa 'dul bdud bzhi tshar gcod bzhugs:

gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: pra khrid gsal ba'i me long bstan: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: bsnyen sgrub brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pas: sa gzhi bkra shis rgyu mthun par: dus bzang yar ngo'i tshes dag la: tho rangs khrus byas zhogs bsang gtong : nyi shar he ru ka pa'i chas: yang na sngags chas rngam pa'i gzugs: rdo rje slob dpon gtsos byas pa: dpal chas brgyan pa rab la brgya: 'bring po nyi shu tha na bdun: rdo rje phur pa phyag tu thogs: ging gi dmag dang bcas rnams kyis: sa gzhi gang yin mtha' bskor nas: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyis: rang gzhung bzhin du phyogs la 'gyu: rang nyid drag po che mchog gi: nga rgyal bskyed cing rngam tshul dang : mi shigs gdeng dang ldan par bya: 'di ni sa 'dul chen mo ste: dkyil 'khor bzhengs dang gtsug lag sogs: sa skyon che zhing dam sri zhugs: de la 'di nyid shin tu zab: gser skyems dkar gtor dang bcas nas: pho brang gang du 'debs pa yi: dbus su bsal zhing byin brlabs te: dang po steng phyogs lha yi sa: 'dul bar bya ba'i rim pa ni: thams cad mtha' bskor rdo rje'i 'gros: gser skyems bya zhing 'cham par bya: hoḥ de ring bkra shis dus tshes bzang : rten 'brel kun gyi mgo yang legs: gnas bdag yul 'dzin phun sum tshogs: mi shigs pho brang sa 'dul lo: de nas dkar gtor btegs shing dkyil 'khor gang yin gyi phrin las phyogs su 'bul: hūm̐: nga ni che mchog khro bo'i rgyal: nga ni snang srid kun gyi gtso: ye shes 'jig rten zil gyis gnon: log 'dren dam sri dam la btags: hūm̐: nyon cig steng phyogs la gnas pa'i: sum cu rtsa gsum man chad nas: na rag dmyal khams yan chad kyi: lha srin gzhi bdag gnas bdag dang : sa 'di 'dzin nas srung ba'i tshogs: 'byung po phra mo yan chad la: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po dang : 'dod yon longs spyod gtor ma 'bul:

mnyes nas byang chub sems ldan mdzod: de ring pho brang sa 'di stsol: khyod rnams ko long gdug sems dang : log sbyor 'tshe ba'i bsam pa spongs: ci ste sdang sems ldan gyur na: dus gsum rgyal ba'i bka' yang bcag: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dam yang bkral: na rag chen po'i dmyal bar ltung : de bas sngon gyi dam tshig srungs: sgrub pa'i sdongs grogs phrin las mdzod: oṃ badzra bhū mi pa ti dza i daṃ bha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: de nas bstan ma dang sa bdag lto 'phye la slong ba ni: gser skyems dang bha ling bcas bsngo zhing : oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: nga ni 'jigs byed he ru kar: nyon cig bstan ma sa bdag tshogs: de ring sa 'dul chen mo ste: khyod rnams gser skyems 'di bzhes la: pho brang 'bar ba'i sa stsol cig: dkyil 'khor sa 'di phul ba'i mthus: khyod kyang byang chub lam du 'god: lto 'phye sa 'dzin chen po yang : sdang sems 'tshe ba zhi gyur cig: ci ste dam la mi gnas shing : pho brang 'debs la bar chod na: ting 'dzin khro rgyal thugs khros te: rdo rje gnam lcags bya khyung 'bebs: de bas dam las ma 'da' bar: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ bhū mi pa ti lokkā pā la i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: zhes phul: de nas sa 'dul chen mo ni: rdo rje rgya gram 'gros kyis blangs te: hūm̐: sngon tshe sa 'dul gang nas 'dul: 'og min rdo rje'i pho brang du: thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang gis: ting 'dzin rdo rje'i rngam stabs kyis: drag sngags me yis stong gsum khengs: ma rig nyon mongs sa sri btul: dbyings phyug mi 'gyur sa yang blangs: de ring gnas 'dir sa 'dzin no: de nas sa 'dul gang nas 'dul: che mchog khrag 'thung khro rgyal gyis: bdud po mgo gsum 'dul ba'i tshe: drag sngags rdo rje'i char chen phab: bar gyi 'jig rten sa sri btul: gsang chen rmang bting sa yang blangs: de ring pho brang sa 'dzin no:

de nas sa 'dul gang nas 'dul: klu srin sa bdag kha rlangs las: nad rigs sa sri dar ba'i tshe: sprul pa'i bya khyung me gshog gis: klu srin ma rungs sa bdag 'joms: 'og min ma rungs sa sri btul: rlung ri rdo rje'i sa yang blangs: de ring dkyil 'khor sa 'dzin no: de nas sa 'dul gang nas 'dul: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis: mchims phu dpal gyi bsam yas su: lha 'dre ma rungs dam la btags: bod khams gling bzhi'i sa sri btul: gsang sngags bstan pa'i rmang gzhi btsug: de ring gsang ba'i sa 'dzin no: hūm̐: 'jam dpal sku yi 'gros stabs kyis: shar gyi sa sri dam la btags: shar phyogs zhi ba'i pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba shing gi sku mkhar tshugs: shar gyi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: padma gsung gi 'gros stabs kyis: lho yi sa sri dam la btags: lho phyogs rgyas pa'i pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba me yi gsung mkhar tshugs: lho yi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: yon tan ma mo'i 'gros stabs kyis: nub kyi sa sri dam la btags: nub phyogs dbang gi pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba chu yi yon tan mkhar: nub kyi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: rdo rje phur pa'i 'gros stabs kyis: byang gi sa sri dam la btags: byang phyogs drag po'i pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba lcags kyi phrin las mkhar: byang gi sa dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: yang dag khrag 'thung 'gros stabs kyis: dbus kyi sa sri dam la btags: dbus phyogs che mchog pho brang 'debs: 'byung ba rlung gi thugs mkhar tshugs: dbus kyis dgra ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: steng du nam mkha'i 'khor lo phub: 'og tu rdo rje'i rgya gram gding : hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bhyo bhyo bhyoḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces rdo rje rgya gram 'gros kyis sa gzhi bcag: de nas las kyi ru tra bsgral zhing snying khar pho brang gdab par bsam: ru tra bsgral zhing mgo bo yan lag rnams phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du rang phyogs la bzhag par bya:
