de nas dkyil 'khor gang du 'debs pa'i dbus su bzhag: lan gsum bkug ste phur bu'i 'gros kyis bsgral: hūm̐: bdag nyid che mchog khro bo'i rgyal: rdo rje phur pa phyag na 'dril: sku la me 'od mtshon cha 'phro: ru tra bsgral ba'i gnyen por gsal: oṃ he ru ka badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ hoḥ mdun du gzugs kyi liṅga la: stong gsum ru tra 'byung po dang : ma dag log par 'dren pa yi: nyon mongs bdud bzhi'i ru tra khug: oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya ru tra dzaḥ de nas rdo rje phur pa gdeng zhing : hūm̐: nga ni stobs bcu khro bo'i rgyal: phyag na ri rab phur bu bsgril: las kyi ru tra'i snying la ya: dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i bar chad sgrol: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya ram̐ ram̐ dzwa la ram̐ ru tra'i tsitta ram̐ rbad bhyo tshal pa ya shig shig: ces phur pas bsgral: snying khrag yi dam chos skyong gis gsol bar bsam: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dam can chos skyong srung ma rnams: ru tra'i snying khrag skom du bzhes: bla med mchod pas dgyes gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes nam mkhar mchod: de nas 'don cha dang bstun te: ru tra'i yan lag dang nying lag phyogs su bzhag: hūm̐: stong khams gdug pa'i ru tra bsgral byas te: snying khar che mchog sprul pa'i pho brang 'debs: dbus phyogs ma la ya yi dur khrod gsal: rtsib g.yas bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod gyur: yang dag lha tshogs sgrub pa'i pho brang 'debs: mgo bo sku la rdzogs pa'i dur khrod gyur: 'jam dpal gshin rje bsgrub pa'i pho brang 'debs: rtsib g.yon laṅka brtsegs pa'i dur khrod gyur: dbang chen rta mgrin bsgrub pa'i pho brang 'debs: gsang gnas padma brtsegs pa'i dur khrod gyur: phrin las phur pa bsgrub pa'i pho brang 'debs: lag g.yas lhun grub gter gyi dur khrod gyur: drag po thod phreng bsgrub pa'i pho brang 'debs: lag g.yon gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod gyur:

ma mo rbod gtong bsgrub pa'i pho brang 'debs: rkang g.yon he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod gyur: 'jig rten mchod bstod bsgrub pa'i pho brang 'debs: rkang g.yas 'jig rten brtsegs pa'i dur khrod gyur: dmod pa drag sngags bsgrub pa'i pho brang 'debs: phyi nang sha khrag nang rol dbang po'i tshogs: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i rdzas su byin gyis rlobs: oṃ badzra dharma aṣṭa na swa bhā wa haṃ: zhes yan lag rnams so sor phral zhing bzhag: de nas rig ma mtshan dang ldan pas: rgyan chas spras te rin po che'i snod kyi nang du 'bru sna blugs: lag tu mda' dar thogs nas: dus mtshan ma mi rgyu ba'i phyogs su kha gtad nas 'gro ba gces so: zhi ba yin na shar du phyin la: rin po che'i 'bru sna gtor zhing bkra shis smon lam btab: sa yang dkar la 'jam par blangs shing : rin po che'i snod 'khyer blang bar bya: rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor yin na: lho phyogs la kha gtad de ser la 'bol ba'i sa blang ngo : dbang gi dkyil 'khor yin na nub tu phyin te dmar la snum pa'i sa blang ngo : drag po'i dkyil 'khor yin na nag la kham pa'i sa blang ngo : gtso bo spyi 'dus yin na sngo la dwangs pa'i sa blang ngo : sa rnams sa bzhi ltar ma rnyed na: gang rung 'jam pa rdo med pa gtsang bar byas: skya 'bol 'dra ba'i sa bse rag ma yin na bzang : gang gi bye ma yin na rung : de bzhin du blangs shing sa de dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i tshad kyi dbus su blug go: de nas las byang nyung ngu zhig gtong zhing bum pa bsgrub: de yang sngar ltar rig mas chu mgo las chu rim ltar nas blangs te: bum chu byas: bum rdzas dri bzang btab: rdo rje slob dpon shar du zhal gyu zhing : bum chus sa de cung zhig 'bol bar bya: de yang slas ma drag pa: gang ma drag par byas te: rig mas sa bcag cing dbus mtho ba 'jam par bya zhing brdung : hūm̐: dam tshig rdo rje ye shes gsang ba'i chu:

rnam dag yon tan dri ma med pa'i rdzas: smon lam dbang gis byang chub sems bskyed mchog: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor sa gzhir chag chag 'debs: oṃ badzra sa ma ya gaṅgā a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: kun rgyu rdo rje'i sa gzhi la: rang byung rten 'brel 'char ba'i rtogs: gsang ba ḍākki'i dal bcag ste: dbang chen mkha' klong yangs par gsal: oṃ sarba dharma bhrūm̐ mi haṃ: de nas thig skud dal gyi nyis 'gyur las ma thung bar dar tshon sna lngas bsgril: dal shes rab yin pas dmar po bya: thig thabs yin pas dkar po bya: rdo rje slob dpon nub na bzhugs: gzungs ma shar du bsdad de: dang po ye shes kyi thig mkha' la gdab pa ni: thig sne rig ma'i spyi bor bzung la: hūm̐: kun gzhi ka dag dbyings kyi klong : rang byung rig pa'i rtsal shar te: mi 'gyur rdo rje spro ba'i lam: gsang ba dbyings kyi klong du thob: oṃ badzra saṃ tri ta gu hya dharma hoḥ de nas longs sku'i thig mgrin par gtad de: hūm̐: sgyu rtsal ma 'gag lam gyis shar: gsal stong snying po'i thabs kyi chos: shes rab drwa ba'i dbyings su spro: longs skus de bzhin thig thob cig: oṃ badzra gi waṃ ti hūm̐ āḥ snying khar tshad cing sprul sku'i 'khor lo gdab par bya la: hūm̐: lhun grub rang byung de bzhin dbyings: 'khor lo lnga ldan dkyil 'khor gtso: rang byung bde chen kunda'i rgyud: shes rab stong pa'i 'khor lo gdab: oṃ badzra dharma dhā tu bhya: de nas rgyu 'byung sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor la thig gdab pa ni: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes ldan dge ba'i grogs: gsang ba'i brda skad 'byin pa'i dbyangs: gar bsgyur bskyed mdzad bde 'byin mas: rnam dag rdo rje'i thig thob cig: oṃ swa bhā wa ātma ko3 dhā tu gharbhe a: zhes tshangs thig drang por gdab bo: de nas rim bzhin bcu drug bzhi pa gdab: tshon rtsi rnams zhib la mdangs che bar bya zhing : dang po 'byung ba rim brtsegs phyir:

dbus su ljang khu 'og tu bzhag: tām̐ zhes pa bri: de'i steng dmar po bzhag: pām̐ zhes bri: de'i steng du dkar po bzhag: mām̐ zhes bri: de'i steng ser po bzhag: lām̐ zhes bri: de'i steng sngon po bzhag: mūm̐ zhes bri: hoḥ 'byung lnga rang byung bsnol brtsegs thabs: gsang ba dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma: rang byung rang shar de bzhin ngang : 'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus de ltar bstim: oṃ yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ bhrūm̐: de nas so sor blangs te: phyogs mdog tu bzhag nas: oṃ trām̐ a hrī hūm̐: zhes bri: hūm̐: zhe sdang nga rgyal 'dod chags dang : gti mug ma spangs dbyings su dag: ye shes lnga ru lam gyis shar: kun rgyu gnas 'gyur sa bon bhrūm̐: oṃ bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe haṃ: zhes pas tshon byin gyis brlabs: de nas lha rang mdog sngon du btang la 'byung ba rim brtsegs bya: de nas dkyil 'khor grub pa dang : hūm̐: snod bcud stong gsal zang thal klong : āḥskye med ngo bo rtsal snang shar: oṃ gnyis bsdus sprul pa'i kha dog grub: bhrūm̐ dur khrod pho brang wal gyis gsal: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dharma dhā tu bhyaḥ zhes pho brang gsal: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sbas tshal padma bkod nas gdan drangs shing padma chos gling du shog ser nas phab pa'o// //

ja)༄༅/ /bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bla ma rgyangs 'bod thugs rje'i lcags kyu bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma: bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: bla ma'i gsol 'debs rim pa ni: gsung dbyangs thugs rje'i lcags bstan: ye shes bu rang yid la zungs: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: de yang byin rlabs bla ma'i gdung dbyangs la gnyis te/ phyogs med ri khrod 'grib pa'i tshe: bla ma'i nyams dbyangs 'bod pa gces: rkyen ngan glo bur shar ba'i tshe: bla ma'i nyams dbyangs 'bod pa gces: khyad par thun drug thams cad du: nyams dbyangs bla ma 'bod pa gces: de ni rang don rim pa'o: sgo gsum rgya yan shor ba'i tshe: bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med bsre: lam bzhi'i shes pa 'gags pa'i tshe: bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med bsre: gnas drug duḥkhas g.yeng ba'i tshe: bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med bsre: de ni nges don rim pa'o: da ni bla ma 'bod pa ste: mi phyed gdung ba'i dbyangs kyi ngang : rtse gcig gsol ba 'di ltar gdab: na mo gu ru: bdag nyid tha mal shes pa rnam dag pa'i: spyi bo dung khang steng gi nam mkha' la: ye shes lnga ldan 'ja' 'od gtibs pa'i klong : sgyu ma'i snang tshul ngang las grub pa'i sku: gtan gyi skyabs gnas bla ma gu ru rje: sku mdog dkar dmar mdzes 'dzum gzhon tshul can: pad zhwa zab ber chos gos rnam gsum gsol: rdo rje bhandha tshe bum kha ṭwāṃ brten: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ye shes rol pa'i tshul: g.yas g.yon zhi ba las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: dkar ser dmar ljang chags pa'i gar stabs can: gcer mo bha ga nu ma rab tu rgyas: bde ba mi bzod gar gyi 'khrul 'khor bsgyur: de ltar rang 'dras mkha' lam bun gyis gang : rtsa ba'i bla ma skyabs yul kun 'dus nyid: ye shes mkha' 'gro gsang ba 'bum gyis bskor: thabs shes zung 'jug bde stong sku nyid la:

mi phyed gdung bas gsol ba snying nas 'debs: snang stong sku la grags stong gsungs: bde stong thugs mchog ye shes dbyings: skyabs yul ngo bo padma 'byung : ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la: rtse gcig gdung bas gsol ba 'debs: khyed nyid lta bur byin gyis rlobs: bla ma mkhyen no: bla ma mkhyen no: bla ma mkhyen no: kye ma kyi hud: mtshungs med skyabs gcig gi ngo bo: thugs rje byin rlabs kyi gter chen: thabs mchog gsang sngags kyi sdong po: drin chen padma de 'byung gnas: shes rab zab yangs kyi gsang mdzod: ma sring mkha' 'gro ni rgya mtshos: gsol 'debs byed po la gzigs dang : thar lam them skas la 'gro ba'i: lam ston lcags kyu zhig gnongs dang : dus ngan mar 'grib kyi bskal pa: rtsod ldan snyigs ma yi dus 'dir: ci byas log pa ru skyes pa'i: dred po bdag 'dra la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: skra bregs ngur smrig 'dra gyon yang : sdom gsum g.yang sa ru dor te: nyon mongs 'ba' zhig la spyod pa'i: las ngan bdag 'dra la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: so thar khas len 'dra zhus kyang : dam tshig ngos lkog la shor zhing : dug lnga mi chos la 'byams pa'i: snying med bdag 'dra la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: lus tshul dge slong du 'dzin yang : spyod pa 'jig rten du shor te: khyim 'dzin phal pa las sdug pa'i: khrel med bdag 'dra la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: bslab sbyang kha bshad la mkhas kyang : snying po'i nyams len de bor nas: byang sems pham ltung du shor ba'i: kheng ldan bdag 'dra la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: dge 'dun tshogs gral la 'grims kyang : dag snang grub mtha' yis bcings nas: chags sdang mi nag las sdug pa'i: skal ngan bdag 'dra la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig:

smon lam yar 'dren la re nas: shi gson sngas kha la 'grims kyang : spyod pa las ngan rang bsags pa'i: rnam smin bdag 'dra la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: gzhis dgon chags sdang gis bzung nas: bsnyen sgrub khe tshong la g.yeng ste: rnam smin rang shugs su 'khor ba'iḥ nyes can bdag 'dra la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: 'dul ba bya btang chas 'dzin yang : ser sna zhen chags kyis bcings nas: yi dwags 'jig rten gyi ser gzugs: bse rag bdag 'dra la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: bla mas thugs rjes rang skyobs shig: las ngan rnam smin las sgrol cig: kye ma kyi hud: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso bo gu ru: rigs kun khyab bdag ngo bo pad 'byung : 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sgrol ba'i ded dpon: dug lnga'i dmag tshogs bzlog pa'i ye shes: bka' drin 'khor med bla ma gu ru: dbyings phyug ḍākki'i tshogs dang bcas la: rtse gcig gsol ba snying nas 'debs so: thugs rjes yal ba ru ma dor: theg chen sa mkhan rang mdzod dang : skyabs mchog yid bzhin gyi nor bu: bla ma mkhyen no: bla ma mkhyen no: bla ma mkhyen no: yang mtha' nyi shu yi sa rtags: 'pho 'chug drag po yi dbang gis: dmag 'khrug mtshon cha la 'thabs pa'i: zhe sdang bdag 'dra la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: gsang sngags theg chen la zhugs kyang : nyams len 'khri ba yis bcings nas: a 'thas gol sa ru shor ba'i: le lo bdag 'dra la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: bskyed rim dkyil 'khor la zhugs kyang : dam tshig bsnyen sgrub kun yal nas: rgyud sde'i khas blangs kun nyams pa'i: bande bdag 'dra la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: a ti snying po 'dra zhus kyang : gnas lugs 'dzin pa yis bcings nas: tshogs drug 'gog lam du shor ba'i: a 'thas bdag 'dra la gzigs dang :

mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: sngags lugs pho nya la bsten rlom: ngo tsha gsang khrel 'dra med cing : byang sems 'pho bsdam las nyams pa'i: 'dod sred bdag 'dra la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: cha lugs btsun chas tsam 'dzin yang : spyod 'gros bud med dang bsdongs nas: byi phrug thor po rang slog pa'i: ya pho bdag 'dra la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: bskyed rdzogs yin lo tsam zhus nas: grong nag dkor sdud la 'byams te: mo rku chang 'thung rang rgyab pa'i: gte pho bdag 'dra la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: dbang yod ser gzugs 'dra yin sems: bsnyen sgrub kha mchu la sbyangs nas: mi lus stong log la bsgrubs pa'i: lcags mgo bdag 'dra la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: mtshan ldan bla ma 'dra mjal yang : nges shes dag snang kun 'grib cing : ci byed log lta la sbyangs pa'i: mun gzugs bdag 'dra la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: bla mas thugs rjes rang gzigs dang : bag chags 'thib po 'di sol cig: kye ma kyi hud: thugs rje byin rlabs kyi nyi 'od: mun pa sel ba yi sgron me: thar lam myur bgrod kyi rta mchog: nyon mongs tshad 'joms kyi sman pa: bkres skom sgrib sel gyi chu rgyun: dbul ba gdung sel gyi mdzod gling : 'dren mchog padma de 'byung gnas: thar lam sa mkhan gyi 'gro mgon: rig 'dzin yab yum gyi tshogs la: gdung bas gsol ba rang 'debs so: thugs rjes da lta rang gzigs shig: mi 'dod sdug bsngal gyi gling 'dir: yun ring tha mal du 'khyams nas: thar lam 'ju thag rang chad pa'i: skye bo las ngan la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: mi lus kun tshang 'dra thob kyang : don med g.yeng ba la zad cing : chags sdang btson ra ru tshud pa'i: skye bo las ngan la gzigs dang :

mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: khyim thabs sa bzung la sbyangs shing: mi tshe 'thab rtsod la phud nas: mya ngan zad mtha' rang med pa'i: skye bo las ngan la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: bsod nams dbul ba yi shugs kyi: kha zas rgyab gos la brten nas: bsad bcad rdung rdeg dang btsogs pa'i: sdig can skye bo la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: khas grags kun bkur gyi ched du: smon lam log pa ru 'brel zhing : gnod 'tshe mi dge lnga spyod pa'i: skye bo las ngan la gzigs dang : mtha' med sems can rnams skyobs shig: bla mas thugs rjes rang gzigs shig: khas len bla ma la zhus kyang : nyams len bag med la spyod de: mi tshe 'khor ba yi g.yog mo: btsun ma chos med la gzigs dang : las ngan sems can rnams skyobs shig: cha lugs ser gzugs tsam 'dzin yang : nyon mongs tshad gdung gis ded nas: dung dung mun nag kun bsnyags pa'i: btsun ma chos med la gzigs dang : las ngan sems can rnams skyobs shig: mi kha sgro skur la 'jigs nas: byi phrug sa dong la sbas shing : 'di phyi gnyis phung rang thon pa'i: btsun ma chos med la gzigs dang : las ngan sems can rnams skyobs shig: snang ba rgya yan du 'gro nas: chang 'thung khyo pho kun 'tshogs sar: bred gdung 'dod chags kyis gzir ba'i: btsun ma chos med la gzigs dang : las ngan sems can rnams skyobs shig: dben ri zla shas tsam 'dzin yang : bsnyen sgrub thag las la brtson ste: mgo bskor mi kha yi mtshams pa: btsun ma chos med la gzigs dang : las ngan sems can rnams skyobs shig: nam zhig 'byung ba rang 'thor tshe: ba nyal glang nyal gyi 'chi stangs: snang ba gar 'gro tsam med pa'i: btsun ma chos med la gzigs dang : las ngan sems can rnams skyobs shig: bla mas thugs rjes rang gzigs shig: nyin mo las dka' la g.yeng zhing : bar skabs chags sdang gi mig ser:

mtshan mo gti mug tu 'khyams pa'i: nag mo chos med la gzigs dang : las ngan rnam smin las skyobs shig: khyim 'dzin dbang chen yin bsams pas: bran g.yog sdug bsngal gyis skyong ste: lto med gos med kyi yi dwags: nag mo chos med la gzigs dang : las ngan sems can rnams skyobs shig: mi lus bud med du yin yang : sdig rngam srin mo las che ba'i: srog gcod dbugs len gyi gtso mo: nag mo chos med la gzigs dang : sdug bsngal sems can rnams skyobs shig: tshe 'dir sdod rogs kyi khyo pho: ngo nag snying rtsub kyis skyong ste: chags sdang byi pho rang bsam pa'i: nag mo chos med la gzigs dang : sdug bsngal sems can rnams skyobs shig: mi tshe nyon mongs la shor ba'i: pho gyod sha rtsa ru gtugs te: rnam smin dmyal ba yi sa bon: nag mo chos med la gzigs dang : sdug bsngal sems can rnams skyobs shig: bla mas thugs rjes rang gzigs shig: lo tshad smin gral du med kyang : nyon mongs a rogs las che ba'i: mdze pho man tsam kun bsdus pa'i: bu mo chos med la gzigs dang : sdug bsngal sems can rnams skyobs shig: khrel dang mi tshul du bral nas: bran g.yog sdug smin la sbyar te: chu snod thor zas yan bsdu ba'i: bu mo chos med la gzigs dang : sdug bsngal sems can rnams skyobs shig: mi tshe las ngan la zad nas: kha gtad mi khyim du bskos pa'i: mnar med khrid pa yi gting rdo: bu mo chos med la gzigs dang : sdug bsngal sems can rnams skyobs shig: bla mas thugs rjes rang gzigs shig: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di skoms shig: mtha' med sems can rnams drongs shig: rigs drug sa bon rnams sregs shig: las ngan rnam smin rnams phrol cig: tshe gcig sangs rgyas lam ston cig: bla ma mkhyen no: bla ma mkhyen no: bla ma mkhyen no: mtshungs med padma 'byung gnas: dbyer med rtsa ba'i bla ma: ༈ gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje/

drin chen rtsa gsum gling pa/ rig 'dzin rdo rje bdud 'dul/ padma gter bdag gling pa/ sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag drag rtsal/ karma las 'brel gling pa/ gnam lcags rdo rje man nas 'di yan mchan bu yin par snang*/ rje btsun khyed rang mkhyen no: thugs rjes da lta rang gzigs shig: na moḥ bka' drin can gyi bla ma: sku drin can gyi bla ma: gsung drin can gyi bla ma: thugs drin can gyi bla ma: gu ru khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs shig: da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig: myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig: 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig: gnas khang 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig: mal sa 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig: thun mtshams 'di nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig: 'bral ba med par byin gyis rlobs shig: brtse ba chen pos byin gyis rlobs shig: sku mnyam par byin gyis rlobs shig: gsung mnyam par byin gyis rlobs shig: thugs mnyam par byin gyis rlobs shig: mdzad pa mnyam par byin gyis rlobs shig: nus mthu mnyam par byin gyis rlobs shig: 'dul bya mnyam par byin gyis rlobs shig: thugs rje mnyam par byin gyis rlobs shig: smon lam mnyam par byin gyis rlobs shig: bla ma mkhyen no: zhes brgya'am stong brjod: sa ma ya: e ma: bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: nyams len bla ma rgyang 'bod 'di: rigs drug 'dren pa'i lcags kyur bzhag: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra padma gter bdag gling pas: lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bsgyur ba'o/ zhal gro bar shog: sarba maṅga laṃ: nya)bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: sngon 'gro theg chen dgu ldan bzhugs so: bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra kho mo ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis:

gu ru rje la bka' gnang legs zhus te: sngon 'gro skyabs yul thig chen rim dgu brtsams: sa ma ya: dang po rang nyid snang snang ldan pa'i lus zungs dang : dang po sems bskyed pa ni/ hoḥ mtha' yas sems can bde dang ldan: sdug bsngal srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol: don gnyis bde dang mi 'bral zhing : rtag par chos 'khor bskor du gsol: gnyis pa skyabs yul gsal gdab pa ni: na mo hūm̐: snang srid snod bcud ye nas zang thal ngang : rang lus rnam dag ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings: dbu ma bde chen 'khor lo'i spyi gtsug dbus: padma nyi zla thabs shes spel ba'i steng : rtsa ba'i bla ma rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal: dkar dmar mdangs ldan lha lcam zung 'jug 'khril: de yi spyi bor rigs bdag rdo rje sems: dkar gsal mdangs ldan rdor dril yum 'khyud bsnol: de yi spyi bor ka dag kun tu bzang : mthing 'od mnyam bzhag bzang mo bde stong 'khril: skyabs yul rnam gsum longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: dkyil 'khor gtso bo rang rang phyag mtshan ldan: g.yas su rin chen padma nyi zla'i steng : dgongs brgyud gtso bo drug pa rdo rje 'chang : mthing nag rdor dril bsnol thabs skyil krung bzhugs: ston pa sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs kyis bskor: rgyab tu padma nyi zla'i khri 'phang steng : las dbang mkha' 'gro mthing ka thabs shes phyag: brda brgyud slob dpon mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: g.yon du rin chen khri 'phang dar 'bol steng : sangs rgyas ye shes he ru ka pa'i chas: dmar smug rdo rje phur pa 'dril thabs gdeng : snyan brgyud grub thob rje 'bangs 'bum gyis bskor: mdun du sna tshogs padma byol song khrir: che mchog smug nag gnam zhal dbyings phyug 'khril: rdo rje dung dmar 'dzin cing bka' brgyad lha: de yi phyi rim phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang : byang sems rig 'dzin brgyud bcas 'bum gyis bskor: mkha' la shar ba'i nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ltar:

dran rdzogs rtse gcig snang stong lam gyis gsal: de yi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas rnams: mos gus gdung shugs gsol ba 'debs pa yis: byin rlabs 'bad med thugs rjes rlabs chen spyod: dkyil 'khor gtso bo gcig dril deng 'dir bsgrub: ces mos gus gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis: dang po bla ma chos sku'i gsol 'debs ni: na mo hūm̐: e ma hoḥ chos dbyings ka dag lhun grub pho brang nas: kun bzang thog ma'i mgon por skyabs su mchi: ye shes lnga ldan ma 'gags pho brang nas: rdor sems longs spyod rdzogs la skyabs su mchi: sna tshogs rang shar rdzu 'phrul pho brang nas: sprul sku thod phreng rtsal la skyabs su mchi: gcig shes kun grol lta ba'i pho brang nas: brda brgyud mtsho rgyal sku l bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod chen po ru: padma saṃ bha'i sku l ra ga ra ti'i gsang ba'i gnas mchog tu: blo ldan mchog sred sku l bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod chen po ru: padma rgyal po'i sku l dur khrod so sa gling gi gnas mchog tu: nyi ma 'od zer sku l za hor siṃ ha gsang ba'i brag phug nas: shākya seṅge'i sku l rdo rje gdan gyi gnas mchog dam pa ru: seṅge sgra sgrogs sku l stag tshang seṅge bsam 'grub gnas mchog tu: rdo rje gro lod rtsal l chos sku longs sku sprul sku yang sprul la: skyabs su mchi'o thugs rje spyan gyis gzigs: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: de nas rgyal ba dgongs brgyud kyi gsol 'debs ni: dbyangs snyan po'i 'di ltar gdab: na mo hūm̐: bskal pa dpag med bkod pa nam mkha'i khyon: ye shes rdo rje rig pa'i khye'u chung : mngon rdzogs ston pa de la skyabs su mchi: tshe lo bye ba mi mjed 'jig rten khams: ston pa mi 'khrugs pa l tshe lo 'bum phrag drod gsher 'jig rten du: ston pa 'jigs pa skyob l tshe lo brgyad khri mngal skyes gnas mchog tu:

gzhon nu rnam par rol l tshe lo bdun khri sum cu rtsa gsum na: ston pa rdor 'chang sku l tshe lo drug khri gsang chen me ri 'bar: gzhon nu stobs ldan ston par? tshe lo khri phrag srin yul ru lu'i gling : drang srong khro rgyal ston par? tshe lo lnga stong rdo rje yangs pa can: ston pa gser 'od dam par skyabs su mchi: tshe lo stong phrag sog po g.yu smin yul: ston pa blo gros rgyal bar? tshe lo lnga brgya bya rgod phung ri ru: ston pa 'od srung de l tshe lo sum brgya rdo rje gdan drung du: mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas de l tshe lo brgya phrag wā rā ṇa sī ru: ston pa shākya thub par? ma la ri bo gsang ba'i gnas mchog tu: ston pa rdo rje chos l dkar me gcig la gnyis mched snang tshul bzhin: sgrol ma brgya rtsa brgyad l byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba'i bla ma mchog: nye ba'i sras chen brgyad l dgongs pa zab mo klong yangs nam mkha'i khyon: sa bcu lam lnga thogs med bgrod par shog: de nas rig 'dzin brda'i brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa ni: na mo hūm̐: kun gzhi ma bcos rang gsal skye med klong : sna tshogs gar mkhan byed las rnam sprul pa: las kyi dbang mo'i sku l dur khrod bsil ba tshal gyi gnas mchog tu: slob dpon hūm̐ chen sku l sku la rdzogs pa'i dur khrod chen po ru: mañdzu shrī'i sku l dur khrod laṅka brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog tu: nā gardzu ni sku l padma brtsegs pa'i dur khrod chen po ru: pra bha hastī'i sku l lhun grub gter gyi dur khrod gnas mchog tu: bi ma mi tra'i sku l gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod gnas mchog tu: dha na saṃ skṛ'i sku l he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod gnas mchog tu: rombu gu hya'i sku l dur khrod 'jig rten brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog tu: shāntiṃ garbha'i sku l snang srid klong yangs ye shes gcig tu shar: dgongs brgyud rdo rje sems dpar?

mtshon byed ri mo snang ba'i grwa zur tsam: brda brgyud dga' rab rdo rjer? nyi ma gcig la mched pa'i 'bum phrag dbyibs: snyan brgyud mañdzu shrīr? brda bzhi dgongs pa bka' bab rten 'brel snod: tshig brgyud shrī singhar? smin grol dbang bzhi gsang ba shog ser mdzod: go byi de ma'i sku l rgyud lung dgongs pa gcig shes kun du grol: las kyi slob dpon sku l byin rlabs nus pa'i sprin phung cher g.yos nas: dbang bzhi grol lam thob par byin gyis rlobs: de nas gang zag snyan brgyud kyi gsol 'debs ni: na mo hūm̐: kun tshang lhun grub snang srid bden gnyis dbyings: rgyal sras tshul byon rig 'dzin padma 'byung : brda yi gsang mdzod ye shes mtsho rgyal lcam: thun mong ma yin snying nas? sangs rgyas ye shes brag la phur pa btab: nam mkha'i snying po nyi ma'i zer la chibs: rgyal ba mchog dbyangs rta skad phyogs bcur sgrogs: bla med rnal 'byor gsum l dpal gyi ye shes ma mo bran du khol: dpal gyi seṅges lha srin dam la btags: bai ro tsa na sgra tshad mtha' ru phyin: lta ba mthar phyin gsum l khri srong lde'u btsan mi g.yo ting 'dzin rnyed: g.yu sgra snying po rtogs pa mngon du gyur: dzñā na ku mās brag la bdud rtsi 'byin: sgom pa mthar phyin gsum l rdo rje bdud 'joms drag sngags mtha' ru phyin: ye shes dbyings ni mkha' spyod gnas su 'phur: sog po lha dpal gdug pa'i gcan gzan 'dzin: spyod pa mthar phyin gsum l sna nam ye shes bya ltar thogs med lding : dpal gyi dbang phyug phur pa gdeng tshad gum: ldan ma rtse mang mi brjed gzungs rnams thob: 'bras bu klong gyur gsum l ska ba dpal brtsegs gzhan gyi shes rgyud mthong : shud bu dpal seng chu bo gyen du bzlog: rgyal ba'i blo gros ro langs gser du bsgyur: gzhi yi klong gyur gsum l khye'u chung lo tsās nam mkha'i bya rnams 'dzin:

dran pa nam mkhas byang g.yag dbus su 'gugs: 'o bran dbang phyug chu la nya ltar 'dzul: lam mchog mthar phyin gsum l rma thog rin chen pha wang zan ltar rol: dpal gyi rdo rje ri brag thogs med bgrod: rgyal ba byang chub nam mkhar skyil krung bzhugs: lang 'gro dkon mchog nam mkha'i thog rgod 'phen: rtogs pa mngon gyur bzhi l rig 'dzin 'dus pa dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i mdzod: snyan brgyud 'bras bu mi brjed dran pa thob: thugs rje nus rtsal phrin las stobs kyis phyug: snyan brgyud rje 'bangs rnams l brda bzhi klong du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs: de nas tshig brgyud shog ser brgyud pa'i dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i gsol ba 'debs pa ni: na mo hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: che mchog zhi khro'i sku la skyabs su mchi: me long ye shes e yi pho brang nas: yang dag thugs kyi lha l mnyam nyid ye shes e yi pho brang nas: 'jam dpal sku yi lha l sor rtog ye shes e yi pho brang nas: padma gsung gi lha l bya grub ye shes e yi pho brang nas: phrin las phur pa'i lha l snang stong lhun grub e yi pho brang nas: ma mo rbod gtong lha l grags stong ye shes e yi pho brang nas: bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs la skyabs su mchi: gsal stong ye shes e yi pho brang nas: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha l bde stong ye shes e yi pho brang nas: dmod pa drag sngags lha l rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang bstan pa'i bya ra ba: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sku l dkyil 'khor gsang ba gdams pa'i srog 'dzin pa: rtsa brgyud bla ma'i sku l smon lam dbang chen mi brjed gzungs bzhi thob: rdo rje bdud 'dul rtsal l 'brel tshad don ldan tshogs gnyis mtha' ru phyin: tshig brgyud shog ser brgyud par? don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: de nas dbang lung khrid kyi brgyud pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa ni:

na mo hūm̐: 'khor 'das snod bcud dag pa lha yi zhing : gzugs rnams yi dam sgra grags chos dbyings gdangs: dran rig 'od gsal stong nyid lhag ge ba: dbang bzhi theg pa'i rim par gsol ba 'debs: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun tshogs kyi mchog: phyi yi skyabs yul rnams l bla ma rnams dang yi dam mkha' 'gro ste: nang gi skyabs yul rnams l chos sku longs sku sprul sku rnam pa gsum: gsang ba'i skyabs yul rnams l rtsa dang rlung dang bde chen thig le gsum: don gyi skyabs yul rnams l lta ba dang ni sgom pa spyod pa gsum: lam gyi skyabs yul rnams l gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu rnam pa gsum: grogs kyi skyabs yul rnams l ngo bo dang ni rang bzhin thugs rje gsum: gzhi yi skyabs yul rnams l bde dang gsal dang ting 'dzin mi rtog gsum: khregs chod skyabs yul rnams l de ltar skyabs mchis gsol btab gdung ba'i mod: phyogs bcu'i rgyal sras brgyud bcas ma lus pa: skyabs yul lnga tshom sku la rim par thim: lnga ldan rnams kyang gtso bo gu rur thim: 'od du zhu nas sku gsung thugs yon tan: byin rlabs yi ge 'bru lnga spyi bor thim: tshangs bug nas zhugs lus kun ltem gyis gang : ka dag zang thal gsal stong 'od lnga yi: rang bzhin 'bar ba 'od gsal snying por gyur: kā ya siddhi om̐: wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐: sa ma ya a we sha ya a āḥ zhes dmigs pa rnams gzhung gi tshig ltar bya: dbang bzhi blang : tha ma spros bral 'od kyi gong bu can gyi rang bzhin du bzhag go: sa ma ya: syaṃ3 bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: dkyil 'khor kun gyi sngon 'gro'i phyir: skyabs yul rim pa e ma hoḥ thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dbyair chaiai: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo padma gter bdag gling pas sbas yul padma rong nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas bod yig tu bsgyur ba'o:
dge'o// //

ta) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: 'od dpag med kyi ye shes snying po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs ni: spros med lta bu bstan par bya: dang po skyabs 'gro ni/ hūm̐: sku gsum dkon mchog rnam gsum rtsa ba gsum: gzhi lam 'bras bu ngo bo rang bzhin mchog: bde gsal mi rtog thugs la skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ hūm̐: sems can bde ldan sdug bsngal kun grol zhing : tshad med rnam bzhi'i byang chub lam 'byongs te: ma gyur 'gro ba smon lam dpal zhing rnams: kun kyang bla med 'bras bu thob par bgyi: gsum pa dngos gzhi ni/ rang rig ma bcos ngang nyid las: dran rig ye shes lha sku yis: gtad med shes pa'i ngo bo bzung : ma bcos snang stong 'di ltar bsgom: hūm̐: chos dbyings ka dag rang byung klong : ma bcos zang thal pho brang dbus: rang rig hrīḥlas 'od dpag med: a mi dhe wa sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gsal stong ngang : zhi 'dzum mdangs ldan mtshan dpes brgyan: thugs rje'i spyan gyis phyogs bcur gzigs: phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag bde stong ngang : zhabs gnyis skyil krung lham me ba: 'khor 'das bral ba chos kyi sku: thugs kar hrīḥyig dmar po'i mthar: a mi dhe wa g.yas su 'khor: spro bsdu zang thal stong pa'i dbyings: ma 'gags thugs rjes 'gro kun skyob: snang ba stong gzugs sgyu ma'i ngang : sgra grags ngo bo brag cha'i dbyangs: 'gyu ba dran rig blo bral chos: phyi nang 'od dpung 'ja' lus bsgom: 'khor ba myang 'das 'gro drug tshogs: thog ma'i sangs rgyas don rtogs shog: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ oṃ buddha ā yurdzñā na hrīḥ zhes sngags phreng 'dzin med stong pa'i rang mdangs las: grags stong dran stong zung 'jug ngang la bzla: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis bris:

tshe gcig sangs rgyas bgrod pa'i lam: yang zab chos sku'i sgrub pa nyid: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo padma gter bdag gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing*/ chos gling du shog ser las zhal bshus so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // tha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: spyan ras gzigs kyi yi ge drug ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: yi ge drug ma'i sgrub thabs ni: 'di nyid spros med lugs su 'dod: rnam snang ldan pa'i lus kyi ngang : rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: snang stong ma bcos 'di ltar bsgom: hūm̐: skad cig dran rdzogs chos dbyings pho brang dbus: rin chen sna tshogs pad zla'i gdan khri'i steng : rang rig hrīḥlas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: sku mdog dkar po zhi 'dzum shel gyi mdangs: zhal gcig phyag bzhi mtshan dpe gzi brjid 'bar: rin chen sna tshogs dbu rgyan cod pan 'phur: snyan cha mgul rgyan rin chen se mo do: g.yas g.yon dang po shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin: nor bu phyag rgya thugs kar thal mo sbyar: lha rdzas dar gyi stod g.yogs smad dkris mdzes: rdo rje skyil krung thugs rjes 'gro la gzigs: 'ja' lus 'od gsal snang stong lhang nge ba: phyi nang sgrib med zang thal ngang la bsgom: thugs kar hrīḥmathar sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor: nyon mongs las sgrib bag chags kun dag nas: rang lus shel sgong dri med lta bur gyur: slar yang thugs nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: snang gzugs thams cad 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: sgra rnams thams cad grags stong yig drug dang : dran rig 'gyu ba thugs rje chen po'i klong : mtha' yas sems can 'gro kun rigs drug rnams: 'jig rten dbang phyug go 'phang thob gyur cig: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ārya lo ki shwa ra hūm̐:

zhes thugs rje chen po bsgoms: gzugs sgra rig gsum ma bcos gnas lugs ngang la bzhag: sa ma ya: e maḥ myur zab spros med sgrub pa 'di: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis bris: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sbas gnas nas gdan drangs pa'o// // da) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: sprul sku pad 'byung gi sgrub thabs bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sprul sku rig 'dzin sgrub thabs ni: 'di nyid spros med lugs su 'dod: ma bcos snang stong 'di ltar bsgom: hūm̐: skad cig dran rdzogs ma bcos lhun grub zhing : ye shes sna tshogs 'khrigs pa'i pho brang dbus: padma nyi zla seng khri'i gdan steng du: rang rig hūm̐ las padma 'byung gnas sku: dkar dmar mdangs ldan gzi brjid 'od stong 'bar: khro 'dzum spyan gyi thugs rjes dbyings su gzigs: pad zhwa sgro dar rin chen rgyan gyis spras: phod kha chos gos za 'og ber chen gsol: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas ka pā la: tshe bum dang bcas gru mor kha ṭwāṃ brten: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rgyal po rol stabs kyis: mu stegs bdud dang dam sri zil gnon tshul: mtshan dpes rab rgyan bde chen gzi 'bar bsgom: thugs ka'i hūm̐ mthar badzra gu ru 'khor: phyi nang bar chad rkyen ngan dbyings su sgrol: spro bsdu sngags phreng 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: drag po'i mthu stobs 'gro ba'i bsod nams kun: 'ub kyis bsdus nas rnal 'byor bdag la thim: 'chi med rig 'dzin 'ja' lus srog bsgrubs nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya dza siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes sngags phreng spro bsdu zung 'jug ye shes lnga'i rnal 'byor du bzla'o:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis bris: byin rlabs bla med gsang ba nyid: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs pa'o// //na)༄༅/ /bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i las byang 'ja' tshon drwa ba bzhugs so: bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: e ma hoḥ rgyal dbang mgon gyur 'gro ba'i bla ma nyid: kho bo mkhas mchog rgya gar pad 'byung ngas: byin rlabs mkhyen brtse'i ti ka dmar po nas: mi zad rgyun gyi dbang phyug thugs rje yi: 'od zer nar mas smin grol lam ston phyir: lugs gnyis mnga' sgyur rig 'dzin gsang 'dus kyi: snying po'i bcud dril yang zab bcud kyi mchog: gang gis reg na yang dag don ldan pa: rig 'dzin bla ma kun 'dus las byang bstan: dbyangs can bde ba'i gar mos rig pas zungs: brda dgu man ngag thig le'i yi ger gzugs: zab rgya nor bu gdengs ka'i sgrom du bzhugs: klong lnga'i rang bzhin khyon yangs rgya mtshor sbas: rmongs tshogs gzhom pa'i shes rab klu la bcol: ma 'ongs yid kyi dbang phyug lotstsha ba: sangs rgyas ye shes rgyal dbang gar gyi rtsal: rtsa gsum gling pa ratna'i khyon rtse mdangs: rig 'dzin thugs sras de la sprod do rgya: khyab byed 'khyil ba'i tha dad nā ga 'dod: rtags sam 'das pa'i dngos ming a thaṃ rgya: dam tshig las kyi srung ma des srungs shig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po zab gnad nyams len rgyun khyer gyi: byin rlabs bla ma sgrub pa'i las rim ni: spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med dang : phyi sgrub nang sgrub gsang sgrub yang gsang sgrub: kho na de nyid mchog gi bsgrub pa dang : bskyed dang rdzogs dang spro bsdu lam khyer sogs: tha dad mos pa'i bye brag sna tshogs yang :

'di nyid zung 'jug don la gzhung 'dzin pa'i: nges don bsgrub pa kun gyi mthar thug ste: byin rlabs bla ma'i las byang gtong ba ni: bkra shis byin chags rten 'brel 'phro bzang bar: rgyal bas lung bstan 'phags pa'i gangs can gnas: dben pa'i rigs mthun ke'u tshang gang rung du: sku rten srung 'khor thugs kyi dgongs gnad rdzas: phyi nang mchod tshogs spyan gzigs la sogs pa: ma tshang med pa tshang zhing yid dwang bas: spyi lung rgyud sde kun la mthun pa ni: dkyil 'khor las rim gsal mdangs lam mer dgram: rang nyid bskyed rdzogs zung ldan bag dro'i ngang : lhun chags dgyes pa'i shugs las brtsam par bya: sa ma ya: dang po sngon 'gro sems bskyed ni: na mo: chos rnams mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las: 'khor 'das thams cad byang sems snying rje'i rtsal: 'bad rtsol bral ba'i smin grol lam 'god phyir: ye nas shes bzhin bag yod sems bskyed do: gnyis pa byin rlabs 'jug pa'i skyabs yul ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dran rig sku lnga'i klong yangs gdod nas dag: rang byung ye shes rgyal ba kun gyi thugs: de sras rol pa rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshogs: mchog gsum 'du 'bral med la skyabs su gsol: gsum pa nga bdag tshar gcod bgegs bskrad ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: rang nyid ye shes rol pa'i cho 'phrul las: rig cing rtsal ston dpal chen he ru ka'i: thugs las spros pa'i snying rje'i sa bon ni: bar med khyab par phyogs bcu kun tu 'phros: shugs kyis ma rig bgegs tshogs kun bsdus nas: gtor ma len phyir yud kyis 'di ru mchis: om̐ badzra bhū ta garbha he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ mi mthun bgegs tshogs a karṣa ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: nga ni bdag med dpal chen he ru ka'iḥ skye med tshig la gnyis 'dzin gdon gyis nyon: ro gcig rtogs phyir mchod sbyin 'di bzhes la: tha dad mos pa'i snang ngor gzhan du dengs: ci ste mi 'gro bag chags a 'thas pa'i:

bdag 'dzin mun pa'i gling du gtan 'khyams na: bag yod shes rab lta ba'i ral gri yis: nyon mongs ma rig gdon tshogs dum bur gtub: de bas skye med klong du dengs thims shig: om̐ badzra kro ta dzñā na hā sa pradzñā ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ mtshan 'dzin bgegs tshogs u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bzhi pa rang bzhin srung ba'i gur khang ni: hūm̐: ye nas snang srid lhun grub gzhal yas khang : snod bcud gzugs snang sgyu ma'i ye shes lha: de don ma rtogs shes sgrib mtshams gcod pa'i: bag yod rang gsal lta ba'i gur khang shar: nam yang 'khor lo khyab brdal srung 'khor gyur: om̐ badzra dzñā na warti dharma dhā tu tsakra hūm̐ bhrūm̐ rakṣa ye swā hā: dang po phyi'i mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: snang srid klong ltar yangs pa'i zhing khams nas: snod bcud gzugs su sgyu mar sprul pa'i sku: mchod pa'i las 'dzin gar mo yid 'phrog ma: blo las 'das pa dpag yas sprin ltar gtibs: bkram pa'i spyan gzigs phyi mchod sna tshogs 'di: ting 'dzin bla med rdzas su byin brlabs nas: rig 'dzin rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rten du gyur: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra lā sye mā lye gīrti nīrti swa ra swa t-i waṃ se pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: rab tu yangs pa chos dbyings bhandha'i snod: zlum zhi dbyings kyi mkha' ltar 'khyil ba'i nang : zung 'jug bde chen kun da ye shes lnga: dug lnga rnam dag sha chen rdzas kyi mchog: dri bzang mdangs ldan dug lnga sel ba'i sman: 'bras bu sna tshogs sbyar ba'i dza gad chang : dkar mngar ro bcud kun ldan la sogs pa: dam tshig phyag rgyas bskyed cing spel ba 'di: rig 'dzin rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rten du gyur: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐:

lan gsum brjod: gsum pa gtor mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: thabs shes las grub nyi zla 'bar ba'i snod: srid pa'i khyon ltar rgyas pa'i dbus nyid du: brjid chags bde stong rol pa'i dpal bshos btsugs: snang srid bcud bsdus 'byung lnga'i gtor kyus bskor: phung khams rnam dag dbang po'i rgyan gyis spras: mdzes shing brjid chags ri rab lhun po ltar: legs par spungs pa'i tshogs gtor rgya mtsho 'di: rig 'dzin rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rten du gyur: om̐ sarba bha lingta ma hā māṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta om̐ āḥhūm̐: bzhi pa rakta byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: lcang lo sil bur 'phyang ba'i ka pā la: phyi dkar nang dmar mtshan ldan rgya che'i dbus: shes rab mkha' dbyings klong yangs chos 'byung du: thabs mchog rdo rjes rol te bsrubs pa yis: mu kha 'dar ma phug pa'i rgyun lam nas: bo dhi su khaṃ rakta'i rgyun chen babs: dam tshig snod du dmar chen mtsho ltar 'khyil: sna tshogs sbyor ba'i rmad byung rakta 'di: rang byung rlung g.yos rlabs chen rba 'khrug khol: sbyangs shing spel ba'i ye shes bdud rtsi 'di: rig 'dzin rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rten du gyur: om̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐: lnga pa byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub bde chen pho brang nas: kun bzang chos sku'i lha tshogs byin phob cig: ma 'gags dbyings rig rang byung pho brang nas: longs sku rdor sems lha tshogs byin phob cig: ma bcos sku lnga rang byung pho brang nas: sprul sku dga' rab rdo rjes byin phob cig: gang 'dul thugs rje mngon shar pho brang nas: rig 'dzin rgyal ba kun 'dus byin phob cig: las bzhi'i dam tshig gnyan po'i pho brang nas: yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i lha tshogs byin phob cig: chos sku'i byin 'bebs thugs rje sha ra ra: longs sku'i byin 'bebs bkrag mdangs ta la la:

sprul sku'i byin 'bebs bag dro me re re: rig 'dzin byin 'bebs gzi brjid spungs se spung : dkyil 'khor byin 'bebs dpal 'bar lams se lam: gnas 'dir byin chen phob la dbang mchog bskur: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sarba sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ a be sha ya a āḥ dang po brda sgo dbye ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe kun gzhi lha dang gnyis su med: bar du bdag 'dzin rab rib mun pas bsgribs: da ni nyon mongs 'thib po'i sgo bcad de: gnas lugs rtogs phyir lta ba'i brda sgo phyes: om̐ bhrūm̐ badzra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ gnyis pa brda bshags brda bzung ni: hūm̐: ma rtogs gzung 'dzin bag chags brdas bshags nas: snang srid phyag rgya brda yi dkyil 'khor che: kun nas klong yangs 'od gsal mchod bstod nas: rtag tu shes rig so mar gnas bgyid do: om̐ sa ma ya badzra shuddhe dharma dzñā na shrī gharba satwaṃ: gsum pa dkyil 'khor dam bca' bzung ba ni: hūm̐: ka dag bde chen rang bzhin dkyil 'khor lha: dbyings rig 'bral med yid kyi lcags kyu yis: gshis lugs gdod nas rang gsal ci bzhin du: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor srog ltar bzung : om̐ badzra hūm̐ dzñā na tsitta dza ya wa ti ma la gharba sa ma ya hūm̐: dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin ni: hūm̐: chos rnams dmigs med klong yangs mtha' dbus bral: rgya khyon mu mtha' gzhal med stong pa'i dbyings: gsal stong skyon bral brjod pa'i blo las 'das: dgongs brgyud dga' rab rdo rjes de ltar smras: om̐ badzra dharma pra kri ti swa bhā tsitta ātma ko3 haṃ: gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ni: āḥ kun gzhi ka dag gnyug ma de bzhin las: dbyings rig zang thal rol pa'i rtsal chen ngang : dmigs med thig le sna tshogs so sor shar: brda rtags shrī singhas de ltar smras: om̐ badzra dharma wā gī dhā tu tsitta warti hūm̐:

gsum pa bdag med sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin ni: om̐: bden gnyis zung 'jug snang srid sgyu ma'i ngang : ye shes lnga ldan gnas lugs yi ge hūm̐: thams cad bskyed pa'i sa bon klong las shar: snyan brgyud ma hā gu rus de ltar smras: om̐ badzra dharma dzñā na ma hā gu ru shrī sarba satwaṃ: bzhi pa 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni: hūm̐: zhing rdul brtsegs pa'i bskal pa'i srid pa stong : rlung me chu sa dbang chen gzhi rim ni: khyab cing g.yo ba'i rang bzhin bsnol brtsegs thabs: de las sa bon yi ge so sor shar: hūm̐ om̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: paṃ padma maṇḍa la: a tsand+ra maṇḍa la: ma sūrya maṇḍa la: hūm̐ badzra gu ru dzñā na tiṣṭha satwaṃ: lnga pa gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: e las nam mkha'i dbyings phyug yum chen mkha': yam̐ las g.yo ba'i dam tshig sgrol ma'i mkhar: ram̐ las sreg byed na bza' dkar mo'i mkha': kham̐ las bsil byed mā ma kī yi mkha': sum̐ las brdal khyab sangs rgyas spyan ma'i mkha': keṃ las ri rab rdo rje'i rmang gzhi brtan: bhrūm̐ las lhun grub rang byung gzhal yas khang : padma sūrya tsand+ra'i gdan gyi steng : rdo rje hūm̐ las rig 'dzin yab yum tshogs: gu ru dzñā na ma bcos lam gyis gsal: om̐ badzra dzñā na sarba rā ga ya hoḥ rā ga ya mi: dzñā na sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya ti: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya a āḥ om̐ sarba dharma dhā tu ātma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: gdod nas rang shar de bzhin ngang nyid du: 'byung lnga lhun grub brdal khyab ri rab steng : sna tshogs rdo rje sra brtan lte ba ru: ye shes lnga ldan 'od zer gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi sna lnga brtsegs pa ste: 'dod snam gar mo mchod 'dzin sprin phung gtibs: gser gyi pha gu drwa ba drwa phyed brgyan: shar bu bskyod cing mda' yab pu shu ldan: ka gdung dral lcam mu tig chun po bres: nang rnams thams cad 'ja' tshon bla bre la: lu gu rgyud kyi zer thag khor yug mched:

sgo bzhi rta babs chos 'khor nyi zla'i tog: dbus su bya 'dab rin chen 'bar bas brgyan: 'khor lo la sogs ye shes drwa ba'i tog: rig pa'i khye'u'i ri dwags chos sgra nyan: thog steng rgyal mtshan 'phan dar pu ru ru: rin chen gdugs mchog gser gyi yu ba can: thams cad brgyad de bcu drug mdangs dang ldan: phyi rol pad phreng dur khrod rdo rwa dang : srung ba'i gur khang me dpung phyogs bcur 'khrigs: phyogs bzhir zad med rin chen gter bum bzhi: ya mtshan bkod pa phun tshogs ldan pa yi: lhun grub gzhal yas ma bcos lam gyis gsal: om̐ badzra bhrūm̐ dzñā na swa bhā dharma maṇḍa la tsakra tiṣṭha hūm̐: drug pa lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: gzhal yas chen po de yi dbus nyid du: rin chen khri rkang padma nyi zla'i steng : gser gyi rdo rje'i lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan: dran rdzogs skad cig padma 'byung gnas sku: snang srid zil gnon dbang sdud rgyal po'i chas: sku mdog dmar smug khro 'dzum mdzes pa'i mdangs: dbu skra lcang lo thor tshugs prog zhu la: thod phreng rigs lnga nyi zla rdo rje'i tog: sna lnga'i dar dpyangs cod pan la sogs 'phur: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga thugs kar 'dzin: g.yon pas mnyam bzhag bhandha tshe bum bsnams: g.yer kha'i sgra ldan kha ṭwāṃ gru mor brten: snyan cha mgul rgyan rin chen gdub bu 'khrol: phod kha chos gos za 'og ber chen bklubs: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum dar chen rgya lham gsol: gsus pa che zhing sku che yan lag rags: sgeg cing dpa' ba'i shugs 'chang rol stabs can: nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid mdangs ldan bsgom: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: om̐ badzra gu ru padma kā ra dzñā na rā dza siddhi hūm̐: hūm̐: rang rig pad 'byung gsal ba'i thugs ka ru: nyi zla'i gwa'u kha sbyor gdan gyi steng : rdo rje sems dpa' dkar gsal shel gyi mdog: rdor dril bsnol thabs snyems ma yum dang sbyor:

srog yig sngags phreng dang ldan skyil krung gsal: om̐ badzra sa twa muṃ shrī hūm̐: hūm̐: sems dpa' rdo rje gsal ba'i thugs ka ru: lnga ldan ye shes rang byung gdan gyi dbus: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang inḍa'i mdog: mnyam bzhag skyil krung dbyings phyug bde stong ngang : thugs kar ka dag thig le dang bcas gsal: om̐ dzñā na sa manta bha tra bhi dho muṃ hūm̐ hrī: hūm̐: rang nyid padma 'byung gnas gsal ba yi: dpral ba mgrin pa lte ba gsang gnas su: sna tshogs padmas mdzes pa'i gdan gyi steng : sar gnas rig 'dzin tshe dbang rig 'dzin dang : phyag rgya rig 'dzin lhun grub rig 'dzin bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang khro 'dzum mdangs dang ldan: thor tshugs rus rgyan rdo rje bhandha bsnams: phyed skyil pang du 'byung bzhi'i rig ma 'khyud: rang 'dra phyag mtshan rgyan ldan bde stong ngang : gsal snang ma 'dres chu zla lta bur bsgom: om̐ badzra bhi dho dha ra ma hā tsa tur muṃ hūm̐: hūm̐: rang rig pad 'byung spyi bor 'ja' zer klong : ye shes lnga ldan lug rgyud gtibs pa'i dbus: shrī singha he ru ka pa'i chas: khro 'dzum mdangs ldan thor tshugs lcang lo 'phyangs: prog zhu rigs lnga snyan rgyan gdub bu 'khrol: rus pa'i rgyan cha stag lpags sham thabs can: rdo rje thod pa 'dzin cing skyil krung tshul: rang 'dra'i yum chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'khril: dmar smug dbang gi longs spyod rdzogs par bsgom: om̐ badzra singha ma hā dzñā na muṃ hūm̐: hūm̐: de yi spyi gtsug 'ja' 'od tshom bu'i dbus: dga' rab rdo rje ka dag snying po'i thugs: mthing ka zhi 'dzum thor tshugs dar dpyangs 'phur: rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dril bu dku la brten: skyil krung bde stong las kyi yum chen 'khyud: chos sku'i rang mdangs dri med 'od gsal bsgom: om̐ badzra dzñā na u ta pra mo ti muṃ hūm̐: hūm̐: gtso bo'i phyogs lnga'i pad 'dab mdzes pa'i steng :

manda ra ba ye shes mtsho rgyal dang : kā la siddhi shākya dhe wi ma: bkra shis khye'u 'dren la sogs mkha' 'gro lnga: dkar ser dmar ljang mdzes mthing 'dzum bzhad can: thor tshugs rigs lnga rin chen rgyan cha 'khrol: phyag g.yas mda' dar g.yon pas tshe bum bsnams: rus pa'i rgyan ldan zhabs gnyis phyed skyil bzhugs: gtso bor chags pa'i tshul gyis gsal bar bskyed: om̐ ma hā dzñā na shrī ḍākki ha ri ni sa muṃ hūm̐: hūm̐: de yi phyi rol pad 'dab brgyad rnams su: thabs shes nyi zla mdzes ldan gdan khri'i steng : hūm̐ ka ra dang 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang : klu sgrub dang ni pra bha hastī dang : bi ma mi tra dha na saṃ skṛ dang : rombu gu hya shāntiṃ garbha sogs: grub pa thob pa'i rig 'dzin rnam brgyad ni: dkar ser dmar ljang mthing smug dud kha nag: thams cad bram gzugs he ru ka pa'i chas: thor tshugs lcang lo dpa' bo'i thod chings can: mi mgo'i phreng dang cod pan du ma 'phur: rin chen snyan rgyan phyag gdub do shal 'phyangs: rus pa'i rgyan ldan stag gi sham thabs can: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas bhandha bsnams: phyed skyil phyag rgya'i 'khrul 'khor bsgyur thabs bzhugs: gzi brjid mdangs ldan gsal 'tsher lam mer bsgom: om̐ badzra hūm̐ ka ra mañdzu shrī nā gardzu na pra bha hastī bi ma mi tra dha na saṃ skṛ rombu gu hya shāntiṃ garbha ya dzñā na bhī dha dhā ra aṣṭa gu ru siddhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de yi mtshams kyi pad tshab rim pa bzhin: gtso bo rnams kyi gsang ba'i yum chen brgyad: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem mdzes pa'i lang tsho ldan: rang 'dra'i rigs mthun rdo rje tshe bum thogs: rigs lnga'i rgyan dang rin chen du mas spras: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil bde chen rgyas par bsgom: om̐ badzra dzñā na ḍākki ha ri ni sa sa ma ya gu hya aṣṭa dhā ra hūm̐: de yi phyi rol pad 'dab bcu drug la: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor mnyes byed ma:

gsang ba'i bde chen rig ma bcu drug ni: mdzes pa'i gar ldan sna tshogs mchod pa thogs: bde ba'i gar sgyur chags pa'i 'dzum mdangs ston: dgyes pa'i dpa' mo bcu drug lam gyis gsal: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe a lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe lā sye mā lye gīrti nīrti waṃ se swa ra swa t-i gu hya ḍākki dwa sha ṣa ṭa muṃ hūm̐: hūm̐: phyogs bzhir phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgo skyong ba: rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi rigs: sprul pa'i ging chen yab yum brgyad rnams ni: rang rtags phyag mtshan rin chen rus rgyan can: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum rol pa'i 'gying stabs gar: phyi nang bgegs tshogs mtshams gcod bsrung bar bsgom: om̐ badzra ratna padma karma ghṛ wa ging kā ra ḍākki nī sarba sa mā ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐: gzhan yang bar khyams 'khor yug la gnas pa'i: zhing skyong laṅka dbang phyug phra men ma: mu ran skyong sogs las kyi dam tshig can: rig 'dzin gsang 'dus tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: ma 'dres dbyings la 'ja' tshon lhags pa bzhin: snang stong zung 'jug sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs nas: 'dzin med dran rdzogs wal gyis lam mer gsal: om̐ sarba dza ya bhi dhwa dha ra pa shaṃ pa ri wā ra ye: gu ru dzñā na he siddhi ri dhi sarba sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a a āḥ dbang bskur ba bdun pa ni: hūm̐: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i gtso: bde gshegs rgyal ba rigs lnga'i tshogs: deng 'dir dbang bskur stsol nas su: ye shes lnga ru byin brlabs te: rig 'dzin 'dus par bdag gyur cig: om̐ dzñā na pañtsa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: dbang bskur de bzhin khrus gsol gyis: kun nas bslang ba'i bag chags dag: lhag ma spyi bor lud pa yis: kun bzang rigs 'dus dbu rgyan gyur: om̐ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: dang po lha tshogs spyan 'dren pa ni:

hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: kun bzang rgyal ba dgongs brgyud gshegs su gsol: rnam dag ye shes lnga ldan pho brang nas: dga' rab rig 'dzin brda brgyud gshegs su gsol: rnga yab dpal ri 'od kyi pho brang nas: pad 'byung snyan brgyud bla ma gshegs su gsol: sna tshogs zab yangs nam mkha'i pho brang nas: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: gsang ba bde chen dbyings kyi pho brang nas: ma sring ḍākki rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub pho brang nas: sgo skyong dpa' bo yab yum gshegs su gsol: bka' bzhin dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i pho brang nas: phyi nang 'dus pa'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: chags med rtog bral padma nyi zla'i steng : rig 'dzin rgyal ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams: thugs rje'i gzi mdangs bdag la bskyed pa'i phyir: mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: om̐ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: gsum pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: kun gzhi ma bcos sems nyid stong pa'i mkhar: gdod nas rang shar rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i gtso: gsang ba kun 'dus rgyal ba'i lha tshogs la: mos gus gdung ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ na mo pu rū sha ya hoḥ bzhi pa phyag rgya gar mchod ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba rgya mtsho rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i yab: bde stong gsang ba'i yum mchog sku la 'khril: zung 'jug phyag rgya drug gi 'khrul 'khor gyis: dga' bzhi bla med mchod pa bzhes su gsol: om̐ badzra rā ga ya hūm̐: pra mo ti ri āḥhūm̐: lnga pa glu dbyangs snyan mchod ni: hūm̐: sgeg mo gar mo glu dbyangs bzhad pa mo: mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan snyan pa'i sgra skad sgrog: yid 'phrog dga' ba'i lha mo tshul bzang tshogs: gsang 'dus rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha la 'bul: om̐ lā sye mā lye gīrti nīrti swa ra swa ti sa ma ya pū dza āḥhūm̐:

drug pa phyi'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: phyi yul tshogs drug dbang po'i gzung 'dzin mar: mchod sprin thogs pa'i lha mo mdzes ma 'phro: yid 'ong nam mkha'i khyon ltar gang ba 'dis: gsang 'dus rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha la 'bul: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: bdun pa nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: sha lnga bdud rtsi pañtsa a mṛ ta: sku lnga lhun grub khams lnga rnam par dag: gshis lugs mchod pa de bzhin kho na nyid: gsang 'dus rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha la 'bul: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: brgyad pa gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: mkha' yi dbang mo shes rab mu kha'i brtsegs: nor bu myos byed spyod pa'i rlung bsrubs pas: babs pa'i dga' chen zag med dkar dmar 'di: gsang 'dus rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha la 'bul: om̐ sarba a haṃ pañtsa pū dza āḥhūm̐: dgu pa sman mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: a gar dzā ti li shi ka ko la: gi waṃ dbang po srog 'dzin ril bu sogs: dug lnga sel ba'i sman mchod bdud rtsi 'di: gsang 'dus rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha la 'bul: om̐ sarba pañtsa uṇa ṇo bha ye sha ran dza a mṛ ta 'dra aṇyau bhyo shrañdza a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: bcu pa rakta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: 'khor bcas nyon mongs rtog pa bsgral ba yis: chags med mdangs ldan dmar chen sa bcud 'khyil: 'od zer 'bar ba rakta'i mchod pa 'di: gsang 'dus rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha la 'bul: om̐ sarba rakta dzwa la rā ga pū dza āḥhūm̐: bcu gcig pa gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bhandha lcang lo 'khyil ba'i snod yangs dbus: 'dod yon bcud kyi rmad byung gtor ma bshams: tshogs brgyad dbang po'i 'bras bus brgyan pa 'di: gsang 'dus rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha la 'bul: om̐ ma hā bha lingta te dzwa bha lingta māṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha raṃ khā hi: bcu gnyis pa rang byung ye shes kyi mchod pa ni:

hūm̐: nyon mongs dug lnga ye nas rang grol te: gshis lugs gnyug mar mtshan 'dzin spang blang bral: lhan skyes gdod nas lhun grub mchod pa 'di: gsang 'dus rgyal ba rig 'dzin lha la 'bul: om̐ badzra dzñā na pañtsa shū n+ya ta haṃ pū dza āḥhūm̐: bcu gsum pa bdud rtsi'i lag mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: ka ni rang bzhin ma skyes stong pa'i dbyings: pā ni 'khor 'das gnyis med ye shes ngang : la ni bde stong dga' bzhi zung du 'jug: don gsum ldan pa'i snod du bdud rtsis bkang : sor bcu rigs lnga yab yum phyag rgya yis: sbyangs spel g.yas kyis bzung nas g.yon gyis mchod: phyogs dus bde gshegs rgyal kun ngo bo nyid: gsang 'dus khyab bdag rig 'dzin lha tshogs la: 'bul lo mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang yab yum la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: longs sku'i mchog gyur rdor sems yab yum la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sa la gnas pa'i lha yi rig 'dzin la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: phyag rgya chen po'i mi yi rig 'dzin la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: tshe la dbang ba grub pa'i rig 'dzin la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lhun gyis grub pa'i klu yi rig 'dzin la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dgongs brgyud rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje la:

rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: brda brgyud rig 'dzin shrī singha la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: snyan brgyud rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: manda ra ba tshe yi rig ma la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: ye shes mtsho rgyal las kyi rig ma la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: kā la siddhi gegs sel rig ma la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: shākya dhe ma rten 'brel rig ma la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: bkra shis khye'u 'dren smon lam rig ma la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sku yi rig 'dzin 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsung gi rig 'dzin 'phags pa klu sgrub la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: thugs kyi rig 'dzin hūm̐ chen ka ra la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: yon tan rig 'dzin dha na saṃ skṛ la:

rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: phrin las rig 'dzin pra bha hastī la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: kun 'dus rig 'dzin bi ma mi tra la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gnyis med rig 'dzin rombu gu hya la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: las kyi rang bzhin shāntiṃ garbha la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsang ba rigs lnga'i ḍākki rnam brgyad la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dgongs brda brgyud kyi slob dpon chen po la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: snyan brgyud rig 'dzin dbang gi slob dpon la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: man ngag lung dang shes rab slob dpon la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: nyams chag bskang dang rtsa ba'i slob dpon la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i slob dpon thams cad la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐:

khyad par dwags po 'bri stag kar 'brug dang : lung zin skyes chen bla ma thams cad la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: bde chen gsang ba'i rig ma bcu drug la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sgo skyong yab yum ging chen 'khor bcas la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: chos skyong dam can gter srung thams cad la: rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: 'bru gsum sa bon bdud rtsi'i ngo bo nyid: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam pa ru: gnas gsum thim pas dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs: mchog thun dngos grub dam pa der thob gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ kā ya siddhi: wākka siddhi: tsitta siddhi: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes bdud rtsis gnas gsum du thig le bya zhing lce ru myong : mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad bde blag nyid du thob par bsam: bcu bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings ngo bo sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul las: ma 'gags ye shes snying po'i rang rtsal nyid: gdod ma'i klong nas 'ja' ltar shar ba'i sku: inḍa nī la'i mdangs bzang rab rgyas pa: thugs rje'i rang rtsal mi g.yo dpal 'bar ba: mnyam bzhag rdo rje skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas: gsang ba'i dbang phyug bde stong dgyes mdzad 'khril: zung 'jug snang mtha' mgon po 'od mi 'gyur: kun bzang chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dbyings rig mkha' la drwa ba'i klong chen shar: ma 'gags zang thal longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: chu shel mdangs ldan thabs shes rdor dril bsnol: zhabs gnyis skyil krung snyems ma zung 'jug 'khril:

rdor sems longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rnal 'byor dkar 'dzum zhi ba'i rig 'dzin ni: ru bya'i mdangs ldan he ru ka pa'i chas: bde stong gsang ba'i yum chen sku la 'khril: sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin la phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: rnal 'byor ser po rgyas pa'i rig 'dzin ni: swa na'i mdangs ldan he ru ka pa'i chas: bde stong gsang ba'i yum chen sku la 'khril: tshe dbang rig 'dzin sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rnal 'byor dmar gsal dbang gi rig 'dzin ni: grus ma'i mdangs ldan he ru ka pa'i chas: bde stong gsang ba'i yum chen sku la 'khril: phyag rgya rig 'dzin sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rnal 'byor dmar ljang drag po'i rig 'dzin ni: mar gad mdangs ldan he ru ka pa'i chas: bde stong gsang ba'i yum chen sku la 'khril: lhun grub rig 'dzin sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: ka dag dbyings la rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor rgyas: zab zhi spros bral 'dus ma byas pa yi: baiḍūrya yi mdangs ldan sprul pa'i sku: rdo rje dril bu hūm̐ mdzad dkur brten nas: skyil krung bde stong las kyi yum chen 'khyud: dga' rab sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: ye shes rol pa'i ngo bo lhun grub la: nam mkha'i mtha' yas thugs rjes dpag dka'i gter: legs par 'byin mdzad padma rā ga'i mdangs: rdo rje thod pa snang stong phyag rgya ldan: rol stabs dga' bzhis rnal 'byor dmar mor 'khril: shrī singha'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: thugs rje'i nyi 'od phyogs bcur rab 'khyil ba: bstan gnyis gtso bo bla med zab rgya'i mdzod: thabs shes mdangs ldan dbang gi longs spyod rdzogs: snang srid zil gnon rgyal po rol stabs can: rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ bhandha tshe bum bsnams: mtshungs med 'gro mgon pad 'byung rje la bstod: hūm̐: dbang gi mdangs ldan mdzes byed lha yi lcam: shel dkar 'od 'khyug 'jo sgeg mtsho rgyal ma:

nī lam zer 'gyed kā la siddhi ma: sa snying utpal bzhad pa'i shākya dhe: mar gad gzi mdangs bkra shis khye'u 'dren ma: mda' dar tshe 'dzin phyed skyil dga' bzhi'i mdangs: yid 'phrog gsang ye rig ma lnga la bstod: hūm̐: shar phyogs bsil ba tshal gyi gnas mchog tu: yang dag snying po'i bka' bab dngos grub brnyes: klong chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor he ru kaḥ slob dpon hūm̐ chen ka rar phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: lho phyogs sku la rdzogs pa'i gnas mchog tu: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i bka' bab dngos grub brnyes: gar dgus sa bcu gnon mdzad he ru kaḥ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: nub phyogs laṅka brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog tu: padma gsung gi bka' bab dngos grub brnyes: tshangs dbyangs drug cu 'brug sgra he ru kaḥ slob dpon klu sgrub sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: byang phyogs padma brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog tu: phrin las phur pa'i bka' bab dngos grub brnyes: dgyes pas stobs bcu'i rtsal 'byin he ru kaḥ slob dpon pra bha hastīr phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: shar lho lhun grub gter gyi gnas mchog tu: yon tan bdud rtsi'i bka' bab dngos grub brnyes: sgeg pas srid rtse g.yo ba'-i he ru kaḥ bi ma mi tra'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: lho nub gsang chen rol pa'i gnas mchog tu: rbod gtong ma mo'i bka' bab dngos grub brnyes: snang srid dbang sdud dpal 'bar he ru kaḥ slob dpon dha na saṃ skṛr phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: nub byang he chen brdal ba'i gnas mchog tu: 'jig rten mchod bstod bka' bab dngos grub brnyes: drag sngags spu gri'i rtsal 'byin he ru kaḥ slob dpon rombu gu hyar phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: byang shar 'jig rten brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog tu: drag sngags dmod pa'i bka' bab dngos grub brnyes: bsad pa'i las kun gdeng mchog he ru kaḥ shāntiṃ garbha'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:

hūm̐: bde chen rigs kyi rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma: dga' bzhi'i 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'khrul 'khor bsgyur: mthong na mi bzod brda 'byin rtsa 'jib ma: lang tsho kun gyi cha shas rab rdzogs pa'i: gsang ba'i ma sring rig ma brgyad la bstod: hūm̐: tshogs drug dgyes byed dbang po'i bcud g.yo ma: rig ma mchog dga'i 'khrul 'khor rgyas pa yi: mnyen lcug mdzes ldan gar mo yid 'dzin gzugs: sna tshogs mchod pas zag med bde stong bskyed: gsang ba'i rig ma bcu drug phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: tshad med rnam bzhi'i 'gro don mthar phyin pa: dgyes pa'i gar ldan sgeg pa'i cha lugs rdzogs: rang rtags phyag mtshan las bzhi so sor sgrub: bde stong dga' ba'i dbyangs can zung 'jug 'khril: sgo skyong rigs bzhi'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gzhan yang ye shes dang ni las grub pa'i: zhing skyong laṅka dbang phyug gnas nyul sogs: bka' yi dam can srung ma gter gyi bdag: phyi nang dkyil 'khor skyong la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: de ltar rab gus gdung ba'i tshangs dbyangs kyis: mi shigs blo yis sgyu ma ltar bstod nas: lhun grub sku lnga'i rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor gyi: tshom bu 'dus pa'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: byams gdung ma bur brtse ba'i thugs bzhin du: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin mos gus bdag cag la: zhal 'dzum lta bas chog mi shes pa yi: dgyes pa'i mdangs bzang dngos 'dir bstan nas su: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: thugs rje mnga' ba nyid ltar bdag gyur nas: don gnyis bla med 'bras bu thob gyur cig: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ rig 'dzin spyi 'dus kyi sngags ni: om̐ gu ru bhi dhwa dhā ra ḍākki ha ri ni sa pa shaṃ sarba siddhi hūm̐: rig 'dzin tshe sgrub kyi sngags ni: om̐ sarba dzñā na badzra gu ru ā yur ḍākki nī siddhi hūm̐:

zhes pa'i sngags 'di khri 'bum bzlas pa yis: bla med rig 'dzin mchog gi sras gyur nas: skye ba kun tu rgyal bas rjes bzung 'gyur: de bas rig 'dzin bsgrub pa 'di nyid zab: byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i gter 'byung bla ma la: gdung bas gsol 'debs 'bad pa 'di nyid gces: skal ldan las 'phro can gyis nyams su longs: so sor lha tshogs sgos su bsgrub mos na: bdag bskyed mjug gi sngags rnams bzlas pas chog: ched du spros bcas mchod pa med na yang : rgyun khyer las byang chag med gtong du rung : khyad par las byang bsgrub pa 'di nyid ni: bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod pa kho na ste: 'di phyi kun tu 'di nyid phan yon che: lhag par gzhan don gshin chog la sogs pa: bla ma mchod pa 'di nyid shin tu zab: spyir yang bsgrub pa mtha' dag sngon 'gro la: rig 'dzin bla ma'i las byang 'di thon na: bsnyen sgrub nyung yang chos skyong bran bzhin 'khor: 'di phyi bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus la: bka' bstan skyong ba zhal bzhes tha tshig bzhin: de phyir bla ma'i bsgrub pa kho na gtso: yang gsang 'di ni rdo rje theg chen gyi: bla ma rig 'dzin kun 'dus yin lags pas: bcud kyi yang snying 'di nyid zab pa'o: sa ma ya: bla ma rig 'dzin thun gtor: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: yon tan lha tshogs phyi nang bka' sdod rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thogs med gnas 'dir gshegs: dug lnga dug gsum bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: dkyil 'khor zab mo'i cho ga'i yan lag dang : sgra chad zur nyams ma tshang mthol lo bshags: bla med mchog gi dngos grub bdag la stsol: om̐ sarba pañtsa bha lingta ma hā rakta go ro tsa na bha su ta kha kha khā hi: de nas tshogs mchod bya ba'i rim pa ni: kun tshang phun sum tshogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsham: mdzes pa'i rig ma bcu drug rgyan gyis spras: ḍā dril thogs sam rang rang phyag mtshan 'dzin: tshogs gzhi dal gyi mtha' kun bskor zhing 'cham:

skabs su byin 'bebs la sogs rgyas par bya: dbyangs snyan gdangs dang rol mo sna tshogs btang : mthun rdzas bye brag spyan gzigs du ma bsnams: bag dro lhun chags ngang nas 'di skad do: hūm̐: chos sku sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin las: ma g.yos khyab brdal rol pa'i cho 'phrul shar: kun nas ro gcig spang blang bral ba'i phyir: de don lta ba'i gshis lugs ci bzhin spel: om̐ badzra dharma gu ya dzñā na pañtsa ka hūm̐: gnyis pa tshogs sbyang ba ni: hūm̐: dug gsum bag chags bsregs gtor sbyang ba'i phyir: dag byed yig 'bru ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gsum 'phros: tshogs la phog pas dngos 'dzin rnam rtog sbyangs: gtsang btsog sme bar 'dzin pa gdod nas dag: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum gyis: gsum pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid rigs 'dus rgyal ba'i thugs ka nas: sku gsum ye shes lnga yi sa bon 'phros: ting 'dzin longs spyod tshogs la phog pa yis: ye nas rmad byung rdzas mchog bdud rtsi gsal: om̐ āḥhūm̐ ga ṇa tsakra sarba dzñā na a mṛ ta dharma ko3 haṃ: bzhi pa spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: ka dag 'og min lhun rdzogs pho brang nas: kun bzang thog ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur: rigs lnga bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: dbyings rig gnyug ma lhan skyes pho brang nas: khyab brdal longs sku'i ston pa rdo rje sems: zhi khro rab 'byams rtsa chen lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rang snang gnas yul dag pa'i pho brang nas: ye shes rang byung rig 'dzin yab yum brgyad: gnas gzhir khyab pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rgyud lung nyi 'od rgya mtsho'i pho brang nas: klong chen dbang phyug dga' rab rdo rje'i thugs: dgongs pa rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:

zab yangs nam mkha' mkhyen brtse'i pho brang nas: lhun grub yon tan rgya mtsho shrī sing : man ngag lung 'dzin grub thob brda brgyud rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: zhing khams mchog gyur dpal ri'i pho brang nas: bstan gnyis gtso bo 'gro mgon padma 'byung : snyan brgyud grub thob rig 'dzin tshogs bcas rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sku lnga 'khor bcas gsang ba'i las 'dzin ma: phyag rgya ye shes spel ba'i rig ma lnga: dam tshig 'du 'bral med pa'i ma sring tshogs: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bka' bab rgyud lung zab mo'i pho brang nas: don gnyis bden tshig grub pa'i rig 'dzin brgyad: gar mo 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sde tshogs bcas: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: zag med bde chen las skyong pho brang nas: mchod sprin lha mo bcu drug gar gyis phyug: sgo skyong la sogs dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: chos sku'i lha tshogs skye med mdangs dang ldan: longs sku'i lha tshogs gzi byin ta la la: sprul sku'i lha tshogs thugs rje sha ra ra: rig 'dzin lha tshogs bkrag mdangs kyi li li: ma sring rgya mtshos glu len kyu ru ru: ging chen dpa' bos bro rdung khrabs se khrab: chos skyong srung ma bran ltar kyi li li: mchod rdzas rgya mtsho'i bcud mchog me re re: dkyil 'khor gnas khang bag dro chi li li: 'dir 'tshogs pho mo dga' bro ya la la: gnas 'dir byin chen phob la dbang chen bskur: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ lnga pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor dang : rig 'dzin kun 'dus gsang ba'i lha tshogs la: mnyes pa'i bde chen mchod pa 'bul ba ni: gzugs mdzes gar mo shes rab lang tsho can:

lha yi khye'u yid dgar 'tshogs 'dra ba: ka la piṅka dri za'i dbyangs ring len: lta na yid sdug chog shes mi long zhing : gzi 'od mdangs ldan sgron mar bsnun 'dra'i dbyibs: gzung 'dzin zin bur mthong dbang mi skye ba'i: rta chen 'bum phrag dbang 'khyud legs 'dzin la: 'dod 'byung la sogs thabs shes gzhong thogs nas: ro brgya sred pa'i zhen bcom rmad byung spungs: rig pa'i gru 'dzin khyon ltar mtho ba'i tshogs: kun tshang dbang po dgyes pa skyed byed la: mi bzad sna tshogs dgyes gar bsgyur te 'bul: dpag med blos blangs 'bul des mnyes pa'i mod: yid la dga' bzhi don gnyis mchog gsum stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī ga ṇa tsakra khā hi: drug pa tshogs bskang ba ni: hūm̐: rten rdzas sgrub rdzas mchod rdzas bskang ba'i rdzas: kun nas ma tshang med pa'i mthun rdzas 'dis: chos sku kun bzang yab yum thugs dam bskang : longs sku rdor sems yab yum thugs dam bskang : sprul sku rig 'dzin sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dgongs brgyud dga' rab rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang : brda brgyud shrī singha'i thugs dam bskang : snyan brgyud ma hā gu ru'i thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : mchog gi rig 'dzin rnam brgyad thugs dam bskang : rig ma gsang ye'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong dpa' bo yab yum thugs dam bskang : yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol: brgyad pa bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: rtsa brgyud bla ma rig 'dzin mchog gsum 'dus: rgyal ba brgyud bcas chos srung bden pa'i mthus: bdag gis dge bcu sgrub la 'tshe ba rnams: tshogs kyi tha ma gzugs ling 'di la khug: om̐ badzra kro ta dzwa la sarba hūm̐: gnod byed bgegs tshogs a karṣa ya dzaḥ dgu pa phur skor bya ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen smod pa'i las byed kī la ya'i:

sras mchog gyad kyi phur bu 'dril thabs gdeng : gzir zhing bsnun no dgra bgegs srog rtsa chod: phye mar gtub cing ming yang med par mdzod: om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ byad ma nṛ tri trig nan ma rā ya myog thum: ha la ha la lokt+ri ya ma raṃ har ling shag baṃ bhyoḥ mā ra ya nan: bcu pa gtubs nas zhal du bstab pa ni: hūm̐: bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams: dug lnga gzhom phyir skye med dgyes zhal phyes: mtshan 'dzin nyon mongs ru tra bsgral ba yi: sha khrag 'bul lo lhag med bzhes su gsol: om̐ ā hūm̐: gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sa ma ya dgra bgegs kyi māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta kha kha khā hi: bcu gcig pa lhag ma gtong ba ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs dregs pa'i tshogs: dbang phyug ma mo ging dang zhing skyong dang : las kyi mtha' sdud gnas nyul shugs 'gro ma: srin mo sha za mtshan mo dur khrod du: srod kyi mun la glog ltar lam lam 'gyu: bag tsha spu gzengs sngangs skrag gtong ba'i tshogs: dkyil 'khor mtha' nas keṃ keṃ rab tu nyul: la las gyad 'gros tshad kyis stong khams g.yeng : la las mtshan mor rab tu dur khrod 'grim: la las ye shes la las 'jig rten nyul: la la rgas dang la la gzhon pa dang : la la nag mo khyo med mtshan ma bsgrad: la las g.yang gzhi gyon cing khram bam thogs: la las rgyu ma 'dren cing rakta 'thung : la las glo snying thogs nas rkang mgo phyar: la las skra dmar ral bsigs ku sgra 'debs: la la gcer mos bro rdung bshugs ring 'then: la las 'jig rten dam nyams bla tshe sdud: la las sgrub la mel tshe rogs dan sgrub: la las bstan pa'i bya ra dbyings nas 'debs: la las snang srid dbang sdud 'dzam gling nyul: la las mdzes 'phrog skye 'gro'i snang ba bslu: don la thams cad dbyings phyug rnam sprul te: sgyu ma'i snang ngor cho 'phrul cir yang ston:

dam tshig bya ra las kyi lhag nyul tshogs: mnyen byed tshogs kyi lhag ma 'di bzhes la: bka' bzhin sgrub la gsang sngags mel tshe ru: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ sarba ma tri ma du pra mo li ha sa ba ti kra tra ti i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: dang po thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: ye shes dbyings kyi rang bzhin dkyil 'khor nas: bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba 'dus pa'i tshogs: mi mngon thugs rje'i klong nas skur bzhengs shig: byin rlabs nus pa'i gzi byin dus 'dir bskyed: bsgrub pa'i skal ldan smon lam bskyed pa bdag: brtse bas gzigs shing nus pa'i shugs kyang ston: ston ka'i zla rgyas yun ring legs phyes bzhin: 'dzum pa'i bzhin mdangs bu yi gdong la gzigs: shes rab lha mos dbyangs snyan sgrogs pa'i gdangs: ji lta'i gsung gis bu la lung bstan stsol: dwangs pa'i mkha' la 'od khyim ngang mo bzhin: gnas lugs skye med ngo sprod bu la ston: phrin las bzhi ldan dpung tshogs rgyu skar bkra: rgyas shing mtha' bstan kun 'byung bu la stsol: hūm̐: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: bskul lo mdzod cig 'gro la snying rjes skyong : da lta snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus mtha' 'dir: chos 'dod bdud dbang rkyen gyis bsgyur lags pas: dmu rgod sems can 'dul ba'i dus la bab: sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem pa'i dus la bab: gsang sngags bstan pa spel ba'i dus la bab: bstan dgrar bka' chad 'bebs pa'i dus la bab: sgrub la dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: hūm̐: dgongs shig dus gsum sangs rgyas dbyings nas dgongs: kun bzang rdor sems dag pa rig 'dzin bzhi: dga' rab shrī sing gu ru padma 'byung : gsang ba ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: hūm̐ kar 'jam dpal klu sgrub pra bha ti: bi ma saṃ skṛ rombu shāntiṃ gar: gsang ba'i lha mo ma sring sgo skyong bcas:

mthu ldan bka' yi srung ma ma lus kun: mthun rdzas mnyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: sgrub la 'chi med mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bdag sogs khyed nyid sgrub pa'i gnas yul kun: bkra shis lo legs dmag 'khrug nad yams zhi: 'dod don mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas: yid la gang smon bden tshig 'di nyid kyis: 'grub par gyur cig rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i gtso: dpang du btsugs so smon lam dngos 'grub mdzod: om̐ gu ru bhi dho dhā ra sarba pa shaṃ ḍākki ha ri ni sa kri ta ya bha lingta pū dza ma hā me gha kha kha khā hi: gnyis pa chad mdo bya ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po dang : rdor sems longs sku rigs lnga sangs rgyas stong : sprul sku dag pa rig 'dzin sa ya khri: dbyings kyi ma sring bye ba 'bum phrag sogs: sku gsum zhing du 'khod pa'i lha tshogs kyis: rang rtsal ye shes cho 'phrul 'gyed pa'i tshe: gnas lugs klong dgu'i rgyud sde'i lha tshogs kyi: so so'i gshis lugs ci bzhin bstan nas su: bag yod khas blangs dran shes tha tshig bzhin: kun tu ro gcig mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: ka dag ye grol bzhin du phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og sa bcur snyeg pa'i ri bo mchog: ma la ya zhes tsaṇḍa'i bam ri'i gnas: dga' rab rdo rje shrī singha dang : padma 'byung gnas ḍākki tsaṇḍi tshogs: grub thob chen po rig 'dzin brgyad rnams kyis: dgongs pa rgyud sde nam mkha' rgya mtsho yi: bka' bab lung gis man ngag bkral ba'i tshe: ye shes las kyi ma sring rgya mtsho yis: gsang mdzod zhal phyes bden gnyis tha tshig bzhin: 'khor 'das zung 'jug mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: kun gzhi mkha' ltar sgrib med rgyas par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og bod yul gangs can rdo rje gdan: brag dmar mchims phu dpal gyi bsam yas su: 'gro mgon rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas dang :
