ye shes mtsho rgyal sangs rgyas ye shes sogs: sprul pa'i skyais mchog rje 'bangs grogs rnams kyis: rig 'dzin kun 'dus dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbang phyug laṅka zhing skyong la sogs kyis: so so'i gzugs bstan bstan skyong khas blangs nas: tha tshig srog gi snying po phul ba bzhin: mthun rdzas bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngags bstan yun ring phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: sbas yul chen po padma bkod pa yi: bal yul yang le 'brog gi rgya mtsho nas: rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho yis: gter sgrom mthong ba don ldan spyan drangs tshe: las kyi mgon po bya rog gdong can dang : bka' yi srung ma ma lus thams cad kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog dam pa bstan nas kyang : g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba yi: tha tshig las kyi dam bcas de bzhin du: sgrub pa'i bar chad sel bar ma chad dam: mchog thun dngos grub stsol bar ma chad dam: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: gsang sngags gnyan gyi mel tshe ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes bzhin: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam bcas bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ sarba ma hā kā la khā kha mu kha ya kṣe ṭa pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: gsum pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: bod khams skyong mdzad ma sring mthu chen tshogs: bdud mo ma bzhi gnod sbyin ma bzhi dang : sman mo bzhi dang yang 'khor bye ba 'bum: lhab lhub dar gyi na bza' sku la gsol: mdzes pa'i rgyan cha mang po khro lo lo: dar dpyangs g.yer kha dril bu si li li: glu len bro brdung bshugs sgra di ri ri: gnas kun nyul zhing dam tshig tshogs khang 'grims: bstan pa'i bya ra ma mo bye ba'i tshogs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: zab chos rgya mtsho snying gi thig le 'di:

phyogs bcur spel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ sa ma ya dhe wi ma tri du pra ṇi tsa tur yaksha re ma ti tsa tur ma mo ting ting shag shag li li tsa tur ḍākki ye i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: bzhi pa rta bro brdung ba ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mkha' ltar kun la khyab pa'i klong yangs su: kun khyab dran rig lta ba'i slob dpon gyis: gcig shes kun grol gnas lugs bro brdungs pas: ma rig gnyid slong nyon mongs rang sar grol: hūm̐: rgyal ba rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du: gsang sngags theg chen slob dpon 'dus pa yis: rten 'brel ye shes lnga yis bro brdungs pas: bdag 'dzin ru tra'i tshogs rnams phye mar rlog: hūm̐: las mtha' phrin las rnam bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du: bka' sdod dam can gter bdag 'dus pa yis: dgyes byed rngam pa'i 'gros kyis bro brdungs pas: bstan dgra sgos dgra'i tshogs rnams ming med bcom: hūm̐: bro ni bde stong ye shes chen po'i bro: glu ni grags stong 'gags med tshangs pa'i dbyangs: gar ni phyag rgya lta ba'i gyad kyi 'gros: rig 'dzin 'dus tshogs glu blangs bro brdungs pas: ma rig mtshan 'dzin phung po ka nas dag: gnas lugs ye grol ngang la rgyas gdab bo: om̐ āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: mā ra ya nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: hūm̐ dzñā na gu ti sa ma ya nan: lnga pa dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings lhun grub bde chen klong yangs nas: byin rlabs rgya mtsho 'byin pa'i gter chen po: rig 'dzin rgyal ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams: thugs rje'i nus rtsal dpal yon shugs phyungs la: tshe chos zas nor mnga' thang longs spyod kun: deng 'dir skal ldan bdag la stsal du gsol: om̐ ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi a bhi shiñtsa hūm̐: drug pa bkra shis brjod pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings klong nas rang byung sprul pa'i sku: thog ma'i brgyud pa rnam gsum bkra shis shog:

ka dag dgongs par mkhyen gnyis nyi zla rgyas: gsang mdzod slob dpon rnam gsum bkra shis shog: thugs rje'i zlos gar gter chen legs phyes pa: rig 'dzin 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: zab rgya'i gnyer gtad mthu rtsal zer chen 'khrigs: dam can gter srung rnams kyi bkra shis shog: nam mkha' lta bu'i rab 'byams mkhyen brtse rgyas: 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bkra shis shog: bdun pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: rig pa 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: dgongs pa mi dmigs lta ba'i klong yangs su: snang stong nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon yal ba bzhin: dran rig gnyug ma'i sbubs su skye med āḥ a a āḥ zhes 'khor gsum yongs dag ngang la bzhag: brgyad pa bsngo bas mtshams sbyar ni: hoḥ dge tshogs rgya mtsho gcig tu bsdus pa yi: sems bskyed zhing gi rdul snyed ci mchis pa: bdag gi blos blangs phyogs gcig spyod pa nyid: ma gyur mtha' yas 'gro la brtse phyir bsngo: dgu pa smon lam gyis rgyas 'debs pa ni: hoḥ deng 'dir rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid: rig 'dzin 'khor lo gcig tu bsgrubs pa'i mthus: tshe rabs 'di dang tshe rgyud thams cad du: mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin rtse gcig gis: ma 'ongs 'di nas rnga yab dpal ri ru: 'tshogs shing rgyal ba'i sras su skye bar shog: ces sogs bsngo smon gyis legs par rgyas gdab: sa ma ya: e ma: zab pa'i yang snying rig 'dzin kun 'dus pa'i: cho ga'i 'don bsgrigs cha tshang lag len bzhag: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi tha ma ru: lo tsā'i mchog nyid sangs rgyas ye shes kyi: rnam sprul gar gyi dbang phyug rdo rje'i mtshan: rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes: padma'i yang sprul de dang 'phrad par shog: bka' yi rgya 'di legs ldan mgon pos srungs: dam sri bdud sprul lag tu ma shor bar: skal ldan smon lam dam tshig can dang sprod:

bal yul yar 'brog g.yu mtshor a thaṃ rgya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: mchog gsum mkhyen rtse'i yang sprul pa: gar dbang rig 'dzin chen po o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos rang byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags byi lor/ sbas yul padma bkod kyi byang sgo bal yul yar 'brog mtsho nas/ las can gyi khrom mang po dang bcas te/ khrom gter nas gdan drangs shing slar chu pho stag gi lor kaḥnams sa bdag rgyal po'i pho brang du shog ser nas zhal bsgyur ba'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // hūm̐/ skye 'gags 'gyur med phrin las rdzogs/ /rang byung thugs rjes 'gro drug sgrol bar mdzad/ yid bzhin nor dang dngos grub char ltar 'bebs/ /rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/

༁ྂ: bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: (pa)bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bskang ba yid bzhin nor mchog bzhugs so: bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: e maḥ rgyal mkhas skyon bral dbang gi mgon mchog nyid: rtsod med bstan gnyis mnga' bdag rgya gar pa: rigs kyi 'khor los bsgyur mdzad pad 'byung ngas: yang zab mkhyen brtse dpag dka'i blo'i dbyings nas: mi zad gsang gsum rgya mtsho'i spyod yul ba: grub pa'i re skong yid bzhin nor mchog gi: spyi 'dus bskang mchog nyi 'od rab gsal bstan: yid 'jo'i snyems ma mtsho rgyal sgeg mos zungs: shes rab gzhon nu'i dbyings rig brda ru thob: 'phrul gyi gdengs khang klong sgrom drwa ba'i dkyil: kun byed khyab pa'i dbang phyug nag por bcol: rang rig lung chen 'dzin pa nga yi sprul: 'brug sgra'i snyan dbyangs bzhin rgyal lo tsā'i mdangs: thogs med sangs rgyas ye shes paṇḍi tas: ngang brgyan bsring ba'i 'khru ba rnam rol nyid: rtsa gsum gling par lung bstan 'phags pa'i gdung : che bzhi'i 'gro don skyong bar bsngags de la: mkha' yi rdo rjes brgyan ltar gegs med sprod: ci bzhin lung bstan dus su ma bor rgya: nyams pa'i tshe srog rgol ba choms shig gtad: lung ma bstan rnams shes rab spyod ldan shog: de yang bskang ba'i bsgrig chog bstan pa ni: thog mtha' bar dang tha mar dge ba'i tshe: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa la: khog phub gzhi 'ding rgyan btags don yang bsdus: phyi nang gsang dang yang gsang kho na nyid: mchog gi don sogs rnam rim med tsam las: thog mar dge ba bkra shis dben pa'i gnas: bar du dge ba bkra shis bca' gzhi tshangs: dngos gzhi dag pa bskyed rdzogs lag len ldan: tha mar dge ba bsngo smon rgyas tshig thebs: de ni dkyil 'khor rang gzhung dge ba'o: de nas sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las:

thog mar byin 'bebs spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol dang : dngos gzhi dam tshig g.yel dang nyams chag bskang : rjes su bshags shing mi dmigs klong du bzhag: de bzhin spyan 'dren byed tshul bsgrig chog go: de nas khog phub gzhi 'deng don bsdus zhes: thog mar yi dam gang yin rang gzhung khog: bar du srog yig dmigs gzhi bskyed pa dang : spro bsdu rgyan mang mtshon byed sna tshogs btags: tha mar sgrog ni rig pa gzhi la bsdu: da ni phyi nang gsang ba kho na las: phyi ltar bsod nams 'byor ldan rdzas kyis bskang : nang ltar ye shes rang byung rdzas kyis bskang : gsang ba bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ngang gis bskang : kho na de nyid bskang bya bral ba'o: de bzhin las rim spyi ltar lang bar bshags: bye brag la yang rang gzhung khyad chos mang : de yang mtshon byed tshig gis smras su bcad: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: da ni ka dag snying po'i rang sgra yis: yang zab rig 'dzin kun 'dus bskang ba bstan: thog mar bskang rdzas phun sum tshogs pa yi: mnyes byed mchod sprin kun tshogs sprin ltar bsham: spyan gzigs mthun pa'i tshogs kyang kun bkram nas: rig 'dzin bla ma mnyes phyir 'jug par brtsam: sa ma ya: thog mar bskang mchod byin rlabs bya ba ni: bdud rtsi sman raka phud kyis bskang rdzas bran: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum brjod: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā bha lingta te dzwa bha lingta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda ā hūm̐: om̐ rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa dri bzang gi dud pa gtong zhing rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas thugs dam bskang phyir spyan drangs pa'o: hūm̐: ka dag lhun grub dbyings rig lta ba'i klong : ma 'gags bde chen rang byung pho brang nas: rig 'dzin mchog gsum rgyal ba 'dus pa'i tshogs:

byin rlabs smin grol thugs rje'i shugs las bzhengs: gdung bas spyan 'dren thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir: gsang sngags dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: chags med skyon bral pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs: rtse gcig gdung ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing : phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul: mnyes shing dgyes nas thugs dam rab bskangs te: g.yar dam sor chud mchog thun dngos grub stsol: gsum pa thugs dam bskang ba ni: hūm̐: ka dag dbyings rig ngo bo brdal khyab las: rol rtsal mtshan dpe'i yon tan kun rdzogs pa: cho 'phrul sgyu ma rtsal du snang ba las: thog ma'i sangs rgyas chos sku kun tu bzang : ye bzhugs gdod ma'i mgon po'i thugs dam bskang : ngang gis ma 'gags shugs las rdol ba'i sku: longs sku rdor sems yab yum thugs dam bskang : zhi ba'i rnam 'phrul badzra thod phreng rtsal: sar gnas rig 'dzin yab yum thugs dam bskang : rgyas pa'i rnam sprul ratna thod phreng rtsal: tshe dbang rig 'dzin yab yum thugs dam bskang : dbang gi rnam sprul padma thod phreng rtsal: phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin yab yum thugs dam bskang : drag po'i rnam sprul karma thod phreng rtsal: lhun grub rig 'dzin yab yum thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: dgongs pa klong yangs nam mkha'i zlos gar mkhan: dga' rab rdo rje yab yum thugs dam bskang : brda rtags lung gi gsang mdzod rgyud sdes phyug: shrī singha yab yum thugs dam bskang : bstan gnyis khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mnga' dbang bsgyur: gu ru padma 'byung gnas thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku yi rig ma mchog: mkhar chen ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskang : padma mkha' 'gro gsung gi rig ma mchog: lha lcam manda ra ba'i thugs dam bskang : buddha mkha' 'gro thugs kyi rig ma mchog: bal 'bangs kā la siddhi'i thugs dam bskang : rin chen mkha' 'gro yon tan rig ma mchog: bal mo shākya dhe wa'i thugs dam bskang :

las kyi mkha' 'gro phrin las rig ma mchog: mon mo bkra shis khye'u 'dren thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: 'jam dpal sku yi bdag nyid he ru kaḥ mañdzu shrī yab yum thugs dam bskang : padma gsung gi bdag nyid he ru kaḥ 'phags pa klu sgrub yab yum thugs dam bskang : yang dag thugs kyi bdag nyid he ru kaḥ hūm̐ chen ka ra yab yum thugs dam bskang : bdud rtsi yon tan bdag nyid he ru kaḥ bi ma mi tra yab yum thugs dam bskang : phur pa phrin las bdag nyid he ru kaḥ pra bha hastī yab yum thugs dam bskang : gnyis med ma mo'i bdag nyid he ru kaḥ dha na saṃ skṛ yab yum thugs dam bskang : 'jig rten rbad pa'i bdag nyid he ru kaḥ rombu gu hya yab yum thugs dam bskang : drag sngags dmod pa'i bdag nyid he ru kaḥ shāntiṃ garbha yab yum thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: bde chen bcu drug rgyas pa'i dpa' mo che: snang ba'i tshogs drug dgyes pa skyed byed ma: phyi yi lha mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : gnas lugs rig pa'i rtsal ston mdangs skyed ma: nang gi lha mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : sangs rgyas kun gyi bde stong lhag gis bstan: gsang ba'i lha mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : rtsa khams rgyas 'debs dwangs ma'i bcud g.yo spel: gnyis med lha mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: byams pa tshad med zhi ba'i phrin las sgrub: rdo rje ging chen yab yum thugs dam bskang : snying rje tshad med rgyas pa'i phrin las sgrub: ratna ging chen yab yum thugs dam bskang : dga' ba tshad med dbang gi phrin las sgrub: padma ging chen yab yum thugs dam bskang : btang snyoms tshad med drag po'i phrin las sgrub: las kyi ging chen yab yum thugs dam bskang : bar khyams 'khor yug mu ran la gnas pa'i: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab dang :

zhal zas rol mo la sogs spyan gzigs dang : glu gar 'bum dang phyag rgya dgyes pa'i tshogs: sman gtor rakta sbyor sgrol rmad du byung : tshogs mchod rmad byung dza gad dkar mngar skyems: ma dā la sogs su ra chang gi bcud: sman mchod sna tshogs shing thog mang po dang : 'bras bu sna tshogs thug pa'i bye brag dang : zla rgyas zla phrom rtsi chen go snyod dang : ri sgog rlung sgog sha mong sna tshogs dang : spod kyi bye brag sna tshogs kun tshang ba: rgyas shing lhun po'i gzengs ltar mtho ba'i tshogs: dngos 'byor yid sprul blo yis legs bzung ste: mchod pas dgyes pa rab bskyed rdzas chen 'dis: thog ma'i sangs rgyas yab yum thugs dam bskang : longs sku rdor sems yab yum thugs dam bskang : rig 'dzin sde bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : dga' rab klong chen yab yum thugs dam bskang : mkhas mchog shrī sing yab yum thugs dam bskang : pad 'byung 'gro ba'i mgon mchog thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : mchog gi rig 'dzin brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : yum chen ḍākki brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : dgongs brgyud slob dpon thams cad thugs dam bskang : brda brgyud slob dpon thams cad thugs dam bskang : snyan brgyud slob dpon thams cad thugs dam bskang : dam rdzas shog ser brgyud pa'i thugs dam bskang : man ngag lung gi slob dpon thugs dam bskang : shes rab brgyud pa'i slob dpon thugs dam bskang : nyams chag bskang ba'i slob dpon thugs dam bskang : rtsa ba brgyud pa'i slob dpon thugs dam bskang : bde chen lha mo bcu drug thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : dam can gter srung rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: bskang du med de skyed med ngang gis bskang :

mchod du med de gnyis med rol pas mchod: sbyor du med de bde stong zung 'jug sbyor: bsgral du med de ye shes chen por sgrol: bshags su med de ting 'dzin lta bas bshags: ye nas rang byung mchod pa chen pos bskang : lta ba nam mkha' ka dag dbyings su bskang : sgom pa 'dzin med rgya yan lhug par bskang : spyod pa bzo med ro gcig klong du bskang : kun gzhi khregs chod skye ba med par bskang : sa lam ye rdzogs bya rtsol bral bar bskang : 'bras bu bdag med gdod nas dag par bskang : ngo bos stong zhing brjod bral rgyu yi bskang : rang bzhin gsal ba zang thal 'gags med bskang : thugs rje 'khor 'das dbyer med chen por bskang : bde ba ye shes sdug bsngal gzhi bral bskang : gsal ba dbyings klong 'du 'bral med pas bskang : rtog med chen po 'od gsal brda yis bskang : kun gzhi'i dbyings rig mtha' dbus bral bar bskang : sgyu ma'i rol rtsal ci snang der ston bskang : 'khor gsum yongs dag rdzogs pa chen por bskang : a ti bsgom med bya rtsol bral bar bskangs: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i thugs mchog der rdzogs shog: bdun pa bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: shes bya sgyu ma'i 'khrul ngor 'byams klas nas: bag med le los rmongs gyur rnam g.yeng dbang : dam 'gal ci mchis mthol bshags bzod gsol bzhes: mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ dharma sa twa hūm̐: om̐ badzra sa twa hūm̐: om̐ gu ru sa twa hūm̐: om̐ badzra sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pa la sogs yig brgya brjod: bzhi pa bshags pa bya ba ni: mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob med par thun mtshams blo'i 'dun pa zhig pa'i ngang nas brjod par bya'o: hūm̐: dgongs su gsol lo gdod ma'i lha: rig 'dzin rgyal ba 'dus pa'i tshogs: mkhyen yangs thugs rje'i klong nas gzigs: ye nas snang srid rang grol la: spang blang 'gyod pa mthol lo bshags: snod bcud gzugs tshogs snang stong la:

mtshan mar lta ba mthol lo bshags: sgra rnams sgyu mar dag pa la: tshigs su bcad pa mthol lo bshags: ye nas gshis lugs rdzogs chen la: 'phral gyi zang zing mthol lo bshags: bde stong gdod nas zung 'jug la: sbyor lam smon pa mthol lo bshags: sa lam ye rdzogs yin pa la: rim gyis bgrod pa mthol lo bshags: gnas lugs bsgom bya bral ba la: dmigs gtad bzo bcos byas pa bshags: bsgral bya sgrol byed med pa la: re dogs mtshan 'dzin mthol lo bshags: kun bzang gtsang sme bral ba la: blang dor bgyid pa mthol lo bshags: nges don rang bzhin brjod med la: re dogs tshig gol mthol lo bshags: phrag dog 'khon shor long gtam la: bden rdzun bgyid pa mthol lo bshags: 'khor 'das mnyam nyid rtog med la: rtog pas tha dad bzung ba bshags: ye rdzogs rang rig dkyil 'khor la: mtshan ma'i sgom sgrub mthol lo bshags: a ti bsrung bsgom med pa la: bslab pa'i khas blangs mthol lo bshags: dran rig gsal stong rang shar la: gnas 'gyu srung ba mthol lo bshags: rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la: dka' thub brnyas smod spyad pa bshags: 'khor 'das ris su med pa la: sangs rgyas sems can lta ba bshags: sgra don ma bcos rang byung la: sdeb sbyor tshig la zhen pa bshags: sangs rgyas rang shes rig pa la: rdo 'chang gzhan la smon pa bshags: gnas lugs rtsal rdzogs byang sems la: bla mar gzhan du smon pa bshags: mkhas pa'i rtsa rlung bye brag la: paṇḍi ta la smon pa bshags: srung sdom 'gog pa'i rnam rtog la: dge slong lus la smon pa bshags: rtsa rlung chos sku'i lam grogs la: bud med spangs pa mthol lo bshags: mi rgyud sha gzugs sangs rgyas la: rabs chad smon pa mthol lo bshags: rigs drug snang ba'i cho 'phrul la: dmyal ba spangs pa mthol lo bshags: ye nas rang rig ye shes la: dud 'gro spangs pa mthol lo bshags: kun tu shes pa bral ba la: yi dwags spangs pa mthol lo bshags:

skye 'chi 'thab rtsod bral ba la: lha min spangs pa mthol lo bshags: pham rgyal 'gro 'ong med pa la: lha gnas spangs pa mthol lo bshags: ye nas chags 'dzin zad pa la: mi lus spangs pa mthol lo bshags: longs sku sems kyi cho 'phrul la: zhing khams smon pa mthol lo bshags: rang lus dkyil 'khor spang ba'i las: gnas skor sa mtha' 'grims pa bshags: rig pa phyi nang med pa la: mgron 'dzems mtshams sgo gcod pa bshags: 'byung ba mtha' dbus med pa la: lha dang 'dre ru lta ba bshags: 'byung lnga rang sar thim pa la: srog gcod 'dre la lta ba bshags: rang sems ma gtogs bdud med la: sde brgyad gzugs su lta ba bshags: hūm̐: chos brgyad zog po g.yo can la: blo gtad bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: sde dpon sdig pa'i pha rgan la: dam tshig 'brel ba mthol lo bshags: gnyom chung snying rje'i pha ma la: re blo ma skong mthol lo bshags: khas drag zhe sdang spu gri la: ngo srung bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: rang mgo mi thon chos pa la: skyabs gnas re ba mthol lo bshags: sdig can zas nor sdig to la: 'brel ba thogs pa mthol lo bshags: ser sna zas nor bse rag la: 'dzin chags bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: zas nor gsog 'jog 'gong po la: blo gtad bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: phyug 'dod yi dwags gter srung la: mu ge phug btsud mthol lo bshags: 'khor 'das kun kyang mnyam nyid la: rang mtho bsgrubs pa mthol lo bshags: phyogs med dag snang chos dbyings la: rang gi grub mthar bstod pa bshags: sbas tshul rnal 'byor nges med la: tho co lta ba mthol lo bshags: kun kyang sgyu ma'i khyab brdal la: ris su phyes pa mthol lo bshags: mthol bshags rtag pa med par grol: ma bshags chad pa med par grol: stong lta a 'thas min par grol: mtshan 'dzin kha las 'das par grol: bshags dang bshags bya mi dmigs kyang : kun rdzob tsam du tshangs par stsol: de phyin ye grol der gnas shog: ces yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bkang :

zhes rgyud lung spyi'i lung ngo : 'di nyid sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor gcig sgrub kyi gdams pa: gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa: tshig nyung la don 'dus pa: kun rdzob a 'thas kyi chos ma yin pa: thog mtha' bar gsum du 'od gsal rdo rje'i tshig rkang zam ma chad pa: sgra dag la zur brgyan pa: dngos po gtsang ma yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra ba: rgyud smin par byed pa: byang chub kyi chu rgyun dang 'dra ba: kha gsal zhing don dril ba: nyin mo'i mgon po dang mtshungs pa: khungs btsun zhing yid ches pa: kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa dang mnyam pa ste: chos nyid la dgongs pa rgyud sde'i klong bzhi tshang ba yin pas: thun mong ma yin pa'i zab khyad dang ldan te: 'brel tshad smin grol dam pa nyid la 'god pa lung las gsal: des na skal ldan las 'phro can gyis nyams su longs: skal med grub mtha' brtsi ba'i rtog ge ba: wa spyang lta bu'i ser gzugs kyis: 'di la spyod yul ma mchis so: ci'i phyir zhe na: rnam rtog mdze yis zin pa dang : nyams rtogs bse rag mu stegs phog: bsnyen sgrub rlung gis khyer ba yi: dred po wa bshad lcags mgo can: chos brgyad mi mgo bskor ba yi: skal med de la mi bstan te: bla med rgyud las gsungs pa yin: de bzhin las 'phro can gyi spyod yul lo:

gter rgya: e ma: zab pa'i bcud kyi man ngag thig le las: rgyud bskang yid bzhin nor bu mchog brgyan nyid: skal ldan las 'phro can gyi don du bzhag: smon lam 'brel tshad sangs rgyas lam zhugs phyir: phyir mi log pa'i sa bcu'i go 'phang 'grub: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras 'gyur the tshom med: shes rab blo ldan snying rje can dang sprod: bka' yi rgya 'di legs ldan mgon pos srungs: dam sri bdud sprul lag tu ma shor rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags byi lor bal yul yar 'brog gi mtsho nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas bsgyur te gtan la phab pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// // pha) bka' brgyad phrin las bsdus pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs so/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos sku kun bzang ston pa rdo rje sems/ /dga' rab rdo rje mkha' 'gro las kyi dbang*/ /'phags yul grub pa'i rig 'dzin brgyad rnams la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin rlabs dbang chen bskur/ /yongs rdzogs sgrub sde'i bka' babs padma 'byung*| |gsang ba rgya mtsho'i mdzod 'dzin mkhar chen bza'/ /rgyud 'dzin rje 'bangs snying gi bu dgu la/ /gsol ba 'debs so rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed/ /mthu rtsal nus pa'i mnga' bdag gnubs chen rje/ /zab mo'i gter la dbang bsgyur rtsa gsum gling*/ /chos bdag lung zin rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so smin grol nyams rtogs spor| khro bo kun 'dus spyi dpal che ba'i mchog /sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rbod gtong dang*/ /drag sngags dregs 'dul la sogs bka' brgyad lhar/ /gsol ba 'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /gnas yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*/ khyad par bka' srung mgon chen sde lnga sogs/ /bdun brgya nyer lnga'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol/

/snang srid gzhir bzhengs lha yi phyag rgyar rdzogs/ /'byin 'jug bde chen rdo rje'i sngags su dag /dran rtog 'od gsal chos skur smin byas nas/ /tshe 'dir rdo rje'i lam mchog mthar phyin shog /ces pa'ang sgrub sde'i nyams bzhes la dgos mkho'i ched au ḍīs nan bskul ngor gu hyas so// // ba)༄༅/ /bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi rgyun khyer snying po'i don bsdus bzhugs so// bla ma rig 'dzin sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ de'ang bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ thog mar dbang gi rgyud smin par byas shing*/ dam tshig gi srog dang ma bral bar sgrub pa nyams su len pa la/ gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan par dam tshig gi bris sku sogs rten bkram pa'i mdun du stegs bu gtsong mar/ ras bris sam 'bru tshom bkod pa'i khar/ sgrub rten gtor ma dang sman rag srung ma'i mchod gtor tshogs kyi yo byad mchod pa'i dngos po rnams 'du bya la/ rang nyid stan du bde bar 'khod pa'i mdun nang mchod ḍā dril 'thor nas bsang bum sogs nyer mkho rnams tshags su tshud par bya'o/ gnyis pa phrin las dngos la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa'o/ dang po tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma rig 'dzin dpal chen gtso dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs badzra sa mā dzaḥs sad par byas la skyabs sems ni/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas: kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol: bla ma dkon mchog gsum po laḥ byang chub ma thob bar du ni: skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi: sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags: 'gro don sangs rgyas 'thob bya'i phyir: smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed do: sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir: gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyod: don dam spros bral byang chub sems:

rang byung mtha' bral gsal stong bsgom: gnyis pa yan lag bdun pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum bstan pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu'i 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ /dag pa mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i dge ba rnams/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams 'od zhu rang la thim par gyur/ gsum pa 'byung po la gtor ma bsngo ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis brlabs la/ sarba bhu ta a karṣa ya dzaḥs mgron dgug /de nas bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐: nga ni gsal stong he ru kaḥ bdag gzhan phye ba'i rnam rtog bgegs: ro gcig gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phyogs med chos sku'i klong du dengs: ci ste mi 'gro a 'thas na: kun rgyu khro mos rig rtsal bskyed: khregs chod rdo rje'i mtshon char 'bebs: nga bdag 'gong po rdul phran gtor: de bas gnyis 'dzin phyir dengs shig: om̐ he ru ka dzñā na badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭḥ gnod byed u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bzhi pa rang byung lta ba'i mtshams gcod ni/ hūm̐: nga nyid ye nas dpal chen he ru kaḥ mkha' ltar khyab pa 'od gsal rdo rje'i thugs: ye shes lnga ru nam yang 'bral brlag med: rnam rtog ru tra gnyis 'dzin ka nas dag: chos dbyings brdal khyab bsrungs mtshams med par gsal: oṃ he ru ka dzñā na hūm̐ phaṭḥ nga bdag ru tra pra we sha ya phaṭḥ oṃ dharma dzñā na badzra tsakra satwaṃ: lnga pa rang byung mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: 'khor lo rnam dag rang byung bhandha'i snod:

blo yi khyon rtse yangs shing rgya che'i nang : phyi mchod me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo sil snyan gdung ba'i dbyangs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dbang po lnga: gzugs mdzes glu dbyangs gar mo phyag rgya can: nang mchod dug lnga ye shes sman raka gtor: gsang mchod bde stong sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi lnga: sgrol mchod la sogs spyan gzigs mthun pa'i rdzas: ma tshang med pa ye nas bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha lingta te dzwa bha lingta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ lan gsum gsum brjod/ de nas dngos gzhi la/ dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin ni| hūm̐: smra brjod bral ba stong pa'i gzhi: khyab brdal ngang la lhun gyis gnas: rgya chad phyogs lhung spu ris bral: oṃ dharma dzñā na tsitta hūm̐: gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ni| āḥ yid kyi rtog pa phra mo la: ma 'gags rtsal snang lam gyis shar: gnyis rtog rlung gi rang bzhin bskyed: oṃ badzra dharma hrī ta āḥ gsum pa rgyu yi ting nge 'dzin ni| oṃ: kun snang 'dzin pa'i sa bon las: rten 'brel hūm̐ yig rdo rje shar: gnas 'gyu lha dang gzhal yas gsal: oṃ dharma bhrūm̐ dzñā na hūm̐: bzhi pa rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni| hūm̐: e yam̐ ram̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: 'byung lnga bsnol brtsegs brtan pa'i steng : rdo rje'i 'od zer gzhal yas khang : dkyil 'khor phyi nang mtshan nyid rdzogs: ye shes lugs su 'byung bar bsgom: oṃ badzra bhrūm̐ sa ma ya hūm̐: oṃ padma maṇḍa la: sūrya maṇḍa la: tsand+ra maṇḍa la: ru tra ti ra baṃ: spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: oṃ sarba shū n+ya ta badzra ātma ko3 haṃ: lnga pa brten pa lha bskyed pa ni/

hūm̐: de dbus zla gam sgo gcig pa: pad nyi byol song gtso brgyad steng : bdag nyid che mchog he ru kaḥ smug nag dbu dgu shin tu khro: g.yas dgu gnam lcags rdo rje gdengs: g.yon dgu bhandha dmar gyis bkang : dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum gling bzhir brjid: thugs kar sems dpa' sa bon hūm̐: gnam zhal dbyings phyug sku la 'khril: phyag drug gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ ma hā kro ti shwa rī satwaṃ: hūm̐: shar phyogs pho brang zla gam dbus: dri za pho mo bsnol ba'i steng : thugs mchog badzra he ru kaḥ mthing nag dkar dmar zhal gsum khro: g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rnga: g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar zhags: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: kro ti shwa rī yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ badzra ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo phaṭḥ hūm̐: lho phyogs pho brang zla gam dbus: gshin rje pho mo bsnol ba'i steng : sku yi bdag nyid gshin rje'i gshed: ser nag dkar dmar khro zhing gtum: be con ral gri dgra satwa g.yas: bhan dmar sdigs mdzub mdung thung g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: bhe ta za byed yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ ya mānta ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: nub phyogs pho brang zla gam dbus: klu dbang pho mo bsnol ba'i steng : gsung mchog padma he ru kaḥ dkar dmar mthing zhal khro la gtum: g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ sbrul: dril bu bhan dmar lcags sgrog g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: padma gzi ldan yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ badzra kro ta hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: byang phyogs pho brang zla gam dbus: gnod sbyin pho mo bsnol ba'i steng :

phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing ka dkar dmar khro la gtum: rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga g.yas: g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭwāṃ thogs: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: shar lho pho brang zla gam dbus: me lha pho mo bsnol ba'i steng : yon tan rbod gtong he ru kaḥ ljang dkar dmar la khro zhing gtum: g.yas gsum rdo rje khyung dang sbrul: bhan dmar zhing dbyug gwa'u g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: nyid zhi yum dang gnyis med sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ ghu na dzñā na shrī he ru ka kro ti hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: lho nub pho brang zla gam dbus: che mchog drag po thod phreng rtsal: dmar dkar sngo la khro zhing gtum: gri gug rdo rje ral gri g.yas: thod khrag kha ṭwāṃ lcags sdig g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: rdo rje gtum mo yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: nub byang pho brang zla gam dbus: 'jig rten khro bo he ru kaḥ dud kha dkar dmar khro zhing gtum: rdo rje lha brgyad mgo bo g.yas: bhan dmar klu brgyad mgo bo g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: 'byung bzhi bdag mo yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: byang shar pho brang zla gam dbus: khrag 'thung khro rgyal dmod pa'i sku: nag dkar dmar la khro gtum brjid: gri gug lha brgyad tsitta g.yas: dung dmar klu brgyad tsitta g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: srid pa spyi 'dul yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal:

oṃ sarba duṣṭāṃ e dza bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: pho brang skyong ba'i rim pa bzhin: rang mdog phyag mtshan rgyan gyis spras: khro nyer gar gyi nyams dgu ldan: zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: ma yengs ting 'dzin gsal bar bskyed: oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐: oṃ badzra spho ṭa hūm̐: oṃ badzra gaṇḍe hoḥ drug pa ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung e yi klong : sku gsung thugs yon gnas mchog nas: che mchog lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdun pa bzhugs su gsol zhing phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐: che mchog zil gnon lha yi tshogs: rtog med shes pa'i gdan la bzhugs: ye grol chen po'i dkyil 'khor la: rang byung de bzhin bdag phyag 'tshal: oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ brgyad pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: zil gnon dpal chen dkyil 'khor la: 'dod yon lha mo phyi mchod 'bul: gzugs sgra dri ro reg mchod 'bul: dug lnga ye shes nang mchod 'bul: bde stong dga' bzhi'i gsang mchod 'bul: phyag rgya zung 'jug gar mchod 'bul: brda skad glu dbyangs snyan mchod 'bul: sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rdzas mchod 'bul: dri lnga ro brgya'i sman mchod 'bul: mkha' dbyings padma'i rakta 'bul: bcud ldan longs spyod gtor mchod 'bul: sgrol ba'i sha khrag dmar mchod 'bul: dza gad bdud rtsi'i phud mchod 'bul: rmad byung gha na'i tshogs mchod 'bul: spyan gzigs mnyes pa'i rgyan mchod 'bul: mchog gi ting 'dzin don mchod 'bul: bla med mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'di: zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mri ta ma hā rakta bha lingta ga ṇa tsakra ta na ga ṇa dharma dhā tu gu hya pū dza hoḥ

dgu pa bstod pa bya ba ni| hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong : byol song gtso brgyad phyogs skyong bcu: bam̐ dang pad nyi zla gdan steng : zhi ba sgeg bzhad gsal 'tsher 'bar: mnyen lcug 'khril zhing dgyes gar ldan: khro tshogs dgod gshe rngam gtum 'jigs: 'bar zhing drag rtsal mthu stobs 'byin: zhi dang khro gar dgyes pa'i lha: gsang ba zil gnon tshogs la bstod: bcu pa dzap bzlas la lnga/ dang po dzap bskul ni/ hūm̐: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: bsgrub pa'i thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: chos dbyings drag sngags rang sgra 'brug ltar ldir: dbang bzhi stsol zhing dam tshig dus la bab: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub deng stsol cig /gnyis pa bzlas pa dngos la bzhi/ zhi bar bsnyen pa/ khro bor sgrub pa/ bsnyen sgrub dbyer med du bzlas pa/ las sbyor bcas so/ dang po zhi bar bsnyen pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gtso dgu'i lha rnams kyi dbu gtsug tu rigs bdag kun bzang yab yum/ spyi bo'i gnas lngar rang mthun rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum dang thugs srog sa bon sngags phreng gis bskor ba/ lha thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas stong gsum thams cad zhi ba'i lha dang sngags sgras gang*| phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs tshur bsdus nas thim par gyur/ dam pa rigs brgya'i rtsa sngags ni/ om̐ ā li kā li dzñā na pañtsa sa twa kro ta mu ne ye swā hā: zhi ba zhe gnyis kyi rtsa sngags ni/ om̐ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ rigs lnga yab yum gyi snying po ni/ om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: zhes zhi ba'i sngags rnams sgra dal zhing 'jam la ring bar bzlas: gnyis pa khro bor sgrub pa la/ dpal chen po rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la ye shes sems dpa' rdor sems dkar po'i rnam par bzhugs pa'i thugs dkyil rin chen zur brgyad nang du nyi gdan la ting 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje sngon po nas 'bru tsam gyi lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag spus bris pa tsam gyi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba/

bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyen du song ljags steng āḥl bskor te shangs bug g.yas nas yum gyi shangs bug g.yon du brgyud spyi bo'i oṃ la bskor nas thugs ka nas yum gyi mkha' la bab pa las 'od 'phros/ bde gshegs thams cad mchod pas mnyes/ 'od zer slar 'dus pa dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi rang bzhin yum mkhar 'khyil ba yab kyi gsang bas rngub ste thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur/ ces gsal btab la bzla'o/ om̐ badzra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ma hā kro ti shwa ri satwaṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khro bo spyi'i sngags ni/ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyoḥ gsum pa spyi dril/ lha tshogs bdun brgya nyer lnga'i zhal nas drag sngags 'brug sgra stong gsum gang bar bsgrags pas khams gsum chos nyid du bsgral/ ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad nas ye shes kyi me mgar gyi tshwa tshwa lta bur 'phros pas snang srid me phung gis gang*/ phyi sems can gyi las nyon phung po| nang sgrub pa po'i rnam rtog 'khrul 'dzin/ bar gdon bgegs thams cad gzhob tu bsregs nas skye med dbyings su thim par gyur/ ces mos la/ bsnyen sgrub spyi dril sngags ni/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la ru pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces gnam lcags kyi thog rgod ltar bzla/ bzhi pa las sbyor ni/ bsnyen sgrub sngags kyi sham bu gang dgos zhi rgyas dbang drag gi kha bsgyur bya ba ni/ 'jigs pa brgyad la sogs pa sdig sgrib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa drug puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: khams gsum srid gsum gyi yon tan dang snang ba thams cad dbang du 'dus par gyur cig pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dgra bgegs dang gnod byed dug lnga thams cad tshar bcad par gyur cig hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ

thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying sngon du 'gro bas mchod bstod ni/ oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta gha na tsakra pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: me dpung rab 'khrigs byol song gtso brgyad steng : che mchog dpal dgu mi bzad gar dang ldan: 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan dur khrod dpal chas rngam: zhi khro'i gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la bstod: ces bstod/ de nas thun gtor 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor gyi: che mchog khro rol lha tshogs rnams: bskul lo thugs dam dus la bab: skye med ye shes klong yangs nas: snying po sngags kyi rang sgra sgrogs: spro bsdu'i dngos grub 'byung ba'i phyir: dug gsum bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: bdud bzhi dgra bgegs dpung gzhom nas: phrin las sna tshogs 'grub gyur cig: oṃ sarba bha lingta kha kha khā hi: zhes pas thun gtor 'bul zhing tshogs mi bya na rjes chog mchod bstod man gsham ltar byas la rdzogs rim bsdu ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas mthar bsngo smon sogs las kyi mtha' bsdu bar bya'o/ yang skabs 'gar thun rjes ma rnams su spros pa bsdu bar mos na rgyun khyer shin tu bsdus pa ni/ thog mar tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa dang*/ skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa ni/ skad cig gis dpal chen khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor mkha' khyab tu sad par mos la/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum bstan pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu'i 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*/ /dag pa mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/

/bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la| |dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i dge ba rnams/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams 'od zhu rang la thim par gyur: de nas dngos gzhi ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ hūm̐: kun gzhi skye med gsal stong ngang : ma 'gags sna tshogs 'phro 'du las: spro bsgyur 'gyed pa'i sa bon gsal: oṃ bhrūm̐ hūm̐: rten dang rten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rdo rje bhrūm̐ gyur gzhal yas lte ba'i dbus: byol song gtso brgyad pad nyi ro yi steng : hūm̐ las che mchog dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad: rdo rje thod pa 'dzin cing zhabs brgyad 'gyings: dbyings phyug yum 'khyud phyag gnyis gri thod 'khyud: gzi brjid gar dgu ldan pa gtso bo yi: gnas lnga yan lag bzhi ru rim pa bzhin: gshin rje rta mgrin yang dag ma mo phur: drag po 'jig rten dmod pa bya rog gdong : rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud gtso 'khor dur khrod chas: rang rang phyag mtshan sa bon 'khor bcas gsal: me dpung klong bzhugs dpa' rngam brjid par bsgom: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la ru pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ye shes dbab cing phyag mchod 'bul ba ni/ ye shes spyan drangs dam tshig bdag la thim: gnas dang phyag bgyid mchod sprin sna tshogs 'bul: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dya shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta gha na tsakra pū dza āḥhūm̐: bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: me dpung rab 'khrigs byol song gtso brgyad steng : che mchog dpal dgu mi bzad gar dang ldan: 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan dur khrod dpal chas rngam: zhi khro'i gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la bstod: bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa ni/ thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' rdor sems kyi thugs kar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas/

snang grags snod bcud thams cad dpal chen po'i sku gsung thugs lha sngags ye shes kyi rol par gyur/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la ru pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci nus bzla'o/ spros pa bsdu na/ hūm̐ mūṃ kro ta kro ti wa na hūm̐ phaṭḥ tsam gyis chog /shin tu spros med hūm̐ kho na la tshang*/ rjes chog sogs gong gsal ltar ram rgyas bsdus blo dang 'tshams par bya'o/ de dag ni thun phyi ma rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i rgyun khyer bsdus pa'i lugs so/ ༈ spyi don gnyis pa rjes kyi bya ba tshogs mchod mdor bsdus bya bar spro ni| dang po byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gyis lan gsum sbyangs: om̐ āḥhūm̐:gis rgyas par spel: hūm̐: stong gsum khyon ltar yangs pa'i bhandha ru: snod bcud srid pa'i gzugs snang tshogs su bshams: 'khor 'das mi dmigs yig 'brus byin gyis rlobs: bde stong bla med ye shes chen por gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis sbyangs/ gnyis pa tshogs spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings skye 'gag bral ba'i pho brang nas/ /kun bzang che mchog zhi khro rab 'byams lha/ /bka' sdod gter srung dam can rgya mtsho rnams/ /zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ hūm̐: zhi ba'i lha tshogs gzi brjid spungs se spung : khro bo'i lha tshogs gad mo ya la la: ma sring mkha' 'gro glu gar khyugs se khyug: chos skyong dam can las byed sha ra ra: gnas 'dir gshegs la dbang bskur byin chen phob: dam rdzas tshogs la ting 'dzin bcud mchog spel: 'dir 'dus dpa' bo mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: dbyings las 'phros pa'i mkha' 'gro mdzes ma 'phyo: phyag na nyi zla bhandha yangs pa'i snod:

'dod yon tshogs mchod lhun po ltar bkod nas: phyag rgya brda skad glu gar rtse zhing mchod: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mnyes gyur cig: om̐ āḥhūm̐ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi: bzhi pa bskang ba ni/ hūm̐: gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla bye ba brgya: brjid chags mdzes ldan lta bas mi ngoms shing : rang bzhin kheng ba'i phyi nang mchod rdzas kyis: mnyes pa'i mchod rdzas phung po dpag med bkod: zhi khro 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : gsang ba zil gnon lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : sgrub chen bka' brgyad thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: lnga pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi phyi nang mchod pa la: phud nyams lhag phri tshig la chad cing lhag: nyes sgrib skyon can rang gnong 'gyod pas bshags: mi sgrib tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol: om̐ badzra sa twa sa ma ya: sogs sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes bzlas shing lhag chad bkang*/ drug pa bsgral ba ni| hūm̐: nga ni rig pa he ru ka: ro gcig lta ba khros pa'i sku: phyag g.yas thabs kyi rdo rje gsor: g.yon pas shes rab phur pa bsgril: ma rig gnyis 'dzin dgra bo rnams: snying rje'i phur bu 'debs shing bsgral: ka dag mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas shog: om̐ badzra dharma kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bsgral lo/ bdun pa bstab cing 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bcom ldan kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams: chos nyid klong yangs dgyes pa'i zhal phyes shig: dug lnga ma rig bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: rang grol bde ba chen por dgyes gyur cig: om̐ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na khā hi: de nas tshogs la rol zhing mchog thun gyi dngos grub thob par bsam/ brgyad pa lhag ma 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i lhag sdud ma: dbang phyug ging dang laṅka pho nya'i tshogs: gnas bzang dur khrod 'grim zhing tshogs khang nyul:

gos bzang g.yang gzhi gyon zhing bhandha thogs: skyems bzang rakta 'thung zhing ro la 'dren: nyams pa'i sha la za zhing tshogs lhag sdud: sku mdog gcer bu skra dmar sa la gzhol: lhag ma 'di bzhes bstan pa'i mel tshe mdzod: om̐ utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: dgu pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: gsang ba zil gnon sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi: bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha tshogs ma lus pa: thugs rje phrin las mdzad phyir deng 'dir bskul: mthu stobs dpa' ba'i gzi brjid bdag la stsol: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma lnga bdo'i skabs: gsang sngags gnyan gyi bstan pa nub la nye: dam sri log 'dren 'byung po kha dar nas: khro chen rgya mtsho mngon spyod dus la bab: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: zhing bcu nyams pa'i dgra bo rtsad nas chod: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub pa mdzod: ces gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol/ bcu pa chad mdo bya ba ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i bskal pa la/ /'og min bde byed brtsegs dang mchims phu ru| |kun bzang yab yum rig 'dzin brgyad rnams dang*/ /slob dpon chen po padma thod phreng gis/ /brgyud gsum dkyil 'khor gtad cing bstan pa'i tshe/ /dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter srung sogs/ /so so'i srog snying phul nas khas blangs bzhin/ /gtor ma bzhes la tha tshig dran par mdzod/ om̐ badzra kro ti shwa rī sa ma ya bhakṣa si bha lingta kha kha khā hi: bcu gcig brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ni: bdud mo gnod sbyin sman mo bzhi bzhi ni: lhab lhub rgyan dang dar dpyangs cod pan 'phur: glu len bro rdung g.yer kha si li li: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzad du gsol: om̐ badzra pra mo ha ni hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ

i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: bcu gnyis pa rta bro ni/ de nas gtor gzhong 'og tu dgra sri bkug cing*/ hūm̐: che mchog buddha thod phreng rtsal: zhi khro gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i bro brdungs te: tshad med bzhi yi phur bu bsgrubs: btab pas dug lnga dbyings su sgrol: mnan no ru tra ma ldang cig: om̐ āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: de nas gtor gzhong yar bslangs la me tog 'thor/ bcu gsum pa dbang bzhi len pa ni/ hūm̐: bde chen 'khor lo kā ya badzra oṃ: longs spyod 'khor lo wākka badzra āḥ chos kyi 'khor lo tsitta badzra hūm̐: sprul pa'i 'khor lo gu ṇa badzra trām̐: bde spyod 'khor lo gu hya badzra hrīḥ dbang bskur yongs rdzogs yi dam lhar gyur nas: sngags dang ting 'dzin rab tu gnas gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ trām̐ hrī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes pas rang nyid ye nas yi dam lha yin bzhin ting nge 'dzin la gnas par bya/ rjes chog la/ dang po mchod bstod ni/ oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta gha na tsakra pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: me dpung rab 'khrigs byol song gtso brgyad steng : che mchog dpal dgu mi bzad gar dang ldan: 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan dur khrod dpal chas rngam: zhi khro'i gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la bstod: ces bstod/ gnyis pa bzod par gsol ba ni| hūm̐: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig 'gal ba dang : ma 'byor nyams dang lhag chad 'khrul pa'i tshogs: mthol zhing bshags la mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: om̐ badzra sa twa hūm̐: zhes yig brgya bzlas shing bzod gsol bya/ chad lhag bkang*/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya/ gsum pa bsdu ldang ni/ hoḥ snod bcud gzugs snang dran rig rol pa'i rtsal: rang byung gnyug ma'i ye shes lha yi tshogs: bskyed pa sprul bsgyur rdzogs pa kun gzhi'i dbyings:

ka dag dran rig sbubs su mi rtog āḥ lhar snang dbyings su bsdus pas rtag mtha' bral/ a a āḥs mnyam par bzhag /phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ kyis lhar ldang gsang ba gsum gyis chad mtha' spang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ma ka wa tsi rakṣa maṃ/ zhes go bgo zhing*/ rgyun gyi spyod lam la 'jug bzhi pa bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ bsngo bya ka dag bsngo byed ye nas stong : bsngo yul sangs rgyas sems can kun rgyu gcig: bsngo ba'i dngos po smra bsam brjod las 'das: mtha' yas sems can rang ngo shes phyir bsngo: lnga pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ dkyil 'khor zab mo gnyan gyi dal bzung nas: tshe rabs 'bral med yi dam lhar 'byung zhing : rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i go 'phang myur thob ste: pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su skye bar shog: ces dmigs med gsal stong ngang du thun cig bzhag /drug pa bkra shis brjod pa ni/ hūm̐: chos longs sprul gsum zhi khro 'dus pa yi: dkyil 'khor gnyan dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing : tshogs gnyis mthar phyin don gnyis lhun grub nas: phun tshogs yar zla ltar rgyas bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor zhing bden tshig brjod/ zhes bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi rgyun khyer snying po'i don bsdus bsgrigs chags su bkod pa 'di'ang rtsa ba gter chen nyid kyis gter gzhung la ljags bsgrigs mdzad pa'i phrin las bsdus pa sor bzhag la gsol 'debs dang gsal byed phran bu gsar du bgyis la kha 'geng dgos pa rnams bka' brgyad rang gzhung sogs rigs mthun gzhan las bsnan ste rang lugs lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi sgrub sde'i rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs bsnyen sgrub nyams len pa rnams la nyer mkhor dmigs te sgrub brtson au ḍi sogs kyis thugs bzhed bzhin bdud 'dul phrin las rol pa rtsal gyis rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu lug zla ba gnyis pa'i yar tshes su grub par bgyis pa'o// //

ma) bka' brgyad rgyun khyer ni/ rang nyid ting 'dzin rnam gsum dran rdzogs su: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rdo rje bhrūm̐ gyur gzhal yas lte ba'i dbus: byol song gtso brgyad pad nyi ro yi steng : hūm̐ las che mchog dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad: rdo rje thod pa 'dzin cing zhabs brgyad 'gying : dbyings phyug yum 'khyud gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: gzi brjid gar dgu ldan pa gtso bo'i gnas: lnga dang yan lag bzhi ru rim pa bzhin: gshin rje rta mgrin yang dag ma mo phur: drag po 'jig rten dmod pa bya rog gdong : rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud gtso 'khor dur khrod chas: rang rang phyag mtshan sa bon 'khor bcas gsal: me dpung klong bzhugs dpal rngam brjid par gsal: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa ri badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yaksha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ye shes spyan drangs dam tshig bdag la bstim: gnas dang phyag bgyis mchod sprin sna tshogs 'bul: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba lingta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza āḥhūm̐: me dpung rab 'khrigs byol song gtso brgyad steng : che mchog dpal dgu mi bzad gar dgu ldan: 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan dur khrod dpal chas rngam: zhi khro gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la bstod: ces bstod cing bsnyen sgrub bya/ de tsam spros pa 'di ltar ro: 'di ltar nyams su blang bar bya: hūm̐: dran rdzogs wal gyis che mchog yab yum gnas: dpal chen gtso brgyad yum sbyor gar dgu ldan: phyag mtshan sa bon la sogs ma 'dres gsal: om̐ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa ri badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pa'i sngags phreng sham bur khā hi tsam sbyar kyang chog /med kyang mi dgos/ spros pa de tsam ma lcogs na/ hūm̐ mūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐:

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: bhyo bhyo bhyoḥ bhyo bhyo bhyoḥ bhyoḥ oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta kro ti aṣṭa baṃ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ spros pa de tsam mi lcogs na hūm̐ mūṃ: kro ta kro ti wa na hūm̐ phaṭḥ de tsam ma lcogs na/ hūm̐: rang la tshang : rgyud las kyang : skye med rdo rje ngo bo nyid: rdo rje hūm̐ ste hūm̐ sgra can: rdo rje rnon po ral gri can: rdo rje sku ste rang byung ba: rdo rje snying po skye med klong : ngo bo hūm̐ dang rdo rje'o: zhes gsungs pa ltar: hūm̐ tsam mi lcogs na: rgyud las: e ma sprul pa'i 'khor rnams nyon: dang po rang byung chen po'i dbus: ma 'gags stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid: bsdu bya snang ba'i yul las 'das: gnyis med ngo bo de kho na: zhes gsungs pa ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o: ྀatsha: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas padma sbas tshal rong nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ma) bka' brgyad rgyun khyer ni/ rang nyid ting 'dzin rnam gsum dran rdzogs su: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rdo rje bhrūm̐ gyur gzhal yas lte ba'i dbus: byol song gtso brgyad pad nyi ro yi steng : hūm̐ las che mchog dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad: rdo rje thod pa 'dzin cing zhabs brgyad 'gying : dbyings phyug yum 'khyud gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: gzi brjid gar dgu ldan pa gtso bo'i gnas: lnga dang yan lag bzhi ru rim pa bzhin: gshin rje rta mgrin yang dag ma mo phur: drag po 'jig rten dmod pa bya rog gdong : rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud gtso 'khor dur khrod chas: rang rang phyag mtshan sa bon 'khor bcas gsal: me dpung klong bzhugs dpal rngam brjid par gsal: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa ri badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yaksha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ye shes spyan drangs dam tshig bdag la bstim: gnas dang phyag bgyis mchod sprin sna tshogs 'bul:

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba lingta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza āḥhūm̐: me dpung rab 'khrigs byol song gtso brgyad steng : che mchog dpal dgu mi bzad gar dgu ldan: 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan dur khrod dpal chas rngam: zhi khro gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la bstod: ces bstod cing bsnyen sgrub bya/ de tsam spros pa 'di ltar ro: 'di ltar nyams su blang bar bya: hūm̐: dran rdzogs wal gyis che mchog yab yum gnas: dpal chen gtso brgyad yum sbyor gar dgu ldan: phyag mtshan sa bon la sogs ma 'dres gsal: om̐ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa ri badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pa'i sngags phreng sham bur khā hi tsam sbyar kyang chog /med kyang mi dgos/ spros pa de tsam ma lcogs na/ hūm̐ mūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: bhyo bhyo bhyoḥ bhyo bhyo bhyoḥ bhyoḥ oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta kro ti aṣṭa baṃ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ spros pa de tsam mi lcogs na hūm̐ mūṃ: kro ta kro ti wa na hūm̐ phaṭḥ de tsam ma lcogs na/ hūm̐: rang la tshang : rgyud las kyang : skye med rdo rje ngo bo nyid: rdo rje hūm̐ ste hūm̐ sgra can: rdo rje rnon po ral gri can: rdo rje sku ste rang byung ba: rdo rje snying po skye med klong : ngo bo hūm̐ dang rdo rje'o: zhes gsungs pa ltar: hūm̐ tsam mi lcogs na: rgyud las: e ma sprul pa'i 'khor rnams nyon: dang po rang byung chen po'i dbus: ma 'gags stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid: bsdu bya snang ba'i yul las 'das: gnyis med ngo bo de kho na: zhes gsungs pa ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o: ྀatsha: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas padma sbas tshal rong nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // tsa)༄༅/

/bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bsangs brngan 'dod rgu char 'bebs bzhugs so: kyai ye shes dbyings lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs skal ldan don slad du: rten 'brel dge legs 'byung ba'i ched: bsang brngan 'dod rgu char 'bebs bstan: 'di yi yon tan bsam mi khyab: tshe rabs las kyi sgrib pa bya: sbyin smin bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs: yi dmalha yi bka' chad ni: dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi dam tshig gso: chos skyong rnams kyi 'khu ldog sel: lha srin sde brgyad gdug rtsub zhi: sngon las 'phral rkyen sha 'khon byang : dus min 'chi ba'i bdud las grol: phyi yul skag rkyen dgra la bzlog: nang gi mnga' thang srid kyang bskyed: che btsan gzi byin mthu dang ldan: bka' gter srung mas bu bzhin skyong : gzhi lam byes su kha 'dzin myur: lo nyes sad ser nad yams zhi: yul bzung sa bcud rnams kyang dge: bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i rten: lha bsang 'di la rag las pas: rten 'brel mchog la 'di nyid bzung : mtsho rgyal brda yi yi ger thob: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dpal bkra shis dge ba'i dus tshes mgor: thabs rten 'brel bsang mchod brtsam pa ni: rgyu bsod nams phun tshogs mchod rdzas bsags: don bden gnyis ngang la gzhung bsrang ngo : sa ma ya: dang po bkra shis dge ba'i yar tshes bzang po la: gzhi gtsang dkar ba yid du 'ong bar bzo: de yi steng du 'bru yi tshom bu rab lha grangs: 'bring padma 'dab brgyad: tha ma gang 'byor bsham: de yang bkra shis dge legs 'byung ba'i gnad rdzas la: tshang zhing 'byor ldan cher dgos so: gnyis pa gtor ma'i rnam dbye ni: pad gzhong lcags min pa'i snod gtsang ma'i nang : gzhi ri rab gru bzhi sum brtsegs sam: yang na lnga brtsaigs bya: de yang srid pa gsum 'byung ba lnga mtshon pa yin: de yi steng du padma mthil sprod bya:

de yi steng du bla ma rtsa gsum gtor ma: de la 'khor gtor zur brgyad kyis bskor: pad 'dab la sogs spyi dang mthun: 'bring po zhi gtor zlum po bzhag: bsdu na dkar gtor gcig kyang bya: ri rab bang rim dag la ni: dang po dpal gtor sum cus bskor: mdun du g.yag lug ra gsum bzhag: phyogs bzhir mtshams brgyad dkar gtor brgyad: de yi phyi rol spyan gzigs dang : mchod rdzas bskang rdzas rnams kyis bskor: de yi phyi rol gzugs 'gros tshogs: de yi phyi rol 'dab chags tshogs: de yi phyi rol changs bu bya: rtse mor nyi zla nor bu bya: dkar dmar rgyan tshogs phra bar bcos: rin chen sna tshogs dar zab rigs: rgyan dang phye ma gcal du bkram: 'bring po gzugs 'gros mi bya na: dpal gtor sum cu g.yag lug ra: dkar gtor brgyad dang changs bus bskor: shel tshig khri dkar stong nag spung : des kyang 'bring po'i lugs shig tshang : gzhan yang phyi nang mchod rdzas 'bul: phye mar 'o skol zhal zas dang : 'bru sman sna tshogs rnams kyang bkram: spyan gzigs go khrab lha rten gzugs: phyi nang mchod rdzas tshang bar bya: de nas dgra lha'i gtor ma ni: g.yas su snod gtsang dag gi nang : ri rab gru bzhi sum brtsegs steng : mkhar thab tog bcas tshang ba la: bshos bu rtse gsum dgu yis bskor: de yi phyi rol dkar gtor bzhi: de dag dkar dmar rgyan gyis spras: g.yon du pad gzhong yangs pa'i nang : bum pa'i steng du sman bshos bzhag: de la brtan ma bcu gnyis bskor: sman leb bcu gnyis sha sogs brgyan: gzhan yang gzhi zur 'tshams pa ru: lcags zangs bhandha'i snod dag tu: chos 'byung bsnol ma de yi steng : dmar gtor dbal bcas tshang ba la: dpal gtor sum cus bskor bar bya: bsdu na dgu'am bcu gsum bya: sha khrag dmar gyis rab tu brgyan: phye mar mar gyis brgyan pa bsham: de nas bsang shug rim pa ni: rab ltar tsandan a ga ru: lha shug ba lu mkhan pa dkar:

'bring ni stab shing mdung shing dang : lo ma phyug pa'i shing lo'o: tha mar dug shing chu shing dang : shel shing ag shing bse shing dang : lcang ma glang ma ma lags pa'i: shing sna gang la byas kyang rung : sna tshogs bsdu na gang yang gnas: rab ni bsang khang gsum tsam phub: dbus su zhi ba'i lha bsang la: g.yas su dgra lha'i lha bsang ste: g.yon du drag po'i lha bsang ngo : zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ltar bya na: dbus su padma 'dab brgyad bri: phyi rim zla phyed rdo rje dang : rigs bzhi'i phyag mtshan me ri'i bskor: nad gcod la sogs khag che na: bsang gzhi'i 'og tu g.yang gzhi bkod: de steng sa stegs bzhag par bya: gnad 'gag med na mi bya'o: de nas dkyil 'khor cha tshang nas: bsang brngan cho gar 'jug pa ni: bde ba'i gdan la skyil krung bzhugs: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs ldan pa'i ngang : dang po skyabs yul rgyas pa gzhung ltar bya: hūm̐: chos dbyings lhun grub bde chen ngang nyid las: mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i gdan: padma 'byung gnas snang srid zil gnon sku: dkar dmar mdangs ldan pad zhwa mthong grol gsol: rdo rje bhandha tshe bum kha ṭwāṃ bsnams: chos gos dmar po za ber smug nag gsol: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum rgyal po rol stabs bzhugs: bag dro lhun chags gzi brjid ldan par bsgom: g.yas su seng khri dar 'bol gdan steng du: sangs rgyas kun 'dus sprul sku shākya thub: btso ma'i gzi 'bar sa non mnyam bzhag bzhugs: g.yon du padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: dge 'dun kun 'dus gsang bdag rdo rje gtum: mthing nag rdo rje sdigs mdzub mkha' la gtad: rgyab tu mdangs ldan pad nyi'i gdan steng du: dam chos 'byung gnas dbyings phyug yum chen mo: mthing ka phyag gnyis ral gri pu ti 'dzin: mdun du padma nyi zla bam ro'i gdan: che mchog smug nag rdo rje bhandha bsnams: skyabs yul phyi nang dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: ma bcos stong pa'i dbyings su 'ja' ltar bsgom:

na mo: dkyil 'khor gtso bo bla ma thod pa rtsal: gsol 'debs skyabs mchi phyi nang bar chad sol: mnyam med bcom ldan sangs rgyas kun 'dus la: gsol 'debs skyabs mchi phyi nang bar chad sol: gsang bdag thugs mchog dge 'dun kun 'dus la: gsol 'debs skyabs mchi phyi nang bar chad sol: dam chos gsang mdzod dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro la: gsol 'debs skyabs mchi phyi nang bar chad sol: yi dam rtsa gsum che mchog he ru kar: gsol 'debs skyabs mchi phyi nang bar chad sol: skyabs yul mchog gsum thugs rje kun 'dus la: bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can bskyab tu gsol: mi 'bral rtag tu spyi gtsug dbyings la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum dwang bas phyag 'tshal bstod: rtse gcig 'dun pa'i mchod sprin bla med mchod: dbang po gling bzhi ri rab maṇḍal 'bul: tshe rabs sgo gsum sgrib gnyis mthol lo bshags: 'gro mgon thugs rje'i mnga' bdag che la bstod: mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i dpal gyur bzhugs: theg chen bla med chos 'khor bskor du gsol: mtha' yas 'gro kun byang chub lam 'god bsngo: las ngan gdung ba'i tshad las rab sgrol shog: de nas mchod pa byin rlabs ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces skabs 'dir spro na sngags drug gis byin gyis brlab pa ni: lag pa thal mo khang stong sbyar ba mtheb sor rnams rtse sprad pa chos nyid rnam dag gi phyag rgya dang sngags ni: oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ gtor ma dang mchod rdzas rnams kyi 'bag pa dang mi gtsang ba sogs ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad stong par gyur/ lag pa gnyis mnyam pa'i thal mo dbus ma gsum gyi tshigs bar ma rnam bcags nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang sngags ni: na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu ṣe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: gtor ma dang mchod rdzas rnams rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po rgyun mi 'chad par gyur cig:

lag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba las mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab tu kha phye la sbyar: mthe bong gnyis bsnol ba bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i phyag rgya dang sngags ni: oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ gtor ma dang mchod rdzas rnams 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur pa thams cad mgron so so'i thob pa la bgegs dang nyer 'tshe med par gyur cig /lag pa g.yas pa pus mo g.yas kyi steng du mchod sbyin dang mnyam bzhag byas pa rgya che shugs ldan gyi phyag rgya dang sngags ni: oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma naṃ a dya nutpanna twata oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ gtor mgron so sos gang la gang 'dod kyi dngos po rnams yid bzhin du 'byung bar gyur cig /lag g.yon khu tshur bcangs la pang du bzhag pas rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdzub mo bsgrengs nas sdigs mdzub bstan pa ye shes skar mda'i phyag rgya sngags ni/ oṃ dzñā na ā wa lo ki te na maḥs manta spha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dzwa la ni swā hā/ gtor mgron rnams drag zhan che chung med par so so'i yid bzhin du tshim zhing rang dbang du longs spyod par gyur cig /drug pa lag pa gnyis rdo rje nang du bsdams pa spyi bo'i thad kar bskor ba dbang sgyur 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dang sngags ni/ na maḥs manta buddha naṃ gra he shwa ri bhañdza na ma hā sa ma ye hūm̐ phaṭ/ gtor ma dang mchod rdzas rnams bskal pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du zag pa med cing mgron rnams mnyes pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig /brjod kyang chog /ma 'byor na gsang sngags rdo rje theg chen lugs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ la tshang : oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃḥ stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i snod gling bzhi ri rab bkod pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong nor lha gter bdag rgyud srung :

gzhan yang lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu: yang 'khor sprul pa'i ru 'dren: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra ba 'bum: khyad par gzhi bdag drag rtsal dang ldan pa: yul ri sa brtan gnyan po srung ba: stong gsum stong gi bdag po: 'dzam bu gling gi zo dor: rdzu 'phrul dgra lha'i dmag dpung : bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis: sbas gnas gangs can srung ma: lo zla zhag dus mtshams 'dzin: rten 'brel chen po la dbang ba rnams la mnyes pa'i rdzas mchog: spyan gzigs dar mtshon rgyan gyis nam mkha' sa gzhi khyab pa: sra brtan go khrab mtshon cha rno la gzeng ba: sku 'bag bla 'khor srog rten ri ltar brjid pa: rkang bzhi gzugs 'gros sna tshogs gar rtsed bsgyur ba: 'dab chags skad snyan sna tshogs 'phur 'jums lding ba: gser dngul rin chen sna tshogs gcal du bkram pa: bkra shis rdzas rtags sna tshogs phun sum tshogs pa: 'bru bcud 'bras bu sna tshogs ri ltar spungs pa: dkar mngar bdud rtsi'i phud mchod mtsho ltar 'khyil ba: phye mar sman dang dri zhim gangs ltar rgyas pa: bha ling rten gtor sgrub rdzas dbyings dang mnyam pa: dri zhim bsang gi dud pa phyogs bcur khyab pa: sna tshogs sgra snyan rol mo 'brug ltar ldir ba: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha lingta te dzwa bha lingta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ āḥham̐'u: oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra gandhe āḥham̐'u: oṃ badzra nai wi dye āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra shabda āḥham̐'u: oṃ badzra rū pa āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra rā sa āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra sparshe ā hūm̐:

oṃ badzra sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: zhes rol mo sna tshogs drag tu brdungs shing dri zhim gyi dud pa bdug: de nas rang nyid bdag bskyed ni: hūm̐: rang nyid dran rdzogs padma 'byung gnas gsal: dkar dmar mdang ldan gzi brjid dpal du 'bar: zhal 'dzum mdangs mnga' spyan rtsa phyogs bcur 'khyil: pad zhwa mthong grol dar dpyangs cod pan 'phur: snyan cha mgul rgyan rin chen se mo do: phod kha chos gos lhab lhub ber chen gsol: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga thugs kar gdengs: g.yon pas bhandha 'chi med tshe bum bsnams: nyon mongs rtsad gcod kha ṭwāṃ rgya rtags 'chang : g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum snang srid zil gnon tshul: g.yas su lha lcam mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: g.yon du mtsho rgyal bhandha bdud rtsi mchod: gnyis ka zhi 'dzum mnyen lcug 'khril ldem la: yab yum bde chen ye shes ngang nyid las: ma bcos lhun grub rang byung de ltar gsal: gnas lngar 'od 'phros rnga yab dpal ri nas: rig 'dzin rgyal ba sras bcas spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badzra sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: padma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal: badzra sa mā ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ bzhugs gsol mchod pa ni: hūm̐: ma chags skyon bral padma nyi zla'i gdan: dran rig 'du 'bral med pa'i pad 'byung lha: sku gsum ye shes ngang la dgyes par bzhugs: zung 'jug bde stong dbyings su phyag 'tshal nas:

sna tshogs dbang po rtsol bral mnyes mchod 'bul: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: ngo mtshar rmad byung padma thod phreng rtsal: mtshan dpe yon tan kun rdzogs dpal 'bar ba: 'o ma'i mtsho las skyes pa rdo rje'i sku: za hor rgyal sras rig 'dzin padma 'byung : skye 'chi 'jigs bral mdo sngags sgron me sbar: gangs can bod du sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs: lho nub gdong dmar srin po thabs kyis 'dul: bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mtshungs med u rgyan rje: ya mtshan mngon gyur sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: khyed la gdung shugs gsol btab bstod pa'i mthus: thugs rje'i klong nas byin rlabs char chen phob: tshe rabs gtan gyi skyabs su mnga' gsol zhing : sku lnga ting 'dzin mchog gsum deng 'dir stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: oṃ ḍākki ha ri ni sa sarba siddhi dzaḥ zhes rtsa sngags bzlas shing rang nyid pad 'byung du gsal gdab: de nas mdun bskyed me lha spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: mdun du bhrūm̐ gyur 'byung lnga yangs pa'i dpal: me thab dkar po gru gsum raṃ gyis mtshan: zla phyed rdo rje kha khyer mu ran bcas: ye shes me dpung sna lnga 'bar ba'i dbus: ting 'dzin snod kyi me lha agne rgyal: zhi rgyas mdangs ldan sku mdog dmar ser bcas: g.yas g.yon phyag na ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin: rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan ra skyes khams pa chibs: nyon mongs bdud bzhi sreg byed tsha zer 'phro: 'khor du ye shes me lha 'bum gyis bskor: rang bzhin gnas nas skad cig spyan drangs gyur: oṃ agne ye badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung ngang las sprul pa'i lha: nyon mongs bud shing sreg mdzad me lha'i tshogs: snod kyi 'jig rten gso mdzad gshegs su gsol: a raṃ me 'phrul tshwa tshwa'i khri la bzhugs: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ

dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tiṣṭha lhan: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: 'jigs byed me lha 'khor dang bcas pa la: phyi nang mnyes mchod dgyes pa'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyis: ji ltar bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub tu gsol: auauauṃ badzra agne ye ram̐ sa pa ri wā ra: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: zhes mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: de yang khag che na mgron rnams me lha'i lto bar bskyed: do gal chung na phyi rol tu bskyed: 'byung po phra mo rnams me la bsngangs nas mi tshugs pas phyi rol tu bskyed kyang rung : de nas mgron bskyed pa ni: oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las: dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi ri rab dang bcas pa: de yi steng du bhrūm̐ ser po yongs su gyur pa las: pho brang gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid rdzogs pa: stong gsum 'khor lo'i khyon dang mnyam pa ye shes 'khor lo'i rang bzhin 'ja' 'od zer thag 'khrigs pa'i gzhal yas su gyur: de yi dbus su stod kyi cha la: seṅge gyad dang padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du: chos sku kun tu bzang po yab yum la gsang ba rigs lnga ye shes mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor ba: g.yas su seng khri pad zla'i steng du: bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po la: dgongs brgyud sangs rgyas byang sems 'bum gyis bskor ba: rgyab tu padma nyi zla'i steng du: dbyings phyug yum chen mo pha rol tu phyin ma la: gsang mdzod brda brgyud bka' yi rgyud sdes bskaur ba: g.yon du padma nyi zla'i steng du: byang sems phyag na rdo rje la: snyan brgyud dge 'dun tshogs kyis bskor ba: mdun du padma nyi zla'i steng du: gu ru rin po che dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas la: gter brgyud bka' bab rig 'dzin tshogs kyis bskor ba: bar gyi cha la padma nyi zla baṃ ro'i steng du:

dpal chen che mchog he ru ka la: rgyud sde bzhi yi yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor ba: g.yas su padma nyi zla ro yi steng du: khrag 'thung legs ldan nag po la chos skyong pho rgyud kyis bskor ba: g.yon du padma nyi zla ro yi steng du: sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi la: chos skyong mo rgyud kyis bskor ba: rgyab tu rin chen padma nyi zla'i steng du: rgyal chen dzam lha dmar po la: nor lha dbang sdud 'bum gyis bskor ba: mdun du padma nyi zla ro yi steng du: zhing skyong dpal 'bar stobs ldan la: gter bdag gter srung pho nyas bskor ba: 'og gi cha la lha srin sde brgyad sde dpon dgu la: snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre'i tshogs kyis bskor ba: de yi phyi rol du rigs drug snying rje'i mgron gyis bskor ba: de yi phyi rol du lan chags bgegs rigs mgron gyis bskor ba: de yi phyi rol du khas zhan dbang chung ming nas ma smos pa rnams kyis bskor bar gyur: de ltar gsal ba'i rang rang gi gnas lnga nas 'od zer 'phros pas: bsang mgron rnams spyan drangs badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ rol mo bya zhing dbyangs snyan po dang bcas pas: hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub bde chen pho brang nas: kun bzang chos sku'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: sna tshogs sgyu ma'i cho rol pho brang nas: sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs bcas gshegs su gsol: ma 'gags dbyings rig zang thal pho brang nas: yum chen phar phyin tshogs bcas gshegs su gsol: mos blos dga' tshal der ston pho brang nas: dge 'dun 'phags mchog 'dus sde gshegs su gsol: mkha' dbyings padma brtsegs pa'i pho brang nas: sku gsum rig 'dzin lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: drag po mthing nag e yi pho brang nas: yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: che btsan stobs bcu ldan pa'i pho brang nas: pho rgyud chos skyong lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: snang srid las la 'gyed pa'i pho brang nas:

mo rgyud mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: longs spyod yid 'ong gter gyi pho brang nas: nor bdag dzam lha 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: khrag zhag rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i pho brang nas: dam can gter bdag pho nya gshegs su gsol: gling bzhi stong gsum yangs pa'i pho brang nas: dregs sde yul lha gzhi bdag gshegs su gsol: 'khor 'das ro gcig snying rje'i pho brang nas: rigs drug bgegs rigs lan chags gshegs su gsol: snod bcud phyi nang bral ba'i pho brang nas: gdul bya srid par grub rnams gshegs su gsol: badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes rol mo bya: de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: seng khri padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: mchog gsum sku gsum lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol: padma nyi zla baṃ ro'i gdan steng du: rtsa gsum bka' srung lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol: sna tshogs rang rang yid 'ong mdzes pa'i gdan: srid pa chags pa'i mgron rnams bzhugs su gsol: oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: phyi nang gi rdzas mchod bsang nang du mchod cing : hūm̐: mchog gsum dkon mchog rin chen la: 'dod yon bsang mchod sna tshogs 'bul: sku gsum dam tshig nyams pa bshags: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: 'dod yon bsang mchod sna tshogs 'bul: sgo gsum bag med dam 'gal bshags: srid gsum stong gi dregs sde la: 'dod yon bsang mchod sna tshogs 'bul: phyi nang bar chad bzlog tu gsol: 'byung 'jug snod kyi gzhi bdag la: 'dod yon bsang mchod sna tshogs 'bul: phog thug 'gram 'khrug zhi bar mdzod: pha ma rigs drug bgegs rigs la: 'dod yon bsang mchod sna tshogs 'bul: tshe rabs lan chags 'khor gyur cig: dbang chung khas zhan mgron rigs la: 'dod yon bsang mchod sna tshogs 'bul: longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod ldan shog: oṃ badzra arghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐:

oṃ badzra puṣpe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra dhū pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra ā lo ke pū dza me gha sa mu dra sa spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra gandhe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra nai wi dye pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra shabda pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra rū pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra shabda pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra gandhai pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra rā sa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra sparshe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: zhes rol mo dang bcas mchod: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings sgyu ma'i ngang tshul can: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la bstod: ma 'gags thugs rje'i lcags kyu can: mchog gsum brgyud pa'i tshogs la bstod: phrin las gzi byin rdzu 'phrul can: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor tshogs la bstod: snod bcud stong 'dzin dbang bsgyur ba: dregs sde skyong ba'i tshogs la bstod: 'khor 'das snying rjes skyong phyir du: pha ma rigs drug kun la bstod: ces bstod cing thams cad dgyes par bsam: de nas sreg mchod bsang sbyang gi 'byung khungs bstan pa ni: kyaiḥ bsang gi rgyu byung gang nas byung : bsang byung stong nyid mkha' nas byung : ma rig nyon mongs sems can la: dug lnga'i 'dzin pas bcings pa'i tshe: thog ma'i chos sku kun bzang gis: stong nyid e yi me hom du: ro gcig lta ba'i bsang shing brtsegs: ye shes lnga yi rang me sbar: thabs shes bdai stong mchod pa bsregs:

tshogs drug rang shar mgron la sbyin: bzang ngan 'dzin pa'i dri za tshims: stong nyid bcu drug bsang dud kyis: gnyis 'dzin nyon mongs ka nas dag: zang thal chos dbyings ngang la grol: de bzhin de ring bsang gis mchod: kyaiḥ de nas bsang byung gang nas byung : bsang byung khrag 'thung dbyings nas byung : lha dang lha min 'thab pa'i tshe: 'khon grib dme ba'i bag chags 'phros: ye shes 'jig rten nyams pa'i tshe: che mchog khrag 'thung he ru kas: rang gsal chos 'byung me hom du: khregs chod gshis lugs bsang shing brtsegs: shes rab rang gsal sgron me sbar: zung 'jug bden gnyis rdzas bsregs nas: sna tshogs sgyu ma'i mgron la sbyin: 'khor 'das phye ba'i stong gzugs tshims: dbyings rig rdzu 'phrul bsang dud kyis: phyi nang bag sgrib ye nas grol: mchod yul sbyin mkhan ye nas stong : de bzhin de ring bsang gis mchod: kyaiḥ de nas bsang byung gang nas byung : bsang byung rten 'brel rgyu las byung : srid pa dang po ming sring gnyis: rim gyis bag chags brtsegs pa las: lus nyams ma rmos lo tog rnying : bzang ngan las kyi lha 'dre 'khrugs: mun gling gyur cing sdug bsngal tshe: mang bkur chos kyi rgyal po yis: rten 'brel thabs kyi dkyil 'khor bris: dpag bsam shing gi lo ma brtsegs: rdzas sbyor srid pa'i me sbar nas: 'dod yon sna tshogs mchod pa bsregs: bzang ngan lha 'dre'i mgron la sbyin: srid par bsdus pa'i dregs pa tshims: dpag bsam byang chub bsang dud kyis: ming sring 'khrig pa'i mnol grib bsangs: 'bru bcud rgyas shing nyi zla gsal: de bzhin de ring bsang gis mchod: kyaiḥ de nas bsang byung gang nas byung : bsang byung rgya gar yul nas byung : rgya gar chos nub mu stegs chags: mtha' 'khob bye ma'i gling du gyur: dbyings bzhugs sangs rgyas thugs yang skyo: mi rnams phal cher srin por gyur: bdud dbang rkyen stobs che ba'i tshe:

bstan gnyis gtso bo shāka thub kyis: sa sna dgu yi dkyil 'khor bris: tsandan dkar dmar lo ma brtsegs: rten 'brel thabs shes me sbar te: sman spos dri zhim dkar gsum bsregs: smon lam las grub lha 'drer sbyin: las stobs bsgyur ba'i 'byung po tshims: tsandan dri zhim bsang dud kyis: ma rungs bdud kyi las stobs zhi: mdo sngags chos kyi sgron me sbar: de bzhin de ring bsang gis mchod: kyaiḥ de nas bsang byung gang nas byung : bsang byung bod kyi yul nas byung : btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis: bsam yas lha khang bzhengs pa'i tshe: bdud blon rnams kyis bsam ngan 'chang : lha 'dre 'byung pos cho 'phrul btang : rtsig pa nyin brtsegs mtshan mor bshig: gtsug lag bshol du thug pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas kyis: rin chen phye mas dkyil 'khor gdab: shing sna dgu yi lo ma brtsegs: mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul rang me sbar: ro mchog 'dod yon sna tshogs bsregs: ye shes 'jig rten mgron la sbyin: 'byung po lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul rnams: brngan dang dri zhim bsang dud kyis: mgron rnams dgyes shing bdud blon zhi: bsam yas lhun grub chos 'khor bskor: de bzhin de ring bsang gis mchod: brngan no ye shes 'jig rten brngan: sngon tshe rten 'brel phun tshogs bzhin: de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: bkra shis dge legs sgrub pa la: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas bsang gzhung gtong ba ni: rol mo gdangs dbyangs snyan po dang bcas nas: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'chi med bdud rtsi yid 'ong lha yi bsang : dri zhim ngad pa mdangs ldan kyi li li: 'dod yon ro mchog gsur dud thu lu lu: g.yu dud sngon po sprin ltar thibs se thib: nyon mongs bsregs pa'i me zhags 'u ru ru: me dud mdangs ldan 'od zer re re la: mchod sprin lha mo grangs med zlos gar rtse: mchod byed sgeg mo lang ling bar snang gang :

steng na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas spungs se spung : bar snang bla ma rig 'dzin thibs se thib: yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs ya la la: ma sring mkha' 'gros gar byed shigs se shig: chos skyong dam can pho nya sha ra ra: nor lha gter bdag longs spyod kyi li li: yul lha gzhi bdag bzhad gad lhangs se lhang : rigs drug bgegs rigs dga' bro ya la la: phyi nang mgron kun mnyes tshim dgyes pa'i rdzas: 'dod rgu phun tshogs sprin phung bsang mchod kyis: ye shes 'jig rten mgron rnams bsang bar bgyi: dge legs bkra shis phun tshogs stsal du gsol: hūm̐: chos sku kun tu bzang po bsangs: snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur ba bsangs: thog ma'i sangs rgyas rigs lnga bsangs: drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen bsangs: ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' bsangs: bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa bsangs: ston pa phyag na rdo rje bsangs: byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bsangs: dgongs brgyud rig 'dzin rnam gsum bsangs: brda brgyud theg pa rim dgu bsangs: yum chen shes rab phar phyin bsangs: bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med bsangs: rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas bsangs: bka' brgyad rig 'dzin brgyad rnams bsangs: rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga bsangs: tshig brgyud shog ser gter brgyud bsangs: rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad bsangs: hūm̐: che mchog he ru ka pa bsangs: zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bsangs: 'bar ba khrag 'thung lnga bcu bsangs: badzra he ru ka pa bsangs: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs bsangs: bcom ldan khro rgyal gshin rje bsangs: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs bsangs: dbang chen khro rgyal rta mgrin bsangs: padma gsung gi lha tshogs bsangs: sras mchog rdo rje gzhon nu bsangs: phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs bsangs: bla med he ru ka pa bsangs: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs bsangs: yi dam gu ru drag po bsangs: go cha khro bcu'i lha tshogs bsangs: bcom ldan dregs pa kun 'dul bsangs:
