'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs bsangs: khrag 'thung stobs ldan nag po bsangs: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs bsangs: legs ldan ma hā kā la bsangs: chos skyong pho rgyud thams cad bsangs: mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong can bsangs: ma sring bye ba 'bum phrag bsangs: sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi bsangs: chos skyong mo rgyud thams cad bsangs: dbang sdud dzam lha dmar po bsangs: longs spyod nor lha thams cad bsangs: zhing skyong dpal 'bar stobs ldan bsangs: las mgon bya rog gdong can bsangs: khyab mjug gza' mchog mgo dgu bsangs: btsan rgod rdo rje legs pa bsangs: snying srung mkha' 'gro sde lnga bsangs: gter srung myur mgyogs thams cad bsangs: sde brgyad dam la gnas pa bsangs: sngags bdag dregs chen bco brgyad bsangs: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu bsangs: bka' gter srung ma yongs rdzogs bsangs: hūm̐: chos dbyings klong gis khyab pa bsangs: longs sku rtsal las 'gyu ba bsangs: sprul sku sna tshogs cho 'phrul bsangs: zhing skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: sngags skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: mngal skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: lhan skyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: nye zhing dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: gnas chen dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: nye gnas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: yul chen dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: nye yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: 'thung spyod dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: 'du ba'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: tshandho'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: nye tshan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: ra la'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: nye ba'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs: gnas yul zhing skyong mkha' 'gro bsangs: ma gcig rdo rje phag mo bsangs: khrag 'thung mkha' 'gro sde lnga bsangs: sha za ḍākki 'bum phrag bsangs: las byed sman mo 'bum phrag bsangs: hūm̐: lha chen brgyad po 'khor bcas bsangs: klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas bsangs: gza' chen brgyad po 'khor bcas bsangs:

rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad bsangs: gdong mo brgyad po 'khor bcas bsangs: 'gyu ba bcu gnyis 'khor bcas bsangs: phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor bcas bsangs: rgyal chen sde bzhi 'khor bcas bsangs: sde dpon brgyad po 'khor bcas bsangs: sa bdag rtsa gnyis 'khor bcas bsangs: lo zla zhag dus 'khor bcas bsangs: phyi nang lha srin sde brgyad bsangs: rtag chags yul skyong sde brgyad bsangs: yang gsang drag sngags sde brgyad bsangs: bod khams brtan ma bcu gnyis bsangs: skyong ma ya ma bcu gnyis bsangs: srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu bsangs: rje yi mgul lha bcu gsum bsangs: 'bangs kyi srog lha bcu gsum bsangs: skyes lha che btsan bcu gsum bsangs: yul lha zo dor thams cad bsangs: gangs gnyan nyi shu rtsa gcig bsangs: sbas pa'i g.yu mtsho rtsa bdun bsangs: sgrub gnas chen po brgya rtsa bsangs: dben ri sbas gnas gzhi bdag bsangs: gter gnas sgrub gnas gzhi bdag bsangs: gzhi lam byes gsum gzhi bdag bsangs: g.ya' gangs tshal gyi gzhi bdag bsangs: chu brag shing spang gzhi bdag bsangs: yul 'di'i gzhi bdag zo dor bsangs: mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon gzhi bdag bsangs: stong gsum snod kyi gzhi bdag bsangs: 'dzam bu gling gi zo dor bsangs: kyaiḥ rgya gar gling bzhi'i gzhi bdag bsangs: li bal kha che'i gzhi bdag bsangs: tho gar zhang zhung gzhi bdag bsangs: dur khrod brgyad kyi gzhi bdag bsangs: dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i gzhi bdag bsangs: mdo khams sgang drug gzhi bdag bsangs: rgya nag yul bcu'i gzhi bdag bsangs: lho rgyal bod kyi gzhi bdag bsangs: chung ngu ming nas ma smos pa'i: khas zhan dbang chung gzhi bdag bsangs: rigs drug lan chags bgegs rigs bsangs: srid rtse mnar med yan chad rnams: thams cad chos nyid ngang du bsangs: rnam rtog chos sku'i ngang du bsangs: 'khor ba mya ngan 'das par bsangs: sems can sangs rgyas ngang du bsangs: dug lnga ye shes lnga ru bsangs: gang shar 'dzin med klong du bsangs:

lha 'dre sems kyi cho 'phrul bsangs: re dogs snang ba'i bag chags bsangs: rgyu 'bras blo yi bye brag bsangs: hūm̐: rang rig sangs rgyas stong rtsa bsangs: grags stong chos kyi rang mdangs bsangs: ma yengs dran pa'i dge 'dun bsangs: lta ba gtad med ye grol bsangs: sgom pa rang shar bzo med bsangs: spyod pa rgya yan lhug bzhag bsangs: kun gzhi 'khor 'das ro gcig bsangs: lam mchog ma 'gags zang thal bsangs: 'bras bu khregs chod ka dag bsangs: dbu ma rtsa yi sgron me bsangs: sgra gcan rlung gi 'khor lo bsangs: srog 'dzin sems kyi thig le bsangs: kun gzhi ma bcos lhun grub bsangs: stong pa ye nas sangs rgyas bsangs: rgyu 'bras bden med shes pa bsangs: ngo bo gsal la 'dzin med bsangs: rang bzhin stong la ma 'gags bsangs: thugs rje 'dzin med sprul sku bsangs: gang 'dul der ston ngang la bsangs: bla med bsang mchod 'di bgyis pas: thams cad chos nyid klong du grol: kun kyang ye shes reg gyur cig: skabs 'dir 'dzam gling spyi bsang 'dzud kyang rung : de nas dgra lha'i dpang bstod bya ba ni go mtshon sna tshogs bsgrengs shing : hūm̐: dang po dgra lha gang nas byung : sngon tshe bskal pa'i dang po la: srid pa ye thog chags pa'i tshe: thabs shes sgong bu dkar dmar srid: rgyas pa ri rab rtse ru bzhag: dbang chen khro rgyal rta mgrin gyis: drag po'i ngang la bcag pa'i tshe: dgra lha ma sang mched dgu byung : rtsal ldan go khrab lus la rdzogs: rno ba'i mtshon cha lag na thogs: mgyogs pa'i rlung gshog 'og na chibs: ma thogs gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: hūm̐: dkar po dung khrab gyon pa 'bum: zhi ba lha yi dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: ser po gser khrab gyon pa 'bum: rgyas pa gnyan gyi dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon:

sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: dmar po bswe khrab gyon pa 'bum: drag po btsan gyi dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol gsol lha gsol lo: hūm̐: ljang khu g.yu khrab gyon pa 'bum: ki kang bza' bdud dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: sngon po mthing khrab gyon pa 'bum: glen pa klu yi dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: smug po mchong khrab gyon pa 'bum: dmu bdud srid pa'i dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: 'od ldan zangs khrab gyon pa 'bum: bshan pa pho nya'i dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: nag po lcags khrab gyon pa 'bum: rngam pa bdud kyi dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: gnam lcags go khrab gyon pa 'bum: lus la 'khor ba'i dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: rdo rje'i go khrab gyon pa 'bum: srog skyob brtan pa'i dgra lha yin: de ring dgra lha rten la byon: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang :

chos skyong dam can gter gyi bdag: sde brgyad dgra lha'i tshogs bcas pa: bsang mchod gser skyems 'di 'bul lo: de ring go cha'i rten btsugs bzhin: dgra lha mi dang ma 'bral cig: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas dgra lha bstod cing bsngags pa ni: hūm̐: dgra lha'i rten mkhar gang nas byung : dgra lha'i rten mkhar dbyings nas byung : ma sang rdo rje legs pa dang : ki kang khyab 'jug nag po yis: nam mkha'i dbyings nas mgar bzo brgyab: rang byung rdo rje'i go khrab brdungs: sngags bdag ma mo'i byin gyis brlabs: slob dpon phyag tu phul ba las: srid pa rdo rje'i go khrab gyur: chos skyong pho nya'i rten du bkod: dgra lha bkod cing rdzu 'phrul 'gyed: pha rol dgra bo cham la phob: sngon tshe go khrab de bzhin du: de ring dgra lha 'di ltar bkod: hūm̐: rmog la dgra lha bkod pa ni: rmog mo shar gyi byang bu la: zhi ba chos sku'i dgra lha bkod: rmog mo lho yi byang bu la: rgyas pa longs sku'i dgra lha bkod: rmog mo nub kyi byang bu la: sprul sku dbang gi dgra lha bkod: rmog mo byang gi byang bu la: sku gsum drag po'i dgra lha bkod: ru dar phrin las lnga ldan la: bla ma yi dam dgra lha bkod: bya sgro khyung ru rngam chen la: mkha' 'gro dam can dgra lha bkod: rmog dkris 'od zer sna lnga la: rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dgra lha bkod: rmog zhol dkar mo leb chen la: chos skyong gter srung dgra lha bkod: rmog rgyan rdo rje'i kheb chen la: pha rol rgol 'joms dgra lha bkod: de ltar dgra lha rten btsugs bzhin: de ring rmog gi kha la bzhugs: dgra lha gnyan po dpa' mkhar bstod: srog skyob rdzong btsan mnga' gsol lo: bsang mchod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: dgra lha bdag dang ma 'bral cig: sang nas dgra lha dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐:

khrab la dgra lha bkod pa ni: stod kheb dkar mo 'khyil chen la: pho lha gnyan gyi dgra lha bkod: lag mdung mu tig 'dzum yag la: skyes lha gnyan gyi dgra lha bkod: sen kheb sngon mo lag ring la: yul lha gnyan gyi dgra lha bkod: mdun sham rdo rje 'od ldan la: dpa' rtsal gyad kyi dgra lha bkod: rgyab sham dkar mo byang ring la: zhang lha gnyan gyi dgra lha bkod: sham bu sna tshogs mdzes rgyan la: myur mgyogs rtsal gyi dgra lha bkod: dkar sham sra mkhregs pha lam la: lam lha gnyan gyi dgra lha bkod: de ltar dgra lha rten btsugs bzhin: de ring khrab kyi mkha' la bzhugs: dgra lha gnyan po dpa' mkhar bstod: srog skyob rdzong chen mnga' gsol lo: bsang mchod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: dgra lha bdag dang ma 'bral cig: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: mtshon la dgra lha bkod pa ni: g.yas shag gsal ba 'od ldan la: myur mgyogs btsan gyi dgra lha bkod: ral gri dgra srog gcod byed la: drag rtsal bdud kyi dgra lha bkod: mdung ring thog rgod 'khyugs yag la: khram thogs gshin rje'i dgra lha bkod: rtse mo phur bu 'dril 'debs la: shan pa dmar nag dgra lha bkod: mda' mo sgra gcan 'gyu byed la: ki kang gza' bdud dgra lha bkod: gzhu mo rdo rje'i 'chang ldan la: dam can legs rtsal dgra lha bkod: gzhu breng 'khyug mau dril chen la: sngags srung ma mo'i dgra lha bkod: de ltar dgra lha'i rten btsugs bzhin: de ring mtshon cha'i mkha' la bzhugs: dgra lha gnyan po dpa' mkhar bstod: dgra srog gcod par mnga' gsol lo: bsang mchod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: dgra lha bdag dang ma 'bral cig: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: phub la dgra lha bkod pa ni: phub mo shar gyi gling khams la: dkar po lha yi dgra lha bkod:

phub mo lho yi gling khams la: shel ging dkar po'i dgra lha bkod: phub mo nub kyi gling khams la: yaksha gnod sbyin dgra lha bkod: phub mo byang gi gling khams la: sngon po klu yi dgra lha bkod: phub mo dbus kyi gling khams la: drag rtsal skyob pa'i dgra lha bkod: drag po'i rnga zhol dmar nag la: srog skyob srung ba'i dgra lha bkod: de ltar dgra lha rten btsugs bzhin: de ring phub kyi mkha' la bzhugs: dgra lha gnyan po dpa' mkhar bstod: srog skyob rdzong chen mnga' gsol lo: bsang mchod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: dgra lha bdag dang ma 'bral cig: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: mi la dgra lha bkod pa ni: spyi bo bde chen pho brang na: 'jam dpal sku yi dgra lha bkod: mgrin pa longs spyod pho brang na: padma gsung gi dgra lha bkod: snying kha chos kyi pho brang na: phyag rdor thugs kyi dgra lha bkod: lte ba sprul pa'i pho brang na: yon tan khro mo'i dgra lha bkod: gsang gnas bde skyong pho brang na: phrin las phur pa'i dgra lha bkod: g.yas pa thabs kyi lag pa la: za byed pha bcu'i dgra lha bkod: g.yon pa shes rab lag pa la: gsod byed ma bcu'i dgra lha bkod: rkang g.yas rdzu 'phrul gyad chen la: las mkhan pho rgyud dgra lha bkod: rkang g.yon myur mgyogs shugs ldan la: pho nya mo rgyud dgra lha bkod: phyi nang gzugs kyi cha gnas su: zhi khro'i lha tshogs bye ba bkod: de ltar dgra lha rten btsugs bzhin: de ring rnal 'byor lus la bzhugs: dgra lha gnyan po dpa' mkhar bstod: srog lha bdag skyob mnga' gsol lo: bsang mchod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: dgra lha bdag dang ma 'bral cig: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: rta la dgra lha bkod pa ni: mgo bo g.yu 'brug rngam yag la:

dbu 'phang mtho ba'i dgra lha bkod: rngog gzhol le brgan 'bar ba la: seng stag 'brug gi dgra lha bkod: sgal rgyud rin chen phreng ba la: sra mkhregs rdo rje'i dgra lha bkod: mjug ma dug sbrul 'khyug chen la: sgab 'dre tshar gcod dgra lha bkod: rkang bzhi rngam pa ling chen la: rtsal ldan myur mgyogs dgra lha bkod: sga stan nyi zla 'ja' ris la: rten 'brel rdzas kyi dgra lha bkod: rta mgo rdo rje'i go khrab la: srog skyob mi shigs dgra lha bkod: de ltar dgra lha rten btsugs bzhin: de ring rta yi srung la bzhugs: dgra lha gnyan po'i dpa' mkhar bstod: myur mgyogs shugs ldan mnga' gsol lo: bsang mchod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: dgra lha bdag dang ma 'bral cig: sang nas dgra la dmag 'dren no: nyes can dgra bo cham la phob: gsol lo gsol lo lha gsol lo: hūm̐: 'bru rigs srid pa'i dgra lha bsangs: gdong rigs srid pa'i dgra lha bsangs: sga rigs srid pa'i dgra lha bsangs: dbra rigs srid pa'i dgra lha bsangs: pha lha gnyen gyi dgra lha bsangs: ma lha gnyen gyi dgra lha bsangs: 'phrag lha gnyen gyi dgra lha bsangs: yul lha gnyen gyi dgra lha bsangs: skyes lha gnyen gyi dgra lha bsangs: srog lha gnyen gyi dgra lha bsangs: byes lam gzhi yi dgra lha bsangs: bsang ngo gsol lo phrin las mdzod: de nas dgra lha'i gtor ma bsang nang du 'bul lam gtsang sar bskyal: hūm̐: dgra lha chen po mthu stobs dbang : gzi byin stobs kyi bdag po rnams: mchod bstod gser skyems 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: kha 'dzin sdongs grogs rgyab rten mdzod: dpung gnyen bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: dmag 'dren dus yin na: go khrab la bstims te gshegs gsol mi bya: kha rog bde gsol dal skabs dpa' mkhar bstod pa yin na bsang gi cho ga bsdus te rang sar bsdu:

de nas brngan bya ba ni: gser skyems mchod cing shel tshig khri dkar yang gtor: hūm̐: nga ni rig 'dzin thod phreng rtsal: ye shes 'jig rten mgron gyi tshogs: dga' mgu legs pa'i yid kyis nyon: bkra shis dge legs stsol ba'i phyir: rten 'brel longs spyod rgyan gyis brngan: so so'i yid 'thad sna tshogs 'bul: hūm̐: chos sku kun tu bzang po la: phyag 'tshal ting 'dzin lta bas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas stong phrag la: rang byung ye shes lnga yis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: yum chen rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag la: lta ba klong yangs shugs kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: dga' rab rig 'dzin rnam gsum la: ma 'gags sna tshogs zer gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: shāka thub byang sems gnas bcu la: stong nyid bcu drug ldan pas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: pad 'byung rig 'dzin rnam dgu la: rang rig mngon gyur shes pas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: che mchog zhi khro rab 'byams la: sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rtsal gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs la: bskyed rim snang stong gzugs kyis brngan: 'dod yon bsang mchod sna tshogs 'bul: padma gsung gi lha tshogs la: grags stong sngags kyi bzlas pas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs la: ting 'dzin ma 'gags rtsal gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs la: las bzhi lhun grub rdzas kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs la: dkyil 'khor rang byung rdzas kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs la: rang byung bsod nams tshogs kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs la:

dug lnga bsgral ba'i mchod pas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: yi dam dmar nag me phreng la: rtse gcig sgrub pa'i dam bcas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: khrag 'thung legs ldan nag po la: bya nag g.yag nag lug gis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: chos skyong pho rgyud thams cad la: dgra bgegs klad khrag sha yis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: sngags bdag ma mo ral gcig la: dgra bo'i don snying dbang pos brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: chos skyong mo rgyud thams cad la: sha khrag ba liṃ brgyan gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: gnod sbyin dzam lha dmar po la: rgyal srid rin chen bdun gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: dpal 'bar zhing skyong mgon po la: gri rgod snying dang gtor mas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: srog bdag bya rog ming can la: 'bru nag bshos bu sha yis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: gter srung dam can yongs rdzogs la: dgra sha khrag mchod phud kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: bla med dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: spyan gzigs rdzas dang rol mos brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: bskang rdzas mchod rdzas sgrub rdzas kyi: brngan mchod 'bul zhing thugs dam bskang : dam tshig nyams pa bsal du gsol: hūm̐: tshangs pa gser gyi 'khor los brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: lha min go khrab gri yis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: gza' rnams snying dang gtor mas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: gshin rje shwa khram rgyan gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: ma mo me long dar snas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: bdud rnams rta nag khyi yis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: btsan rnams glo snying khrag gis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul:

rgyal po za 'og gos kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: gnod sbyin g.yag nag stag gis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: klu bdud sbal sbrul sman gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: dri za dri dang gsur gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: grul bum nam mkha' rgyang bus brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: me lha 'bru mar til gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: srin po sha khrag gtor mas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: rlung lha ba dan mdung gis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: dbang ldan chu glang ma hes brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: bgegs rgyal changs bu glud kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: 'byung po sna tshogs dud pas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: sa bdag gser dngul phye mas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: brtan ma bum pa gtor mas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: dmu rnams gcan gzan tshogs kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: ma sang go khrab rgyan gyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: sman mo shwa ba ri dwags brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: mgul lha sna tshogs mchod pas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: zo dor yid mthun gtor mas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: yul lha dkar gtor phud kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: mkhar lha rgyal mtshan tog gis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: khyim lha 'bru bcud gtor mas brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: me lha mda' dar phud kyis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: yul skyong gser mkhar bsang gis brngan: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: hūm̐: stong gsum gzhi bdag thams cad kun: rang rang 'dod pa'i rdzas kyis brngan:

rigs drug lan chags bgegs rigs rnams: sbyin sreg 'dod yon rdzas kyis brngan: rgyal brngan mchod pas dgyes gyur nas: phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad sol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas brtan ma'i gtor ma bsang nang du 'bul: gzhi mtshams su 'bul na lha bswo bya: hūm̐: yul ni gangs can bod kyi yul: gzho stod ti sgro'i gnas mchog nas: gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma: 'khor ni ye shes mkha' 'gro bzhi: gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni kong yul mthing brag nas: sring gcig rdo rje bod khams skyong : gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: dus 'khrug zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni ma pham g.yu mtsho'i gnas: sring gcig rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong : gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: nad yams zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni bal bod mtshams kyi gnas: sring gcig gangs dkar sha med ma: gser skyems phud dang gtor ma brngan: sad ser zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni gnam mtsho phyug mo ru: sring gcig 'brog chen 'khor 'dus ma: gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: nor gyi g.yang nyams zhi bar mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni brag dmar mchims phu ru: sring gcig rdo rje g.yu bun ma: gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: bod khams bde ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni sbas lung yar 'brog mtsho: sring gcig kha rag khyung btsun ma: gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: zab chos rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni tsha shod rong bzhi ru: sring gcig rdo rje klu mo rgyal: gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: gangs can srung ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni bal yul shel phug tu: sring gcig rdo rje drag mo rgyal: gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: rin chen gter gyi srung ma mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni ri bo ma la'i shar:

sring gcig btsan gyi sman gcig ma: gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: phyi nang bar chad zhi bar mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni na len shing gcig drung : sring gcig ug chos g.yar mo sil: gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: dgra bgegs tshar gcod phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: yul ni rdo rje brag dmar na: sring gcig dril bu si le ma: gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: khams sum dbang sdud phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: skye mched bcu gnyis gnas 'dzin ma: lo skor bcu gnyis skyong mdzad ma: dus tshod bcu gnyis mnga' sgyur ma: don la rnal 'byor bcu gnyis te: dam tshig can gyi tshogs khang nyul: dus drug nyul le bcu gnyis ma: gser skyems phud dang gtor mas brngan: phyi yi snang ba dbang du sdud: nang gi rtsa rlung ljon shing skyed: bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs spel: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gser skyems 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: de nas brngan 'bul ba ni: gser skyems dang bcas gtsang ma'i ri zhig tu bskyal lo: hūm̐: nga ni rig 'dzin padma 'byung : nga ni dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso: nga ni mkha' 'gro kun gyi yab: nga ni dpa' bo kun gyi rje: mchog gsum rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i gtso: ye shes 'jig rten mgron rnams kun: bden gnyis dkon mchog bka' la nyon: de ring sna tshogs brngan gyis mchod: kun tshang ya mtshan 'di ltar ro: hūm̐: dar tshon 'ja' gur kyi li li: mchog gsum lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul: dkar rgyan gzi 'bar ta la la: rtsa gsum lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul: ba liṃ brjid chags ye re re: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul: dpal gtor bshos bu hrangs se hrang : 'jig rten dregs sde mnyes phyir 'bul: dkar mngar sman sna chi li li: phyi rgyud dkar phyogs mnyes phyir 'bul: sha khrag rgya mtsho me re re: nag phyogs dregs pa mnyes phyir 'bul: go mtshon ru dar lhabs se lhab:

chos skyong dgra lha mnyes phyir 'bul: bkra shis rdzas rtags spungs se spung : nor lha gter bdag mnyes phyir 'bul: 'dab chags gshog 'gyur lings se ling : phyi rgyud gzhi bdag mnyes phyir 'bul: g.yag nag ngar sgra khra la la: pho rgyud chos skyong dgyes phyir 'bul: lug dkar 'ba' sgra di ri ri: yul lha sa srung tshogs la 'bul: ra skyes sbrid pa sha ra ra: the'u rang dam can tshogs la 'bul: gyi ling rta skad tse re re: ma sang g.ya' spang tshogs la 'bul: ri dwags gar rtsed khyugs se khyug: zo dor gnyan po'i tshogs la 'bul: gcan spyang ngar skad 'u ru ru: 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs la 'bul: changs bu gtor ma nyi li li: rigs drug lan chags bgegs la 'bul: hūm̐: phyi nang mchod pa sna tshogs dang : spyan gzigs brngan mchod dpag med 'dis: ye shes 'jig rten la sogs pa: srid pa'i rtse mo man chod dang : na rag dmyal khams yan chod kyi: srid par chags pa'i lha 'drer 'bul: so so'i mnyes pa'i 'dod yon tshogs: zad med nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam: yid mthun mchod pa sna tshogs kyis: stong gsum 'dzam gling sa bdag brngan: mthun rdzas 'dod rgu 'di 'bul gyis: rten 'brel legs pa'i yon tan spel: shi ba yod na bslang du gsol: na ba yod na gso bar mdzod: gas pa yod na srub tu sbyor: chad pa yod na mthud du gsol: bla med dkyil 'khor dam tshig bskang : yi dam rgyud sde'i bka' chad bshags: chos skyong rnams kyi 'khu ldog khrol: yul lha gzhi bdag phog thug zhi: rigs drug lan chags bu lon 'khor: tshe rabs mi dge'i sha 'khon byang : dus 'khrug mtshon cha'i bskal pa nyams: nad rims dal yams ngan pa chod: yul 'dir bkra shis phun sum tshogs: 'jig rten lo phyug rtag tu legs: char chu dus 'bebs bskal pa bzang : hūm̐: lha dang phyi rgyud srung ma kun: dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: phyi nang bar chad zhi ba dang :

rnal 'byor bdag gi kha 'dzin mdzod: nyin gsum nyin gyi bya ra dang : mtshan gsum mtshan gyi mel tshe gyis: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: sngon tshe kun bzang che mchog bka': bar du khro rgyal 'dus pa'i lung : rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas la: bsam yas mchims phu'i ke'u tshang du: khyed rnams srog snying phul ba bzhin: tha tshig gnyan po dran par gyis: khas blangs dam bca' ma 'da' bar: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srung : rig 'dzin bdag gi grogs dan sgrubs: zab chos snying gi thig le 'di: phyogs bcur spel ba'i sdong grogs mdzod: rnal 'byor bdag gi bcol ba'i las: deng 'dir 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ sarba dharmā swa bhā he kha kha khā hi: oṃ sarba nā tha swa bhā he kha kha khā hi: oṃ sarba lo ka swa bhā he kha kha khā hi: oṃ sarba dharma pā la ya kha kha khā hi: oṃ sarba kṣe ṭa pā la ya kha kha khā hi: oṃ sarba lo ka pā la ta ya kha kha khā hi: oṃ bhū mi pa ti ya kha kha khā hi: oṃ sarba lau ka pā la ya kha kha khā hi: oṃ āḥhūm̐ pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye kha kha khā hi: zhes phul: de nas chos skyong spyi yi gtor ma ni: byin gyis brlabs la kha bsngo bya: de nas 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong : gru gsum e yi klong dkyil nas: legs ldan nag po phyag bzhi pa: rdzu 'phrul dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung du gsol: rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung gnyen mdzod: bstan dgra dam nyams cham la phob: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ka ra tsa tur ya kā li dhe wi sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas mchog nas: srog bdag las mgon bya rog gdong : rdzu 'phrul nam mkha'i dbyings nas bzhengs: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: zab gter gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod: sngon gyi tha tshig dran par gyis:

brnag pa'i dam nyams dgra bo yi: mgo snying srog rtsa phrol la shog: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma hā kā la he ru ka khā kha mu kha kro ti tsaṇḍi ya bha lingta kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: rngam chen gangs dkar sbas yul nas: stobs ldan zhing skyong seṅge'i gdong : drag rtsal me rlung dbus nas bzhengs: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ka cha dkor nor gnyer du bskos: dus drug srung ba'i mel tshe gyis: pha rol gdug pas sdang gyur na: snying khrag drong zhing don snying bzhes: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma hā kā la singha mu kha si ṇa ra ma kro ti singha mu kha ya i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rba klong nas: ma gza' rdor legs shan pa 'bum: mngon spyod phrin las mdzad phyir bzhengs: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag la dgra byung na: gnyen 'dun yin yang myur du sgrol: brnag pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: byad ma'i yul zhing rten dang phrol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma tri e ka dzā ṭi ki kang rā hu la badzra sa dhu ya bha lingta kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: zangs ri khrag mtsho'i dur khrod nas: btsan rgod rol pa skya bdun rnams: myur mgyogs las la bskul phyir bzhengs: dgra sha khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: btsan dmar dmag-dpung dgra la drongs: ka cha dkor nor 'phrog byed pa'i: dam nyams dgra yi yul du chos: gri thogs shan pa'i dmag dpung skyed: dgra bo mi nor phyags mas thob: reg phung dug mda'i gzer bu rgyob: sngon tshe pad 'byung bka' ma bcag: da lta rig 'dzin dam ma bkral: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ tsa tri shu la tsaṇḍa swa bhā wa ya bha lingta kha kha khā hi: hūm̐: bka' gter dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi: srung ma dam can gter bdag rnams: rang rang mngon rtogs bstan phyir du: dgra sha khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra:

g.yab pa'i tshe na spyan ma rtul: rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung : mngag pa'i tshe na bang ma bul: rig 'dzin bdag gis bskul ba'i tshe: bstan dgra sgos dgra rtsad nas chod: dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: gdug pa'i ru tra myur du sgrol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ sarba dharma pā la ya sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: zhes phrin las bcol zhing skabs 'dir rang lugs chos skyong gzhan rnams kyi gsol ka rgyas bsdus gang rung 'dir 'dzud kyang chog /dgra lha'i gtor 'bul dang brtan ma'i gtor 'bul mthar rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i sogs spyi ltar ro/ de nas mda' dar dang phye mar thogs la g.yang 'gugs pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings bde chen pho brang nas: kun bzang che mchog yab yum gyi: thugs rje rang rgyud smin mdzad pa: de ring 'od gsal g.yang 'gug go: bde chen lhun grub zhing khams nas: yi dam rtsa gsum 'dus pa yi: byin rlabs dngos grub ster mdzad pa: bskyed rdzogs rten 'brel g.yang 'gug go: klong lnga zer phreng pho brang nas: pad 'byung rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshogs: zab chos gter gyi mdzod gling rnams: myur du 'gyed pa'i g.yang 'gug go: mtha' yas gang 'dul pho brang nas: grub thob rjes 'brang 'tshogs pa'i mchog: bka' bab gter la spyod mdzad pa'i: kun 'byung nor bu'i g.yang 'gug go: gzi ldan me yi pho brang nas: chos skyong dam can gter gyi bdag: mthu stobs che btsan myur mgyogs pa: drag rtsal mthu stobs g.yang 'gug go: yid 'ong 'dod rgu'i pho brang nas: dzam lha dbang sdud nor bdag 'bum: snyan grags tshe chos bkrag dang mdangs: longs spyod srid kyi g.yang 'gug go: phyi rgyud rang rang gnas mchog nas: srid pa'i lha 'dre mgron gyi tshogs: lo legs bkra shis 'bru spel ba: 'dod rgu thun mong g.yang 'gug go: rgyun bsang skabs 'di nas 'og gi hūm̐ ye shes 'jig rten la sogs pa'i:
sogs kho nar mdzad srol 'dug

mchan/ hūm̐: brtan pa mtho ba nam mkha'i g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: rgyud 'dzin gsal ba nyi zla'i g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: srid 'phel grangs mang gza' skar g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: snyan grags kun khyab g.yu 'brug skad: de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: dgra lha myur mgyogs glog zhags g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: mthu rtsal stobs ldan thog rgod g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: mdzes rgyan bkrag mdangs 'ja' tshon g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: sna tshogs 'dzin med chu 'dzin g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: zab chos mtha' rgyas bar snang g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: stobs bskyed 'ja' lus rlung gi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: longs spyod rgya chen sa yi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: mi zad kun 'byung chu yi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: rtsal chen 'bar ba me yi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: mi rgyud grangs mang rtsi shing g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: sra mkhregs rdzong btsan lcags kyi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: rta drel nor lug phyugs kyi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: bang ba bcud rgyas 'bru yi g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: yul bzung sa 'dzin rten 'brel g.yang : de ring gnas 'dir g.yang du len: hūm̐: bla ma'i chos g.yang 'dir 'gug go: sde dpon khrims g.yang 'dir 'gug go: phyug po'i phyugs g.yang 'dir 'gug go: 'phan po'i 'phan g.yang 'dir 'gug go: zhing bzang sa g.yang 'dir 'gug go: dpa' bo'i rtsal g.yang 'dir 'gug go: bu 'phel srid g.yang 'dir 'gug go: pha spun gnyen gyi g.yang 'gug go: tsha bo mag pa'i g.yang 'gug go: mna' ma tshur 'ong g.yang 'gug go: bu mo phar 'gro'i g.yang 'gug go: dkor bdag chas kyi g.yang 'gug go:

du ba rtse sprod g.yang 'gug go: gaṅgā chu 'dus g.yang 'gug go: 'gyu ba rlung khyab g.yang 'gug go: khyim mtshes grong gi g.yang 'gug go: sa yul lung pa'i g.yang 'gug go: snang srid kun gyi g.yang 'gug go: hūm̐: ye shes 'jig rten la sogs pa'i: srid pa chags pa'i lha 'dre kun: gser skyems phud mchod 'di bzhes la: phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i pho nyar rbad: 'dzam gling srid pa'i g.yang sdud la: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la stims: sngon gyi tha tshig ma nor bar: phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: g.yang skor de ni kyi li li: phywa skor de ni me re re: srid skor de ni spungs se spung : phywa g.yang char chen tshubs se tshub: gnas 'dir g.yang rten 'dzugs su gsol: brtan par bzhugs shig tiṣṭha lhan: de nas phye mar gyi srung 'dzugs shing bkra shis pa'i tshig kyang brjod: mchod bstod ni/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐: chos dbyings sgyu ma'i ngang tshul can: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la bstod: ma 'gags thugs rje'i lcags kyu can: mchog gsum brgyud pa'i tshogs la bstod: phrin las gzi byin rdzu 'phrul can: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor tshogs la bstod: snod bcud stong 'dzin dbang bsgyur ba: dregs sde skyong ba'i tshogs la bstod: 'khor 'das snying rjes skyong phyir du: pha ma rigs drug kun la bstod: bzod par gsol ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can dang : chos skyong gter bdag gzhi bdag mgron rigs rnams: snying rje brtse ba'i thugs kyis dgongs su gsol: bkra shis bsang mchod cho ga'i rim pa la: chad lhag nor 'khrul 'gal tshab mchis pa dang : rgyu chung phud nyams lhag ma phri ba sogs: dam tshig nyams dang phog thug 'gram pa bshags: bzod par gsol la tshangs par stsal du gsol: oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang :

de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: oṃ: khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad: āḥ rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang : trām̐: sems can rnams kyi don slad du: hrīḥ slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol: oṃ badzra muḥ bsang mgron 'jig rten pa rnams rang rang so so'i gnas su gshegs: zhes nas me lha'i dal du bsang rdzas mchod: hūm̐: ye shes dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang : 'dzin byed me lha 'khor bcas la: sna tshogs mchod pa 'bul gyis bzhes: phyi nang rten 'brel spel la bstod: lhun grub ngang du dgyes par stsol: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ agne raṃ dzwa la pū dza hūm̐: zhes rol mo dang bcas te bstod: nang gi dkyil 'khor ye shes pa dang me lha bsdu ba ni: hoḥ rang byung me yi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: dmigs med chos dbyings stong pa'i ngang la bsdu: sna tshogs spro bsdu rang byung ye shes rtsal: skye med ka dag ngang du āḥl ldang : a a āḥ zhes bsdu'o: bsngo ba smon lam bya ba ni: hoḥ bdag gi bla med bsang mchod bgyis pa yi: sbyin tshogs dpag dka'i zag med dge ba bsngo: mtha' yas 'gro kun byang chub mchog reg nas: skye dang tshe rabs pad 'byung 'grub gyur cig: ces bsngo ba smon lam rgyas pa ci rigs bya'o: de nas bkra shis bya ba ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis kun bzang thog ma'i mgon: rang rig mngon du 'gyur ba'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis rdor sems rigs lnga'i gtso: sprul pas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis rig 'dzin padma 'byung : gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: yi dam bkra shis che mchog he ru kaḥ mi 'bral dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i bkra shis shog: mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis sngags bdag dpal 'bar ma: brgyud 'dzin gter la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog:

chos skyong bkra shis las mgon seṅge'i gdong : bstan dgra bgegs srin tshar gcod bkra shis shog: dam can bkra shis sngags srung rdo rje legs: dam nyams bdud dgra bcom pa'i bkra shis shog: gter srung bkra shis las mgon bya rog gdong : zab chos mkha' ltar rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: gter gnas bkra shis mtsho sman khyung btsun ma: ma yengs bya ra byed pa'i bkra shis shog: gnas mchog bkra shis yar 'brog gangs kyi ri: rten 'brel legs tshogs 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog: yul lha'i bkra shis sbas yul gzhi bdag gnyan: sa steng g.yul 'khrug zhi ba'i bkra shis shog: sbyin bdag bkra shis bde skyid phun sum tshogs: gang bsam thogs med 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: ces bkra shis rgyas bsdus gang rung brjod: bkra shis legs tshogs gong 'phel sgrub: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: bkra shis dge legs lha bsang bzhag: bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi: bsang mchod bgyis pa'i skal ldan rnams: rang byung ye shes chos skur 'char: phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi: bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs: yul gru bkra shis nad yams zhi: lo 'bras phun tshogs mtshon bskal nyams: tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan: yi dam chos skyong dngos grub 'byung : yul lha gzhi bdag 'gram 'khrugs gso: dge legs 'bras bu sna tshogs 'grub: ye shes mtsho rgyas bskul phyir bzhag: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes kyi: skye ba o rgyan gter bdag gling : thugs sras de dang 'phrad par shog: legs ldan mgon po bya rog gdong : zab chos 'di yi mel tshe gyis: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo padma gter bdag gling pas lcags byi lor padma sbas tshal yar 'brog lha yi mtsho chen nas gdan drangs te padma chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas bod yig tu zhal bsgyur ba'o/

zab chos nam mkha'i mthar khyab bkra shis shog/ // tsha) bka' brgyad chen po gsang ba zil gnon las: gsur mchod lha yi longs spyod mdzod bum bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: sbyin sreg me yi mchod pa ni: dri spos sman dang longs spyod zas: bsreg rdzas 'os pa thams cad bsdus: zhib 'thag 'bri mar rgyun kyang byas: me gsur btang ba'i dus skabs ni: tho rangs snga gong dag tu bya: me hom chung ngu'i nang du bsreg: chu gtsang bran zhing 'bru gsum brjod: sku gsung thugs yig gsum gyis spel: byang sems snying rje tshad med bsgom: mgron rnams bya rkang gling bu'i 'bod: 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das kyi: mgron rnams tshim phyir sbyin par bya: sa ma ya: dang po: hūm̐: sku gsum dkon mchog rnam gsum rtsa ba gsum: gzhi lam 'bras bu ngo bo rang bzhin mchog: bde gsal mi rtog thugs la skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa: hūm̐: sems can bde ldan sdug bsngal kun grol zhing : tshad med rnam bzhi'i byang chub lam 'byongs te: ma gyur 'gro ba smon lam dpal zhing rnams: kun kyang bla med 'bras bu thob gyur cig: gsum pa: hūm̐: rang nyid snang stong kun tu bzang po'i sku: mthing kha mnyam bzhag chos sku 'gyur ba med: bzang mo yum 'khyud thabs shes bde chen ngang : snying rje'i zer 'gyed 'gro ba'i dpal du shar: oṃ sa manta bha dra mūm̐ hrīḥswā hā: bzhi pa: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba bi pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā brtā ya ā brtā ya ho a hu ti spha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā: stong pa'i ngang las rang byung me thab ni: kha khyer mu ran dang bcas gsal ba'i dbus: sreg rdzas 'dod yon zag med mchod pa yis: kun bzang lha yi longs spyod lta bur gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hā sa bha dra su ru bhū pa ye swā hā: lnga pa: rang nyid kun bzang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: ye shes 'jig rten mgron rnams spyan drangs gyur:

oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ padma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: drug pa: hūm̐: ye shes lnga yis byin gyis brlabs pa yis: kun bzang thugs kyi sprin las spros pa 'di: chos longs sprul sku sangs rgyas byang sems dang : bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang : dam can nor lha gter bdag 'khor bcas la: 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol: hūm̐: phyogs skyong zhing skyong rgyal chen sde bzhi dang : dregs pa sde brgyad dpal mgon bdun cu lnga: mgul lha brtan ma stong gsum gzhi bdag dang : khyad par yul rir gnas pa'i srung ma la: bsreg rdzas 'bul lo grogs dang rogs dan mdzod: hūm̐: dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' zur phud lnga: lo zla zhag dus rgyu ba'i sa bdag dang : bgegs rigs lan chags 'byung po rigs drug mgron: snga lus bor nas phyi lus ma thob pa'i: rig pa gtad med bar do'i sems can la: sbyin no bsngo'o tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs shog: bdun pa: hoḥ ye shes 'jig rten mgron gyi tshogs: mi dmigs klong yangs shugs 'byung gis: dgongs pa zang thal ngang du gshegs: badzra muḥ brgyad pa: hoḥ bdag gis bla med gsur mchod bgyis pa'i mthus: mgron rnams nam mkha'i mdzod la longs spyod nas: zag med ye shes 'od skur grol bar shog: dgu pa: hoḥ chos dbyings thugs mchog rin po che: ma gyur 'gro ba sems can rnams: byang chub lam mchog rab 'byongs te: rtag tu bde legs bkra shis shog: ces bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab kyang rung : rjes shes mi dmigs ka dag ngang la bzhag: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad 'byung gis: sbyin sreg longs spyod kun ldan bzhag: 'di yi yon tan bsam mi khyab: tshe 'dir bar gcod bdud las grol: phyi ma bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs: yi dam lha yang dam tshig bskangs: mkha' 'gro chos skyong mchod pas dgyes: rigs drug sems can re ba khengs: lan chags bu lon sha 'khon 'khor: bsdus bya phung po'i glud kyang rdzogs:

de bas sbyin pa kun kyis mchog: kha tshang don 'dus sgrub thabs 'di: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal rgyas pa'o/ bkra shis shog/ // dza) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dzam lha dkar phyogs kyi gsur mchod bzhugs so: na mo: theg mchog 'bras bu mngon gyur dkon mchog gsum: longs spyod 'phel phyir gus pas skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun dbul ba'i 'jigs pa rab grol te: dga' chen bsod nams rgya mtsho thob par shog: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: hūm̐: zhi thab dkar po zlum 'khyil mdzes pa'i dbus: dkar gsum bsreg rdzas mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dkar phyogs nor srung dgyes pa bskyed phyir spel: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza me gha hūm̐: hūm̐: rang nyid yang dag thugs mchog he ru kaḥ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mthing nag khro 'dzum mdzes: phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol: dur khrod chas ldan shwa rī pang du 'khyud: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar dgu'i nyams kyis bzhugs: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭ: hūm̐: thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer 'phro 'du yis: dzam lha nor bdag 'khor bcas spyan drangs gyur: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ padma ratna sa ma ya tiṣṭha swā hā: hūm̐: byang phyogs lhun grub gter gyi pho brang nas: nor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan dzam bha lha: padma rgyal po ārya re manta: rnam sras skya brgyad dzam lha nag po dang : rta bdag brgyad dang lug bdag ku bāai ra: nor bu bzang po gang ba bzang po dang : nor rgyun ma dang phyugs kyi ma lha brgyad: lha bu tshe 'dzin rgyal mo bu rdzi ma: thab lha yu mo zhing lha tshangs pa dang : sgo rdzi stag g.yag la sogs phyugs kyi bdag: srid pa'i lha rgan phyug po mgon dkar dang :

longs spyod nor gyi bdag po thams cad la: 'dod yon sna tshogs dkar dmar bsres pa yis: mnyes pa'i dri gsur mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'bul: mnyes shing tshims nas sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin la: bsod nams nor dang longs spyod char bzhin phob: don gnyis mthar phyin gter la spyod par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ bai shrā ma ṇa ye swā hā: hoḥ bdag gi bsod nams nor lha'i tshogs bcas la/ /zab mo sbyin sreg mchod pa phul ba'i mthus/ /pha ma rigs drug sems can ma lus pa/ /mi zad longs spyod gter la spyod par shog hoḥ yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi 'khor lo can/ /longs spyod char gyis 'gro rnams nges bsgyur la/ /'byor drug 'dod yon lhun grub spyod par shog /dge legs rtag tu rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces gong 'og gter chen rin po che'i gter ma bka' brgyad dkar gsur khol du phyung bas dge 'dis bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam dbul phongs pre ta'i gdung ba sel zhing longs spyod pa'i rgyur gyur shog /sarba maṅga lam// // wa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: rigs drug bar do'i gsur mchod bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: tshogs rdzogs rigs drug gsur mchod kyi: zas mchog 'dod yon sna tshogs rnams: me hom chung ngu'i nang du bsreg: dus ni nyi ma shar dros bya: thugs rje'i zer gyi lcags kyus 'dod: byin gyis brlabs te byin par bya: 'di nyid bsod nams bla na med: rigs drug bar do'i sems can rnams: yid lus gtad med 'khyams pa'i tshe: sha gzugs srid pa'i bag chags kyis: 'dod yon ro la sred pa yis: dbul ba yi dwags snang ba 'char: sbyin pa'i dge stobs chung ba rnams: dri gsur tsam yang mi dbang nas: nyam thag sdug bsngal myong ba'i tshe: snying rjes me gsur 'di bgyis na: dbul bar nor dang bkres par zas: skom par bdud rtsi'i longs spyod 'thob: 'bras bus bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs:

'khor lo bsgyur ba'i bsod nams mnyam: de bas 'di nyid shin tu gces: sa ma ya: dang po: na moḥ mngon gyur rig pa 'od gsal rjen ne ba: snang srid snod bcud thams cad buddha'i zhing : yang dag de don rtogs pas skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun rang rig chos sku mngon gyur bgyi: gnyis pa: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las rang byung me thab dbus: ro mchog lnga ldan 'dod yon bsreg pa'i rdzas: rigs drug so so'i yid dang mthun pa yi: zad mi shes pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a hu ti pu dza me ga spha ra ṇa swā hā: gsum pa/ hūm̐: rang nyid longs spyod rdzogs sku rdo rje sems: dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril bsnams: mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan gsang ye'i sku la 'khril: rdo rje skyil krung 'gro ba'i dpal du shar: oṃ badzra sa twa hṛ da hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: rang rig thugs rje snying po'i 'od zer gyis: dam tshig lcags kyu'i srid gsum kheng bar 'phros: rigs drug bar dor 'khyams pa'i sems can kyi: yid lus rnam shes gnas 'dir mchis par gyur: oṃ nṛ a karṣa ya dza dzaḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ: bzhi pa: hūm̐: 'jig rten gnas nas pha rol tshe 'phos te: bar dor 'khyams pa'i tshe 'das yid lus can: sha gzugs bag chags srid par 'khreng ba yis: dbul zhing ltogs dang bkres skom gyur pa rnams: bdag gi snying rjes sbyin pa'i tshig la nyon: rang byung stong nyid snying rje'i thab khung du: rin chen ro mchog rnam lnga'i zas bsregs pas: rigs drug so so'i longs spyod nam mkha'i khyon: zag med mdzod la spyod phyir bsngo bar bgyi: mig yul gzugs mdzes rna bar sgra snyan pa: sna la dri zhim lce la ro mchog ldan: lus la reg 'jam rnam shes snang bas tshim: ci 'dod rdzas la spyod pa'i yul gyur nas: rigs drug srid pa'i sdug bsngal grol bar shog: nges par shi ba yin par thag chod de:

bar do'i 'khrul gzugs yin par ngo shes nas: nyams len bla ma'i gdams ngag dran byas te: ye shes lnga yi sku ru grol bar shog: gal te rigs drug gnas su 'khyams srid na: srid pa gang du skye ba'i gzugs mthong nas: 'du 'phrod rnam shes gnas der chags pa'i tshe: yab yum lha yi sprul bsgyur shes par shog: g.yang sar lhung snyam mngal du zhugs pa'i tshe: gzhal yas khang gi bkod pa mthong bar shog: bzang ngan gang du dri za'i mngal 'tshol tshe: ma rungs ngan pa'i mngal sgo 'gag par shog: skye ba 'dzin par sprul sku thob pa'i tshe: mi brjed gzungs thob yon tan chud par shog: skyes nas smra shes rtags dang yon tan tshang : yul phyogs gnas kyang bkra shis ldan par shog: lnga pa: hoḥ yid lus bar do'i rnam shes gtad med khyod: byin rlabs thugs rje'i 'od zer phog pa'i tshe: sgrib med yi ge āḥru gyur nas kyang : 'og min kun bzang rgyal ba'i thugs ka ru: rtsal chen mda' 'phang bzhin du skye bar shog: phaṭḥ drug pa: hoḥ bdag gis bla med mchod sbyin dge rtsa yis: pha ma rigs drug bar do'i sems can rnams: nyon mongs srid pa'i tsha gdung las grol zhing : byang chub bsil ba'i chu rgyun zad med kyi: bde ba ngoms med myong ba'i 'bras bu yis: rnam mkhyen bla med go 'phang reg gyur cig: ces bsngo smon gyis rgyas btab ste 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i ting 'dzin la gnas par bya'o: sa ma ya: rgya: e ma bdag 'dra pad 'byung gis: bar do'i rigs drug sems can rnams: bla med byang chub reg pa yi: mchod sbyin gnad zab nyung ngu bzhag: snying po'i sa bon lcags kyu yis: btab na nam mkha'i tshad kyang zin: de bas gdams pa shin tu zab: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so//

zha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: sbyin sreg klu'i mchod thabs bdud rtsi lnga ldan bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: klu la bsreg rdzas mchod pa ni: klu sman klu shing sna tshogs dang : dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bru sna tshogs: mnyes pa'i rdzas kun legs par bsags: bsang mchod tshul gyis sbyin bsreg btab: snyan pa'i gling bus spyan 'dren bya: 'di nyid bgyis pa'i skal ldan rnams: klu yi nad rigs thams cad sos: kha rlangs dug rnams rab tu zhi: phog thug 'gram 'khrug rnams kyang byang : char chu 'bebs dang lo phyugs 'phel: longs spyod pho brang klu dang mnyam: de bas 'di nyid shin tu gces: dus ni nyi ma phyed yol lo: sa ma ya: dang po: hoḥ kun rig thog ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur: skyabs kyi dang po 'od gsal snying po mchog: srid mtsho ma rig gzhom phyir skyabs su mchi: mar gyur 'gro rnams ye shes spyan ldan shog: gnyis pa: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: hūm̐: rang byung ye shes me yi zhi thab tu: klu dang sa bdag mnyes pa'i mchod sbyin bsreg: byin gyis brlabs pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ nā ga bha su ki maṃ: gsum pa: hūm̐: rang nyid skad cig dbang chen khro bo'i rgyal: rta dbu'i gtsug rgyan sku mdog dmar gsal 'tsher: khro 'dzum phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams: dur khrod chas rdzogs padma gzi ldan 'khyud: zhabs gnyis bskyang bskum gzi brjid dpal 'bar bsgom: oṃ badzra kro ta hya ghri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ bzhi pa: hūm̐: yid 'ong gaṅgā ne'u gseng na ra dang : khron pa gdengs ka mdzes shing rgyas pa'i dbus: sna tshogs nam mkha' 'phrul gyi gnas mchog nas: klu rgyal 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a gatstsha gatstsha swā hā: padma shwa ra tiṣṭha lhan: lnga pa: hūm̐: klu rgyal dga' bo gtsug na nor bus brgyan:

nye dga' dung skyong stobs rgyu nor rgyas dang : rgyal rigs rje rigs dmangs rigs gdol pa'i rigs: bram ze la sogs klu rigs bye ba stong : sa bdag dbang chen sa 'dzin lag pa che: the se rgyal po the khyim btsun mo dang : hang ne bstan po tsang kun se lo dang : nor srung dus 'dzin hal khyi gnam gshed brgyad: lo skor spar sme zhag dus 'gyu ba sogs: sa bdag klu gnyan ma lus thams cad la: sreg rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshos mchod pa 'bul: tshogs brgyad dbang po drug gi spyod yul rnams: mnyes shing tshims nas 'dod yon kun ldan shog: sa bdag klu yi nad rigs zhi ba dang : bsod nams sbyin mthus tshogs chen yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes gang mang gis rgyas gdab: drug pa: hoḥ bdag gis sbyin sreg klu mchod bgyis pa'i mthus: pha ma rigs drug sems can ma lus rnams: ma rig nyon mongs rab zhi longs spyod ldan: bstan gnyis dus bskal rgya mtsho legs 'phel zhing : bden gnyis smon lam dge 'dis mthar phyin nas: kun kyang 'dod don 'bras bu lhun grub shog: bdun pa: hoḥ ye shes klong gi shes rab nyi 'od che: 'dzam gling ma rig rmongs pa'i mun sel nas: nyon mongs rnyog pa'i srid mtsho rab skem ste: thugs rje'i drod rtags smin pa'i bkra shis shog: brgyad pa: hoḥ snang srid gdod nas dgos 'dod klu yi gru: yongs su 'gengs pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: rgya yan zang thal ngang du badzra muḥ zhes bsngo ba smon lam sogs rgyas pa 'don kyang rung : thun tha mar rgya yan ma bcos thog ma'i gshis lugs la bzhag: e ma: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: klu mchod gsur gyi rim pa bzhag: kun las ya mtshan khyad par 'phags: las 'phro can dang phrad par shog: sa ma ya: : gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags byi lor sbas yul padma'i tshal du shog ser nas zhal bshus so//

// za) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: rin chen gter bum sba ba'i rim pa 'dod rgu mchog sbyin bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: longs spyod bsod nams 'du ba dang : yul lha brtan dang lo phyugs legs: nad rims chod dang bkra shis phyir: gter bum sba ba'i rim pa bstan: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter bum sba ba'i rim pa ni: rab ni rin po che yi snod: yang na rdza bum gsar pa ni: chag gas med pa'i snod dag la: phyi na srung bzhi bkra shis brgyad: kha chod rdo rje rgya gram steng : g.yung drung 'og tu shes par bya: de nas rgyal srid sna bdun dang : rin chen sna tshogs 'bru sna gos: sman sna stong ldan dar zab dang : dkar gsum mngar gsum bag rtsam bsres: bum rdzas nyer lnga klu sman rnams: nang du blug cing kheng bar bya: dbus su tsandan shing dag la: gru bzhi ri rab gzugs byas te: sngags 'di 'bri zhing dkyil du bcug: oṃ nā ga rā dza bhū mi pa ti ma ma rā dza hṛ dha ya siddhi pha la hūm̐: zhes smad du bris: rtse mor: oṃ bhrūm̐ trām̐ hoḥ zhes bris la bzhag: 'bru sman rnams dang rdzas: sngags 'dis byin gyis brlab: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma ṇi ratna siddhi dza dzaḥ sngags la blug: bum pa bgegs bskrad bya: nang ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ ngo: de nas grub pa dang kha la chas bkag ste: zhag gsum bsgrub bam gang rung la kun gyis mi mthong bar sba: de yang mtho zhing rgyas na legs: dang po 'bru'i tshom bu'i kha ru bzhag la dkyil 'khor gang rung gi las byang gzhung bsrangs shing sngags la bskyal: de nas gter bum bskyed pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ swa bhā wa shuddho haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las: bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i gter gyi bum pa: mtshan nyid dang ldan pa: yangs shing rgya che la shar zhi ba lho rgyas pa nub dbang byang drag po:

stag 'brug bya dang rus sbal gyi srung bzhi dang ldan pa: bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis spras pa: de'i dbus su ri rgyal mchog rab la klu dang sa bdag bye ba gnas pa: mtha' dang bar khyams thams cad la: rgyal srid sna bdun dang : nor bu rin po che'i rigs 'bru sman dar zab phun sum tshogs shing : nam mkha'i mtha' klas khyab pa: lha klu sa bdag gzhi bdag gnas bdag yul gyi srung ma rnams mnyes pa'i rdzas nor longs spyod phun sum tshogs par gyur: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra na sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐: de nas sngags brgya rtsa bar du bsgrub: oṃ dhe wa nā ga bhū mi pa ti ye hṛ dha ya me gha sa pa ri wā ra ye swā hā: zhes bzla'o: de nas sa slong ba ni: sa dpal bzang bar dus tshod dge ba'i nyin bkra shis shing rigs gtsang ma'i bu mo lnga'am gcig la rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras te phyag tu mda' dar bcas bzhag: dkar gtor bsngo: gnas khang la bskor ba gsum byas la gser skyems gtong nas 'gro: gnas su phyin pa dang bsang btang gser skyems bya: de nas sa mig gang yin gyi gong du mchod gzhi bya: sa rko ba'i mig tu dkar gtor bsngo la bstan ma brtsi zhing rko: dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las gter bum mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa: dbus su rol mtsho gling dgus khyab cing ri bo mchog rab gser ri bdun gyis bskor ba: de la lha chen po brgyad: klu chen po brgyad: sa bdag brgyad yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyis bskor bar gyur: de ltar gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas: lha klu sa bdag gzhi bdag gnyan po 'khor bcas spyan drangs te: gter gyi bum pa la thim par gyur: oṃ dhe wa nā ga aṣṭa bhū mi pa ti aṣṭa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gter bum dang dbyer med par gyur: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐:

hūm̐: lha klu gzhi bdag gnyan po rnams: mi shigs dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs: pho brang gter gyi khang bzang 'bul: rin chen mchog rab ri bdun 'bul: rol mtsho gling dgur 'khyil ba 'bul: nor bu gser dngul la sogs 'bul: sman mchog dri bzang sna tshogs 'bul: 'bru bcud sa bon sna tshogs 'bul: dar zab rgyan gos sna tshogs 'bul: bkra shis rtags brgyad mnyes phyir 'bul: rgyal srid sna bdun rin chen 'bul: dkor cha spyad cha sna tshogs 'bul: stag 'brug bya sbal srung bzhi 'bul: pho brang srog yig bla rten 'bul: mnyes shing dgyes la rab gnas shing : pho brang rten la bzhugs gyur cig: oṃ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: de nas dong du 'bru sna gtor zhing sol bas bkang : sa la mi reg pa'i rdo bting : steng nas bkab la dong dang mnyam pa'i kha chod bya: de nas nang du bum pa bzhag la 'di skad do: hūm̐: lha klu sa bdag gzhi bdag rnams: snying po'i srog mkhar brtan pa'i phyir: de ring rin chen gter sba'o: khyed rnams mnyes pa'i rten du 'bul: rten mkhar 'di ru brtan par bzhugs: yul rten 'dzugs pa'i gter sba'o: gzhi bdag chags pa'i gter sba'o: lo phyugs rgyas pa'i gter sba'o: yul bcud mi nyams gter sba'o: nad gdon zhi ba'i gter sba'o: lha 'dre yid kyi gzugs can rnams: gter bum rin chen 'di 'bul bas: rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas rnams: snyan grags chos kyi dngos grub stsol: rgyud 'dzin srid kyi dngos grub stsol: 'jam phrug gos kyi dngos grub stsol: tshe dang dpal gyi dngos grub stsol: srog lus dbang thang rlung rta bskyed: bsam ngan sbyor rtsub zhi bar gyis: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdus: 'dod rgu longs spyod dpal 'byor dang : lo legs bkra shis phun sum tshogs: rtag tu kha 'dzin sdongs grogs dang : rogs dan mthun rkyen 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: lha klu gzhi bdag rnams la bcud dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs par gyur:

oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: me tog 'thor zhing bkra shis rab gnas dang : rdo rjes rgyas gdab: de nas bsngo smon bzang pos mtshams sbyar: rten 'brel brtag cing nang du log: lam nas sa rdo rtags chen rnyed na rten 'brel bya zhing 'khyer bar bya: sgrub pa'i dus su yin na rdul tshon ma bsdus skabs su gnas khang gi phyogs gcig tu sbas te rten 'brel tshogs 'khor bzang po bya: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs rjes 'jug bu yi don: 'dod rgu shugs 'byung bum gter nyid: 'di nyid sbas pa'i sa phyogs su: 'dod rgu longs spyod phun sum tshogs: ci bsam don 'grub the tshom med: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas sbas tshal padma rong nas gdan drangs shing padma chos gling du shog ser nas bsgyur to// // 'a) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: rnga thug srid gsum zil gnon 'dzugs thabs kyi gsol mchod bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: yi dam chos skyong pho brang phyir: rnga thug 'dzugs pa'i gdams pa bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rnga thug 'dzugs pa'i rim pa ni: byang g.yag mda' gris shi ba yi: rnga ma dang ni rngog ma bcas: gzhan yang g.yag rog zhol chen gyi: rnga ma nag po zhum chen bsags: chos skyong rten du btsugs pa yi: rnga ma dmar po mang du bsags: thams cad gdugs ltar btsem par bya: rnga thug nag po'i cod pan dang : dkar po lnga ru tshem par bya: dmar po dag ni cod pan ring : zhags pa lcags kyu rnams kyang btags: rtse mor kha ṭwāṃ rtse lnga'am: rtse gsum dpa' bo'i kha ṭwāṃ btsugs:

nang du srog yig rnams kyang bzhag: grub na bla 'khor yongs rdzogs bcug: mgul du dmar nag ru mtshon brgyan: de la rtsa sngags srog yig bri: srog shing tsandan dkar dmar ram: seng ldeng dag ni rab tu bsngags: yang na drang zhing 'khrod pa yi: gang rnyed gtsang ma'i shing la bya: rgyas pa me long phur pa dang : rdo rje bcas pa mgul du 'dogs: gcig tu 'dzugs na stod smad bya: gzhung ni rnga thug so sor 'dod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas rnga thug bskyed pa ni: rnga thug bslangs shing bgegs bskrad: mtshams gcod bya: de nas chu gtsang bran zhing me bshur brgyab: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis byin gyis brlab: rgyas par thug bskyed las byang rgyas pa bsrang : bsdu na nyung ngu 'di nyid lugs su 'dod: skad cig lha bskyed ni: hūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: badzra dharma shuddha swa bhā wa haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig e yi mkha': 'byung lnga bsnol brtsegs rang byung pho brang ni: gru bzhi sgo bzhi dur khrod bkod pa rdzogs: phyi ni rnga thug nang ni drag po'i zhing : rngam lhun chas rdzogs bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar: rno ngar spu gri mtshon cha tog gis spras: phyag mtshan sa bon yig 'bru glog ltar 'khyugs: tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs pa'i pho brang nas: padma nyi zla bam ro nag po'i gdan: byol song gtso brgyad bsnol ba'i khri steng du: khrag 'thung khro rgyal dpal chen he ru kaḥ sku mdog smug nag dbu ni nyi shu khro: g.yas pa nyi shus gnam lcags rdo rje gdeng : g.yon pa nyi shus bhan dmar rakta bsnams: dur khrod chas rdzogs sgro gshog mkha' la brgyangs: bco brgyad zhabs ni gling bzhir dor stabs bgrad: gsang ba'i yum mchog gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma: mthing nag dbu dgu khro zhal rngam la dgyes: g.yas dgus gri gug nam mkha'i mthongs la phyar: g.yon dgus bhan dmar yab kyi zhal du stob: dur khrod chas ldan brkyang bskum yab la 'khril:

bskal pa'i me ri dmar nag klong du gsal: dpral bar gshin rje mgrin pa rta mgrin dang : thugs kar yang dag lte bar rbod gtong lha: gsang bar phur pa dpung g.yas me phreng can: dpung g.yon dregs 'dul brla g.yas stobs ldan nag: brla g.yon las mgon srog bdag bya rog gdong : spyi bor thugs sprul bya khyung ga ru ṭa: phyi rol sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha tshogs gsal: hūm̐: de yi mdun du thod mkhar dmar nag dbus: padma nyi zla bam ro'i gdan steng du: khrag 'thung chen po bdud mgon seṅge'i gdong : sku mdog mthing nag seng zhal nga ro sgrogs: g.yas pas dar nag ru mtshon mkha' la phyar: g.yon pas dmar chen gtor zor dgra la 'phen: stag ral gzig shubs go khrab rgyan gyis spras: rta nag rlung gshog rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang chibs: yum mchog seng gdong dmar nag go khrab can: kha ṭwāṃ dgra snying dmar chen gtor zor 'phen: zangs rta dmar nag myur mgyogs 'phur shes chibs: shar du sngags srung e ka tsa ti ma: lho ru gza' bdud khyab 'jug rā hu la: nub tu btsan rgod 'bar ba rdo rje legs: byang du shan pa sde dpon srog bdag dmar: de yi phyi rol chos skyong gter gyi bdag: lha srin sde brgyad sde dpon dregs pa 'bum: slob dpon spyan sngar zhal bzhes khas blangs pa'i: dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i lha tshogs ma lus gsal: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes dang 'jig rten pa'i lha tshogs spyan drangs: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: 'jigs byed che mchog khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon lha tshogs rnams: dur khrod pho brang gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: rnga thug drag po'i klong du brtan par bzhugs: hūm̐: khrag 'thung chen po zhing skyong seṅge'i gdong :

bka' gter gnyen srung chos skyong yang sprul 'bum: rtsub 'gyur pho brang gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: rnga thug rten mkhar 'di la dgyes par bzhugs: hūm̐: gsang ba zil gnon bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha: ye shes 'jig rten srung ma 'khor bcas la: dug gsum sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'bul: rten mkhar pho brang 'di la bzhugs nas kyang : sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin pa'i srog shing tshugs: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsrings la mnga' gsol spel: che btsan mthu yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ badzra he ru hūm̐ phaṭḥ dkyil 'khor gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi zhal du ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na la khā hi: hūm̐: khrag 'thung chen po zhing skyong seṅge'i gdong : chos 'khor skyong ba'i dregs sde'i dmag tshogs la: dgra sha khrag mchod dmar chen rgya mtsho 'bul: rnga thug pho brang rten la bzhugs nas kyang : yul 'dzin phywa rten gnyan gyi srog shing tshugs: rnal 'byor snyan grags gzi byin stobs bcu spel: rbad bskul sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ ma hā kā la singha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭḥ chos 'khor skyong ba'i dam can rgya mtsho'i zhal du dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na la khā hi: zhes gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol: de nas dregs gzugs mnga' gsol ni: gser skyems gtong zhing : hūm̐: chos dbyings bde chen lhun grub pho brang nas: 'jigs byed che mchog khro rgyal he ru kaḥ chos sku'i mnga' gsol sku mdog smug nag brjid: rdzogs chen bla med snying por mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: rigs bdag mnga' gsol spyi bor khyung chen brgyan: steng gdon 'byung po 'joms par mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: rigs lnga'i mnga' gsol thod skam dbu la brgyan:

sku lnga'i phrin las mngon par mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: 'jigs byed mnga' gsol sma ra dbu skra 'bar: log 'dren 'byung po tshar gcod mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: longs sku'i mnga' gsol nyi shu'i rngam zhal khro: snang srid zil gyis gnon par mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: gza' rgod mnga' gsol spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyugs: pha rol rgol ba 'joms par mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: khrag 'thung mnga' gsol zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: byad ma'i srog snying dgyes par mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: sprul sku'i mnga' gsol bzhi bcu'i phyag dang ldan: sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul 'gyed par mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: khro rgyal mnga' gsol mtshon cha phyag na bsnams: pha rol byad ltas bzlog par mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: khro mo'i mnga' gsol gnam zhal pang du 'khyud: mo rgyud dbang du sdud par mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: che btsan mnga' gsol dur khrod dpal chas rdzogs: dam sri 'dre rgod 'dul bar mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hyum̐: ye shes mnga' gsol rtsal gyi sgro gshog brgyangs:

gdug pa'i g.yul ngo 'joms par mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: dregs 'dul mnga' gsol me dpung klong na bzhugs: dug lnga'i nyon mongs sreg par mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: stobs bcu'i mnga' gsol byol song gtso brgyad brdzis: snang srid bran du bkol bar mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: sku yi mnga' gsol 'jam dpal dpral bar brgyan: pha rol log sbyor 'jam dpal mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: gsung gi mnga' gsol rta mgrin mgrin par bzhugs: drag sngags phyogs bcur sgrogs par mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: thugs kyi mnga' gsol yang dag snying gar bzhugs: zab chos dbyings ltar khyab par mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: yon tan mnga' gsol rbod gtong lto bar bzhugs: ma sring 'khor gyis bskor bar mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: phrin las mnga' gsol phur pa gsang bar bzhugs: bstan pa'i ru tra 'joms par mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: yi dam mnga' gsol dbang drag dpung pa g.yas: dngos grub char ltar 'bebs par mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: 'jig rten mnga' gsol dpung g.yon dregs pa brjid:

gzi brjid rtsal bcu 'gyed par mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: drag sngags mnga' gsol dmod pa brla g.yas bzhugs: mthu rtsal stobs kyi shugs 'byin mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: chos skyong mnga' gsol bya rog brla g.yon bzhugs: dgra bo'i srog snying len par mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: snang srid mnga' gsol dregs pa yang 'khor 'bum: phyi nang bka' bstan skyong bar mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: pho brang rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang 'jigs rung chen po 'di: dpal chen he ru ka pa'i rten du 'bul: bka' brgyad zil gnon lha tshogs rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang 'di la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: rnga thug nag po khams gsum zil gnon 'di: dpal chen he ru ka pa'i rten du 'bul: gsang ba zil gnon lha tshogs rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang 'di la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: gnam lcags mtshon cha rtse lnga rtse gsum 'di: dpal chen he ru ka pa'i rten du 'bul: bka' brgyad zil gnon lha tshogs rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang 'di la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: le brgan dar gyi rgya chings ldan pa 'di: dpal chen he ru ka pa'i rten du 'bul: bka' brgyad zil gnon lha tshogs rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang 'di la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: bla 'khor srog yig rdo rje phur pa 'di: dpal chen he ru ka pa'i rten du 'bul: bka' brgyad zil gnon lha tshogs rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang 'di la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: drang zhing dpag bsam brtan pa'i srog shing 'di: dpal chen he ru ka pa'i rten du 'bul:

bka' brgyad zil gnon lha tshogs rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang 'di la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: srog yig sngags bris rten dar 'phyang ba 'di: dpal chen he ru ka pa'i rten du 'bul: bka' brgyad zil gnon lha tshogs rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang 'di la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: 'phan dar rgyal mtshan sna tshogs bsgrengs pa 'di: dpal chen he ru ka pa'i rten du 'bul: bka' brgyad zil gnon lha tshogs rten du 'bul: rten btsugs pho brang 'di la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: che mchog yon tan lha tshogs rnams: rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams: rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs rnams: rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: dbang chen gsung gi lha tshogs rnams: rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs rnams: rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs rnams: rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: dbang drag thod phreng lha tshogs rnams: rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs rnams: rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs rnams: rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: gter srung dam can lha tshogs rnams: rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: yul rten tshugs la srog rdzong tshugs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: 'jigs su rung ba'i thod mkhar nas: khrag 'thung mgon po seṅge'i gdong : rten gzugs mnga' gsol gser skyems 'bul: hūm̐: bla ma rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas: stong nyid seng zhal gnam du gdongs: srid gsum zil gnon mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: yi dam rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas: sku la mun rub phod kha gsol: dregs pa tshar gcod mnga' gsol lo: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la:

rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: mkha' 'gro rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas: bdud mo seng gdong g.yon du rngam: ma g.yel 'dul bar mnga' gsol lo: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: chos skyong rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas: ru dar gtor mtshon dgra la 'phen: bgegs srin tshar gcod mnga' gsol lo: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: dam can rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas: go khrab dpal gyi chas dang ldan: bstan pa srung bar mnga' gsol lo: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: gter bdag rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas: bdud rta nag po rlung gshog chibs: ma rungs tshar gcod mnga' gsol lo: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: yul lha rnams kyis mnga' gsol bas: dur khrod khrag zhag klong na bzhugs: rdzu 'phrul 'gyed par mnga' gsol lo: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: ye shes 'jig rten mnga' gsol bas: chos skyong gter bdag 'bum gyis bskor: dgra srog len par mnga' gsol lo: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rnga thug rten la bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang 'bar ba 'di: chos skyong gter bdag rten du 'bul: rten mkhar 'di la bzhugs su gsol: rnga thug srid gsum zil gnon 'di: chos skyong gter bdag rten du 'bul: rten mkhar 'di la bzhugs su gsol: rtse gsum rno ngar dbal ldan 'di: chos skyong gter bdag rten du 'bul: rten mkhar 'di la bzhugs su gsol: ru dar bla 'khor srog rten 'di: chos skyong gter bdag rten du 'bul: rten mkhar 'di la bzhugs su gsol: 'phan gdugs dar dpyangs sna tshogs 'di: chos skyong gter bdag rten du 'bul: rten mkhar 'di la bzhugs su gsol:

go mtshon rnam pa sna tshogs 'di: chos skyong gter bdag rten du 'bul: rten mkhar 'di la bzhugs su gsol: phyi nang chos skyong gter bdag rnams: gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs su gsol: drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces rten du gzugs shing gtor ma 'bul: bka' brgyad spyi bskul gtor 'bul dang : chos skyong so so'i gtor 'bul bya: rab gnas bya zhing bkra shis brjod: hūm̐: phyi nang gsang ba'i lha tshogs rnams: mthun rdzas gser skyems 'di bzhes la: bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra: g.yab pa'i tshe na spyan ma rtul: mchod pa'i tshe na mgu ma dka': bskul ba'i tshe na phrag ma dog: rten pa'i tshe na rtags ma zhan: rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung : sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs: sdang ba'i dgra bo cham la phob: dmod pa'i phrin las gang bcol ba: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i las mdzod cig: ces phrin las bcol me tog 'thor zhing : oṃ: 'grub par gyur cig dkyil 'khor lha: phyi nang gsang ba'i lha tshogs rnams: rten 'dir brtan par bzhugs su gsol: oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: zhes brtan par bya: gzhan yang chos skyong sogs 'jug na gter srung gi thugs de'i tshig rnams kha bsgyur rgyun du gso zhing phud kyis mchod: lo re cis kyang kha gso bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: yi dam dkyil 'khor brtan pa dang : chos skyong dam can gnas pa'i phyir: rnga thug rten du 'dzugs thabs bzhag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal yi ger thob la sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// //

(ya)༁ྂ: bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: reg phung dug mda' nag po'i spyi chings ma yig chen po bzhugs so: drag sngags dmod pa'i lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra sprul sku thod phreng ngas: ngan sngags kun gyi mthar thug las: thog mda' spu gri rlung zhon gyi: lag len spyi chings pra khrid bstan: ye shes grogs gsum legs par zungs: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang sprod: bstan dgra sgrol ba'i mtshon char shog: sa ma ya: de yang dgra bgegs bzhom pa'i las tshogs ni: ltas ngan btang dang srog las byed pa ste: las khog gcig la phrin las so so yi: kha bsgyur dmod pa la sogs sbyar ba ni: gang dgos 'os 'tshams zhib rgyas legs par bkod: gzhan yang spyi yi liṅga thams cad dang : 'khor lo la sogs ci ltar bskor na yang : rang gi ming dang gos dri ma song bya: bdag cag 'khor bcas la sogs bcug pa spangs: 'di la 'khor lo nyi shu tsam yod pas: pha rol shin tu dpung tshan che ba na: 'khor lo thams cad cha tshang ma bu sprad: liṅga rnams kyang sa yas mang nyung bya: khyad par sde shog tsam la bskor na yang : liṅga stong phrag tsam las ma nyung bya: ltas ngan stong sa gcig kyang bskor ba la: bsad sngags lha dbye bsha' gri bshas ldan dang : steng 'khor 'og 'khor gnyis ni med par bya: yang na drag po'i shing la bskor kyang rung : 'gugs dang pho nya bkye sogs thams cad ni: bka' brgyad gzhung gi bsad las nang nas blangs: khyad par dregs pa 'di yi las tshogs la: gtad rgyud rgya mtsho nā ra chu 'thung dang : sde dpon dregs pa bco brgyad 'khor lo sogs: re re la yang byed lugs mi 'dra bas: kun la nyer gcig nyer gcig re re 'dug: 'di ni dregs pa sde gsum 'khor lo la: rang gzhung bgyis te sde brgyad kha sab nas: cha tshang bsdus pa lag len 'khyer bde ru: gang la gang 'dul dgos rim rtsa tshig brtsam: 'di nang nyung ngur 'gags su bsdus pa ste:

dgos pa'i lag len chad lhag gang yang med: rnam bshad la sogs tshig tshogs yig 'gros che: des na go shes rnams la 'di nyid zab: gti thug ngag nus mi ldan sngags nag gis: dregs sde lag len 'di 'dra ag nyen med: da ni spyi chings liṅga brtsam pa la: thog mar pha rol dgra yi rdzas dag ni: rkang rjes sa dang mi gtsang ljan ljin dang : skra sen dang ni gos rnying dri ma can: pho mo gang zhig de yi rdzas kyi rigs: yul phung la sogs ri bshig byed pa la: kho yi khang khyim sa dang zhing kha'i sa: ri yi sa dang sgo nor srog chags spu: gang du dmod pa de yi rdzas dag bsags: de yang bsags tshe re ba'i thum bur dril: liṅga lha dbye tshar nas gnas su byug: de nas bri ba'i dus tshes bstan pa ni: dgu gsum dag tu gza' skar ngan pa'i tshe: de yi dus su sprad de liṅga bri: mun rub nyi nub srod du lha dbye bya: dgun gsum ri bo rlung sgra che bar bskor: dbyar gsum chu rlung 'ur sgra 'byin par bskor: dpyid gsum chu mig gnyan pa'i nang du bskor: ston gsum brag dmar ri dmar zur du bskor: phung zla dag la 'jug pa'i mgo bo bzung : zla ba gsum du bskor ba gzhung gi tshad: des ni myur du dgra la rtags kyang 'byin: rmi lam dngos sam khug rtags byung ba'i tshe: sbyin sreg bya'am gtad pa skabs dang bstun: than 'gyed sogs ni snying rje'i byang bu sbyar: da ni dregs pa rang gzugs than dbyibs bstan: dang po dbang phyug chen po smug nag la: ral gri sog le thogs pa'i dbyibs dag bri: stag dmar wa bzhi dmar dang sprel bzhi ser: than srog snying khar mu khyud 'phreng gcig yin: gnyis pa dregs pa sde gsum 'khor lo ni: than bdag sprel ser zhon pa'i gla ba sngo: 'ug pa'i dngas ru ser dang sbrul dmar thogs: gsum pa rā hu la yi 'khor lo ni: gza' bdud dud kha chu srin rgyal mtshan g.yas: g.yon pas mda' gzhu 'dzin pa rngam gzugs bri:

bzhi pa dam can rdor legs 'khor lo la: rdo rje mdung dar 'dzin nas seṅge zhon: lnga pa bdud nag rang rgyug 'khor lo la: bdud po sprel gdong gla ba nag po zhon: sbrul bzhis bskor nas lag tu sbrul zhags thogs: drug pa mgar ba bya zhon 'khor lo ni: btsan chas bya sngon zhon nas tho phur thogs: 'ug pa la sogs than rigs mang pos bskor: bdun pa mun nag sgo rdung 'khor lo la: btsan gzugs lcags kyu sdigs mdzub mi dmar po: brgyad pa shan pa ku 'debs 'khor lo ni: sprel mgo btsan gzugs spyang ki sngon po zhon: sbrul zhags dang ni lcags kyu lag na thogs: dgu pa rlung nag 'tshub ma'i 'khor lo ni: mi nag zhwa nag gos nag ba dan g.yas: spyang ki zhon nas seṅge dkar mo khrid: bcu pa sha med las kyi 'khor lo la: bud med srin gzugs khram shing sbrul zhags thogs: co 'dzin bud med bzhi dang khyi bzhi 'dzing : bcu gcig mun pa khrom rgyug 'khor lo ni: mi dmar bya khra phur thogs rmog khrab can: bcu gnyis gnod sbyin dkor bdag 'khor lo ni: a tsar sngon po sbrul dbyug spre'u zhon: bcu gsum a tsar nag po'i 'khor lo ni: a tsar sngon po lcags kyu sog le 'dzin: bcu bzhi seng stag spyang gsum 'khor lo ni: mi dmar seṅge zhon pa ba dan gri: stag dang spyang ki'i g.yas g.yon dag nas bskor: bco lnga the'u rang nor bsnyag 'khor lo ni: byi la'i mgo can sho dang khram shing thogs: bcu drug dug gi mdung thung 'khor lo ni: bsad pa liṅga sngags kyis bskor bar bya: bcu bdun sa srin pho mo'i 'khor lo la: liṅga la sogs spyi mthun bsad pa ltar: bco brgyad klu bdud nag po'i 'khor lo ni: liṅga'i snying khar phur pas bsnun pa bya: bcu dgu rkun ma mgo 'khor bya ba la: liṅga bsad dam than 'gyed gang rung 'dod: nyi shu lkugs pa kha tham 'khor lo ni: liṅga'i lce dag phyi la 'then nas su: sngags 'phreng bskor sogs zhal shes lta bur bya:

'di ni spyi yi byed tshul rang gzugs yin: bye brag so sor bri ba'i skabs su ni: dgra bo 'thab dang gri mdung bsnun pa'i gzugs: gzhan yang than rigs mi gcig mang po dang : lung ma bstan gyi gzugs 'gros sna tshogs pa: bkra mi shis pa'i mtshan rtags mang po bri: da ni liṅga'i rnam dbye bri thabs ni: gzhi ma ra dug dag gi shog bu la: btsan dug khyi dug phag dug rgya dug dang : dug rdzas mi rung bsres pa'i shog bu bya: de ngos liṅga spyi mthun dag tu bri: than 'gyed lta bur 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe: liṅga re dang dregs pa kha sbyor bya: bsad pa lta bur 'khor lo bskor ba na: liṅga'i 'og tu bshas gdan re re dang : steng nas bsha' gri de steng dregs pas mnan: liṅga'i phyi nas sngags phreng bskor thabs ni: dang pos pho nya 'gyed dang gnyis pas 'gugs: gsum pa lha dbye bzhi pa bsad pa'i sngags: lnga pa liṅga'i snying khar bsha' gri'i sngags: bsad pa lnga yi 'khor lo thams cad dbus: liṅga gsum gsum bri'am che ba re: bar pa thams cad gnam lcags so 'thab bskor: than 'gyed yin na liṅga mig phugs par: rabs chad shing gi kha sbyor bar du bzhag: bsad pa ltar na dregs pa bskor thabs bri: gri lcags gzer gyis sraug shing lte ba phugs: nam yang 'gul bskyod med par dam du bya: gshog sgro rnams la sgab 'dre mnan bsad bri: liṅga'i phyi lpags gro ga'i tshas kyis btum: sa ma ya: rdzas ni dug sna khrag sna'i rigs: spyi bshad gzhung rigs lta bur bya: 'khor lo bskor ba'i mdun du ni: rdza'am shing gi sgrom bu ru: kham sar than gyi gzugs bcas te: dgra la kha gtad bzhag par bya: dgra bo mtho sar gnas pa la: liṅga dma' bar bskor mi bya: liṅga mtho ba'i rtse ru bskor: 'khor lo bri dang 'dzugs pa'i dus: bsad bcad la sogs ming thos na: dgra la rbad kyang 'gro ba'i rtags: rlung 'khor bskor ba'i dus su ni: mi 'khor skad ngan bsgrags pa na:
