rang la ldog pa'i rtags yin pas: rnam 'joms 'don zhing bzlog pa bya: gegs med rtag tu 'khor ba na: dgra la rbad kyang myur ba'i rtags: khyad par 'khor lo 'di 'dzugs nas: las mtha' rbad bsad tshogs gtor sogs: byad bzlog dgra bzlog yang yang bskyal: rang nyid che mchog bka' brgyad kyi: rgyun du ting 'dzin ngang la gnas: dmigs pa spro bsdu la sogs bya: gzhi bdag rnams la phrin las bcol: nyer dgu rnams la zor kyang 'phen: skabs su 'khor lor rakta bran: nyungs thun sogs ni zhal las shes: nang du rang srung 'khor lo ni: bka' brgyad spyi yi srung 'khor ram: rnam 'joms dag gis chog par bshad: sa ma ya: de sogs man ngag pra khrid bsdus pa'o: spyi yi dgos khyad lag len zhal las gab: gsang sngags gnyan 'di gab sprad 'khrugs bsdebs dang : zhal shes snyan brgyud phran bu med pa la: yig chung gsal na ras chod gzu lum gyis: chos kyi ngad pa yal lam rang phung rgyu: khyad par snying rje chung ba'i slob dpon gyis: ka cha phran bu tsam la mi bsad mang : 'di dag khyad du dgos pa'i skyes bu ni: sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong la dmigs pa yis: lag len mos na 'di brtsam go ba yod: blo rmongs rang 'dod can tshos mos pa na: brda yig 'di la ltos dang tshang ba yod: 'di tsam ma go nga rgyal cher rlom na: gte pho so skyes po rang cog ger sdod: nam zhig dus su mkhyen rig rgyas cha mchis: de bas mkhas dben rnams kyi thugs la bcag: sa ma ya: da ni rnam 'joms 'khor los sngags 'phreng bstan: oṃ tru ṭa tru ṭa tro ṭa ya a mu ka bighnan: sphu ṭa sphu ṭa spho ṭa ya a mu ka trig nan: sarba sha truṃ ni gha ṭa gha ṭa a mu ka gzer nan: ka ṭa badzra ma tha badzra aṣṭa ha sa nṛ a mu ka myog thum: ha ra ha ra: sa ra sa ra a mu ka mā ra ya thum thum: sarba badzra ku la ma warta ya a mu ka gzer thun: phyag na rdo rje'i sngags ni: oṃ badzra pā ṇi phaṭ hūm̐ hūm̐:

dgra bo mā ra ya nan: sde brgyad nan: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba a mu ka ṇi trig nan: sde brgyad nan: dgra la zlog: dgra la bhyoḥ tshindha tshindha bhandha bhandha sarba a mu ka zlog zlog: sde brgyad thun: sde brgyad nan: dgra la zlog: dā ha dā ha: pa tsa pa tsa: ma tha ma tha: sarba a mu ka sha truṃ nan: tsu ru tsu ru ku ru ku ru mu ru mu ru dgra bo a mu ka gzer thum bhi sha ha la tsakra dgra bo zlog zlog: sde brgyad dgra la zlog: 'byung po kun gyi gdug pa dgra la zlog zlog: dgra bo bsad pa'i spu gri ni: oṃ ma hā dhe wa dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya rbad: ma hā dhe wa dgra bo cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ'i srog la rbad: dbugs la rngub: sha khrag snying rtsa yam yam: ma hā dhe wa dgra bo'i snying la tshal pa tshal pa dum bur gtub ma hā dhe wa u phu lu bye sha e tsa ti ti na he dgra bo'i srog la bhyoḥ dgra bo ha ra ha ra rbad: ma hā dhe wa nā ga ha na dgra bo nan: ma hā dhe wa shu kha rag dhe wa nā ga dgra bo nan: ma hā dhe wa bdud tri dgra bo sod: ma hā dhe wa tri tri dgra bo chums: ma hā dhe wa tri la tsi pa la dgra bo choms shig: ma hā dhe wa pa tri pa tri du tri sho ma tri tu tri tu tri dza dgra bo sod sod: bdud me ru rtse ru he ṭa dgra bo'i srog snying chod chod: ces pa'i sngags de legs par bkod: rtsibs dang rtsibs mchan rim pa bzhin: thob 'os bzhin tu legs par bstan: dug mda' rlung zhags nag po 'di: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i gnyen por shog: shant+ri ya ma kha thun rgya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gnyan rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: bdag 'dra dgra 'dul gshin rje nag pos lcags byi lor gdan drangs te dug shog nas phab pa'o// // ra)༄༅/ /bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: reg phung dug mda' nag po dregs pa nyi shu'i bu yig bsad pa rlung gi spu gri bzhugs so:

'jig rten dregs pa dmod pa'i lha la 'dud: yang snying dregs pa spu gri'i las tshogs las: dgra bo glo bur bsad pa'i man ngag ni: pho nya rlung la bcol ba'i gdams pa ste/ 'byung ba rang sgri'i ye shes spu gri'i dbyibs: dregs pa so so'i skad kyis bsgyur ba yis: sgra sdeb la sogs go ldog mi gcig brtsam: sham bu'i gnad dang bye brag mang nyung khyad: las sbyor rang gzhung lta bur bstan pa'o: dbang phyug ma hā de wa yis: las mtha' spu gri'i sag brdar las: bu yig spyi chings sngags 'phreng ngo : oṃ ma hā ka ṭa sa du ha ra wa tsa ya mag mag mug mug myag myag myog myog gang gang gong gong rgyug rgyug yul 'di zhes bya ba nas ka cha 'di zhes bya ba khyer mi'i steng du rgyugs rgyugs: a tsa ra yis dgra srog rbad: khug tsa ra ye rbad: yab dbang phyug chen po rbad: yum u ma dhe wa rbad: 'khor lha srid sde brgyad kyis dgra bo cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo'i sha zo: khrag 'thung : rus pa 'chos: za lam gtod dgra bo'i snying du rgyugs rgyugs: ra mdar rgyugs: myur du rgyugs: dgra la cho 'phrul sna tshogs thongs shig: dgra bo 'gugs pa'i las sngags ni: oṃ ma hā dhe wa u ma dhe wa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dgra bo mā ra ṇi tri rbad rbad: 'khor lha srin sde brgyad kyi dmag dpung rab tu bsdus la: dgra bo'i srog snying khyer la shog: had bhyo hud bhyoḥ dmag dpon chen po dgra la rgyugs rgyugs: de nas than srog snying khar sngags 'di bri: tri dza tri dza rgyugs rgyugs: dgra la rgyugs: de yi phyi rol sngags 'dis bskor: oṃ haṃ pra ma rbad: nṛ tri mā ra ya: srog la mu kha he: mā ra ya rmugs thib sod: truṃ dgra'i srog rtsa thum: baṃ rus rtsa la breng shag: tsitta thum rmugs: khrag thab ling shag rbad: nṛ tri hur thum dzaḥ mā ra ya khram rbad nan: zhes pa'i sngags 'di tsheg med legs par bri:

'khrugs bsdebs gab sprad yod pa zur du gsal: sa ma ya: las mkhan shan pa sdai gsum gyi: spu gri thog mda' 'khor lo yi: bu yig spyi chings sngags 'phreng ngo : oṃ kan pa ta ra tsa ta ta ra ma tha bhan dza ta tro me me: ra tri ru tri re ma tri than phob ya: tṛ tri phob ya: khas khas than phob ya: du tri du tri than phob ya: e mu tri dza la ya: sarba sa dhu sa ma ya: sa cha 'di zhes bya ba nas chas ka 'di zhes rkun ma'i steng du rgyugs rgyugs: du tri sa ma ya phob: rā hu la ru tsi ru tsi re ma ti dgra bo'i steng du rgyugs rgyugs: mi le mi le bring bṛng e ka hring hring : dgra bo'i steng du rgyugs rgyugs: nor 'di'i ra mda' gyis la khyer shog tri tri ya bring bring : mi li mi li breng breng e ka hring hring : dgra bo'i steng su rgyugs rgyugs: de sham ku ru nor khyer la shog: ya ya bhyo bhyoḥ e te ra ga dgra bo'i khang khyim du rgyugs rgyugs: hring hring tri tri: dgra bo'i steng du rgyugs rgyugs: ra tri ru tra re ma tri srog pri ta tro ta ni: dgra bo'i thog tu rbad rbad: dgra bo'i steng du rgyugs rgyugs: dgra bo ya ya bhyo bhyoḥ shan pa sde gsum yin zer ba ming nas bos: dgra la rgyugs: dgra bo bskrad du chug: brgyal du chug: smyo ru chug: 'bog tu chug: cho 'phrul sna tshogs thongs: dha pa dha pa ya dgra la mtshan mo 'o dod skad ngan thongs: 'od 'khyil cho 'phrul thongs: bya than thongs: dgra bo'i khang khyim shig tshag tshag thongs: dgra bo 'di zhes bya ba'i srog snying khyer la shog: yang na nor 'di khyer shog ces dang : ra tri ru tri re ma tri tri tri ya: khas khas phob ya phob ya than phob ya: oṃ tri tri ra tsa tu chom: hur hur dun tri sa ma ya: dgra la yam yam su tri raksha them them: dgra la yaṃ yaṃ: rā hu yaṃ yaṃ: re ma ti dgra la yaṃ yaṃ: badzra sā dhu sa ma ya dunt+ri dgra la yaṃ yaṃ:

bdud phos dgra bo'i srog la chom chom: mon pa pho mos dgra bo'i srog la 'jib 'jib: shan pa nag pos dgra bo'i srog la rngub rngub: pri tri ra tsa dza dzaḥ ra tsa dgra bo'i srog la dha sa dha sa: myos myos ra tsa ging ka ra dgra bo mā ra ya sod sod: nan nan: dgra bo 'gugs pa'i las sngags ni: oṃ har te 'bang ye dum phur pa ni pri tri: lce gtam dza la su: dgra bo'i ba spu'i bu gar dza la dza la ram̐ thun thun: than srog snying khar sngags 'di bri: tri ra tsa hring mā ra ya rgyug dza dgra la rgyugs: de yi phyi rol sngags 'dis bskor: 'ur ba 'ur ba rgyugs rgyugs: ru lam̐ ru lam̐ bhyo bhyoḥ pring pring rgyugs rgyugs: dgra bo'i mi nor gtor gtor: dkrugs dkrugs: sarba sha trum̐ mā ra ya rbad: dgra bo khug dza dzaḥ zhes pa'i sngags 'di tsheg med bri: las ltar sbyor ba zur du gsal: sa ma ya: gza' bdud ki kang rā hu la'i: 'khor lo 'byung ba kha 'thab las: bu yig spyi chings sngags 'phreng ngo : dang po: oṃ thil phrum pa shag ga dza tri nan pa baṃ he tri pa la rā hu la pra ma ni: ka cha 'di zhes bya ba khyer mi'i steng du rgyugs rgyugs: yang na dgra bo 'di la thog ser phob phob: ces gang dgos kha bsgyur: oṃ ma hā du na raksha dgra bo'i steng du rgyugs rgyugs: pra ma raksha dgra bo'i steng du rgyugs rgyugs: rā hu la thun thun 'grim 'grim dgra bo'i srog snying khyer la shog: chas 'di rku mi'i tsitta khyer la shog: de tha ta tha ma mo nag mo dur bhyoḥ yaksha rā hu la chas 'di khyer la shog: dgra la thongs shig: dgra bo'i steng du rgyugs rgyugs: ltas ngan sna tshogs dgra bo'i khyim du phob ya: gza' bdud chen po rā hu la 'khor dang bcas pas: dgra bo'i steng du mi ring mdung thung thogs pa'i ltas ngan thongs shig: pha rol dgra bo'i steng du tho rangs sgo khyi ngu ba'i ltas ngan thongs shig: srod la wa mo brgyal ba'i ltas ngan thongs shig:

la)༄༅/ /bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dam sri mnan pa'i gdams pa chu srin kha tham bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma las rab kyis: dam sri sgab 'dre mnan thabs bzhag: ro ras sam ni dug shog dang : ra dang gcan gzan sog pa'am: gang rnyed dag la liṅga bri: de yi khog par sngags 'di bri: ru tra ma ya dam sri trig nan: wag tham: gzer thum: bīg nan: kha tham: yam ching : rmugs myog myog rbad dril: tsur ṇa ya rbad ching tri tri nṛ tri te phur nag mo dzaḥ god srid ching nan: rmugs thum: kha tham nan nan: de nas sgrub khang gi phyi rol lam rgya gram mam: sa gru gsum sogs la gom pa nyi shu'i mtshams su mnan: dong rim pa gsum brus shing : de'i nang du mgo mjug log: steng nas rdo rje rgya gram gyis mnan: dang po 'gugs pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid che mchog gsal ba'i mdun: lto 'phye gshin rje'i kha gdang ba'i: gre bar ya ma dam sri khug: nam yang ma shor sa ma ya: oṃ ya ma dam sri aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ zhes lan gsum bkug: de nas las byang gzhung gi rta bro na rag bsdus par byed na: hūm̐: nga ni khro rgyal he ru kas: stong gsum snyil ba'i rngam bro brdung : ru tra mnan pa'i chem bro brdung : dam sri mnan pa'i rtsal bro brdung : mnan nan nam yang ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: srid pa'i gnam lcags mchod rten ni: nag po bang rim stong dang ldan: de las snang srid dug rlangs 'thib: rang 'dra'i gnam lcags mchod rten stong : mthil sprad rtse mos ru trar bsnun: nam yang mi gtong gnon par 'gyur: oṃ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: rbad nan: chum nan: rgya nan: zhes steng du phur pa bzhag gam sātstsha: yang na tho cog slong ba'o: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sbas yul padma'i tshal nas gdan drangs shing sgrub sde padma chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so//

// sha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dregs pa dgra snying dmar 'byin gyi las mtha' rlung gi spu gri nag po bzhugs so: gsang ba ḍākki'i skad du: ha ling yaṃ shag du na ra sad tri la ma du ma ra wor ka tsi ta 'u ra ti ha raṃ bhyoḥ rgya gar skad du: darpa sarba du karma anta pa sha dza yaṃ shwa kha rā ga kā la a mu ka tsitta rakta ha ri na ma: bod skad du: dregs pa thams cad kyi phrin las mtha' sdud rlung gi spu gri nag po dgra snying dmar 'byin zhes bya ba: 'joms byed gtad rgyud nā ra chu 'thung gtab pa lan med dmod pa ngan sngags par bu reg phung dug gi thog mda' la 'dud: sa ma ya: kho bo drag sngags thod phreng bdag 'dra yis: dregs pa rlung 'khor spu gri dmar po las: byad ma rtsad brlag gdams pa zab mo bstan: brda yi gzungs ma ye shes mtsho rgyal dang : mthu chen dbang phyug sangs rgyas ye shes nyon: 'di nyid bstan pa'i rgyu dang dgos pa'i khyad: sba dang ma 'ongs don du 'byin pa'i dus: gsal bar ston no shog ser logs su bris: dang po bstan pa'i don dang dgos khyad ni: ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga brgya'i yang mtha'i dus: bskal pa'i 'phel 'grib khug pa lhu tshigs su: 'byung ba 'khrugs pas thog ser rlung dmar g.yo: mu stegs dmag gis mtshon cha mun ltar gtib: mtha' bzhi ral nas dur sa'i khrims kha chags: mdo sngags bstan pa bdud kyis dmyal thag gcod: gtsug lag chos 'khor phal cher sprul pas sdud: chos rgyal sde dpon dmangs kyi khol du 'bebs: rig 'dzin skyes chen rnams kyang grong yul 'grim: sdig spyod lta log ma rungs sde tshogs dar: yul sde kun 'khrugs gtsug lag 'thab rar 'dzin: lha srin 'khrug pas kun kyang nang dme byed: khyad par chos sgrub byed pa'i gang zag rigs: dben par 'dun kyang tsau ra jag chom sdang : bsad bcad 'phrog dang khas nyen rdung gtag byed: mi 'os las byed yi mug skyo ba skye:

nus mthu med zer chos skyong khyad du gsod: gsang sngags rdo rje theg chen gshe dang smad: las su mtshon brtsams chos su mi dge spyod: mig rgyangs lam tsam bgrod la bsu skyel dgos: ci bzhin bsags pa'i ka cha mi dbang zhing : snying brtse'i grogs kyis dgra la phyogs pa dang : so skye dpung tshan che rnams dpon du bkur: nyes med sngags kyis rnal 'byor ar la gtad: ci bzhin spyod la dug gi tshong 'dus smra: zog po khrims ral dam nyams lung pa 'gengs: bdud sprul ban bon khengs sems chags sdang can: bstan la 'tshe dang sgrub la 'gras tshol zhing : ci bzhin tshad mar spyod la dben pa'i dus: mi 'dod sna dgu thams cad skabs der 'tshogs: dus ngan yang mtha' de skabs la dmigs nas: kun las 'di nyid gtso che de phyir bstan: 'di yi dgos khyad mkho don bstan pa ni: ma 'ongs bod rnams phrag dog dug lnga hrag: sems can las kyi shugs la bsod nams dman: khengs sems rang 'dod dbang gis log par gol: brtson 'grus zhan pas yi dam sgrub thag ring : dregs pa phal cher bsgrubs kyang srog la gzan: mthu med sngags pa'i klu gtad phal cher kyang : gnyis phung rang la ldog gam 'khor la 'tshe: pho nya re zung tsam ni dpung tshan nyung : che rgyud ye shes lha ni bzhengs bskul dka': man ngag 'thor bu tsam ni yid gnyis za: spyi lung mthu gtad phal cher lag len chad: dgos lung 'ga' re yod kyang sbas tshul mang : phal cher rnams ni 'thor zhing cha mi tshang : rgyas pa rnams ni lag len mgo mi chings: bsdus pa rnams ni dbye gsal ris mi 'byed: yun ring bsgrub la lto gos chas mi 'dang : rdzas sngags grangs tshang rtags ldan 'dzoms mi thub: de bas ci byed las kun dka' ba'i tshe: 'di nyid lta bu'i gdams pa ma shes na: tshig tshogs mang po rang mgo bskor ba'i rgyu: shes shes mang po byed don lam la zad: mi 'ongs stong skad kun gyis khrel ba'i rgyu:

dge 'dun mthu med dug la re ba'i tshe: man ngag 'di 'dra phangs pa'i srog las dkon: pho nya rlung gi phrin las sgrub thabs te: bya sla rtags myur rang la mi ldog cing : reg phung gang la btab kyang thogs med 'di: ma 'ongs yang mtha' de la dgos phyir bstan: 'di nyid sba zhing gsang ba'i dgos khyad ni: nus stobs sngags kyi spu gri phyung brdeg la: dgra bsad stong thang shor bsam sbas pa min: las kyi pho nya rlung gis srog bcad la: nyes dmigs rnam smin 'khor dor sbas pa min: sangs rgyas bstan bshig ru tra bsgral ba la: byams sems snying rje bsgom 'dod sbas pa min: nus rtsal 'bras bu dus 'dir smin pa la: gdams ngag the tshom dogs nas sbas pa min: yin pa'i sbas lugs ci ltar bshad ce na: ma 'ongs mdo sngags bstan pa skyong ba yi: rig 'dzin brgyud pa sring ba'i skal ldan la: pha rol dam nyams bdud rigs gang zhig dang : khyad du nang tshan rgyab log ma rung rigs: 'tshe zhing dgrar langs gdug sems sdang ba dang : bstan dgra sgos dgra bsgral ba'i gnyen por sbas: khyad par rmangs po snod min log lta can: tha snyad tshig la zhen pa'i rtog ge ba: skam tshig sna re bzung ba'i gdeng bsran can: snod du ma gyur rnams la gsang phyir sbas: spyi dang bye brag mdo sngags rgyud lung kun: bdud sprul sde dgus bshig cing 'thor ba'i tshe: 'di nyid chad pa mthud dang ma tshang bkang : nam yang mi zad don phyir sbas pa'o: de phyir bsten dang dgos khyad sbas gsum mo: da ni bye brag dgos khyad mdo tsam las: sangs rgyas bstan pa spyi la dgrar langs na: dregs pa sde dpon yongs rdzogs 'khor lo bskor: bye brag 'phral du jag chom ma rungs pas: ka cha nor rdzas spyad kha 'phrog khyer dang : bud med snying ring gnas bdam byed mkhan la: gnam sa ri rab go ldog 'khor lo bskor: mtho non can dang sde dpon khrel med la: lkugs pa kha tham dgu brtsegs 'khor lo bskor:

pha spun gnyan tshan dgra ru langs pa na: klu bdud mdze nad par bu'i 'khor lo bskor: ban bon sngags pa dgra ru sdang ba na: sa srin ltau sbyor nag po'i 'khor lo bskor: slob bu bran g.yog dgra ru sdang srid na: mdung thung dug gi ral gri'i 'khor lo bskor: byis sba chung rgyud dag gi 'tshe ba la: the'u rang snying rlung nor bsnyag 'khor lo bskor: rkang phran byol song dgra yis khyer srid na: seng stag spyang ki gsum gyi 'khor lo bskor: nang gnyer khyim spyad ka cha shor ba na: gnod sbyin dkor gyi bdag po'i 'khor lo bskor: grogs po lam rogs dgra ru sdang srid na: mon pa khrom rgyug nag po'i 'khor lo bskor: yul mis mi kha 'bu shu sdang ba na: a tsar rdo char 'bebs pa'i 'khor lo bskor: bud med rnams kyis sdang sems kha gtong na: sha med nag mo'i las kyi 'khor lo bskor: yul mi dgon sde dgra ru sdang ba na: mon pa rlung nag 'tshub ma'i 'khor lo bskor: zhon rta sgar khal rku la shor ba na: btsan dmar shan pa ku 'debs 'khor lo bskor: dpe cha rten gsum rku la shor srid na: mon pa sgo brdung nag po'i 'khor lo bskor: phyogs kyi mi chen dgra ru sdang srid na: dam can mgar ba nag po'i 'khor lo bskor: bon nag mu stegs dgra ru sdang srid na: bdud nag ma rbad rang rgyug 'khor lo bskor: go khrab dar gos dgra la shor ba na: dam can srog bdag dmar po'i 'khor lo bskor: lam 'phrang la chu sogs la dgra byung na: ki kang rā hu la yi 'khor lo bskor: sbyin bdag gzhungs ngan le gu lha log la: drag po sde gsum las kyi 'khor lo bskor: ma rungs bande ngan pa dgrar langs na: dbang phyug srog gi sag brdar 'khor lo bskor: gnon pa ri rab lta bu'i gdams pa la: rnam par 'joms dang phyag na rdo rje'o: brlag pa thog rgod lta bu'i gdams pa la: bsha' ba spu gri dmar po'i glog zhags so: shor med lcags khang ar gtad gdams pa la:

bshas gdan lcags sgrog dgra chings nag po'o: dpung tshan shan pa nag po'i gdams pa ni: sde dpon nyi shu rtsa gcig 'khor lo'o: dgra bo gzugs nas nyams pa'i gnad gsum ni: dur shor khrag sna lcags snyug rnam gsum mo: dgra bo lha dang dbye ba'i rdzas gsum ni: lte khrag mdze khrag sre mong sha gsum mo: dgra bo'i bla rtags 'phrog pa'i gnad gsum ni: gzugs bris yi ge 'god pos lhag chad spang : dgra bo 'khor bar byed pa'i gnad gsum ni: zag rdzas gos dri ming rus bla dwags so: dgra bo khug par byed pa'i gnad gsum ni: srod 'phros nam phyed nyin phyed thun brdeg 'gugs: dgra bo theb par byed pa'i gnad gsum ni: dus nag zla 'dzin nyer dgu mun rub bo: dgra bo shor med ngos 'dzin gnad gsum ni: lo zla dmod dang gza' skar sprad pa'o: dgra bo gzir bar byed pa'i gnad gsum ni: pho nya rbad dang dmod pa drag bstim mo: bzlog med mtha' sdud de yi gnad gsum ni: dgra ling mang zhing sgab 'dre bcad pa'o: log rdugs 'khyams gsum mi 'byung gnad 'gag ni: sde brgyad srog yig 'chang zhing yang bzlog bskyal: myur zhing ci bcol sgrub pa'i gnad 'gag ni: tha tshig bsgrag dang gsol mchod gtor ma phul: yid ches tshad du phebs pa'i gnad 'gag ni: 'khor lo bskor dang rmi lam brtag cing bskyal: dgra bo rtsad brlag 'byung ba'i man ngag ni: gsang khar mnan nam 'byung ba gsum la bskor: dmod tshig gzhan gyis mi mthong gnad gsum ni: 'khor lo dgra la gsang thabs sba ste bskor: rno dbal ngar btags rtsal 'gyed gdams pa ni: sde dpon la sogs rang rdzas tshang bar bsags: dgra bo 'phro mtha' gcod pa'i gdams pa ni: rten 'brel yi ge la sogs go ldog bya: dgra bor mi rung sna dgu 'byung ba'i gnad: than gzugs thams cad dgra la kha bstan bzhag: tha ma rjes shes gsum gyis gdams pa ni: dgra bo shi nas bsngo smon ting 'dzin 'dud:

rgyun du rang nyid gur khang gdams pa ni: srung bzlog 'khor lo btags sam bskor bar bya: bya ba thams cad yongs su grub pa'i tshe: liṅga sbyin sreg sde brgyad rang sar gshegs: mnan pa sogs la dmos par ma mchis so: de ni dregs pa gtad rgyud rgya mtsho yi: pra khrid rnam dbye 'byung tshul bsdus pa tshang : rgyas pa sogs ni dregs rgyud rgya mtshor gsal: 'on kyang rtsa tshig zab gnad 'di kho na: khyad par 'di yi rgyud pa'i zab khyad ni: phung byed mthu mkhan shāntiṃ garbha yis: dbang phyug ma hā dhe wa yab yum dang : spu gri ma mo gsum yang dbang bsdus nas: las kyi srog thigs dwangs ma 'di nyid blangs: de yis pad 'byung rje la gcig tu brgyud: gu rus de nyid bsam yas mchims phu ru: legs par bsdus nas go rim yi ger bkod: de la rgyud dang rang gzhung spyi lung ni: dregs pa snying 'byin gtad rgyud ces kyang bya: spu gri rlung zhags dmar po zhes kyang bya: shan pa me lce'i 'khor lo zhes kyang bya: dregs pa spu gri rkyang shab ces kyang bya: gtad khyim mthu lung nag po zhes kyang bya: sde dpon las kyi 'khor lo zhes kyang bya: me rlung srid pa kha sbyor zhes kyang bya: spyir ni reg phung dug mda' nag po'i rgyud: ngan sngags kun gyi yang bcud zab mo de: ma 'ongs dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mtshon char bzhag: bstan pa spyi dang gnad 'gag mi che bar: 'di nyid bskor na yul phung dag tu 'gro: ci phyir shāntiṃ garbha'i spyi lung las: mu stegs tha nag yul du bskor ba'i tshe: phyi pa rtsad bcad nang par cung 'tshe bas: phyag na rdo rje'i dam bzhag kha gnon mdzad: de phyir da lta 'khor lo 'di la yang : steng na phyag rdor dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan no: de bas gar thod sa ru bya mi rung : khyad par dus mtha'i sngags pa zhe sdang can: gdug rtsub 'byung po 'dra der gsang bar bya: ci phyir 'gro ba kun gyi srog bcad nyes:

de bas gcig brgyud mna' rgyas gdams te byin: 'di ni gnyom chung sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa: mi dpung lha la re ba'i gdams pa nyid: phrin las rlung gi sgrub pa'i man ngag ste: bka' 'di legs ldan bya rog gdong gis srungs: dam nyams bdud rigs lag tu ma shor cig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gnyan rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: bdag 'dra dus mtha'i sngags 'chang padma gter bdag gling pas lcags byi lor sbas tshal bal phu yar 'brog mtsho nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ༁ྂ: bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las:(sa)dregs pa snying 'byin gyi las mtha' gsol mchod bzhugs so: 'jig rten dregs pa dmod pa'i lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las: dregs pa dgra snying dmar 'byin gyi: gsol mchod dgra la rbad pa'i thabs: shan pa las la bskul ba ni: lcags snod shor med hom gyi nang : dgra ling steng du 'bru nag gi: dpal gtor che ba gcig la ni: bcu dgu dag gis bskor bar bya: mdun du dmar chen khrag mchod bshams: las la bskul zhing dmod pa ni: rnga brdung dung bus raktas bran: rang nyid che mchog nga rgyal bskyed: bskul zhing tha tshig bsgrag pa'i tshe: las kyi pho nya ma lus kyis: dgra yul dpung bcas brlag par bsam: yang yang nan cing dus drug bskul: phrin las gzhung ltar 'di skad do: hūm̐ ya bhyo dzaḥ 'chi bdag pho nya 'khrugs pa'i dur khrod nas: mi bsrun las kyi shan pa bye ba 'bum: srog la rngam byed gshin rje dregs pa'i sde: myur mgyogs bka' yi las mkhan ma lus kun: rlung ltar 'tshub rnams dgra la rbad phyir gshegs: hūm̐: ma hā dhe wa gshegs su gsol: shan pa sde gsum gshegs su gsol: gza' bdud ki kang gshegs su gsol: sa mā ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs: khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni: dam nyams dgra bgegs sdig can gyi:

dbang po sha khrag don snying 'bul: zas skal gtad do zhal du bzhes: nor skal gtad do zhal du bzhes: dgra skal gtad do zhal du bzhes: gshed skal gtad do zhal du bzhes: bzhes shig dgra bo zhal du bzhes: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas gtor ma btegs te raktas bran la: hūm̐: rab tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod nas: las mkhan dregs pa'i sde tshogs rnams: bzhengs shig sha khrag klong nas bzhengs: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: de ring gtad pa'i dgra bo 'di: gnam sa gling bzhi gar gnas kyang : gnam gyi 'ju thag chod la shog: sa yi brtan phur phud la shog: srog gi 'phar thag chod la shog: tshe yi 'dus byas shig la shog: dus las ma 'da' dregs pa'i sde: do nub nam gyi gung thun la: dgra bo cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ khrid la shog: pho nyas rgyug log ma byed cig: las mkhan tshur la ma ldog cig: log rdugs 'khyams su ma shor cig: dgra la rbad do dus la bab: bhyo bhyo dam nyams dgra la bhyoḥ bcol ba'i las 'di ma bsgrub na: dus gsum sangs rgyas bka' yang bcag: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dam yang nyams: bsgrubs pa'i sngags 'chang yi yang chad: de bas dam la ma 'da' zhig: sngon tshe slob dpon pad 'byung gis: bsam yas mchims phu dge'u gong du: bka' bsgos gnyer gtad mi dran nam: dgra sha khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: ma hā dhe wa dgra la bhyoḥ u ma dhe wa dgra la bhyoḥ dregs pa sde brgyad dgra la bhyoḥ sde dpon sum cu dgra la bhyoḥ shan pa nyi shu dgra la bhyoḥ rbad pa'i pho nya mthu ma chung : sngags pa'i las la rtsal ma zhan: dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: dregs pa'i dmag tshogs dus la bab: dgra la gri rigs bco brgyad phob: lhog rgod glang thab snying gzer thongs: rbad do las la mā ra ya: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: e ka he dun ma hā dhe wa u ma dhe wa a ya ma du ru tsa sha na rā hu la badzra sā dhu sha khrag rakta dgra bo'i snying la bhyo bhyo yul la bhyo bhyoḥ

khang khyim nor rdzas kun la bhyo bhyoḥ zhes gtor zor dgra phyogs la 'phang zhing thal mo brdab: dgra bo'i ming nas dmod de zas skal du gtad: 'khor lo la raktas bran cing thun kyang brdeg: des ni dregs pa thams cad la rbad skabs las kun gang bcol 'grub cing log rdugs 'khyams gsum mi 'byung ngo : rbad pa 'di nyid shin tu gtso che bas dus drug tu bskul lo: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: dgra 'dul gshin rje nag pos sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// //

ha)༄༅/ /bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dpal dgu'i bzlog 'khor spu gri reg chod bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i yang snying las: dmod pa drag sngags las kyi mtshon: bzlog 'khor spu gri reg chod bstan: 'di la rgyas bsdus 'bring gsum ste: rgyas pa phyi rgyud rgya mtsho yin: bsdus pa bya khyung rkyang shab yin: 'bring po 'di nyid lugs su 'dod: de yang bri thabs bstan pa ni: dug shog ngar ma 'jam pa'i ngos: dug khrag bsres pa'i snag tsha dang : lcags snod zhun mas 'di ltar bkod: sa ma ya: dpal chen sreg brtsam: ma rungs bdud sprul dam nyams gang zhig gis: 'tshe zhing sdang sems 'chang na sbyin sreg brtsam: 'di ni ched du dgra la dmigs gtad phyir: dgra bo med par bya bar mi rigs so: khyad par dmod pa'i las tshogs thams cad la: gnad kyi gdams pa sbyin sreg 'di nyid zab: sa ma ya: de yang lag len bca' gzhi bstan pa ni: dkyil 'khor kha 'gengs bgegs srin tshar gcod la: sgrub khang ngam ni gang bder byas kyang rung : pha rol dgra la mngon spyod bgyis pa'i tshe: phung shul dur khrod lha srin btsan par bya: dmod pa'i gzu dpang la sogs kha tshar btags: spyi yi rnam bkod bkram pa'i mtshan nyid ni: drag por sa gzhi smug nag 'dom gang la: dbus mtho mtha' rgyas lag mthil ltar mnyam bya: thog mar dug khrag rdzas kyis chag chag gdab: de dbus drang por gzhung thig cha tsam gdab: de yi dbus su gnam lcags 'khor lo bri: de yi mtshams su liṅga brgyad kyis bskor: de yi phyi rol ral gri brgyad dag ni: rtse mo liṅgar 'gyu ba bsnol thabs bya: de yi phyi rol gru gsum 'bar ba'i rtsibs: rtsibs kyi nang du liṅga re re bri: de yi phyi rol zla gam gru gnyis su: g.yas su pho ling g.yon du mo ling bri: de yi phyi rol gru bzhi khru rnams su: dgra bo'i nor rdzas yul zhing mkhar khang bri:

de yi phyi rol me ri khor yug mched: tshon rtsi rnams kyang gang 'os skabs dang bstun: rang gi dri dang 'bag gtsog mi 'chor gtso: de steng drag po'i tsher shing seng ldeng dang : skyer pa tsher nag spo tri nag po'i shing : gru gang tshad kyi stong phrag long bar bya: de yang brtsegs thabs drag mchod lta bur bya: phyogs bzhir g.yab pa'i dar nag bzhi yang 'dzugs: gnyis pa rdzas kyi lag len bstan pa ni: sgrub pa'i kha 'gengs bar chod bsal ba la: sbyin sreg spyi ltar zur bkod bzhin du bya: pha rol rgol ba'i byad la btab pa'i tshe: gri khrag dug khrag sman chen gu gul nag: rta nag khyi nag bya nag dom nag khrag: g.yag nag ra nag phag nag bong nag khrag: mu zi shing kun ra dug spyang tsher ma: rgya rtsi dug lo bcas pa zhib par bsags: de dag thams cad zhib 'thag bgyis nas su: 'bru nag bra sran ram pa'i phye mar bsres: dgra bo'i rdzas dri rnyed na de yang bsres: phag khrag brlan gyis sbags nas zan du bcos: de la liṅga rab la dgra bo'i grangs: mi gcig yin na lo grangs tsam byas rung : 'on kyang brgya dang rtsa brgyad tshad du 'dod: de yang pho ling mo ling bsre bar bya: gtor chung dag kyang liṅga'i grangs ltar dgod: pho shing shug pa mo shing glang ma la: pho mo'i liṅga stong phrag tsam du bya: gong gi dug khrag dag gis bri bar bya: ma traṃ thog tu 'gugs pa'i hom yang dgod: de yi nang du liṅga thams cad bzhag: zhag bdun bar du dmigs rtags thon par 'gugs: mtshams su drag thun sngags kyis legs par brdeg: bsad pa'i sngags kyang dus dang bstun par bya: bsgral ba'i mtshon cha rnams kyis mtha' nas bskor: mchod rdzas gzhan rnams las gzhung spyi ltar bya: dam par mtshams bcad gnad du dril bar bya: dgra bo rtsad brlag 'byung bar the tshom med: sa ma ya: de yang las kyi rim par 'jug pa ni: thog mar yi dam che mchog dkyil 'khor btang : sgrub pa'i sngags rnams gang lcogs tsam du bzla:

de nas drag po'i las gzhung hom bskyed bya: 'gugs nas phur bskor bar gyi mtshams la bskyal: de yi skabs su 'gugs sngags 'di nyid bgrang : oṃ ya ma ra tsa ya ma du tri ki kang ma tri ya har ling shag dgra bo cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo'i bla yid nṛ tri dza dza thun thun a karṣa ya khug dzaḥ zhes sngags brgya phrag re'i mtshams su 'gugs gzhug cha re bya la thun sngags 'dis brdeg: oṃ badzra he kro ta karma traṃ bhyo ya ma he bhyo yakṣa kā la ya dgra bo cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo'i srog la rbad: dgra bo'i snying la rmugs chum: dgra bo mā ra ya nṛ tri myog thum ha la ha la hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pas thun gyis brab cing phye mar gzhom par bya: nub mo zan ling nang nas re re blang zhing bsgral nas zhal bstab bya: de nas sgrub pa rtags thon pa'i nyams byung nas: las la sbyor ba ni: gong bzhin sbyin sreg gi chas thams cad 'grigs bzhin du nyi shu'i mgo nas bzung dgu'i bar du byas kyang 'thus: yang na bco lnga nas nyi shu dgu'i bar du bsgrub kyang rung : nyer dgu'i nub la sbyin sreg gi thal ba las mnan ling bzo zhing gang rung gnad du sba: sa ma ya: thog mar me hom bskyed pa ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gyis bsang sbyangs: oṃ shuddhe shuddhe shwa dha na ye swā hā: lan gsum gyis sbyangs: de nas sbyin sreg gi hom la dgra bo dgug pa ni: phaṭ tri kham̐ nṛ tri dzaḥ hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du 'byung ba lnga rab tu 'khrugs pa las 'byung ba'i khro chu khol ma'i sa gzhi: de'i dbus su gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom zlum po: de'i nang du ram̐ dmar nag las grub pa'i gnam lcags ur mo 'khor lo spu gri'i rtsibs can drag tu 'khor zhing : de la rtsibs ldan grangs med 'phro bas hom yangs phyi la rdul ltar 'khrigs shing 'khor bas byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa phye mar gtub pa:

'khor lo'i so bar du dgra bgegs pho mo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa gsal ba: de'i phyi rol du ral gri drag po skar ltar 'khrugs pa'i so thams cad dgra bgegs la rub rub byed pa: de'i phyi rol du gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom gru gsum pa rnams kyi nang gi g.yas su dgra bo pho rgyud g.yon du dgra bo mo rgyud mdun du dgra bo'i rigs rgyud dang bcas pa: de'i phyi rol du gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom zla gam: de'i gong gi zur g.yas su dgra bo'i lha srung g.yon du dgra bo'i pha tshan dang bcas pa: de'i phyi rol du gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom gru bzhi: de'i nang gi zur g.yas gnyis su dgra bo cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo'i nor rdzas dang phyugs zhing g.yon gnyis su dgra bo'i bla rtags dang mkhar khang bcas gsal ba'o: de'i phyi rol bskal pa'i drag spyod kyi me rlung dmar nag tu 'khrugs pa: me dpung de'i dbal las sprul pa'i gsod byed pho nya dregs sde 'bum dang bcas pa skar ltar 'khrugs pas dgra bo'i bla 'khyams 'ded cing 'gugs nas bstim pa'i rang bzhin du gyur: ces 'di yi skabs su 'gugs gzhug las gzhung nas blang zhing tshar gsum bya: de nas hom gyi lha bskyed pa ni: hoḥ mdun du dgra bgegs bsad pa'i khang sgrom bskal pa'i me ri drag tu 'bar ba de'i steng gi mkha' ru drag po e'i zhing khams chen po bskal pa'i khyon dang mnyam pa 'byung ba tsha grang 'khrugs pa'i sgra 'brug ltar ldir zhing rlung nag mun pa'i bu yug 'tshubs pa: de'i dbus su gnam lcags 'khor lo'i lte ba mthur du zug pa phur pa'i dbal ltar gzengs nas byad ma'i srog snying phral te phye mar gtub pa: rtsibs dbus ma'i steng du hūm̐ smug nag yongs su gyur pa las dpal chen las su chas pa'i rang bzhin te zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon bhandha bsnams pa:

de'i shar gyi rtsibs steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las yang dag dmod par chas pa g.yas kha ṭwāṃ dang g.yon rgyu zhags bsnams pa: lho'i rtsibs steng du hūm̐ ser nag las 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed g.yas be con dang g.yon mdung thung 'dzin pa: nub kyi rtsibs steng du hūm̐ dmar po las dbang chen hya ghṛ wa dmod par chas pa g.yas dbyug pa g.yon lcags sgrog 'dzin pa: byang gi rtsibs steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu dmod par zhugs pa g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon phur pa 'dzin pa: shar lho'i rtsibs steng du hūm̐ ljang nag las ma mo rbod gtong las chas su zhugs pa g.yas khyung khra dang g.yon zhing dbyug gwa'u 'dzin pa: lho nub kyi rtsibs steng du hūm̐ dmar nag las dmar nag me phreng dmod par zhugs pa g.yas ral gri dang g.yon lcags sdig 'dzin pa: nub byang gi rtsibs steng du hūm̐ kham nag las 'jig rten dregs 'dul dmod par zhugs pa g.yas spu gri dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa: byang shar gyi rtsibs steng du hūm̐ nag po las stobs ldan khro bo dmod par zhugs pa g.yas phur pa dang g.yon me zer 'dzin pa: de rnams thams cad rang 'dra'i yum gyis 'khyud pa gcer bu stag lpags kyi sham thabs can las byed rngam pa'i tshul gyis gsal ba: de'i 'khor du srid pa gsum gyi dregs byed pho nya rnams kyis bskor ba: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas bka' brgyad sprul pa'i rang bzhin drag po mngon spyod kyi lha tshogs thams cad skad cig gis spyan drangs te mdun bskyed dang dbyer med du gyur: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: dbyings nas skur bzhengs bka' brgyad bdun brgya'i lha: deng 'dir dgra la mngon spyod dbab pa'i phyir:

dmod pa'i las la chas phyir gshegs su gsol: dgra bgegs srog la dbang phyir gshegs su gsol: nyams pa rtsad nas gcod phyir gshegs su gsol: dregs pa gnad nas bskul phyir gshegs su gsol: byad ma zhal du bstab phyir gshegs su gsol: sreg byed me dpung bskyed phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ karma kro ta he kā la duṣṭa ya badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ a we sha ya a āḥ zhes dbyer med du gyur pa'i thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul ba'i tshe: mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dal gyi las byed pho nya rnams la phog: pho nya thams cad shin tu khros te sreg byed me'i zhags pa drangs nas lcags khang gi: steng 'og bar khyams khor yug thams cad du mched pas dgra bgegs byad ma cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ dmigs bya ma lus pa bsregs shing gzhom nas dmod las kyi lha tshogs rnams kyis gsol bar gyur: de nas phyogs bzhir me sbar zhing : hūm̐: dpal chen las kyi bka' nyan pa: mi bsrun shan pa me 'od gdong : phyag na sreg byed me dpung thogs: hom yangs phyogs bzhir mched pa las: tshwa tshwa drag po skar ltar 'khrugs: dgra bo byad ma pho mo'i rigs: mi nor yul zhing bcas pa la: mtshon dang me yi char pa phob: brlags shing gtubs te bsregs nas kyang : dkyil 'khor lha yi zhal du stob: khrag 'thung dmod pa'i zhal du stob: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i zhal du stob: rta mgrin khros pa'i zhal du stob: yang dag gtum po'i zhal du stob: rbod gtong ma mo'i zhal du stob: dgra 'dul phur pa'i zhal du stob: mdog dmar drag po'i zhal du stob: 'jig rten dregs pa'i zhal du stob: srog bdag dmod pa'i zhal du stob: sprul pa bdun brgya'i zhal du stob: shan pa nyer lnga'i zhal du stob: bstab bo dgra bo zhal du stob: bzhes shig byad ma zhal du bzhes: dus la bab po sa ma ya: oṃ ma hā kro ta ya ma rā dza badzra hri ta ma tri kā la badzra kī li tsaṇḍa ha tri lo ka sarba lo ka sarba karma dhu dza ya dgra bo cha3lt;!TCC

dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nyin phyed dgra bo rta lo pa'i: bla rtags ma shor khug la shog: hūm̐: klu bdud nag po'i dus la bab: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phyed yol dgra bo lug lo pa'i: bla rtags ma shor khug la shog: hūm̐: dmu bdud nag po'i dus la bab: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgong mo dgra bo sprel lo pa'i: bla rtags ma shor khug la shog: hūm̐: lo skor bcu gnyis dbang byed pa'i: sde dpon myur mgyogs chen po rnams: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra bo'i bla 'khyams khug la shog: nyin mo g.yeng ba'i skabs su khug: mtshan mo rmi lam skabs su khug: dus drug 'khrul pa'i skabs su khug: 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i skabs su khug: lha byang dkar po 'di la khug: bdud byang nag po 'di la khug: btsan byang dmar po 'di la khug: nyes can dgra bo shor ra re: da lta nyid du khug la shog: oṃ ya ma rā dza du pra ma raksha ya yaksha ma hā de wa ging ha ra bī ha ra badzra sā dhu ki kang gra ha ti pa ra tsa ya dgra bo cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo'i srog la dza dzaḥ dgra bo'i dbugs la dza dzaḥ dgra bo'i lus ngag yid gsum la dza dzaḥ zhes 'gugs bstim rtags thon bya: de nas thun brdeg pa ni: hūm̐: shan pa sde dpon dus la bab: dgra bo las ngan sdig can la: gnam lcags thog gi char pa phob: bla srog dbang po myos par gyis: brgyal zhing rengs te sgrol bar mdzod: oṃ sarba tsi tri nṛ tri mā ra ya thun bhyoḥ dgra bo'i lus la rbad rbad: dgra bo'i ngag la rbad rbad: dgra bo'i yid la rbad rbad: dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: dgra bo'i dbugs la rbad rbad: dgra bo'i sha la rbad rbad: dgra bo'i rus pa la rbad rbad: dgra bo'i dbang po lnga la rbad rbad: dgra bo'i rnam shes drug la rbad rbad: dgra bo'i skye mched bcu gnyis la rbad rbad: dgra bo byad ma'i lha srung mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la rbad rbad:

thun bhyo ram̐ bhyo trag bhyo raksha ya ma bhyo byad ma nṛ tri thum bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces thun gyis drag tu brdegs pas byad ma lha srung thams cad phye mar bshigs shing dum bur gtor bar bsam: de nas mchod g.yog pas lcags skam gyis liṅga blangs te sbyin sreg tu gdab pa ni: cung btegs nas: hūm̐: mdun gyi me dpung gnam lcags tshwa tshwa'i dbus: dmod pa las chas srid pa'i khro bo dgu: yang 'khor bdun brgya nyer lnga sum cu bdun: dgra bo'i srog la dbang phyir skur bzhengs shig: drag po'i zhal gdongs hom yangs rngam par skyed: rno dbal sgrol mche hom shing brtsegs ltar gzengs: ljags dmar hom gzar brkyangs pas mgrin par drongs: ldog med las kyi gshin rje'i lto bar bskyil: mi med srid pa 'khor lo'i klong du thim: phyes shig bzhes shig bstab bo zhal du bstab: srog bdag gshin rje 'bar ba'i zhal du bstab: dus bdag rdo rje nag po'i zhal du bstab: rngam byed dbang chen 'bar ba'i zhal du bstab: sngags bdag rbod gtong chen po'i zhal du bstab: sgrol byed kī la chen po'i zhal du bstab: me 'phreng drag rtsal chen po'i zhal du bstab: 'jig rten dregs pa chen po'i zhal du bstab: dmod pa spu gri chen po'i zhal du bstab: dregs sde bye ba sa ya'i zhal du bstab: dgra bo pho rgyud thams cad zhal du bstab: pho rgyud thams cad rtsad nas da chod cig: dgra bo mo rgyud thams cad zhal du bstab: mo rgyud thams cad mngal nas da skoms shig: dgra bo'i rigs rgyud thams cad zhal du bstab: dgra bo'i rigs rgyud rlung la da bskur cig: dgra bo'i gnyen 'brel thams cad zhal du bstab: dgra bo'i gnyen 'brel bdun rgyud da chod cig: dgra bo'i sgo nor thams cad zhal du bstab: dgra bo'i sgo nor phyags mas da thob cig: dgra bo'i rten mkhar yul zhing zhal du bstab: dgra bo'i rten mkhar yul zhing da gtor cig:

byad ma dmigs pa'i sde tshogs zhal du bstab: byad ma rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: khro rgyal me dpung 'bar ba'i hom yangs su: dgra bo'i lha srung mi nor 'khor bcas rnams: myur mgyogs shan pa 'bum gyis rab btegs nas: bskal pa'i las rlung g.yos pa'i sgyogs chen ltar: 'phrul gyis phul nas byad ma zhal du bstab: ming shul rjes tsam med pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bo byad ma mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la khā hi: zhes dug khrag dang bcas nas zhal du bstabs: sngags 'di lan bdun gyis 'bul: de nas liṅga thams cad rdzogs pa dang shog ling 'dra yod kyang bstab: thams cad sbyin sreg zin nas gtang rag mchod gtor drag po dgyes pa'i rdzas gang 'os 'dzoms tshad chabs cig tu phul nas: hūm̐: 'jigs byed khro bo rol pa'i lha tshogs la: sreg rdzas 'dod yon kun 'byung dgyes mchod 'di: snga bcol gtang rag ched du bzhes su gsol: da bcol phrin las myur bar bzhes su gsol: phyi byed zhu rten 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol: khyed la gsol zhing phrin las bcol ba ni: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs dmag dpung bzlog pa dang : byad ma gnod byed thal bar brlags nas su: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pū dza me gha a hu ti ram̐ ram̐ kha kha khā hi: de nas dkyil 'khor la bstod pa ni: hūm̐: mngon spyod las la bzhengs pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul gyis rab bskul nas: ma rungs 'dul phyir dregs sde'i rngam tshul ston: mtha' sdud ched du shan pa'i rnam 'gyur 'gyed: las la chas phyir pho nya'i cha lugs 'chang : nyams pa bsgral phyir gcer bu gcig bshur mtshon: byad ma pho mo gshed du du mar bsdu: ma nges rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i rba rlabs ltar:

gcig dang tha dad du ma sa ya 'bum: grangs med gaṅgā'i rdul ltar 'khrigs pa'i tshogs: nyams pa bsgral phyir che btsan shugs kyi sprul: sna tshogs snang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la bstod: ces pas bstod cing bzod gsol bya: de nas me lha'i dkyil 'khor gshegs pa ni: hoḥ sprul pa sgyu ma'i rnam rol gar mkhan gyis: ci bzhin phyag rgya'i 'khrul 'khor bsgyur ba'i tshogs: spro bsdu rmi lam rol rtsed zhig pa bzhin: kun gzhi skye med klong du badzra muḥ zhes dkyil 'khor lha sprul sku'i gzugs: longs sku'i rtsal thams cad chos sku'i klong : gdod ma'i dbyings kun gsal 'phrul gyi lding khang gi drwa ba ris med chen po'i khyon yangs su bsdu: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas las sbyor tha ma mnan pa'i pra khrid ni: drag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi thal sol rdul tshon bcas thams cad gri lcags kyis bsdus te lcags snod du btab: gong gi dug rdzas rnams kyis sbos shing liṅga bcos: dgra bo lan gsum gyis 'gugs pa gces: lha 'dre'i 'gyu srang ngam mchod khang gi them pa'i 'og: yang na bdud 'dul mchod rten gyi 'og tu mnan: sa 'og gshin rjer 'bod cing rgyas gdab pa ni: hoḥ mdun du 'chi bdag nyi khri dgu 'bum 'khrugs pa'i dbus su za byed gshin rje ya ma ra tsa chu srin gyi mgo bo can gyis kha gdang ba'i nang du: dgra bo byad ma mi nor thams cad btab pas gnam lcags gwa'u 'grigs pa ltar bsdams te: bskal pa mtha' sdud kyi rlung rdo rje'i rgya gram ma zhig bar ma btang zhig mā ra ya nan nan: ces sa 'og gshin rje la gtad de rgyas gdab pa ni: hūm̐: sa 'og rim dgu'i lcags mkhar nas: 'chi bdag las la bsngags pa yi: mtha' sdud ya ma rā dza la: dgra bo'i mi nor 'khor bcas gtad: nam yang btang bar ma byed cig: kha thun nag pos rgyas gdab bo: oṃ ya ma rā dza byad ma nṛ tri kha thun mā ra ya wag tham nan nan:

ces rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas gdab: lha 'dre 'gyu srang yin na bca' khri nag po sum brtsegs bya zhing steng du drag po'i shing la phur pa bgyis te 'dzugs: de nas phyi mig mi blta bar nang du log: spyir liṅga mang po yin na cha gcig phung shul gyi sa ru rlung la phyar: cha gcig lam rgya gram du mnan: cha gcig chu la gtad: dmigs pa gong bzhin bya bas rung : dkyil 'khor de'i sa rnams thams cad ma lus pa chu la btab: rjes zhag dgu'i bar dkyil 'khor de'i shul du mi 'gro: zhag dgu nas de shul khrus bya: slar rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i ting ngai 'dzin gyi ngang la bzhag: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ zab pa'i mthar thug dmar 'od rab 'khyil ba: shar lho'i zhags pa 'chi bdag pho nya'i glog: byad ma 'ching byed sgra gcan gdong ltar 'gyu: spu gri'i phreng ba tshar du bsgrigs pa 'di: reg phung dgra bor 'bebs pa'i dug mdar shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing 'brug lor shog ser nas zhal bshus so// //

oṃ)༄༅/ /bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: las bzhi'i sbyin sreg me 'od 'khyil ba bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: las mtha' sbyin sreg rim pa bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sbyin sreg bya ba'i rim pa ni: dkyil 'khor zhi rgyas dbang drag gis: las kyi gzhung tshig dag dang bstun: gong du yar gzhi dag gi khar: dkyil 'khor las rim bzhin du bshams: de nas mdun bskyed mchod pa'i gzhi: legs shing gtsang ba'i steng du ni: phye mar tsandan dkar dmar shing : 'om bu rgya shug shing dag la : mgo bo padmas mtshan pa byas: ku sha dūrba bilba dang : nas 'bras gro dang sran ma dang : swa ba til dkar til nag dang : rgun 'brum bu ram ka ra dang : dar tshon sna lnga rin chen lnga: mchod pa sna lnga rol mo bcas: sa ma ya: dbang gi sbyin sreg bzang sman drug: sa ma ya: rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg rin chen lnga: sa ma ya: drag po'i sbyin sreg liṅga brgya: sa ya ma: de ltar zhib tu bshams byas te: dang po dkar gtor bgegs gtor bsngo: las byang gzhung bsrang sngags la bskyal: mdun bskyed zhi rgyas dbang drag shes: lha bskyed bya na las gzhung bzhin: dang po mdun du me lha bskyed pa ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ dang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sbyangs: de nas skad cig dran rdzogs su: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las: mdun du zhi rgyas dbang drag gi pho brang : mtshan nyid dang ldan pa: zur bzhi zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa: bud shing gis gang ba yangs shing rgya che ba: de'i dbus su ram̐ las skyes pa'i me lha sku mdog dmar ser ra skyes kham pa la chibs pa phyag g.yas kyis ril ba dang rtse gsum: g.yon gyis spyi blugs dang bgrang phreng 'dzin pa: yum tsaṇḍa lī dmar mo gri thod 'khyud pa: phyogs bzhir rang mdog gi me lha gtso bo dang mthun la:

mtshams bzhir rlung gi lha mo ljang nag phyag na rlung g.yab dang ba dan bsnams pa: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas drang srong me lha'i rgyal po agne la: 'khor me lha 'bum gyis bskor ba spyan drangs te thab kyi dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur: oṃ badzra agne ye sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs pa mgon gyi sras: ye shes me lhas nyon mongs ma lus sreg: gzi brjid mdangs ldan drang srong rgyal po'i tshul: me lha yab yum 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: oṃ ram̐ agne ye badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ hūm̐: me lha'i rgyal po 'jigs byed 'bar ba'i sku: tshwa tshwa 'phro ba ram̐ gyi dal dbus bzhugs: rang byung ye shes khro chen 'bar ba'i shugs: gsal byed mdangs 'byin khyed la bdag bstod do: oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan pu ru sha ya hoḥ oṃ agne sa pa ri wā ra badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: rang byung khro bo 'jigs byed me yi lha: 'bar ba'i shugs 'chang shes bya'i bag chags sreg: phyag mtshan chas ldan ra skyes kham pa chibs: me lha'i phyi nang dkyil 'khor tshogs la bstod: de nas phyogs bzhi'am las gzhung phyogs nas me sbar zhing rlung g.yab kyis bskyod: mda' dar lngas me mgo gnon: hūm̐: zhi ba'i me sbar shar nas sbar: me long ye shes me sbar bas: zhe sdang nyon mongs bud shing bsregs: me lce dkar po 'od du 'khyil: oṃ badzra ram̐ dzñā na su ra ba ram̐ ram̐: de nas rlung g.yab kyis: hūm̐: rang byung rlung gis srid pa'i bud shing bsregs: me lce ser po 'od du 'khyil: oṃ ratna ram̐ dzñā na pā sa tsi ma ram̐ ram̐: rlung g.yab gong ltar la: mda' dar dmar po thogs nas: hūm̐: drag po gzi byin 'bar ba'i gtsos: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs par: me lce nub tu ma 'phros shig: me rlung dmar pos nub nas srungs:

oṃ padma yam̐ pā sa ma ya rakṣa: mda' dar dmar po nub tu 'dzugs: byang du phyin la: hūm̐: drag po'i me sbar byang nas sbar: bya grub ye shes me sbar bas: phrag dog 'tshe ba'i bud shing bsregs: me lce ljang nag 'od du 'khyil: oṃ karma dzñā na atta ram̐ ram̐: rlung g.yab gong ltar la: mda' dar ljang gu thogs nas: hūm̐: drag po gzi byin 'bar ba'i gtso: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: me lce byang du ma 'phros shig: dam tshig rlung ljang byang nas srungs: oṃ karma yam̐ yam̐ u ta ra rakṣa: mda' dar ljang gu byang du 'dzugs: de nas mda' dar sngon po thogs nas: hūm̐: rang byung me sbar dbus nas sbar: chos dbyings ye shes me sbar bas: gti mug ma rig bud shing bsregs: me lce mthing ga 'od du 'khyil: oṃ buddha ram̐ dzñā na dharma ti shi ram̐ ram̐: rlung g.yab sngar ltar la: mda' dar sngon po thogs nas: hūm̐: drag po gzi byin 'bar ba'i shugs: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs par: me lce steng du ma 'phros shig: mkha' rlung mthing gas steng nas srungs: oṃ buddha ma la yam̐ uddha rakṣa: zhes khang thog gam steng gcig tu btsug: de nas me drag po sbar zhing : lha ye shes zhi rgyas gang yin gyi me'i lha lto bar bskyed cing spyan drangs la bstim: las byang lha bskyed nas bstod pa ma rdzogs par btang : tshogs dang mchod pa gtor ma sogs thams cad mer 'bul: oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'jigs byed me lha'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che ba stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i dbus su: de nas zhi rgyas gang yin gdan dang bcas: spyan drangs te ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa dbyer med par gyur: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pas: mi bskyod pa'am kun bzang ngam 'od dpag med sogs gang yin gyis: dbu brgyan par gyur: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐:

zhes sogs brjod: de nas mar khu thogs nas hom gzar gyis drangs nas sngags bdun nam gsum mam nyer gcig gis: oṃ agne ye swā hā: nad zhi ba'am gang rung la: yi dam rtsa sngags la: 'jigs pa mi mthun pa brgyad dang : nad gdon thams cad zhi ba shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rgyas pa la: tshe bsod chos spyod longs spyod mnga' thang thams cad rgyas par puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dbang la: phyi'i snang ba nang gi rlung sems lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du bar gyur cig: wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: drag po la: bdud dang dam sri la sogs pa nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnod pa thams cad brlag par gyur cig: hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ ces kun la sbyar: zhi ba yin na lha bshos: rgyas pa yin na tshogs: dbang yin na ril bu: drag po yin na gtor ma zur gsum: lha bshos la: oṃ nai wi dye swā hā: tshogs la: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra swā hā: ril bu la: oṃ gha na la swā hā: gtor ma la: oṃ bha lingta swā hā: de nas mchod pa sna lnga 'bul: me tog la: oṃ badzra puṣpe swā hā: spos la: oṃ badzra dhū pe ye swā hā: mar me laḥ oṃ badzra ā lo ke swā hā: zhi ba'i dri chab chang phud dam drag po khrag la: oṃ badzra gandhe swā hā: zhal zas rang rang bzhin: rol mo la: oṃ badzra shabda swā hā: gzugs la: oṃ badzra rū pa swā hā: sgra la: oṃ badzra shabda shang kha swā hā: dri la: oṃ badzra gandhe ghra naṃ swā hā: rol mo la gong ltar: reg bya la: oṃ badzra sparshe āḥhūm̐: phye mar ram mar zan la: oṃ tsarna taṃ bu la ye swā hā: tsandan dang yam shing rnams la: oṃ badzra bo dhi bhikṣa kal pa swā hā: ku sha dang dūrba bilba rnams la: oṃ a ku ra bhikṣa puṣpa swā hā: nas 'bras gro dang swa ba sran ma rnams la: oṃ ge pa ra pha la kandha swā hā: til dkar nag la: oṃ pa sya swā hā: rgun 'brum bu ram ka ra sbrang rtsi la: oṃ a mṛ ta a ha ra swā hā: dar tshon la:

oṃ shi ra si bi shwa swā hā: rin chen sna lnga sogs la: oṃ ratna bi shwa spha ra ṇa swā hā: sman sna tshogs la: oṃ oṇṇa bi shwa ge sa ra swā hā: zho dang 'o ma dkar gsum la: oṃ rasmi a mṛ ta tra ya swā hā: zhun sna tshogs la: oṃ sa ra me ga pra tītstsha swā hā: zas sna tshogs la: oṃ me ga a ha ra bhi shwa swā hā: star kha kham bu ku shu nyi khri co le la: oṃ bhikṣa sa ra a ru sa swā hā: mar khu la: oṃ agne ye swā hā: zhes rdzas rnams la lan grangs gang 'bul skabs dang bstun: drag po yin na skabs 'dir bsgral las byas la 'bul: de nas phrin las bcol ba ni: gtor ma las gzhung ltar bshams shing sbyin sreg tu 'bul: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings nas rang byung sprul pa'i lha: zhi rgyas dbang drag dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dang : 'jigs byed me lha'i 'khor tshogs bcas pa la: deng 'dir sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di phul bas: thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sel ba dang : las sgrib sbyangs shing 'phral rkyen myur du zhi: sha 'khon bu lon tshe thung nor dbul sbyangs: ma 'byor lhag chad nor 'khrul 'gal ba bshags: g.yar dam sor chud dam tshig gsos su gsol: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam can: drag po gzi byin me yi klong dkyil nas: rdzu 'phrul ye shes rtsal shugs bskyed du gsol: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: ma rig nyon mongs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang : glo bur rkyen ngan bar chad dmod pa'i tshig: zhi bar mdzod cig rgyal ba thugs dam can: hūm̐: tshe bsod chos dang mnga' thang longs spyod nor: khas drag dbang chen gzi mdangs rgyas pa'i ngogs: mthu rtsal rmad byung 'dod rgu srid kyi tshogs: rgyas par mdzod cig yang gsang thugs dam can: hūm̐: phyi yul snang ba nang gi rlung sems rigs: 'byung lnga'i bcud dang lha 'dre mi gsum bcas: dam tshig ma dang mkha' 'gro bka' skyong rnams: dbang du sdus shig rig 'dzin thugs dam can:

hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan dgra rnal 'byor sgos kyi dgra: snga dgra phyi dgra 'byung ba las kyi dgra: bsam sbyor ngan pa'i log 'dren byad ma rnams: brlag par mdzod cig khrag 'thung mthu ma chung : hūm̐: bskul lo mdzod cig bcol ba'i phrin las rnams: che btsan 'bar ba'i shugs las rab tu phyungs: las bzhir dmod pa'i bya ba gang mchis pa: da lta nyid du 'grub par mdzad du gsol: oṃ badzra agne a hu ti ka ru ye swā hā: zhes zhi rgyas dbang drag gang yin gyi gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: gzhung gi gtor 'bul rnams kyang sbyin sreg bya: nad pa sogs yang na god sri dang rkyen kha sdang ba: chung sri dang skag rkyen langs pa: bag grib ngan pa: lo thog nyams pa yul khyim 'dre chag sogs la me zhags brgyang na 'di'i skabs su bya: de yang shing tsam mam sbang phye sogs gang rung la snum phran bu byugs te: drag po'i rdzas rgod kyis bsres la: snod gtsang ma'i nang du bzhag: mi yin na sgo phye phyogs bzhin gral du 'khod: yul yin na me sgo phye nas cha gcig lcags snod du blangs la shing hom chung ngu byas: phyi nang khyab par me zhags brgyang : 'grub nas me sbyin sreg la bstim: zhi ba rnams la bdud rtsi dang : drag por rakta sbreng zhing : hūm̐: shar phyogs chu rlung mkha' 'gro mas: bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: rakta sogs? chu rlung tsakra'i rgya khrol cig: sreg byed me yi zhags pa drongs: oṃ ram̐ dzwa la yam̐ yam̐: ces mda' dar dkar po blangs: de nas lho ru: hūm̐: lho phyogs sa rlung mkha' 'gro mas: bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sa rlung tsakra'i rgya khrol la: sreg byed me yi zhags pa drongs: oṃ ram̐ dzwa la yam̐ yam̐: mda' dar ser po blangs: nub tu: hūm̐: nub phyogs me rlung mkha' 'gro mas: bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: me rlung tsakra'i rgya khrol la: sreg byed me yi zhags pa drongs: oṃ ram̐ dzwa la yam̐ yam̐:

mda' dar dmar po blangs: byang du: hūm̐: byang phyogs rlung bskyed mkha' 'gro mas: bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: las rlung tsakra'i rgya khrol cig: sreg byed me yi zhags pa drongs: oṃ ram̐ dzwa la yam̐ yam̐: mda' dar ljang khu blangs: dbus su: hūm̐: dbus phyogs mkha' rlung ḍākki mas: bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dbyings rlung tsakra'i rgya khrol cig: sreg byed me yi zhags pa drongs: oṃ ram̐ dzwa la yam̐ yam̐: mda' dar sngon po blangs: de nas me zhags kyi rdzas lag tu thogs nas: dkyil 'khor gtso bo dang me lha'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i khro bo dpag tu med pa chad nas stong khams khyab cing byad ma gdon rigs rnams gzhob thul gyis bsregs par bsgoms la: me zhags las kyi mtshon du bskyed nas 'phang yang rung : me bskul ba ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i klong : rang byung sprul pa'i 'od rtsal las: 'byung lnga rnam dag ye shes me: drag po rba las spros pa'i mtshon: phyogs bzhi dbus lnga'i klong nas 'khyugs: stong khams tshwa tshwa si li li: me zhags 'tshub ma chi li li: 'bar mched bsregs sgra 'u ru ru: steng 'og khyab pa'i me dpung 'khrigs: gzhom zhing gtor ba'i glog dmar 'khyugs: me sgra 'ur chem 'brug sgra sgrogs: me yi 'tshub ma re re la: sreg byed khro tshogs bye ba 'bum: phyag na las kyi me zor bsnams: rdzu 'phrul rlung gi rta la zhon: byin za khro bo las la bskul: hūm̐: ye shes ka dag bsgribs pa yi: nyon mongs bdud la me zor ya: mi mthun rkyen la me zor ya: lo zla'i skag la me zor ya: bgegs dang ye 'drogs me zor ya: nad gdon grib la me zor ya: phung sri bdud la me zor ya: 'gong po dbul srir me zor ya: yul chag 'dre la me zor ya: grong khyim 'khu la me zor ya: lo nyes rkyen la me zor ya: dgra dang 'byung por me zor ya: gtad mnan byed la me zor ya: grib gdon nyams grib me zor ya:

god sri dmangs 'drer me zor ya: phung thal sna dgur me zor ya: mi mthun rkyen la me zor ya: phyi nang rkyen ngan gnod byed la: drag pos me yi char pa phob: bsregs shing gtor ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badzra tsand+ra dzwa la ram̐ ram̐ dam sri 'byung po 'dre rgod thams cad ram̐ da ha da ha tshindha tshindha ma tha ma tha a mu ka mā ra ya phaṭḥ ces mang du bzlas shing me yis khyab par bya: de nas me zhags rdzogs nas: me 'od kyis dam sri 'byung po bsregs shing thul gyis song nas: kho'i gzi brjid thams cad 'ub kyis bsdus nas mched pa'i me la thim nas: tshur 'dus thab kyi lha la thim zhing me'i phung po cher 'bar nas: srung ba'i gur chen por bsgom: zhes me dang dbyer med bsregs: hūm̐: pho nya rbad pa'i me zor gyis: phar 'phros snang srid gdon bgegs bsregs: tshur 'dus gzi byin me la thim: slar 'phros srung ba'i gur du gyur: oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐ ram̐ rakṣa rakṣa ye swā hā: zhes srung ba'i gur khang bsgom: de nas las gzhung rdzogs te dkyil 'khor bsdu ba la: me lhar gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: 'jigs byed chen po ye shes 'bar ba'i me: drang srong rgyal po agne 'khor bcas la: dam rdzas bdud rtsis brgyan pa'i bha ling 'bul: bzhes shing mnyes nas las bzhi'i phrin las rnams: da lta nyid du 'grub par mdzad du gsol: oṃ agne ye sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: zhes 'bul: hūm̐: ye shes gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor ram̐ gyi dal: mi dmigs chos dbyings ngang du badzra muḥ bkra shis ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor gsang ba ye shes 'khor lo'i tshogs: bde chen dbyings nas rang byung lhun grub te: rol rtsal nyon mongs bud shing sreg mdzad pa: me lha'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bkra shis shog: ces dang : bsngo ba smon lam ni: hoḥ chos dbyings lhun grub khyab pa'i bden tshig gis: ma nor 'chug med ci bgyis dge ba bsngo:

bdag gzhan mtha' yas byang chub lam bkod nas: tshe rabs sa bcu 'dzin pa'i don rtogs shog: de nas dkyil 'khor thams cad bsdu zhing bkra shis sogs rgyas par bya: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs rjes 'jug skal ldan don: las mtha' sbyin sreg gdams pa bzhag: dgos ched yon tan bsam mi khyab: las ngan 'bras bu smin pa dang : bka' chad 'khu ldog rten 'brel nyams: dam tshig bral dang dbang thang chung : dgra sri sdang zhing god kha gyod: na 'chi rkyen ngan glo bur ba: lha 'khrugs sde brgyad ma mo'i rigs: nad yams dar zhing lo nyes mang : mi kha phung sbyor byad ltas sdug: bkra mi shis pa'i rigs dag la: sbyin sreg las mtha' 'di nyid zab: dam tshig sor chud chos brgyud 'phel: dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i bar chod zhi: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus: rten 'brel bya ba sna tshogs 'char: chos srid longs spyod phun sum tshogs: lo legs 'bru 'phel nad yams zhi: byad zor phur kha rkyen ngan bzlog: bkra shis 'dod rgu bde blag rnyed: mchog thun rtsol med nyid la 'grub: de bas zab pa'i mthar thug nyid: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: ma 'ongs lnga brgya dus kyi mthar: padma gter bdag gling pa la: 'phrad cing chos brgyud mthar phyin shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos padma sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing*/ padma chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// //

༁ྂ: bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las:(ā)srung bzlog bsad pa'i dpe'u ris bzhugs: bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon lha la bstod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: kho bo bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis srung bzlog bsad pa'i lag len zhib par bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs yang mtha' bdud rigs sna tshogs kyis: sangs rgyas bstan la sdang zhing rab tu 'tshe: de dag bzlog pa'i gdams pa yang zab bstan: rten 'brel gnad kyis gleng gzhi rnams kyang 'brel: rdzas kyi nus pas ri rab thal bar bshig: de phyir srung bzlog zab mo shin tu gces: ma 'ongs thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas srung ba 'bri thabs ni: shog bu dkar 'jam legs po'i ngos: dbus su zla gam dmar po'i nang : chos 'byung smug nag lte ba ru: hūm̐ khroṃ bhyoḥ de'i phyi rol rtsibs bzhi la: hūm̐ he ru ka khroṃ bhrūm̐: oṃ ma hā hrī dha bhrūm̐: oṃ dzñā na trām̐ bhrūm̐: oṃ kro ti bam̐ bhrūm̐: rtsibs mchan bzhi la/ oṃ ma ma tsakra rakṣa: de'i phyi rim mu khyud la: oṃ kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ ma hā kro ti shwa rī satwaṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig: badzra rakṣa: de'i phyi rim rtsibs brgyad la: oṃ sarba he ru ka ro ṣa na ma ma rakṣa sha ra ṇa bhrūm̐: rtsibs mchan la: oṃ sarba kro ti dha ra ma ma rakṣa bhrūm̐: de'i phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ badzra ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyoḥ oṃ hriṣṭi wi tri ta na na hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ padmanta kṛta ma hā kro ta hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badzra kī li kī la sarba bighnān trig nan baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ gu hya dzñā na ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badzra gu ru ma hā tsand+ra hūm̐: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭāṃ na hūm̐ phaṭḥ

oṃ sarba duṣṭāṃ na e e dza bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badzra rakṣa: de'i phyi rol rtsibs bcu drug la: oṃ khroṃ gha ru ṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ shwa rī ind+ra ye hūm̐ rakṣa: rtsibs mchan la: oṃ sarba bha ru ḍākki nī sa ma ya hring hring hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ kro ta ma hā bha le ma ma rakṣa: de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ badzra kro ta padma kro ti shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'jigs brgyad zhi bar gyur cig puṣṭaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du bar gyur cig pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad tshar bcad par gyur cig: hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ de yi phyi rol rtsibs sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig la: oṃ badzra kro ta hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badzra kro ta bi dza ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badzra kro ta ya mānta ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badzra kro dha hya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badzra kro ta a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badzra kro ta nī laṃ daṇḍa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badzra kro ta a tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badzra kro ta a pa rā tsi ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badzra kro ta trai lokya bhi dza ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badzra kro ta ma hā bha la hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa uṣṇi ṣa hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badzra suṃ bha rā dza hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badzra bighnān ra kri hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badzra padma ta kri ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badzra pañdza ta kri hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ badzra kro ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ ratna kro ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ padma kro ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ karma kro ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ gu hya kro ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ bi shwa kro ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ rtsibs mchan la: oṃ kro ti shwa rī makṣa pre ka ma ma rakṣa bhrūm̐: de'i phyi rol mu khyud la: dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po bris la 'dod gsol sbyar:

de'i phyi rol me dang khyung dgu bri: rab gnas bya zhing 'dzugs: yang na srung ba'i gur bris la rgyun du bzlog pa'i rtser bshams kyang chog: sa ma ya: de nas bzlog pa'i bya khyung bri thabs ni: dug shog gam ro ras la dbus gnam lcags 'khor lo'i lte ba ru: khroṃ bhyo ya: rtsibs brgyad la: khroṃ khro ta bhyoḥ rtsibs mchan brgyad la: a mu ka trig thum bhyoḥ de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ khro ta ya dgra la zlog: rbad dun shag bhyo ya dgra la zlog zlog: trig nan trig thum dgra la zlog: shaṇṭa sham mo ru dgra la zlog: rakṣa ma tri ya dgra la zlog: ces bri: de'i phyi rol rtsibs bcu drug la: dza gri nye lo thun ya pha rol byad ma zlog zlog: rtsibs mchan la: dza gri ma a thun ya dgra bo byad ma bzlog: de'i phyi rol mu khyud la: khroṃ ya ma dza tri nye mo ya dun ya byad ma pha rol stong gi dgra bo ching ya rmun ya: ha thun trig thum dgra la zlog zlog: rbad tshal pa shig shig: de yi phyi rol me ri bris te khyung gi lte bar gzugs sam 'dzugs par bya: sa ma ya: de nas sprul pa'i bya khyung dgu'i bri thabs ni: dbus su chos 'byung la: hūm̐ khroṃ bhyoḥ de'i phyi rol rtsibs bzhi la: khroṃ raṃ bhyoḥ rtsibs mchan la: khroṃ yam̐ bhyoḥ de'i phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ khroṃ gha ru ḍa kā la ya kṣiṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ pha rol gyi byad kha phur kha rbad 'dre rbod gtong mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dgra la zlog: de'i phyi rol me ri bris la khyung gi lto bar bcug: g.yas kyi gshog zur brgyad la: hūm̐ kro ta ya pho rgyud kyi byad kha dgra la zlog: g.yon gyi gshog zur brgyad la: hūm̐ kro ti raṃ mo rgyud kyi byad kha dgra la zlog: mgo yi nang du: oṃ ka ru nna tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ steng phyogs kyi byad kha dgra la zlog: snying kha la: oṃ kro ta khroṃ raṃ pa kṣiṃ hūm̐ bhyo: snang srid yongs kyi byad zor phur kha dgra la zlog:

lag g.yas su: hūm̐: gha ru ḍa la yam̐ hūm̐ bhyoḥ ye shes lha'i bka' chad dgra la zlog: g.yon du: bhyo khroṃ ha la hūm̐ bhyoḥ 'jig rten dregs pa'i gdug sems dgra la zlog: pus mo g.yas su: khroṃ ki kang ya hūm̐ bhyoḥ pha rol gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa dgra la zlog: g.yon du: khroṃ he ru ka ya hūm̐ bhyoḥ pha rol gyi mi kha dmod pa'i tshig sbyor ngan pa thams cad dgra la zlog: mjug sgro la: khroṃ trag thur sha ya: 'og phyogs klu dang sa bdag gi nad rigs thams cad dgra la zlog: sgrom gyi nang du: nā ga ha la ya dza thun rbad: gnyan dang yams rims lhog rgod ngan pa dgra la zlog: ces rim bzhin shes par bya: sa ma ya: de nas bzlog pa'i 'khor lo ni: dug shog gam ro ras la: dbus su chos 'byung la: khroṃ bhyoḥ rtsibs bzhir: thun bhyoḥ rbad bhyoḥ raṃ bhyoḥ ngag bhyoḥ rtsibs mchan la: kha la dun: raksha dun: yaksha dun: triksha dun: de yi phyi rol rtsibs brgyad la: traka raksha ye nṛ tri bhyoḥ kha la dza thun nṛ tri bhyoḥ nā ga shug tse nṛ tri bhyoḥ shīntaṃ sa ra nṛ tri rbad bhyoḥ ma ṇi raksha nṛ tri rbad bhyoḥ yaksha kha thun nṛ tri rbad bhyoḥ kha dun tshal pa nṛ tri rbad bhyoḥ hri tri dza la nṛ tri rbad bhyoḥ rtsibs mchan la: ma ṇi dza thun kha la rbad: ma ṇi raksha snying la rbad: bhi dza ra na gzugs la rbad: snying khrag dza la srog la rbad: a karṣa ya dbugs la rbad: mā ra aṅku sha snying la rbad: e hur mā ra byad ma rbad: nā ga raksha myog thum: de yi phyi rim mu khyud la: oṃ ma hā dhe wa tha ra kha tri ka na sa ma ya: byad ma'i srog la dung dung dza dzaḥ dza thun kha la raksha ya: du ra yaksha snying la ya: khal rtse nag ga srog la ya: kha raksha rbad phu ya ma ra raksha khrag la ya: ha ri kha ni raksha lus la ya: khroṃ bhyo taṃ bhyo las la ya: oṃ de byi ma raksha ranḍa maṇḍa ru lu ru lu byad ma'i srog rtsa tsitta dung dung : shag 'gas rbad bhyoḥ trag thum myog thum:

gzer thum trig thum rbad thum: de'i phyi rol gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug la: phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ ā hūm̐ badzra tsaṇḍa artsi ma li ta dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ sgrub la 'tshe zhing sdang ba'i bar chod bdud rigs nag po'i phyogs kyis gnod cing 'tshe ba: dus drug 'gyu ba'i sha za srin po'i bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad dgra bo'i steng du bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: de yi phyi rol rtsibs bzhi ru: hūm̐ trag raksha tri bhyoḥ de yi mtshams kyi rtsibs mchan la: bhyo dunt+ri shag thun bhyoḥ de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: tshe dang bsod nams la gdug cing sdang ba'i byad kha brgya yi lam kha zug pa: stong gi bram mchus brdeg pa dus tshod kyi chad pa lo zla zhag dang za ma'i skag rkyen thams cad pha rol dgra bo'i steng du bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: de yi phyi rol rtsibs brgyad du: oṃ ya ma du na bhyoḥ de yi mtshams kyi rtsibs mchan la: bhyo ru tsa sha na bhyoḥ de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ badzra kro ta he ru ka hūm̐ kā ra ka ra ya badzra hūm̐ yakṣa hūm̐ raksha hūm̐ tsaṇḍa hūm̐ duṣṭāṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ lho nub me lha'i gnod pa lo lug la dgra dar ba me'i khams kyi 'khrug rtsod spar kha khon gyi gdug pa sme ba gnyis nag gi dur mig la sogs pa 'byung 'khrugs bdud kyi bar chod thams cad pha rol dgra la bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: lcags sdig thod phreng me ris bskor: drag po'i tsakra 'bring po'o: sa ma ya: brgyad pa mchod bstod tsakra ni: thog mar zla gam lte ba ru: de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ badzra garbhe dzñā na prañdza shrī ma hā kā la he kro ti hūm̐ phaṭḥ nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas 'byung 'khrugs dus kyi chad pa ma rungs bdud kyi g.yul ngo thams cad pha rol dgra bo'i steng du bhyo bhyo zlog zlog:

de yi phyi rol rtsibs bzhi ru: hūm̐ lokka tsanḍa bhyoḥ de yi mtshams kyi rtsibs mchan la: bhyo ma trāṃ shan thun bhyoḥ de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭāṃ hūm̐: snang srid snod kyis bsdus pa'i gling khams 'di'i phyogs bzhi nas snga dgra yid la sems pa phyi dgra zhe la 'chang ba da dgra thad du langs pa dmag jag 'khrug pa'i sna 'dren bdud kyi sprul pa'i rigs thams cad dmag dpung phar la bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: de yi phyi rol rtsibs brgyad du: hūm̐ ka ṭa ka ṭa bhyoḥ de yi mtshams kyi rtsibs mchan la: bhyo nan ṭa nan ṭa bhyoḥ de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ lokka kro ta trai lokya trag yaksha bighnān trig thun mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ nub byang rlung lha'i gnod pa lo khyi la dgra dar ba lcags sa'i khams kyi 'khrug rtsod spar kha khen gyi gdug pa sme ba drug dkar gyi dur mig la sogs pa 'byung 'khrugs bdud kyi bar chad thams cad pha rol dgra la bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ral gri thod phreng me ris bskor: 'jig rten tsakra 'bring po'o: sa ma ya: dgu pa dmod pa'i tsakra ni: thog mar gru gsum lte ba ru: de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ badzra shrī tsakra la tsaṇḍa tsaṇḍa he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ lus dur mig tu tshud pa srog dur mig tu tshud pa dbang thang dur mig tu tshud pa rlung rta dur mig tu tshud pa sme ba dur mig tu tshud pa la sogs pa'i sri thams cad dgra bo'i steng du bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: de yi phyi rol rtsibs bzhi ru: hūm̐ mā ra ya tri bhyoḥ de yi mtshams kyi rtsibs mchan la: bhyo ru tra mā ra bhyoḥ de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ sarba duṣṭāṃ e dza bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ lo kag zla kag zhag kag za ma'i kag dus tshod kyi kag chu tshod kyi kag cha shas kyi kag na kag shi kag bdud kag che sri chung sri gzhon sri phung sri gyod sri la sogs pa khyad par rmi ltas mtshan rtags ngan pa thams cad pha rol dgra bo'i steng du bhyo bhyo zlog zlog:

de yi phyi rol rtsibs brgyad du: hūm̐ ru tra trig nan bhyoḥ de yi mtshams kyi rtsibs mchan la: bhyo ru tra thun rbad bhyoḥ de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ anḍa artha pad kham karma gho ṣa ya pra ha ra pra ha ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ byang shar bgegs dang 'byung po'i gnod pa lo glang la dgra dar ba chu sa'i khams kyi 'khrug rtsod spar kha ging gi gdug pa sme ba brgyad dkar gyi dur mig la sogs pa 'byung 'khrugs bdud kyi bar chad thams cad pha rol dgra la bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: gsal shing thod phreng me ris bskor: dmod pa'i tsakra 'bring po'o: sa ma ya: bcu pa dpal chen gtor ma yi: g.yas pa sreg byed lo yi mtshon: spu gri dmar po'i tsakra ni: thog mar rtsibs dgu'i lte ba ru: de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: hūm̐ he kro ta ka badzra artsi ta ram̐ ram̐ dzwa la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ srid pa pho rgyud yongs kyi byad kha phur kha thams cad mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: de yi phyi rol rtsibs bzhi ru: hūm̐ ru tra bhandha bhyoḥ de yi mtshams kyi rtsibs mchan la: bhyo bighnān tshindha bhyoḥ de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ye shes dang 'jig rten pho rgyud thams cad kyi dmod pa'i rigs sngags mthu gtad byad kha phur kha rbod gtong thams cad dgra la bhyo dgra la bzlog dgra la rbad: de yi phyi rol rtsibs brgyad du: hūm̐ khro ta ru tra zlog: de yi mtshams kyi rtsibs mchan la: hūm̐ ghardza ru tra zlog: de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ lokt+ri pa la ya byad ma dgra bo rang gshed du phob pha rol gyi byad ma lha srung thams cad bhyo bhyo dgra bo kho rang la bhyo hom sbar mes sreg pa 'byung ba rlung la bskor ba sa gtad lha 'drer gnyer ba chu gtad klu la bcol ba la sogs pa'i rbod gtong thams cad pha rol byad ma dgra bo kho rang la zlog cig:

e ya ma zlog: baṃ ru lu zlog: ru tra nṛ tri zlog: byad ma bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: phyi rol spu gri 'khor lo'i gur: me ri rab tu 'bar bas bskor: g.yas kyi tsakra 'bring po'o: sa ma ya: bcu gcig dpal chen gtor ma yi: g.yon pas 'joms byed chu yi mtshon: spu gri sngon po'i tsakra ni: thog mar rtsibs dgu'i lte ba ru: de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ he kro ti ma tri dhi shwa de paṃ tra tra dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐ bhyoḥ srid pa mo rgyud yongs kyi byad kha phur kha thams cad mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: de yi phyi rol rtsibs bzhi ru: hūm̐ ru tra ṭa trig thum bhyoḥ de yi mtshams kyi rtsibs mchan la: bhyo bighnān hur thum bhyoḥ de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ye shes dang 'jig rten mo rgyud thams cad kyi dmod pa gzungs sngags kyi mthu gtad gzir gsum btang ba thams cad dgra la bhyo dgra la bzlog dgra la rbad: de yi phyi rol rtsibs brgyad du: hūm̐ ru tra sha trun bhyoḥ de yi mtshams kyi rtsibs mchan la: bhyo ru tra ṇir myog rbad: de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ ma tri kā li ya ma dun ti lokka duṣṭāṃ sarba artha ya hūm̐ bhyoḥ snang srid dbyings su khyab pa'i lha 'dre'i yams kha dmod pa zhang zhung gi mthu bsgrubs bande'i hom sbar bon po'i ngan sngags mu stegs kyi zor mda' me nyag gi gdan bgos rgya nag gi bsgyur gto rgya gar gyi dmod yig bal po'i dug 'gyed gyim shang gyi dgra rtsis bod kyi bsam ngan sde brgyad kyis rtsis la btab pa la sogs pa thams cad pha rol byad ma dgra bo kho rang la zlog cig: e mā ra zlog: tri sha trun na zlog: ru tra tshindha zlog: byad ma bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: phyi rol chu gri'i 'khor lo'i gur:

me ri drag tu 'bar bas bskor: g.yon gyi tsakra 'bring po'o: sa ma ya: bcu gnyis gtor ma'i zung 'jug sngags: gang la dmod kyang thogs med pa: thog rgod 'bar ba'i 'khor lo ni: dang po chos 'byung bsnol ba ru: oṃ tri tri thun dzaḥ de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ badzra he kro ta kā la thun bhyoḥ drag po dmod pa'i dpal chen las kyi mtshon 'dis pha rol bdud kyi dpung thams cad mā ra ya zlog zlog: de yi phyi rol rtsibs bzhi ru: tri tri har byad ma zlog: de yi mtshams kyi rtsibs mchan la: ṇi thun pra ni byad ma zlog: de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ sarba tri ta karma ni ka khor dha rbad bhyoḥ oṃ parsha a lam thun tsa de ya bhyoḥ dza la ya dza la ya biṣṇa bighnān thun bhyoḥ gnod pa'i dbal kha mi bzad khro bo'i mtshon gyis pha rol byad ma dgra bo lha srung dang bcas pa phye mar rlogs shig choms shig: bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog: de yi phyi rol rtsibs brgyad du: e ma bhyo dza thun rbad: de yi mtshams kyi rtsibs mchan la: e bhig tri ta zlog: de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ sarba artha ya thun rāau dhri ya thun tri kā li ya thun bhyo bhyo byad ma dgra bo nṛ tri thum bzlog ya rbad ya: dpal chen srid pa'i zor bzlog 'dis pha rol byad ma thams cad phye mar shig cig mā ra ya zlog zlog: phyi rol rdo ra me ris bskor: gzungs sngags 'khor lo 'bring po'o: sa ma ya: bcu gsum gtor ldan bsad 'khor ni: zan ling steng nas phyal gyis bkab: de yi steng du gtso gtor bzhag: thog mar spu gri rtsibs brgyad dbus: nṛ tri rbad bhyoḥ de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: e du pra ma tri tri mā ra ya dgra bo cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo'i srog la rbad rbad: de yi phyi rol rtsibs bzhi ru: byad ma nṛ tri hur thum: de yi mtshams kyi rtsibs mchan la: su tri byad ma'i srog la rbad:

de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ yaksha kā la ya e thum dgra bo'i srog la rbad thum: dgra bo'i srog la rbad: bhyo ra tri rakṣa kā li bam thun dgra bo'i srog la thun srog la rbad: he he gu ṇa tsa tri thun dgra bo'i srog la thun srog la rbad: dgra bo cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo'i srog la rbad rbad: sha la za za: khrag la 'jib 'jib: dbugs la rngub rngub: rus la krum krum rmugs rmugs chum chum tha ra tha ra nan nan: de yi phyi rol rtsibs dgu ru: nṛ tri trig thum rbad bhyoḥ de yi mtshams kyi rtsibs mchan la: dgra bo la ā yu dha thum rbad: de yi phyi rol mu khyud la: oṃ du pra ma rā dza kriṣṇa badzra dzwa la ya dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: oṃ nā ga raksha u pa sa ka kā la ti pa ra tsa ya dgra bo cha3lt;!TCC Tibetan character 3,148 undefined in unicode!>ཻ mo'i srog la rbad rbad snying rtsa la chod chod khrag rtsa la btung btung dbang po lnga la myog myog 'du ba drug la thun thun rnam shes brgyad la dza dza dgra bo'i tsitta ha la ha la 'gas 'gas ya ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: phyi rol ral gri me ris bskor: gtor bsregs bsad 'khor 'bring po'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma: zab pa'i mthar thug che mchog 'bar ba'i mtshon: pha rol cham la 'bebs pa'i gnam lcags sgyogs: dgra bo'i yul khams rtsad brlag gdams pa bzhag: snyigs dus byad ma 'joms pa'i cha rkyen shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: them rgya: gtad rgya: lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing 'brug lor shog ser nas bshus so// //

hūm̐) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dus drug gnas nyul sprad pa khro bo'i rngam stabs bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: dug lnga'i gsang rdol gnyen po ru: gnas nyul khro bo bskul thabs bstan: sa ma ya: rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa yis: dkyil 'khor zab mo sgrub pa'i tshe: nyon mongs phrag dog las gyur pa'i: phyi nas dgra dang chom po yis: tshig ngan ca co la sogs pa: rnam rtog 'phro ba'i bgegs zhugs na: de tshe gnas nyul bskul bar bya: nyon mongs gti mug las gyur pa'i: shes pa bying rmug 'thib pa dang : bskyed rim ma gsal sngags sgra nyams: gnyid kyi 'thib zhing shes pa nyog: snang ba ma dag rig gyur na: de tshe gnas nyul bskul bar bya: nyon mongs zhe sdang las gyur pa'i: shes pa rgod cing snying mi dga': smra rgod 'thab snying 'dod pa dang : sems la sdug bsngal che gyur na: de tshe gnas nyul bskul bar bya: nyon mongs 'dod chags las gyur pa'i: zas gos rgyu la 'khreng ba dang : dbang po 'dod chags langs pa dang : rmi lam bud med mang mthong dang : khrag 'khrugs 'dod snying mi 'dod dang : de tshe gnas nyul bskul bar bya: nyon mongs nga rgyal las gyur pa'i: gzhan gyi lta sgom sdang ba dang : dag snang mi 'byung kun slong ldang : las ka phra rags blo la 'khor: sang bya gnangs byed rgyud la 'khreng : rlung kheng gnyid mang sang gyur te: ser sna 'du 'dzi sdang gyur na: de tshe gnas nyul bskul bar bya: nyon mongs bdag 'dzin las gyur pa'i: phyi yi bskyed rim nyams la chag: nang gi gnas lugs don la rmongs: rmi lam 'tshub cing sdug bsngal che: sbra nag khang nag hrul po dang : kun gyis sdang tshig smra gyur rmis: phyi rtags grib kyis lus kyang na: blo bur rkyen stobs las gyur tshe: de tshe gnas nyul bskul bar bya: zhes pa'o: dkyil 'khor la bar chad sdang zhing sgrub pa rkyen gyis g.yengs na gnas dang yul gyi bdag po rnams kyi drod tshad nyul nas:

dam tshig bzang ngan rjes su gcod pa'i ging chen yab yum drug rnams kyis: byang bu tshar gcig gam: tha mal gyi tshogs 'khor tsam la yang : bzang ngan gyi grogs byed pa yin no: de bzhin du rnal 'byor dam tshig mi gtsang zhing yi dam la 'dun pa chung ba: sngags dang bsnyen pa rtags tshad mi sbyar zhing : phyi tshul kha bshad ne tso 'jol mo las bde zhing : nang tshul ha la dug sdong las ngad tsha ba: lkog tu dam tshig bral zhing : bde skyid sogs byung na rang gi 'jon thang : bla ma dang dkon mchog med bsam zhing tshod yod can ngan par gyur na: yi dam lha bsgrub dang mchod pa byed tshe: nyin gcig po grangs brtsi zhing yi chad dang lha la lha ma gyur zer na lha 'grub pa'i dus med: dngos grub rtags thon pa la: dam tshig tshul bzhin srung zhing : tshe 'di'i 'dun ma la phyi phyag bya: da na rung shi rung sdang ba'i dgra sleb pa: byams pa'i gnyen bral: steng nas ri zhig pa: 'og nas me mched pa: lcam dang spun zla bral zhing ma 'phrad kyang : sgrub pa'i dam bca' mi btang bsam zhing : gnyis su 'dzin pa med cing : tshul dang ldan na sgrub pa la bar chad mi 'byung : gnas nyul gyis grogs bya zhing bran du mchis par 'gyur: dam tshig bral zhing snod chung ngu dang the tshom can la bar gcod sdang bas bskul dgos: ci'i phyir zhe na: lha 'dre sems kyi cho 'phrul yin: re dogs 'khrul pa'i bag chags yin: ma rig blang dor dgag sgrub yin: lha bdud sems kyi rang rtsal la: rang sems mthong na su yi gnon: zhes pas gtso bo sgrub pa kun la yang : bzang po mi bsgrub ngan pa mi bkag: sgrub pa'i lhong ci byung yang rang mal du 'gro: dbang po 'bring dang tha mal gnyis la: nyul le bskrad pa ni: ging yab yum gyi sku 'bag gyon zhing gcer bu rus rgyan dang stag sham gyi spras la: lag tu rdo thun bzung ste rol stabs dang rngam stabs mchong rgyug sogs bya zhing drag tu bskul:
